rooms.name: The Void
rooms.desc: You don't think that you are not floating in nothing.

rooms.name: Limbo
rooms.desc:
You are floating in a formless void, detached from all sensation of physical
matter, surrounded by swirling glowing light, which fades into the relative
darkness around you without any trace of edges or shadow.
   There is a "No Tipping" notice pinned to the darkness.

rooms.name: A Totally Empty Room
rooms.desc: The walls are completely bare...nothing at all in the room...weird.

rooms.name: Frontline's Sphere
rooms.desc:
You float inside a massive clear glass sphere that seems to be suspended in
fire! If you will yourself, you find that you can move about the sphere with
some difficulty.  Although it is clear that the blazing fires of Hell lie
just outside the walls of this sphere, the atmosphere inside is almost too
comfortable. Many random objects float about in this space with you, some
of which are charred corpses. Hrmm.. hope Frontline isn't mad at you.

rooms.name: Falling...
rooms.desc:
You fall and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall
and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall
and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall....
and then you die.

rooms.name: The Tower of Aralius
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small, circular room atop a tall granite tower.
Below you, you can see the wispy tendrils of cumulus clouds that
conceal the tower from the mortal world below.
   Out the northern window you can see a dark sphere floating in
a layer of suspended ice crystals where the cold emptiness of
space meets the outer reaches of the planet.  A few eruptions of
bright light stream from the sphere, often followed by loud
explosions and swearing.

rooms.name: Skarash's Room
rooms.desc: DAMMIT SKARASH, GET TO WORK!!!! :)

rooms.name: A Safe Haven
rooms.desc:
This ancient room whispers of unfathomable history and wealth.  Intricate 
marble carvings interlace and entwine within themselves along the thick
columns that line the walls.  Brass-leaf lanterns hang suspended from the
ceiling, bathing everything in an ethereal glow.  Rich, plush rugs cover
the black marble floor, scattered with silken and velvet pillows.  Above,
three cresent moons have been carved from the cathedral ceiling to gaze
upon the heavens above.

rooms.name: Prep Room
rooms.desc:
You find yourself in the prep room for battle, various artifacts and 
weaponry line the walls in honor of the great victors that have passed
before.  Large mystical runes lie to the east, creating a doorway into
the onslaught.  A peaceful aura is settled around the room, allowing 
you to prepare for the battle that awaits.

rooms.name: The Immortal Conference Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a huge stone room.  The walls are made of huge grey-stone blocks
that seem to reach to the sky.  In the center of the room is a huge wooden
table that is perfectly round.  In the center of the table is a large
fire that lights most of the room.  There are torches along the walls that
provide even more light.  There are huge wooden chairs around the room that
allow all of the pantheon to assemble in some sort of order.

rooms.name: The Hall of Fortune
rooms.desc:
You are in a huge room, ballroom-sized, in fact.  Tapestries
of the greatest battles in history adorn the walls.  In glass
cases are some of the most exquisite pieces of art ever created.
Jewels, paintings, swords, rings, goblets - it is all here!  You
must be a welcome guest, for not just anyone should be here.

rooms.name: Roach Coach
rooms.desc:
You are in a seedy, vile place.  What a nasty looking area.  It must breed
some nasty beings.  Little roachs scurry around, but there are some large
footprints here as well.  Strange.

rooms.name: A Stable (Buy 'em Here)
rooms.desc: You are in, imagine this, a stable.  You know.  Where you buy horses.

rooms.name: A Stable (Rent 'em Here)
rooms.desc:
You are in, imagine this, a stable.  You know.  But you don't buy them
here, you give your horse a place to sleep here.

rooms.name: Nevyn's Room
rooms.desc:
The room before you reeks of the sharp, clean smell of plants, spring
growth, rotting leaves, and biting nettles. A large iron cauldron stands in
the center of the room cooking over redly glowing coals. Steam rises from
under the cauldron's lid. The walls are crammed with boxes; the ceiling is
hung with bunches of strange herbs, many of them still fresh. You hear a
sudden scuttling noise, and one of the boxes falls from a shelf, spilling
black seeds over the dirt floor.

rooms.name: Walking the Etherial Plane
rooms.desc:
You are here..yet you are not. This place exists in a single time frame
and nothing else has meaning here. For an instant, you are walking the
hills near the Pagoda, the next you're rowing across a vast ocean. Your
mind is generating many images all of which appear before you.

rooms.name: The Beginning
rooms.desc: Not much here.

rooms.name: Serapis's House
rooms.desc: blah

rooms.name: The Ice Box
rooms.desc:
Here lie the frozen remains of mud players who just couldn't play with
the other kids in the sandbox.

rooms.name: The Board Room Of The Immortals
rooms.desc:
This large room is well-decorated, and lit from above by a soft
magical glow of no particular origin.  Scattered around the room are
comforable chairs and piles of furs of various dimension, and in the
very middle there is a huge oaken table that shimmers in an odd manner.
A large picture window looks down over the whole world, showing the
exploits of the many intrepid mortals.  A spiral staircase leads down
to another part of this room.  There is a sign hovering in the 
awesomeness of this room.

rooms.name: The Lower Board Room of the Immortals
rooms.desc:
This room is a close twin to the main Immortal Board Room at the top of the
spiral staircase.  Your mind and body cannot help but relax as you gaze
around this comfortable room, and hope that you will be able to linger here
a while.  Many green plants line a marble stairway that leads down to the 
Temple of Kir Drax'in.

rooms.name: Steam Chamber
rooms.desc:
You come to rest in a large circular chamber whose ceiling extends upward far
beyond your range of vision.  The smooth rock walls curve slowly upward in a
cork-screw fashion, allowing the the massive amount of steam rushing in from the
south to be vented upwards into the darkness.  A large ring of metal has been
set into the floor of this room, binding the elemental energy that dwells here.

rooms.name: The Vent
rooms.desc:
You look up to see a massive fissure in the rock wall above you venting a
torrent of hot steam in massive waves directly towards you!  Unable to react, 
you find yourself lifted off of your feet and hurled backward away from the fissure
with hot steam and water scalding your flesh almost instantaneously.  You begin
to loose conciousness - this may be the end.

rooms.name: Blackness
rooms.desc:
You step into total darkness and vertigo immediately sets in.  Without any
feeling or sense of direction it is impossible to know if you are standing still
or falling rapidly to your doom.  Desperately, you grope around and cry out into
the blackness to no avail until suddenly you feel bathed in the sound and fury
of hot, rushing air...

rooms.name: Lava Tube
rooms.desc:
The narrow lava tube abruptly ends here, expanding into a chamber so large that
you cannot see the walls, floor or ceiling.  Hot wind rushes quickly somewhere
below your perch on a small ledge at the precipice of this cavern - you can feel
the radiant heat on your skin and hear the drone of the wind as it passes over
the rocks below.  Inky blackness surrounds you.

rooms.name: Lava Tube
rooms.desc:
The narrow walls of the lava tube grip your body claustrophobically as you 
slide along them.  The tube seems to follow a north-south path, gradually sloping
southward, where you can hear the sound of wind rushing along the rock walls.

rooms.name: Lava Tube
rooms.desc:
The lava tube here is incredibly narrow, forcing you to hold your breath in
an effort to squeeze through.  The walls of volcanic rock are sharp and unyielding
against your exposed flesh.  The tube slopes upward to the north and downward to
the south.

rooms.name: Lava Tube
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small, spherical cavern made up of hard, black rock.
Your surmise that this must be the end of an ancient lava tube.  The rock walls
of the cavern and slighly shiny and shimmer in the meager light your lanterns
provide. The only apparent path is that of the old lava tube, a smooth and
narrow passage that drops away to your south.

rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room of the Elemental Temple
rooms.desc:
The temple will be broken up into 6 components - the initial entry which
is now underwater, a plane for each element and a temple for the fifth element.
Players will only be able to progress to an elemental plane if they possess
the previous plane items. For example, if the player has obtained the item
from the earthen plane, they'll be taken to the aerial plane and so on. Here's
a brief map.

rooms.name: Beneath the Surface
rooms.desc:
Light filters down through the ocean surface above and is quickly swallowed
by the depths below. Small groups of fish swim by, obviously cautious of your
intrusion in their domain. Every direction looks fairly similar so you may
either swim upwards to the surface and descend into the darkness below.

rooms.name: Deep Beneath the Surface
rooms.desc:
Darkness surrounds you like a blanket and you strain your eyes in an attempt
to see anything at all that would help you regain your orientation. You can
just sense a difference in temperature and determine which way is up and
which way is down. You're not quite sure, but a hidden presence speaks to you
from the depths - then again, it could just be your imagination running wild.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
The only way you know you're skimming the ocean floor is by feeling the
sand slip between your fingers as you try to keep yourself down here. Your
ears pop under the increased pressure at this depth and how long you stay
down here is up to you, especially with the immense cold. For a brief instant,
you could have sworn you saw a flicker of light to the south.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
It is surprising that even in the darkness of the ocean depths, the fish
find a way to adapt and survive. A few of them have developed a phospherescent
skin that radiates a small amount of light - not enough to see great distances
but certainly enough to know you've arrived at the mouth of an underwater
tunnel that leads to the north and south.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You make your way along the underwater tunnel that runs to the north and
south by feeling your way along the rocky walls. More than once, you stumble
and slip on the sandy ocean floor but fortunately do not hurt yourself.

rooms.name: The Depths of the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You stand at the mouth of an underwater tunnel that continues to the north.
The darkness of the ocean kept at bay by a magical light to the south in what
looks like a courtyard. The water temperature is also noticeably warmer in
that direction, perhaps another benefit of whatever magic inhabits this place.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
The courtyard floor is slightly uneven and your travel to the west or
north is blocked by a large rock wall. Looking upwards, you can see the
remains of a tree, somehow preserved against the ravages of the salt water
and cold temperatures.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You find it unlikely that someone would have created this place underwater
so perhaps at some time it was on the surface. Your thoughts are supported by
a number of crumbled and fallen columns which block several areas of the
courtyard. There is something around this place, magical in nature, but you
can't quite put your finger on it.
   To the north, a rocky tunnel leads back into the depths of the ocean while
the courtyard continues to the south, west and east of here.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You reach the edge of the courtyard and can progress no further, a rock
wall preventing travel to the north and east while a collapsed column to the
south stops you from moving in that direction. You consider swimming over the
top of it but there is a strange magic at work here that seems to keep you
firmly planted on the ground.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
Rubble is strewn all over the ground, covered lightly in sand. A large,
cracked column has fallen and blocks your path to the south but the courtyard
lies open to the north and east.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
At one time, this courtyard would have looked quite grand with the ocean
as its backdrop and sunlight streaming through the surrounding columns. Now,
it is just a shadow of its former glory. The columns have collapsed, the
sunlight blocked by a few hundred feet of water and all you can see around
the edge of the courtyard is a rocky wall. You can swim to the north, west
or south.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
To the south, several steps lead up to what remains of a gate while the
underwater courtyard lies to the north and east. Climbing a few of the steps,
you look back upon the courtyard and marvel at what it must have been like in
the past. The are four short pillars nearby but there is nothing to provide
clues as to what they are for.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You have to swim through some rubble to get here and perhaps it was not
worth the effort. You are surrounded by rock and stone and have no alternative
but to return back to the west.

rooms.name: An Underwater Courtyard
rooms.desc:
Stairs lead upwards to the south towards an elevated platform of some kind.
There are flashes of light but it's not quite clear from here - to the north,
the underwater courtyard opens up before you and offers the only visible
exit from this place, whatever it is.

rooms.name: A Glowing Column
rooms.desc:
You're not exactly sure what you're standing in, but it's impressive to say
the least. It's a perfectly shaped column standing approximately 10 feet high
and hollow in the center. Spirals of flame encircle the column although you
can feel no heat; the ocean waters stir about you, churned by a mystical
force; several small orbs of stone cover the ground and bubbles of air
mysteriously rise from beneath them.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
The plateau appears to be perfectly square and has rocky pillars placed
at regular intervals around its border. Any attempt to walk past the pillars
is met with some kind of resistance, possibly the sphere that surrounds this
place.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You walk along the nortern edge of the plateau and gaze around. Beyond the
sphere there is only darkness, although you can see three other spheres of
similar size in the distance surrounding a larger sphere. From here, you
cannot determine what's in them.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You carefully approach the corner of the rocky plateau and look over the
side...you can see absolutely nothing! It's not that its too dark down there,
just that there is nothing to see. Whatever, or wherever this place is, there
doesn't appear to be any obvious way off it.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
It may only be a visual illusion, but the plateau looks almost generated
rather than formed. Someone or something has gone to great efforts to construct
this place with an almost eerie precision. Every little bump in the ground
appears in another area, as if the plateau had been created using several
replicated blocks. The only difference is the rocky outcrop to the east.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You stand atop a slightly elevated rocky outcrop overlooking a square
plateau below. There are a number of pillars placed around its border and
a central column within which you are standing. Some kind of sphere surrounds
the plateau and isolates it from whatever lies beyond.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You skirt the edge of a rocky platform which sits just above you to the
west, the plateau extending to the north and south. Any attempt to move past
the pillars surrounding the plateau is met with resistance, most likely from
the sphere.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
There's something moving just beyond the edge of the sphere but you can't
determine what it is from here. You can even see what appears to be a soft
glow far beyond the sphere to the south but that could just be your
imagination. The plateau extends to the north and east from here.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You clamber up one of the waist-high pillars in an attempt to get a better
view of your surrounds but it doesn't help too much. The plateau looks
remarkably similar whichever way you cast your eye and the sphere surrounding
it either blocks out light or there is none beyond it to see.

rooms.name: A Rocky Plateau
rooms.desc:
You accidently kick a small stone on the ground and it careers off the
edge of the plateau before striking the sphere. A ripple forms and expands
all over the surface of the sphere, like throwing a pebble in a lake. It's
an interesting sight and leaves you wondering what, or where, this place
really is.

rooms.name: The Earthly Plane
rooms.desc:
You stand on a single platform of rock in a place far beyond any you have
travelled before. There is no sky, nor is there any ground...all around you
is darkness. There are several similar rocky platforms but they all lie
beyond your reach. In the center of the platform is a strange column that
rotates slowly.

rooms.name: The Earthly Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of platform and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
Wispy cloud swirls around your ankles, disturbed by your passage. Beyond
the sphere, you see three similar spheres of the same size surrounding a
larger sphere. You cannot be sure what lies within the other spheres or their
intent.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You carefully approach the edge of the cloud and look out upon your
surroundings. Surprisingly, there is no sky and there doesn't appear to be
any ground! Only darkness surrounds the sphere which leaves you wondering
exactly where you are...

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
Every once in a while, you get the sensation that you are moving. Without
a place of reference, that may well be true but the sensation quickly passes
and you are once again left with your thoughts. You may continue around the
cloud to the west or south.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You walk towards the edge of the cloud and reach out, inspecting the sphere
that surrounds this cloud. It is soft to the touch and moves freely with your
touch, yet its purpose is still unknown. It ripples softly as you remove your
hand and you watch in awe as the ripples spread across the spheres' surface.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You stand atop what can only be described as a cloud! For a moment, you
panic at the thought of falling but the ground beneath your feet feels solid
and you take a few tentative steps just to be sure. Wherever this place is,
it has a roughly square shape and appears to be surrounded by some kind of
sphere. Situated right in the middle of the cloud is a large column within
which you are standing.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
You gaze around at the sights before you, but unfortunately there's not a
lot to see. The cloud is rather featureless and any attemp to pass beyond
the sphere is met with some form of resistance. A large column rises from
the middle of the cloud to the west.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
The ground rolls beneath you, leaving you slightly unsteady on your feet.
The cloud is relatively featureless compared to some of the other areas you
may have adventured in the past...the only distinguishing feature is the large
column of mist that rises from the center of the cloud.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
From the base of the cloud, four small pillars rise up as if pushed from
below. The pillars themselves are nothing more than mist, but they retain
a somewhat solid form. Above each, a small sphere materialises and glows
softly with a rhythmic pulse.

rooms.name: High Among the Clouds
rooms.desc:
There is a definate presence nearby and you imagine that something or
someone is looking down upon you. A light breeze sends a shiver down your
spine and you try hard not to let your imagination loose. Perhaps it's better
if you just continued on.

rooms.name: The Aerial Plane
rooms.desc:
You find yourself standing on what appears to be a cloud, yet there is no
sky, nor is there any ground. Darkness surrounds you but you can see several
other clouds nearby, all beyond your reach. In the center of the cloud is a
strange column that rotates slowly.

rooms.name: The Aerial Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of cloud and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
The island surface, although solid enough, is rather brittle and you
break through it several times. You cast your eye westwards, out upon the
sea of lava and find nothing. Flames dance along the surface of the lava
while huge plumes leap into the sky at irregular intervals.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
As you approach the edge of the island, a large jet of flame explodes from
the lave pool and travels upwards. Surprisingly, it doesn't radiate any heat
although testing that theory could be hazardous.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
Just beyond reach to the east lies a lava fountain, quite possibly the
source for the lava pool which surrounds the island. It bubbles away quietly,
obvious very hot given the viscosity of the fluid as it flows out. However,
you can feel no heat despite being so close.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
The lava pool simply ceases at the boundary of the sphere, beyond that
lies nothing but darkness. The lava bubbles away with intense heat but from
an unknown source since this place appears to be entirely surrounded by the
sphere.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
You stand within a column of fire which marks the center of a small island.
Created by some form of volcanic activity, the island is the only solid ground
within viewing distance - lava surrounds it making travel anywhere else
impossible. The island also appears to be enclosed within some kind of sphere,
but from your vantage point you can't be too sure.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
There is a slightly elevated portion of the island resembling a small
pillar. It's about waist-high and rather nondescript, although engraved on
the top is a picture of a small flame. The island continues to the north, south
and west where a large column of fire slowly rotates.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
You look outwards into the darkness and notice three similar spheres to
the one you are in now. The four in total surround a larger sphere but from
your position, you are unable to see what lies in any of them nor can you
see any way of reaching them.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
The sphere that surrounds the island has the unique ability to distort
light that provides for an interesting effect. There is an eerie orange glow
created by the bursts of flames that leap from the lava pool. Any flames
that reach the surface of the sphere create a rippling effect that spreads
out around the sphere.

rooms.name: A Lava Pool
rooms.desc:
Steam gently rises from the ground and wafts upwards before disappearing
completely. Lava laps at the edge and small pools are left to cool, perhaps
adding to the islands' growth. There is no heat being radiated from either
the lava or the flames on its surface, leaving you slightly perplexed.

rooms.name: The Fiery Plane
rooms.desc:
You stand on a slab of cooled, volcanic lava that seems quite isolated
from anything else. You look around and discover there almost is nothing else
apart from similar slabs at very locations around you. Other than that, there
is only darkness. In the middle of the slab is a strange column that rotates
slowly.

rooms.name: The Fiery Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of the slab and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You swim towards the edge of the whirlpool and rest a little, allowing the
current to spin you around slowly. There appears to be some kind of sphere
just a little further to the north, and beyond that nothing but darkness. You
can swim to the west, east or south from here.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You're tossed and turned in the churning waters and have some trouble trying
to stay afloat. The current, while not as strong as the middle of the
whirlpool, is certainly strong enough to pull you around. You can fight it and
swim to the north, south or east.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
Rough waters toss you back and forth as you fight to keep your head above
the waves. You're in the middle of a swirling whirlpool which, while trying
to move you around, does not appear to be sucking you down. There is a column
of water around you, its origin from the depths of the whirlpool itself.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You are pushed into the sphere surrounding the whirlpool and it stretches
before pushing you back into the churning waters. Your impact causes a ripple
that spreads over the surface of the sphere in an interesting pattern. The
only notable item of interest is the large water column to the west.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
You barely avoid a chunk of rock that sits within the churning waters of
the whirlpool. There's nothing remarkable about it except that it's the only
feature within visible range.

rooms.name: A Churning Whirlpool
rooms.desc:
On the outer edge of the whirlpool, the pull is not as strong and you have
a chance to survey your surrounds. The sphere surrounding this place lies
just beyond arms reach but even if you could get to it, there's nothing
beyond it.

rooms.name: The Aquatic Plane
rooms.desc:
You're swimming in a vast ocean and regardless of how hard you try,
movement in most directions seems futile - a force simply pushes you back to
this location. The sky has been replaced by a blackness, a void from which
no light escapes. Nearby, a strange column of water rotates slowly.

rooms.name: The Aquatic Plane
rooms.desc:
You step towards the edge of cloud and you feel a tingling sensation
all over your body. There is a brilliant flash and when you open your eyes,
you find yourself...

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. You look around for an obvious exit from the chamber and
see none - the only clue would perhaps lie within the column.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. The hum of the central column is quite peaceful and
relaxing but there is a force within this chamber which leaves you on guard.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. Looking around the chamber, you notice that everything
seems to revolve around the column in the middle as if it played a key role
in the function of the chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. In the center of the chamber sits a giant column, it glows
an eerie red as it rotates.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. You can venture in any direction throughout the
chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Sunlight beams in from several openings in the
chamber walls and ceiling, but whether it is real or synthetic is anyone's
guess.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. You cannot see any exit from the chamber and can
only assume that the column is the key which you seek.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. The air is stale in this place and it feels as if no one
has ventured here in centuries, whatever purpose this chamber may have served.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. You can proceed along the western wall of the chamber or
further towards the center by travelling eastwards.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Small, pulsing spheres materialise in the corner
of the chamber and make their way to the large column to the east before
disappearing in a puff of light.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber is quite large and its walls are engraved with all manner of
arcane symbols. In each corner is a small pedestal but from here, not much
detail can be seen. There is a rotating column in the middle of the chamber,
only feet from where you stand - there is a soft hum associated with its
movement and it radiates an enormous amount of energy.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. There is a definate force at work within the chamber
and all of your senses point towards the column to the west. You are almost
drawn to it with some type of hypnotic acceptance.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. You can continue to the north, south or west.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. For a brief moment, the column in the middle of the chamber
stops rotating, pulses intensely, and then resumes.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Despite the sterile nature of this place, it feels
as if it has not been used in centuries...whatever that use may have been.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. You can venture in any direction throughout the
chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, an almost pristine
environment. Arcane symbols cover the walls, the odd one or two glowing
softly in various colors. Your movements echo around the chamber and drown
out the soft hum coming from the column in the center of the room.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. As you touch one of the unknown symbols, there is a quiet
musical tone that resonates throughout the chamber.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. Light beams in from several openings in the chamber wall
but whether it's real or not cannot be determined from down here.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. In the center of the chamber sits a giant column, it glows
an eerie red as it rotates.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
The chamber floor is smooth and cold to the touch, as is the chamber wall.
You run your hands over the numerous arcane symbols and a great power courses
through your body. A number of colored spheres appear from nowhere and make
their way towards the column on an unknown journey. Upon reaching their
destination, they simply vanish in a puff of light.

rooms.name: The Elemental Chamber
rooms.desc:
Made from the same material as the chamber itself, a small pillar stands
here in the corner approximately waist-high. There is a symbol etched onto
the top but nothing else remarkable stands out to you.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
Above the ambient noise of the temple, there is a soft chanting but you
can't see the source. The temple is devoid of other people apart from your
own adventuring party. It is, however, a very soothing chant and you take
a moment to sit and listen.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
Looking around the temple, it is empty apart from the wooden pews and the
mystical altar. It is clearly meant to be the focus of this place despite the
fact that there is no one else here to worship it.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
You stand before a great altar to the elements, a symbol of their union
and place within this world. Steps lead down in the four cardinal directions
to a small area surrounding the altar, an area to worship and pay homage.
There is a narrow opening in the temple ceiling which leads into the darkness.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
There is a strong life force within the temple, you can feel it as it
seems to look you over. You do not feel in any danger, just an overwhelming
inquisitiveness. Then, as quickly as it came, the force is gone and you are
left standing here.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
A series of steps lead up to a magnificient altar in the middle of the
temple. This lower area has been set aside for people to kneel and worship
the elements, a number of pews set up around the temple perimeter.

rooms.name: The Temple of Elements
rooms.desc:
There are a number of pews lining the temple wall, each appears to have
an elemental symbol etched into. You take the time to sit down on a couple of
them and images of places far beyond this world enter your mind. Some you
recognise, most you do not - it is a very therapeutic experience.

rooms.name: The Elemental Plane
rooms.desc:
One minute your ascending through the opening in the temple roof, and the
next you are floating towards the top of a large sphere in openness. Around
the sphere is nothing, only blackness - orbitting at some distance are four
other spheres, all smaller than this one. There is an incredible power and
you are almost paralysed with its intensity.

rooms.name: A Tropical Island
rooms.desc:
The island isn't very large and you imagine if the ocean swell were to
rise sufficiently, it would be submerged. A single palm tree stands to your
right and a stone cross sits embedded within the soft sand.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the churning surface of the water.  As 
you float above the surface, eddies crash into you, forcing you to 
pay attention to the water's motion.  In the distance, you can see 
the foam of a broken ocean eddies. To the north, a lone island breaks
the surface of the waves.

rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room of the Orc Burrows
rooms.desc:
You stand upon a cloud in the sky, overlooking an intricate maze of passages
below, even though in fact they reside below the surface.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
For the first time during your journey beneath the surface, you actually
feel a sense of peace and security. If you wish, you can remain here to rest
your weary bones or you could venture back into the network of tunnels to the
south. It may also be possible to work your way through the dirt roof and
back onto the surface.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Small is right! You have no sooner walked into the tunnel than you are at
its end. The only choice you have is to return the way you came.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You walk further down the tunnel and come face to face with a wall of dirt.
Whether it was intentional or not, work on this area of the tunnel has not been
completed. You could be mistaken, but it looks like you could work your way
through the scant covering of grass above you and onto the surface. The tunnel
to the south will take you back into the burrows.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As expected, you now stand face to face with a wall of dirt. It appears
as if this area of the tunnel as been set aside as some type of animal shelter,
a number of kennel-like holes dug into the tunnel walls either side of you.
The bones of small forest creatures lie scattered about on the floor and
tufts of fur have been placed down to fashion what looks like a mat.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
For once you can see relatively well further ahead of you and unfortunately
it doesn't look like there's a lot there. The tunnel extends to the west and
north, both directions ending in a dirt wall. There is also the option to
return east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
It is becoming remarkably cooler the further north you travel within the
burrows. You cannot see it but can quite clearly hear the dripping of water
from the east and wonder what its source is. The tunnel also extends to the
west and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The sound of dripping water grows louder and is most probably coming from
the east. There is also a small recess in the northern wall which you could
enter or you may travel back to the west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You discover the source of the water is in fact numerous tree roots which
crowd the southern exit from the tunnel. It streams down the roots and forms
pools of water on the ground, changing the usually dry dirt into mud. You
could push your way south through the roots or return to the west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The temperature within the burrows is actually starting to cool down but
you are unsure as to why. The layer of dirt covering every part of your
exposed body is now a thin film of mud thanks to the heat you've already
experienced. You may travel to the east or south from here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A T-junction in the tunnel system allows you to travel to the north, west
or south. Any thoughts of leaving a trail should have been carried out by
now as you find yourself deep within the maze beneath the surface. Looking
down, you see a series of footprints, the majority of which lead to the north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Crawling around on your hands and knees is becoming tiresome, especially
since you are now filthy! You make a silent promise that next time you'll
let others do the adventuring for you. You may crawl to the south or east of
here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A light breeze cools you down slightly and you wonder why you had not
noticed any air flow previously. The only entrance for air into this place
was through the way you came in and it certainly couldn't progress this far
without an exit point. You are uncertain as to which direction the breeze
came from but you can try and find it by crawling to the west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The first thing you notice is the smell, then you see the cause. Off to
the side of the tunnel is the rotting carcass of what must have been a deer.
You are almost overwhelmed by the stench but notice that the animal could not
have been dead for too long. Large sections of flesh have been torn from its
body and congealed blood has mixed with dirt to form a sticky mass on the
floor. You decide to move on and can travel to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As you make your way northward you become even more suspicious that there
is a reason no one walks this route. You are unsure why because the path to
the east is covered by large tree roots beyond which you cannot see. However,
they look flexible enough so you might be able to squeeze through if you
wanted. Otherwise, you will have to journey back to the south.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of a Pit
rooms.desc:
No sooner have you made your way through the wall of roots than you stumble
and fall down a rather deep pit. Cursing silently you realize there is no easy
way out of here and climbing up the dirt wall would surely result in half of
it collapsing down upon you. The bones of others as fortunate as yourself rest
on the ground but you can find nothing that would aid in your escape.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
For some reason this area of the burrows has been frequented regularly 
judging by the number of footprints on the ground. However, what strikes you
as odd is that they only travel north and south along the tunnel, not to the
west. Tree roots to the west make it difficult to pass but you could certainly
squeeze through with some effort.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the east or to
the north. As you ponder which way to go, the earthen walls begin to shake and
a cloud of dirt fills the air. There is a rumbling noise which grows louder
and louder by the minute before it passes over the top of you and is gone
as suddenly as it came. You have no idea what is was and decide that it might
be more prudent to move on unless the roof itself caves in upon you.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You pass by the unfortunate corpse of a fellow adventurer. It's still in
one piece so you can only assume it wasn't eaten by the inhabitants of this
place. Whatever remained of the poor soul's possessions have been taken and
he now rests here in eternal sleep. Stepping over the corpse, you can go to
the west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Well...you are now stuck. You are wedged firmly between the walls and no
matter how hard you struggle, you can't pull yourself through. While you sit
and ponder what to do, you hear what sounds like escaping air. You realize that
by sticking yourself in the tunnel, you've created a pressure differential
which thankfully pushes you out. Of course, you strike your head on a tree
root in the process but you are now free to continue to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You work your way through the narrow tunnel hoping beyond all hope that it
actually leads somewhere. To the east, it opens out into a larger tunnel where
you can again stand or you may crawl northward into the darkness.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel twists and turns for several hundred feet before arriving at
this T-junction. There is a small opening in the western wall which you could
probably crawl through or you may progress to the north or south if you wish
to remain upright.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The first thing you notice about this tunnel is that it doesn't appear to
have ever been used. Of course, something had to create it but over time, any
footprints on the ground have been covered by the endless amount of dirt down
here. You can travel to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You make your way slowly as you are now on your hands and knees. The earth
closes in around you and it's a tight squeeze to move yourself through. The
tunnel continues to the south and also to the east where it opens up.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The odor grows stronger to the west and you can just hear the faint sounds
of metal moving against metal. The tunnel in that directions also grows rather
small so it will be necessary to crawl through it should you wish to travel
that way. Alternatively, the tunnels to the north and east are more open.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You detect a faint odor from the west and it's not overly pleasant. Noises
from the east also grab your attention and you must now decide which is the
safest of the two options.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You realize that you had better pay attention to where you walk as you get
your foot snagged on another of those annoying roots. Thankfully, you do not
injure yourself and may continue to the north, west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You crawl further down the tunnel and come face to face with a wall of
dirt. Whether it was intentional or not, work on this area of the tunnel has
not been completed. You could be mistaken, but it looks like you could work
your way through the scant covering of grass above you and onto the surface.
The tunnel to the east will take you back into the burrows.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel slopes uphill gently before leveling off, thus making it an
even tighter squeeze than it was before. Fortunately, the tunnel ends further
to the west or you can return to the T-junction to the east to escape the
narrow crawlspace.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The earthen walls still make it difficult to squeeze more than one person
through at a time. The tunnel now splits and you can travel to the west,
north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the south or
east. You are finding it difficult to breathe with the combination of the heat
within these tunnels and the cloud of dirt that you kick up as you move.
Nothing seems more appealing right now than cool, fresh air and perhaps a swim
in the river to clean yourself.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As you work your way through the burrows, you notice that the roof is
sometimes nothing more than a thin layer of dirt covered by grass on the
surface above. It's a wonder that nothing walking above you comes crashing
down but whatever constructed these tunnels has obviously done the bare
minimum of work to ensure that won't happen. You have a choice of exits; north
west or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You could swear that there are a number of eyes staring at you but the more
you try and peer into the darkness, the less you are able to see. You stand
silently for a moment and hear nothing but your own breathing. You may push on
to the west, south or north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have difficulty navigating the bend in this narrow tunnel. You almost
get stuck but have just enough room to continue to the north or to the east.
The odor is getting close to unbearable and is definitely coming from the
east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You find yourself crawling through a small layer of what appears to be
blood! It's fairly fresh too considering the warmth and ease at which it
ripples as you place you hands and knees in it. The tunnel bends again and
continues to the west and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You peer around the corner in the tunnel and are dismayed to find even more
dirt. Face it, you're not getting out of here in a hurry. The roof is also
quite low here which means you have to stoop to get by. It looks very similar
to the south while to the east you may be able to stand upright.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have a choice of four directions here, the only difference being that
to the west the tunnel roof slopes downward so it may be difficult to travel
through. You notice another bundle of tree roots to the east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The roots here surround three sides of the tunnels end and would allow
you to easily climb them if you wish. The tunnel roof might take some work to
get through but if you wish to leave this place, it's definitely an option.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have to push your way through the tunnel walls to progress any further
and as a result are now covered in dirt. You would have thought that the tunnel
would now be wider but it looks the same as it did before. A large tree root
passes from the west to east through the wall and you have to crouch down to
get by it. The tunnel extends to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have actually found the first signs of life within the earthen walls of
this place! They may only be worms, but they are indeed a sign that something
happens here. You may continue to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You must be careful to avoid the tree roots which protrude through the
tunnel roof. and disappear into the dirt floor upon which you stand. Numerous
footsteps can be seen on the ground, some of them yours, the majority belonging
to something else. The tunnel bends here and you can travel to the east or to
the south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel has simply been carved out of the earth as is evident by the
claw marks on the tunnel walls. A small amount of light comes from an opening
to the south allowing you to see without the aid of a torch or magic. Tunnels
to the north and west stretch into the darkness.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have found the source of the odor and it's through a large hole in the
tunnel floor. The fresh blood drips down into it and you can hear it collecting
at the bottom which doesn't sound that far away. Tree roots will allow easy
access to the lower level if you wish to go down there.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You now have trouble staying in one spot as the tunnel slopes downward to
the south and the layer of blood is making traction difficult. Fortunately,
the number of tree roots is growing larger and you are able to steady yourself
as you travel. The tunnel extends to the north and west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You are forced to stoop as you make your way through the tunnel, the roof
dipping quite significantly compared to other areas you have progressed
through. To the south, the tunnel opens into a larger chamber while it doesn't
appear to be much better to the north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You actually have found the first signs of life within the earthen walls
of this place! They may only be worms, but they are indeed a sign that
something happens here. You can continue to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You find it surprising that whoever built these tunnels was not uniform
about it. While the place you stand is the same as the tunnel to the east and
south, the tunnel to the north is noticeably smaller and would slow you down
immensely if you wanted to travel through it.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You just miss falling into a small ditch in the middle of the tunnel. It is
perfectly shaped as though a giant ball had been placed there at one time.
Fortunately, you are not hurt and can continue to the west, north or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Clumps of dirt fall from the roof and walls as you walk through the burrows.
Despite the roots that appear to extend in all directions, the tunnels lack
the moisture necessary to hold this area together. You must be careful as you
journey to avoid being buried alive. A small source of light can just be seen
to the east while tunnels continue to the north, west and south.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Light filters through a maze of tree roots above you and illuminates a
small room carved out of the earth. Tunnels spear off in all directions
although you can't see more than a few feet into them. Unknown sounds
occasionally break the silence around you and a shiver runs down your spine
either in anticipation or fear.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Dirt, dirt and even more dirt. Not surprising since the tunnel has been
created beneath the surface of the forest but you're already covered in the
stuff and it's not pleasant. You duck just in time to miss one of the many
tree roots that criss-cross the roof and walls and wonder how far this
tunnel system could possibly extend. You can barely make out a small room to
the west while the tunnel extends to the south and east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
It must have taken years to build this underground network, especially
since it looks like it was done by hand...or perhaps you could say claw. The
scratch marks in the walls are very obvious and although the earthen walls
crumble easily under your touch, it must have taken a lot of work to dig
through and then remove the tons of dirt. Your only options here are to
travel to the west or east.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
You step into the northwestern corner of what appears to be a sleeping 
chamber within the burrows. The only difference between this area and the
tunnels you have traveled through is the size, dirt is still everywhere and
the oppressive heat from lack of air flow is starting to wear you down. Simple
mats of branches and leaves are scattered haphazardly around the cave and you
can easily hear the loud slumber of something but you cannot see into the
darkness. The cave continues to the east and south or you may enter one of
the tunnels to the north or west.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
This corner of the chamber is noticeably smaller than the others and funnels
into a tunnel that leads to the north. You trip on something and land face
first into the dirt floor, narrowly missing one of the branches laid out here.
Looking back, a collection of six animal bones has been painstakingly buried
into the ground in the shape of a circle for reasons unknown. Ponder as you
might, you cannot find a reason and decide to continue.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of a Pit
rooms.desc:
No sooner have you made your way through the wall of roots than you stumble
and fall down a rather deep pit. Cursing silently you realize there is no easy
way out of here and climbing up the dirt wall would surely result in half of it
collapsing down upon you. The bones of others as fortunate as yourself rest on
the ground but you can find nothing that would aid in your escape.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Once again you are forced to weave your way through a number of tree roots
that pierce the surface and continue downward through the dirt floor. With a
little effort, you could push your way westward or travel to the north and east
where the roots aren't as thick as they are here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the west or to
the south. As you ponder which way to go, the earthen walls begin to shake
and a cloud of dirt fills the air. There is a rumbling noise which grows louder
and louder by the minute before it passes over the to of you and is gone as
suddenly as it came. You have no idea what it was and decide that it might
be more prudent to move on unless the roof itself caves in upon you.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A sense of foreboding descends upon you as you walk by what appears to be
the carcass of a small animal. It has been here for some time judging by the
distinct lack of flesh and the layer of dirt covering it but why it is here
remains a mystery. The tunnel extends to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel gently slopes downhill to the south and the roof of grass and
roots is slowly replaced by a layer of dirt. A recess to the west appears to
have been the beginning of another tunnel but it never progressed more than a
few feet. The entrance to the burrows lies just to the north while the tunnel
continues to the east and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You stand at a crossroads within the tunnel system. The only difference
between any of the exits is that the one to the south looks slightly narrower
than the other three. Even with your light source, you cannot see much further
than a few feet in front of you as clouds of dust and dirt float around you.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
This T-junction allows you to access tunnels to the west and south while
it enters a slightly larger chamber to the east. You can hear sounds of some
description coming from the chamber but apart from that, no others factors
can help with your decision on which way to go.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
You find yourself in the southwestern corner of a small cave which is in
fact merely an extension of the tunnel system you have made your way through.
It's simply connected to three other rooms and has had the centre area removed
to increase its size. Judging by the collection of branches and leaves, you
believe the area is used as a sleeping chamber by the tunnel occupants which is
somewhat disconcerting since it means they are probably still here. The cave
continues to the north and east while a single tunnel departs to the west.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
You weave your way through the makeshift beds to another corner of this
sleeping chamber. The only difference between this area and the tunnels
through which you arrived is the size. A fair amount of work has gone into its
construction to provide a suitable area to accommodate a large number of
creatures, whoever they may be. The cave opens up to the north an west while
a tunnel leaves to the east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You blink as shafts of light beam through small holes in the roof. You fear
that anything walking on the surface above you would more than likely come
through the weakened roof and land on you so perhaps it is prudent to move
into the tunnel to the west or south. You could also try and climb out onto
the surface.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A section of the earthen wall has collapsed making it difficult to proceed
in any direction but you have the choice of north, east or south. The heat
within the tunnels is almost unbearable as there is virtually no air flow.
You can imagine this place during the heat of the day as being similar to
walking through a wall of fire and are thankful at least that the darkness
keeps the temperature down a little.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A T-junction in the tunnel system allows you to travel to the north, west
or east. Thoughts of leaving a trail enter your mind as you progress deeper
into the maze as every part of this area looks exactly the same. Looking down,
you see a series of footprints and wonder if any of them are actually yours.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel walls narrow here and are just wide enough to allow one person to
pass through. You trip and fall on an exposed root and curse at your misfortune
as you get a face full of dirt. Coughing and spitting, you have the choice to
travel north, west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have to push your way through the tunnel walls to progress any further
and as a result you are now covered in dirt. You would have thought that the
tunnel would now be wider but it looks the same as it did before. A large tree
root passes from the west to east through the wall and you have to crouch down
to get by. The tunnel extends to the north and to the south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The first thing you notice is the smell, then you see the cause. Off to the
side of the tunnel is the rotting carcass of what must have been a deer. You
are almost overwhelmed by the stench but notice that the animal could not
have been dead for too long. Large sections of flesh have been torn from its
body and congealed blood has mixed with dirt to form a sticky mess on the
floor. You decide to move on and can travel to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the south or
east. You are finding it difficult to breathe with the combination of the heat
within these tunnels and the cloud of dirt that you kick up as you move.
Nothing seems more appealing right now than cool, fresh air and perhaps a swim
in the river to clean yourself.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Clumps of grass have begun to grow on the floor in front of you indicating
that perhaps the tunnels in this part of the burrows have been here for quite
some time. You are amazed that the grass can grow without the aid of sunlight
and water but then again, you don't know what lies beneath your feet if in fact
the burrows extend that far. You can travel to the west or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The earthen walls slowly give way to solid rock to the east which is why the
tunnel continues to the west and north. There is evidence that whoever
constructed these tunnels did try to dig through the rock but it was obviously
unsuccessful.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You walk further down the tunnel and come face to face with a wall of dirt.
Whether it was intentional or not, work on this area of the tunnel has not been
completed. You could be mistaken, but it looks like you could work your way
through the scant covering of grass above you and onto the surface. The tunnel
to the east will take you back into the burrows.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As you work your way through the burrows, you notice that the roof is
sometimes nothing more than a thin layer of dirt covered by grass on the
surface above. It's a wonder that nothing walking above you comes crashing
down but whatever constructed these tunnels has obviously done the bare
minimum of work to ensure that won't happen. You have a choice of exits;
north, west or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You almost get wedged between the narrowing tunnel walls but just scrape
through. Something similar to a snicker catches your attention but before you
can register a direction, it is gone. The tunnel opens up to the west and
continues deeper into the darkness to the east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The earthen walls still make it difficult to squeeze more than one person
through at a time but it looks as if the tunnel opens up to the south where you
can also hear the sound of running water. Alternatively, you could try and make
your way to the west or north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The effort to reach the tunnels end seems hardly worth it. Whoever built
the tunnels has decided that this section should travel no further and you now
stare blankly at a wall of dirt, claw marks still visible on the southern end
of the tunnel. Bones cover the floor although you cannot determine the original
owner or why they sit in this place.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel bends here and continues to the north and east. The roots that
have been quite prolific elsewhere are noticeably absent from the roof of
this section. You notice that its nothing more than a thin layer of dirt
covered by grass on the surface above. With a little effort, you might be
able to force your way through the roof and back into the forest.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Footsteps on the dirt floor lead to the north and west from here, the only
exits from this part of the tunnel system. You are almost speared by one of the
numerous tree roots while you stare at the ground but manage to pull yourself
back in time. An ear piercing shriek startles you but it is the only sound made
and you are uncertain as to which direction it came from.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel ends almost as soon as it started...it is nothing more than a
small recess off the cavern to the south. The walls here are almost purely
constructed from tree roots which provide hand and foot holds through the
hole in the ground. Silence is the only thin to greet you from the hole and
its murky darkness provides no clue as to what lies below.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The edge of the river is relatively small and you have to be careful not
to sink too deeply into the mud that has been created. Dirt walls prevent
further travel to the west or north but you can travel along the shoreline to
the east. The river to your south simply appears from an opening in the wall
and flows steadily to the east.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground River
rooms.desc:
If you had been wondering where the many trees of Noirwood got their
nutrients then the river before you is the most likely of answers. You stand
on the edge of an underground river that flows to the east and into a small
tunnel that you cannot clearly see down. The shoreline extends to the west
and abruptly ends while the tunnel network of the burrows lies to the north
through a narrow opening.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
The shoreline extends to the east and abruptly ends while a narrow tunnel
leads off to the north. The calmer waters of this underground lake lie directly
to the south but you would have to fight the river current if you intended to
leave this place.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
Unless you plan to return to the water, your only option here is to walk
along the shoreline to the west. Although there is no natural source of light
within the cavern, the obvious exit appears to be back along the river you
traveled although you can make out the entrance to a tunnel at the western end
of the shore.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river flows through a narrow opening in the western wall but it is too
small for you to fit into. A steady current travels to the east where in the
distance you can see the river disappears into the eastern wall. A small
shoreline lies to the north.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river pulls you towards the east as it rushes into a narrow tunnel in
the wall. You could fight the steady current and travel to the west or
alternatively, you could struggle onto the shoreline to the north.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river continues its travel to the east although you can try and move
upstream to the west if you wish. The sound of the river reverberates off the
hollowed tunnel and is almost deafening at times.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river continues its travel to the east although you can try and move
upstream to the west if you wish. The sound of the river reverberates off the
hollowed tunnel and is almost deafening at times.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river continues its travel to the east although you can try and move
upstream to the west if you wish. The sound of the river reverberates off the
hollowed tunnel and is almost deafening at times. You can see what looks like a
small lake to the east where your journey will undoubtably end.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
The river pours out into a larger chamber and the current dies almost
instantly allowing you free travel around this underground lake. The lake
itself is not overly large, the southern side terminates at a wall of mud
and dirt while to the north you can see another shoreline.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
This is the furthest point on the underground lake that you can travel. To
your south and east you are prevented from moving further by the cavern wall
but you can continue back to the west or onto the shore to the north.

rooms.name: At the Base of a Large Hole
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of a large hole in the roof, ankle deep in
a pool of blood. This thought doesn't overly worry you since you've had to
slay many creatures to reach here, but the fact that the blood is still warm
does concern you. Just above your head sit a number of tree roots which you
could use to climb back to the level above or you could enter a medium sized
chamber to the south.

rooms.name: An Orc Storeroom
rooms.desc:
The two rooms here, the other to the south, are obviously used to store
the bounty the orcs obtain when they go on their village raids. You can see
a variety of weapons and armor pieces, chests of treasure and a number of
useless trinkets which must have caught their eye. Most of the items here
are damaged beyond repair but something may be of value if you scrounge
around a bit.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have stumbled across the heart of the orc burrows for it is here that
the numerous raids these creatures carry out are planned. The rotting corpses
of many unfortunate creatures litter the floor and the stench of death is
very overpowering. Screams of agony echo around you and you realize not all
within this chamber is dead. Eyes glow in the surrounding darkness and all
seem to be focused on you.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You skirt around a makeshift table in the centre of the room and have the
choice of moving to the west or south. You trip over a collection of bones
in the corner and land head first into the carcass of a small forest animal.
The signs of decay are abundant as you look around after having wiped yourself
off and you pity the victims of the Dharzi orcs who will eventually wind up
here.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You step on the arm of what looks like a dwarven warrior and he yelps in
pain and surprise. He has a number of tear marks and his flesh almost hangs
from his body. The Dharzi orcs have claimed another victim who will shortly
join his companions in the spiritual plane. You may leave him and travel to
the north or east.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Blood pooling on the floor is now rising at an alarming level given the
size of this chamber. You are now up to your ankles in the stuff which doesn't
seem to be disappearing quickly. Body parts from numerous creatures have been
hung from the chamber roof in the twisted maze of roots that cover it. You
decide it might be more prudent to continue moving to the north or west.

rooms.name: An Orc Storeroom
rooms.desc:
The two rooms here, the other to the north, are obviously used to store
the bounty the orcs obtain when they go on their village raids. You can see
a variety of weapons and armor pieces, chests of treasure and a number of
useless trinkets which must have caught their eye. Most of the items here
are damaged beyond repair but something may be of value if you scrounge
around a bit.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You stand outside some type of store room, only apparent by the large amount
of goods you can see through the molded doorway in the western wall. You may
enter if you wish or journey back down the tunnel to the south.

rooms.name: At the Base of a Large Hole
rooms.desc:
There is no real difference between the tunnel you now find yourself in and
those you have passed through to get here. At least the proximity to the river
has provided some moisture to the earthen walls and they now look slightly more
robust that others within the burrow. The tunnel leads on to the north or you
can return to the upper level through the hole in the roof.

rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
This is the western tip of a small sandbar at what looks like the entrance
to a larger bay to the south. Although the sandbar is high enough to keep
you dry, the sand itself is quite moist and is difficult to move through.

rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
You are on a narrow strip of sand which runs east-west. Further to the
east you can see a wooden jetty which may have berthed one or two ships in
its time. To the south, the calmer waters of a large bay look slightly more
inviting than the ocean waves.

rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
Waves sweep forward from the surrounding ocean to the north but the
sandbar you are on prevents any further travel to the south where you can
see much calmer waters. You can travel to the east or west along the sandbar,
south into the sheltered bay or north into the ocean waves.

rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
You stand at the eastern end of a small sandbar which stretches away to
the west. You can walk onto an old looking jetty to the north but it doesn't
look overly safe given its current condition of neglect.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You emerge from the thickness to the south and the view before you leaves
you breathless. Standing at the top of an 80-foot cliff, the world around
you is amazing to say the least. Ocean waves crash against the cliff face
to the west while the waters of the island lagoon lap calmly to the east.
Behind you, the island you find yourself on is covered in all forms of
plant-life which make travel look difficult.
   Towards the southwestern corner of the island you can see a fairly large
wooden structure but you have no idea on how you're going to get there.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The sheltered waters of this lagoon are due in part to the sandbar to the
north and an almost vertical cliff to the west. You can wade your way to the
east or south into the lagoon if you wish.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The waters of this place are quite shallow and you walk easily on the
sandy floor. The sandbar to the north prevents the ocean waves from having
any effect while large cliffs to the west and east provide additional
shelter.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
You are now waist deep in the calm waters of this lagoon. It is quite
temperate and you could certainly swim around in it to relieve the pressures
of your travels. A sandbar to the north provides adequate protection from
the ocean while cliffs further to the west and east shelter the lagoon from
the harsh ocean winds.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
You wade through the shallow waters of the lagoon and now have the choice
of travelling to the west or south. If you wish to dry off, a small sandbar
to the north offers some respite while a cliff face to the east stops you
travelling in that direction.

rooms.name: A Jungle
rooms.desc:
The view before you is absolutely breathtaking. Standing at the top of an
80 foot cliff, the world around you is amazing to say the least. Ocean waves
crash against the cliff face to the east while waters of the island lagoon
lap calmly to the west. Behind you, the island you find yourself on is
covered in all forms of plant-life and you imagine travel will be difficult
in those areas.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
The ground slopes increasingly upwards towards the north and you now find
yourself totally submerged in the jungle. You have the option of continuing
to the north or to the south.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
Steep cliffs to the east and south block your path and they are simply
not suitable for climbing. The lagoon continues to the east and also to the
north where you see a small sandbar.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
