The floor here is bluish-gray marble with black streaks. You can look over
the railing and see down into the library to the south. A door heads north.

rooms.name: The King's Entry
rooms.desc:
The entryway to the King's office. Do you have an appointment?  A door
leads north.

rooms.name: King's Waiting Room
rooms.desc:
You are waiting in the King's waiting room. It's very comfortable here.
A door goes south.

rooms.name: The King's Office
rooms.desc:
This is the official offices of the King of Amber and it contains all
the lavish trappings of a powerful liege. The room also has powerful
spells placed on it to prevent the King from being influenced by magic.
Doors go north and west.

rooms.name: Conservatory
rooms.desc:
This was once a part of the office but Random has had it walled off to
provide him a place to practice his drums. South and east lie doors.

rooms.name: Royal Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the personal sitting room of the royal couple. It's very
comfortable, a great place for a casual visit.  Doors head north,
south, and east.

rooms.name: Royal Bath
rooms.desc: This is the royal couple's bath. It's quite large. A door heads west.

rooms.name: Royal Bedroom
rooms.desc:
You are in the royal couple's bedroom. A large, comfortable bed is
standing in the middle of the room. There is a fireplace to the east
and a door leads north.

rooms.name: Behind The Fireplace
rooms.desc: A dark, unfurnished room.

rooms.name: Vialle's Studio
rooms.desc:
You are in an artist's studio. Several unfinished sculptures are about.
A door goes south.

rooms.name: Small Staircase

rooms.name: Dworkin's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
Dworkin's bedroom is sparsely furnished. It's dusty and looks like it
hasn't been used in years. Doors go west and south.

rooms.name: Dworkin's Library
rooms.desc:
Everything is covered with dust here. You hesitate to touch anything.
A door leads north into the bedroom.

rooms.name: Dworkin's Study
rooms.desc:
This would be a very comfortable place to sit if there were any chairs
and if it wasn't so dusty in here. There is a fireplace here. That's
probably where the dust has blown in.

rooms.name: Behind The Fireplace
rooms.desc: A dark, unfurnished room.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc:
The guest room is sparsely but comfortably furnished. A door leaves
north from here.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: This part of the guest room is for sleeping.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc:
This guest room is elegantly and comfortably furnished. A door
heads north out of the room.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: This part of the guest room is the sleeping quarters.

rooms.name: Lab
rooms.desc:
This looks like the family laboratory. However, there are also a number
of medical supplies about. It appears that this room served as a hospital
as well. A door is in the south wall.

rooms.name: Llewella's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
Llewella's apartments reflect her fascination with Venus, the Graeco-
Roman goddess of love, whom she claims to have met during her first
Shadow-shift. Her rooms bear a beautiful seashell motif. Doors head east and
west.

rooms.name: Llewella's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
The bedroom continues and extends the seashell motif. A door heads
east out of here.

rooms.name: Martin's Room
rooms.desc:
Martin's room looks like any guest room. He must not be in Amber much.
A door goes north from here.

rooms.name: Martin's Bedroom
rooms.desc: Martin's bedroom is as devoid of personal artifacts as the front room.

rooms.name: Flora's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
Flora's furnishings are French, from the Napoleonic era. There is a large
oil painting on the wall.

rooms.name: Flora's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
The bedroom also features furnishings from the Napoleonic period. A bright
red canopied bed occupies most of the room.

rooms.name: Flora's Bath
rooms.desc:
One of the most outlandish baths you've ever seen, it carries the
French-style decor into its historically weakest area. Little, cute
statues spout water into a large, shell-shaped tub. The fixtures are
gold on the sink, toilet, and - what's that thing? Oh, a bidet.

rooms.name: Fencing Room
rooms.desc:
This room is used as a training room. Apparently, some swordfighting
goes on here. The room continues to the north. A door goes west.

rooms.name: Steam Room
rooms.desc: There's steam all over! And it's hot in here.

rooms.name: Weight Room
rooms.desc:
If anyone lifts these weights, they must be superhuman. A doorway
leads west and the fireplace on the east wall looks large enough to
crawl into.

rooms.name: Behind The Fireplace
rooms.desc: A dark, unfurnished room.

rooms.name: Racquetball Court
rooms.desc: This area looks just like a racquetball court.

rooms.name: The Great Stair
rooms.desc:
You are on a huge, stone spiral staircase.  It appears to have been carved
from the solid rock of Kolvir. There is on note on the step here, held in 
place by a large silver dagger stuck through it and into the stone.

You stand in a narrow space between the wall and some glowing lines on
the floor to the east that pulse with deadly energy. The room itself is
large; its ceiling and walls lost in shadows.
   To the west you see a door. A charred bird skeleton lies left to decay 
at its base, proclaiming that whatever lies outside the pattern is deadly.

Stepping on the Pattern here would surely be fatal, though it appears you

rooms.desc:
You started walking the Pattern at the wrong place. That's a deadly
mistake.


  The Pattern kills you.

rooms.desc:
You have inadvertantly stepped off the great Pattern.  The cosmic energies
infused within this mystical symbol tear your puny mortal body to shreds.


The Great Pattern has unmade you.

rooms.name: The Center Of The Pattern
rooms.desc:
The center of the Pattern is the center of the universe. From here you
may seek the powerful artifact known as the Eye of the Logrus (as well
as other names).

rooms.name: Fishmonger's Road
rooms.desc:
This muddy path runs north. You can hear noises all around you.
A shop is to the west.

rooms.name: Fishmonger's Road
rooms.desc:
This muddy path runs north along the harbor. The heavy rainstorms
keep the ground moist. A shop is to the west.

keep the ground moist. A shop is to the west.

rooms.name: The Armory
rooms.desc:
This is a clean looking shop which sports a foundry in the back, they
must make all these armors in house, instead of trading for them. Most
of the pieces are complete suits designed specifically for the royal family
of Amber, but it looks like the blacksmith has enough talent to repair or
replace any armor you can specify.

rooms.name: Stven's Armaments
rooms.desc:
This store contains a wide variety of swords, axes, and other weaponry
that a soldier or adventurer might purchase.  Most of the armaments are
displayed on the walls or hung from the ceiling, you'd hate to be nearby
if any of those swords hung from the crossbeam fell.

rooms.name: The Smithy
rooms.desc: A forge and blacksmithery surrounds you.

rooms.name: The Hotel Safe
rooms.desc: The blank walls of the hotel safe surround you.

rooms.name: Inside the Pub
rooms.desc:
This run-down wooden building has seen better days. Business seems really
slow.

rooms.name: A Dirt Road through the Forest
rooms.desc:
The ironwood trees begin to thin out, giving way to huge ancient willows 
and oaks festooned with spanish moss.  The effect is eerie.  A trail running
roughly north and south can be barely made out, and a narrow path to the east
leads behind some tall ironwood trees.
   As you scan the trail to the south, you make out a set of gates, mostly
obscured by the branches that jut out into the path.

rooms.name: A Dirt Road through the Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest crowds in around you, as if eager to reclaim the path you are
travelling upon.  In some places the brush is so thick that you are forced to
hack your way through.  In one such section, your efforts reveal a decrepit
building just to your east.  You can still see remnants of the path to your 
north and south.

rooms.desc:

in several places, the door is ripped from its hinges, creaking eerily with the
wind. Something about the altar nags at you though.  The forest is to your west.

   To the southeast lies the walls of a small town, the center of which

wall, and in all other directions lies forest.

rooms.desc:

rooms.name: At the Top of the Volcano
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the peak of what appears to be an active volcano, if the
pool of lava to your southeast is any indication. Down from here, the slope
of the volcano leads to a verdant jungle which sprawls from the volcano's
base. In all directions, except for the distant northwest, the jungle
continues until is almost seems to flow into the ocean. Far to the northwest,
you can see a clearing between the jungle and the ocean, along with a small
village. To the east and south, you can continue to walk around the pool of
lava.

rooms.name: The start room
rooms.desc: Nothing much here

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
To your west and south the sea clashes with the sturdy walls of the
domed structure.  Centered on the surface of the massive structure is a
bubblelike formation.  Within the center you can vaguely make out what
looks to be a porthole, but there is no opening on the dome here.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
Raging waves pound into the ledge, creating a salty cloud of mist
that permeates the air. To your east is a spherical entryway, though
you cannot get in through this point. Through the walls you notice
a dark opening, yet it seems you must walk around to the front before
you can enter.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
You stand on the surrounding ledge of a massive structure that rises
from the depths of the ocean. To the southeast is a domed, transparent
entryway that juts out from the core of the encompassing, solid margin.
Peering through the walls you can see a small porthole, though you
cannot enter the sphere here.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
To the south is what looks to be an impenetrable bubble. However,
by looking through the transparent walls of the dome, you can see that
the entryway is on the opposite side.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
The ocean is a bit calmer here on the northeast corner than it
was to the south, though you are still unable to hear yourself speak.
Southwest from here is what seems to be a domelike formation that may
be the entryway to the dense, underwater structure.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
You're relieved to find yourself on the surface of a sturdy
structure that rises from the sea. Thin strips of kelp are scattered
about the surface, making movement tedious.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
You're standing on the southeast corner of what seems to be the
surface of an underwater structure. Within the center of the surface
is a transparent, global formation. Barnacles are strewn about the
surface along with slick seaweed.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
The hemispherical entryway is transparent, and within you can see a 
dark outlet descending into the heart of the structure. The entropic
sea to the south creates such a loud uproar that all other sounds are
silenced.

rooms.name: Inside the Dome
rooms.desc:
The walls are amazingly airtight and soundproof. Thus, the blaring
sounds of the sea fade out, allowing you to hear some of the strange,
echoing sounds that come from below.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
While descending you hear what sounds like someone breathing in the
shadows below, though you're not sure if you're hearing things or not.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
An eerie, distorted moan comes from below and reverberates
throughout the conduit. Your depth of sight is limited to the small
sphere of illumination from your light-source.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
Barnacles tear at your hands and feet as you carefully nudge
yourself downwards. The lower you descend, the more humid the air gets,
making it difficult to breathe.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
A sharp scent of fish comes from below, and for the first time you
can see shimmering light below. The soothing, oscillatory sound of water
emanates all around you, reminding you that you're UNDER water in this
strange structure.

rooms.name: Underwater Concavity
rooms.desc:
This massive cavity seems to be designed such that each segment of
wall is supported by the other, and the only added reinforcement is
water-pressure. There is no other material in this room that adds
support, making the whole design ingenious. The material is unusual,
for it seems strong, yet it's transparent like a cut diamond. The whole
effect is rather peculiar. It's as if you're submerged in water without
feeling any liquid. Arched, transparent passageways lead off in all
directions.

rooms.name: Transparent Passage
rooms.desc:
A soft glow seems to come from the seafloor that illuminates everything 
faintly. Schools of fish swim below, and to your right is a flat bed of
coral. Sea creatures encircle the whole chamber, which makes you feel 
uneasy.

rooms.name: Transparent Passage
rooms.desc:
A massive shark cruises above the channel, creating a reverberative
gushing noise and a slight swaying of the passage. The pressure from the
water could shatter the passage and drown you instantly, though whoever
or whatever build this seems confident in its design, so you should be
too--right?

rooms.name: Transparent Passage
High-pressured Chamber
rooms.desc:
You hear a slight ringing in your ears due to the extreme pressure in
this chamber. The whole room is like a hollowed out globe, with the lower
half submerged in the seafloor and the upper exposed to the waters. The
seafloor glows bright orange, making the chamber feel like a burning
sphere of light.

rooms.name: Northeast of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
To your west you can see the entrence, and southwest from here is a
thin ladder that protrudes from the top of the globe, allowing one to
climb into an upper chamber. It's difficult to stand here, for the walls
slope upward due to the spherical interior of this chamber.

rooms.name: Within a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
Due to the sharply angled walls it's difficult to stabilize your 
stance. To the west you can see a thick substance that drips from
the axis of the global chamber. It leads up into an upper loft, which 
seems to serve as some sort of observatory. Your clothes are illuminated
by the glowing seafloor, making you light up like a firefly.

rooms.name: Southeast of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in the southeast area of a global chamber, and to your west
and north is the ladder-like substance that leads upwards into another
joint-formation. You marvel at the carfully placed blocks of transparent
walling. Each are cut flawlessly so that no other supporting material is
needed.

rooms.name: Within a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
Aside from the humidity and the unbearable pressure, the ambiance
is otherworldly: nudged against the translucent walls are patches of 
multicolored coral and, almost hidden below, lies purple, gray, and orange
starfish. What makes the scene so extraordinary is that you feel as if
you're completly surrounded by water, and for a moment you forget that
the walls are there.

rooms.name: Southwest of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
Pure silence overtakes you, making you feel uneasy. You glance up
through the crystalline ceiling, only to notice a small shadow move 
slowly from one side of the chamber to the other, then make a sharp turn 
in your direction. Is it outside or inside? You can't tell, but either way
it senses your presence.

rooms.name: Within a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
The walls here slope upwards, making it difficult to stand without 
using your hands for support. Looking out of the walls to the west you
see that a school of jellyfish gliding by. Light from the glowing seafloor
reflects within the translucent fish, making them appear as if they
glowed internally.

rooms.name: Northwest of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
You notice how, for some reason, the seafloor glows fainter here than 
any of the other positions within the spherical chamber. Then, suddenly, 
an anomalous, crablike creature glides across the seafloor and burrows 
underneath the chamber. Glowing streaks of gelatinous substance ooze from
the creatures mouth, which fuses with the seafloor, causing it to brighten
considerably.

rooms.name: Underneath the Observatory
rooms.desc:
A grooved, thick substance extrudes from what seems to be a formation
attached to the exterior of the sphere. It seems that the ruts in the
material function as grips, allowing one to climb easily above. For a 
moment the entire chamber is darkened. Looking up, you notice an abnormally
wide manta ray that sails by sluggishly.

rooms.name: Observatory
rooms.desc:
You shuffle around in the dark until you nudge what feels to be a lever.
Upon doing so, an illuminated liquid flows out from a bladder within the 
interior of the transparent walls. Gradually, the glowing liquid flows out 
and covers the shell of the observatory, lighting the entire area. The walls
in this area seem to magnify everything outside, amplifying your sense-
perception.

rooms.name: Tubular Pass
rooms.desc:
Gradually, the pasage descends underneath the seafloor's surface, making
the transparent walls encased with soft earth. You can see fluorescent liquid
flow through small veins through the glass-like tubing, which reveals a
labyrinth of hydraulic networks--twisting and winding about--providing light
for an otherwise dark passage.

rooms.name: Tubular Pass
rooms.desc:
Much like a tree's manifold branches that, when growing, sprout out in a
random fashion, the veins of glowing liquid spread out and intertwine,
illuminating the pass. An overwhelming sensation of wonder resinates within
this pass, and for a moment you loose track of where you are.

rooms.name: Tubular Pass
rooms.desc:
The underground network of fluorescent liquid must originate from somewhere
within the core of the structure, and from that point it flows throughout the
areas which require lighting. The complexity of this infrastructure fills you
with awe, though you doubt the creatures that live here would care for your
admiration.

rooms.name: Junction
rooms.desc:
There's a split here that resembles a 'v', allowing one to travel more
east or west depending on which direction is chosen. The luminous liquid
flows quickly through the veins, much like the branching system of muscular
tubes that carry blood away from the heart to the organs of the body.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
The material used for the walls is no longer transparent, though every few
meters there is a small, organic bulb that drops from the ceiling. The bulb is
filled with swirling, illuminating liquid, making a cone of light extend from
the ceiling that creates a circular patch of lit flooring.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
Cold vapors flow from underneath a thin slit on the ground to the north,
thereby revealing a virtually hidden door. You reach out and touch the cold,
organic surface of the door, searching for a handle, but find nothing. Almost
hidden on the east wall is a thin slot, and from this you realize that you
require some kind of key to enter.

rooms.name: Hatchery
rooms.desc:
The temperature of this room is frigid, and there is no light source.
White vapors flow fourth from the periphery of the ceiling onto the floor
like liquid, carpeting everything with a thin layer of fog. Hundreds of
thin trays align the walls, and within the trays are thousands of small,
pearl-like eggs. From each corner there are small tubes that feed water
into the trays which, in turn, creates a constant gurgling noise.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
In the distance you can hear what sounds like leaves rustling in a violent
wind; however, upon moving closer, you make out thousands of glimmering
shells moving about on the ground, clacking into each other as they skitter
about. Once amidst the activity, the shellcrabs stop and hide within their
shells for protection.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
The bulbs that extend from the ceiling resemble those found on kelp, yet
these bulbs are much larger and seem to be grafted onto the ceiling. Light
pulsates slowly, and every few minutes the passage becomes opaque. To the
north is what appears to be a door. It's hard to tell due to the vine-like
growth that covers it.

rooms.name: Repository
rooms.desc:
Hollowed compartments extend from the floor to the ceiling on every wall.
Green-tinted film covers some of the compartments, creating an airtight seal
to preserve their contents. Upon touch, the film quickly disperses away from
where you placed your finger, much like ripples in a pond moving away from
whatever ruptures the surface.

rooms.name: Translucent Channel
rooms.desc:
This conduit is slightly narrower than the others, forcing you to bend
uncomfortably as you walk. Also, unlike the other passages, this channel 
seems to descend slightly, gradually submerging into the seafloor.

rooms.name: Translucent Channel
rooms.desc:
To your west, at the end of the channel, you see an undulatory, orange
light. The entire channel slowly phases from darkness to an orange haze,
then back to darkness, making your walk precarious.

rooms.name: Covered Channel
rooms.desc:
Only a small transparent space remains at the apex of the arced ceiling,
making the channel seem more like an underground tunnel. Below you see only
dirtlike substance with stringy burrows twisting about, marking the existence
of some kind of ocean dwelling worm.

rooms.name: Brachyuraian Hive
rooms.desc:
Thousands of miniature crablike creatures are scattered about the chamber,
some half burried in crevices, others skittering about, transporting food and
material from above to create and sustain their hive. They don't seem to notice
you, and continue with their reproductive process.

rooms.name: Northeast within the Hive
rooms.desc:
The entire chamber ebbs with an orange light that emanates from within the
shells of the crablike creatures. They cling and traverse the ceiling as well
as the floor, making the entire cavern move as if it were alive. The creatures
seem to be familiar with interacting with humanoids, or humanlike beings, for
they go about their duties without taking notice to your presence.

rooms.name: Southeast within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Being carful not to step on any of the creatures, you painstakingly edge
your way to the southeast corner of the Hive. The walls and ground are damp 
and claylike, making it easy for the crablike creatures to burrow within the 
walls for the use of storage and reproduction. Small piles of kelp are
heaped in the corner here, proabably used as a food source.

rooms.name: Within the Hive
rooms.desc:
It seems that these creatures are being bred for the sole purpose of
reproducing the glowing substance they produce naturally, for this substance
can be used as a natural light source. A self-sufficient creature that can
secrete such a substance is fascinating, though the other beings who have
also discovered this would not appreciate you leaving with this discovery.

rooms.name: Southwest within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Scurrying about everywhere are young crablike creatures. Some carry in
kelp, while others scape the walls and burrow holes for housing. Each creature
seems to have a specific duty that is carried out efficiently. For the first
time you notice some of the larger--perhaps female--creatures half burrowed
within the wall to the left.

rooms.name: Within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Stockpiles of kelp are stuffed into gaping holes in the wall to the left,
providing nourishment to the larger creatures which seem to be bound to the 
wall. You assume that these larger creatures are the females, and are situated
in this fixed fashion due to their reproductive duties.

rooms.name: Northwest within the Hive
rooms.desc:
To your left is a female crab embedded within the wall, and, for a short
moment, it wiggles left and right until it dislodges itself. What is left 
behind is the rear section of its body, and dozens of newly-born creatures
scatter out from the rump, leaving only an empty shell that will be recycled
and used as food or building material.

rooms.name: Within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Infant crabs align all sections of the wall to the north, and when the
pulsating glow fades it looks as if the wall is alive. A profusion of crabs
pour out from a hole in the ceiling, and soon after they quickly seal it.
These creatures' disgusting habitat and mode of living is repulsive, and for
a moment you become nauseated with the overwhelming stimulus of their life-
sustaining activities.

rooms.name: Center of the Hive
rooms.desc:
It seems as if the creatures avoid walking within the midst of their
breeding grounds, for there is an invisible symmetric circle that they
avoid crossing, leaving a bare patch of earth beneath your feet. There is
no obvious explanation for the purpose of avoiding the center, though there
must be some reason they do not cross here. Then, around the fringes of the
circle, you notice a carcass from one of the crabs and you see many skeletal
remains from these creatures scattered about beneath your feet.

rooms.name: Underwater Walkway
rooms.desc:
Transparent material is used for the tubed passage, thus, you are able
to see in all directions, including below, for the tubing is elevated about
one meter from the seafloor.

rooms.name: Underwater Walkway
rooms.desc:
For the first time you notice thin strands that fasten to the exterior of
the walkway and extend upwards at an angle. You assume these cables are used
as support for this elevated walkway, and must connect to the solid block
from which you entered.

rooms.name: Underwater Walkway
rooms.desc:
The angle that you must ascend increases dramatically, and the whole
walkway is lifted even higher from the seafloor, almost to the point where
it's no longer visible. The water is darker here, making it difficult to see
with any depth, though you catch sight of a few fish when they swim close to
the tubing.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
Aligning the perimeter of this cylindrical, hovering chamber, is a thin
rim that appears to be used for hibernation. Glancing upwards, you realize
that the elevation of this cylinder is much greater than expected. There
must be similar hibernation quarters above, accessible by the three ladder-
like beams that are located in front and on the sides of the chamber.

rooms.name: Northwest corner
rooms.desc:
Resting on the rim to your west and north is a layer of peculiar
insulating material. You assume that the temperature of the waters drop
at times, and thus whatever sleeps here must require extra warmth to avoid
hypothermic condtions. This seems strange, however, for the humidity would
lead one to belive it's warm all year round. Perhaps the moisture comes
from somewhere else.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
An awkward, organic ladder leaders upwards through a porthole, and to
the south is a thick tube of transparent material that functions as a
brace within the center of the complex. Because of this, one can glance
through the center beam, allowing partial visibility through to the other
side.

rooms.name: Northeast Corner
rooms.desc:
A thin veneer of glowing substance is used to align the outer rim of the
bunking, creating a guiding strip of light around the border of the chamber.
The light source is faint, allowing one to espy vague figurations, though
nothing completely distinguishable.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
From a porthole in the upper loft, a thick, organic ladder stretches to
the floor. When placing your hand on the organic substance, it slowly bends
about your hand, providing a strong grasp for climbing. Eerie light ebbs in
and out, and for a moment everything is visible. Then suddenly, the light
dissipates, leaving you motionless in darkness.

rooms.name: Southeast Corner
rooms.desc:
Moisture has condensed on the ceiling and walls, leaving a thick blanket
of dampness. Every few minutes the moisture builds up on the ceiling, leaving
glistening droplets that await a minor disturbance to make them fall and
splatter. The droning sound of the droplets dislodging and falling to the
ground could potentially drive one insane.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
Vague silhouettes dance about on the other side of the transparent beam.
You cannot tell if they are alive, or whether they are nothing more than
reflections from the waters outside. Ether way, the effect makes you grow
more anxious, more tense. Whatever would call this place home is surely
mad.

rooms.name: Southwest Corner
rooms.desc:
Tediously repetitious sounds of liquid falling from the ceiling becomes
increasingly annoying, making you grit your teeth with tension. You wonder
how, due to the lack of heat within this chamber, there is so much humidity.
There must be another source that creates this moisture. To the northwest you
can see the entrance, and east from here is a strange, organic ladder that
allows access to the upper level.

rooms.name: Upper Level
rooms.desc:
Another thin bunk encircles the upper loft, allowing more space for
hibernating. There is a large bundle of insulating material resting on the
bunk here, and it looks as if something or someone could be underneath it.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
From this point, you can see a red, glowing ring at the peak of the
center-beam. You look closer and notice that it is a heat source, and
the water within the center of the beam is boiling. Small holes in the
beam open up, venting steam into the chamber. This must be used to
maintain a constant climate for proper sleeping conditions.

rooms.name: Upper Level
rooms.desc:
Pulsating light from the surrounding bunk creates a bizzare ambiance, and
at once your face is flushed with anxiety. You hear a faint humming coming
from somewhere within this chamber, though you cannot make out the source.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
Small vent holes open on the surface of the beam, spraying a fine cloud
of mist into the air. This is the source of the humidity, and its function
must be climate-control for hibernation. You notice that the water within
the beam is bubbling, and when you touch the surface, you realize that it's
extremely hot.

rooms.name: Upper Level
rooms.desc:
To the north through the transparent beam you can make out a looming,
dark figure. You quickly become still and stare at it, waiting for signs
of movement to see if it's alive. After blinking, it's gone.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
Above, at the top of the center-beam, you can see that the rim is 
glowing red-hot. In turn, this heats the seawater within the center of
the beam, and through small vents steam is released into the air, creating
a controlled climate.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
Steam vents from small holes on the wall to your east, and the glowing
veneer on the rim of the bunk pulsates. Glassy reflections move about on the
walls, and you wonder if they're coming from you or something else.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
It's extremely hot and humid here, for above you on the outside of the
structure is a red-hot circlet that heats the water within the center-beam.
Through the ceiling here you can make out the surface of the ocean, and to
your left through the walls you can see the solid structure from which you
came.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The opening in the crags to the east has allowed the formation of this
small, shallow lagoon.  Like liquid within a bowl, the crags lagoon the
water in all directions, leaving the waters fairly calm aside from a few 
humps that roll across the waters from waves that manage to break through
the small opening to the east.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
South of here are towering jagged cliffs that lean out over the lagoon,
casting a shadow over the waters. Small swells ripple through the opening 
to the east, though the water remains calm enough to traverse comfortably. 
When compared to the ocean, the lagoon is clear and relatively shallow,
making a wonderful habitat for exotic fish.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The water feels like a warm-springs due to the tropical climate, and 
because of the encompassing crags, the water remains calm and clear, 
allowing you to see through the surface. Purple sea-cucumbers and wispy 
urchins clad the lagoon's floor. West of here is a sandy inlet that 
extends out from the base of the craggs to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
There's an abundance of beautiful fish, including harmless sand-sharks, 
that glide about within the clear lagoon. You see a thin, white fish with 
yellow bands and silky threaded fins dart underneath some rocks on the 
lagoon's floor as you pass. To the west is a black-sand beach that 
stretches across to each crags' base.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
In the distance to your north and south, you see towering black cliffs 
that form a small lagoon to the east. The cliffs provide shelter from the 
raging waters, and have allowed the formation of this sandy inlet. Pale 
water surges onto the shore after each breaking wave, leaving white film 
behind at the contour of its reach. The sand is opaque, which in turn 
absorbs the heat from the sun, making your feet noticeably warmer. To your 
west is a thick, topical jungle.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
Black cliffs rise out of the sand to the north, and curve out to the 
east like a demon's horn. The tide swells inland, then quickly rolls back 
into the small lagoon to the east. A tropical jungle outlines the beach to 
your west that, upon further notice, appears to have been trimmed somewhat. 
Slash marks cover the palms, and whole bushels of various plant life have 
been mutilated, allowing a crude passage.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
To your east a calm lagoon has been formed by the island's cradling 
rock formation, and outstretched here at the shore of the lagoon is a 
small black-sand beach. West of here, outlining the beach, is a thick 
tropical jungle. Glancing further west you can see the cliffs circle 
around the fringes of the jungle in the form of a circle. From this 
observation you realize that the only way into the heart of the isle 
is through the small opening into the lagoon.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
Dark cliffs hang over the cove to the south and curl out to the east, 
forming a small lagoon. The cliffs prevent any significant ocean activity, 
allowed the formation of this small, sandy inlet. After walking about for 
a bit, you notice your footprints on the sand's surface, and while doing 
so become aware of others--others that, when observed closely, look to be 
fresly made. However, these prints are not your own. The prints recede into 
a lush jungle to your west.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
If it were not for the preclearing of paths through the jungle, moving 
about would be impossible due to the thickness of the plant life. Narrow 
trails lead off to the west and south, and to the north the isle's crags 
rise high above the tropical trees.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
Ferns, palms, sugar cane, guava trees, and hundreds of other exotic 
plant life imbue the entire area. However, every so often you notice some
sort of deformity in the foliage, as if caused by a clash between unknown
forces, tearing at each other and, in turn, destroying the environment.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
Constant chirping from strange birds and tree-animals almost drowns out
the hacking noise in the distance: a steady, repetitive chopping, much
like the noise one makes when clearing a path in the forest. Bamboo shoots 
are skattered about here, and a delicate mango tree has sprouted up within 
the center of the area.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
South of here the cliffs curve around and continue back into the jungle. 
You can hear the lapping of the lagoon's waters to the east, and also a faint
hacking noise in the distance to your west. The humidity here makes your 
breathing difficult, and holding onto your weapon becomes increasingly 
challenging with a damp grip.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
The crags block passage to the north and east, and continue to stretch 
out to your west. A strange symbol has been carved into the wall of the 
north crag that seems to be placed as a territorial mark indicating the
perceived ownership of the isle. Clearings have been made to your west and 
south.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
A large tropical tree juts out of the earth here, and covering its trunk
are thousands of intertwined roots that twist about to the trunks. You see 
some monkeys springing from one branch to the next above you, and to the 
north a bit is a patch of rubber trees and bamboo.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
On the ground are a few empty coconut shells that have been crudely 
bashed open. A patch of sugar cane has been partially chopped down behind 
you as well, leaving the ground skattered with chunks of cane and leaves.
The sound of birds chirping fills the air, and all you can see is jungle
in every direction.

rooms.name: A lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
A boar's hide has been strung up on a tree here to dry along with some
kelp. To the east you can make out a small clearing, and thin paths are 
torn through the jungle in every other direction. A few ant beds rise up
from the ground, and you realize that you've been treading over a bed of 
ants the whole while.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
You notice a large, unset snare resting in the center of the trail 
here. You admire the craftmenship of the snare until, after looking up, you 
realize its full intention: the snare is designed to fling an animal--or 
human--into a bed of sharpened stakes that are fastened to a tree above 
your head.

rooms.name: A lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
Black cliffs rise up to the south and are angled such that they jut
out over the jungle a bit, casting shadows along its base. A strange 
symbol has been carved on the cliff's wall to the south that must may
be some sort of territorial marking.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Various fruit trees hang low enough for one to pluck the offerings
without stretching. Ferns and moss covered rocks cover the ground, 
making everything seem as if it were painted with a dark green. The 
island's crags rise up to the north and curve around to the west, 
allowing passage to the east and south.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Hundreds of birds inhabit the tree here, making you cringe from the 
sound of their constant chatter. Small felines skatter upon sensing your
presence, as if conditioned to be hypersensitive to potential danger.
The trails taper off here, making passage difficult, though you manage
to cut yourself a path wherever you please, except west, where a large
boulder blocks your path.

rooms.name: A Jungle Clearing
rooms.desc:
Fastened between two palms is a bench, and a braided roap made out 
of kelp has been strung across further up the palms to hold bags of 
food off of the ground and out of reach of animals. A fire pit has also 
been constructed out of large shards of black rock. Palm leaves are 
resting upon wooden beams that are secured on various trees, forming 
sturdy roofing designed to keep the area dry during rains.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
A faint buzzing noise comes from the south, and narrow trails have 
been carved into the jungle in almost every direction. You can see the
sky for the first time here through a small opening in the tropical 
trees. Arrrg! The mosquitoes are driving you mad! You decide to move
on before they eat you alive.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
A bright, multicolored bird rests at the base of a trunk here that 
quickly flutters away when you get too close. A wasp hive has been 
plastered to the base of a palm here, and swarms of wasps buzz in and 
out of the hive, paying no attention to your presence.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Cliffs continue to encircle the jungle, halting passage to the south.
The surrounding jungle seems to be left undisturbed compared to the rest 
of the island, making you feel more alone and at ease. Somewhere to the 
northeast you hear a cacophony of birds chattering and chirping.

rooms.name: Somewhere in the Void
rooms.desc:
You float in nothingness - or perhaps stand on nothingness, which is
firm beneath your feet. All is dark, except for the glowing portals that
lie in the cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Secluded Grove
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a grove of strange, and possibly
magical trees which climb into the sky all around you. In the middle
of the grove, you can see a strange grass with a blueish tinge. It's 
hard to see anything beyond the trees of the grove.

rooms.name: In the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the common room of the Lakeshore Tavern. The rough -
hewn walls of stone hold many portraits of heroes and legends from the
past. Maybe one day, you could have your portrait here too. The tables
and chairs surrounding you look comfortable and inviting, but not as
inviting as the roaring fireplace to the east.  
   To the southeast, a bar where one can order drinks or food seats 
thirsty patrons.

rooms.name: In the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing before a roaring fireplace in the Lakeshore
Tavern. The warmth of the fireplace is very comforting, as is the
general atmosphere of the tavern. It's no mystery as to why so
many people like to come here.
   Just south of here, the back door of the tavern leads out to
the docks.

rooms.name: On the Docks at the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the old wooden docks just behind the Lakeshore
Tavern.  Looking out east over the beautiful Lake Kialoren, you can
only wonder at the majesty that is nature. The fast flowing Bhyroga
River flows into the lake just north of you. To the south, you can
see the back door of the Lakeshore Tavern.

rooms.name: In the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing just before the back door of the Lakeshore Tavern.
The common room is full of life as people sit around at tables with
mugs of ale, recounting numerous tales of bravery and heroism. Just
south of here, you can see the bar, where fine food and drink is 
served.
   To the north, a cozy fireplace is embedded in the wall.

rooms.name: On the Docks at the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing on some old wooden docks just behind the Lakeshore
Tavern.  Looking out east over the beautiful Lake Kialoren, you can only
wonder at the majesty that is nature. A door to your west goes to inside
the Lakeshore Tavern.

rooms.name: In the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
The common room bustles with life and looks very much as if it never
dies.  The wooden spiral stairs leading up to the second floor here seem
like they've been here for centuries, but they're just as firm as when
they were first put in. A welcoming bar to the east offers refreshment.

rooms.name: In the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing beside the bar inside the common room of the Lakeshore
Tavern.  The worn and polished bar looks grand, despite its age. The aged
innkeeper stands behind the bar, directing his workers with a kind, but 
firm tone of voice.  Waitresses walk in and out of the door to the east
that leads to the kitchen.

rooms.name: The Kitchen of the Lakeshore Tavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the kitchen of the Lakeshore Tavern. People are hard
at work here, trying to make the wonderful food that the tavern offers to
its patrons. The smell of the food being cooked here is absolutely delightful.

rooms.name: A Narrow Pass Through the Mountains
rooms.desc:
You have entered a narrow pass. On both sides of you, the granite walls
climb steeply up and out of sight. The ground has been covered with sand in
the manner of a semi-primitive road. You feel almost trapped in the small
space that you have. The pass continues to the north.

rooms.name: A Narrow Pass Through the Mountains
rooms.desc:

steeply up and out of sight. The ground has been covered with sand in the 
manner of a semi-primitive road. You feel almost trapped in the small space
that you have. The pass continues to the north, while the entrance to the
pass lies just to the south.

rooms.name: A Narrow Pass Through the Mountains
rooms.desc:

steeply up and out of sight. The ground has been covered with sand in the
manner of a semi-primitive road. You feel almost trapped in the small space
that you have.

the entrance to the pass.  The pass continues to the south.

rooms.name: At the Southern Entrance to a Small Village
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a small village. Looking inside, you can see
that the village and villagers are semi-primitive, though the village's
walls are made of granite and look as if they could withstand a decent
sized army.
   The gate to the north is generally left open, as if travelers are very
welcome here. You notice that the temperature has dropped dramatically
since leaving the pass.
   There is a small sign here.

rooms.name: Inside the Village
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a small fishing village. You watch as busy people
go about their daily lives. All around are small uninteresting looking huts.
You hear what sounds like some sort of auction to your east. It's pretty cold 
in here, but nothing you can't handle.

rooms.name: The Marketplace
rooms.desc:
You have entered the marketplace. All sorts of people are here selling fish,
fish, and more fish. You try to find vendors selling something else, but with  
all the fish vendors, the others seem to get lost in the crowd. You hear what
sounds like an auction to the north and east. It's much warmer in here with 
all the people crowded together.

rooms.name: The Marketplace
rooms.desc:

vendors and merchants have firm holds on some territory here in the
back.

rooms.desc:

thing this village has to an inn. There are a few pallets on the ground, 
and this DOES at least seem like a good place to rest your weary bones. There

rooms.name: At the Northern Entrance to a Small Village
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a small fishing village. The large granite
wall and the locked gates look very impressive, and not very welcoming.
   To the north, east, and west, the valley you are in is mostly frozen
tundra, but you can just make out a lake far to the north.  To the south,
you see the village gates. It's very cold out here.

rooms.name: A Frozen Valley
rooms.desc:

The valley is very hilly, and you have a hard time walking here. In all 
directions, you can see the mountains looming above you. To the south, you 
can see the small fishing village known only as Bhyroga. You're freezing your 
ass off, better have some damn thick blankets for the night.

rooms.name: In Freezing Water

insane? There is a passage down under the ice to the north, full of more 
freezing water, but you are unsure if you should stay down here long.

rooms.name: In Freezing Water
rooms.desc:

in your extremities and the cold water has sucked the life out of your lungs.

rooms.desc:

It's a large cave, and appears to have been abandoned for decades, but you
hear a loud snoring sound coming from the room to the north. Wonder what it
could be? Below you, there is a hole leading to some freezing water.

rooms.name: The Hidden Cave
rooms.desc:

awakened the beast, and he doesnt look too pleased about it. The temperature
is so cold in here that you're afraid to flex your fingers.

rooms.name: A Treasure Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the ice dragon's treasure room!! Better take what you can get
before he finds you.

rooms.name: A Small Cave
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small cave. All around you, you see animal hides
made into the shapes of beds - very large beds. The walls are covered with
primitive art and soot.
   To the south, the cave opens up in to a passage leading east.

rooms.name: A Small Cave
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small cave. All around you, animal hides have
been made into the shapes of beds - very large beds.  The walls are 
covered with primitive art and soot.
   A passage leads out to the east.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use.
   The passage here opens up into two small caves, one to the north, and
one to the west.  The passage continues to the east.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use. 
   The passage south of you opens into a large cavern.  To the west,
the passage continues.

rooms.name: A Small Cave
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small cave. All around you, animal hides have been
made into the shapes of very large beds. The soot-covered walls exhibit 
primitive art and sketches.
   To the south stretches an east-west passage.

rooms.name: An Icy Prison
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small barren cave. To the south, crude bars
block your way to a passage that leads west.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in the northwest corner of a large cavern. Scattered piles of 
ashes lie everywhere as do large piles of bones, some of which appear to
be human.
   To the north, you see a passage through the caves.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in the northeast corner of a large cavern. Scattered piles of a
ashes lie everywhere as do large piles of bones, some of which appear to
be human.
   A passage opens up to the east.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use. 
   To the west, a large cavern opens up, while to the north is a small
cave.  The passage continues to the east.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use. 
   The passage continues to the east and west, while a small cave appears
to the south.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use.
   The passage leads back to the west, while to the north, crude bars
block the entrance to a prison cell.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are on the west side of a large cavern. Scattered piles of ashes
lie everywhere as do large piles of bones, some of which appear to be 
human.
   The cavern continues to the north, east, and south.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are on the east side of a large cavern. Scattered piles of ashes
lie everywhere as do large piles of bones, some of which appear to be
human.
   The covern continues to the north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Small Cave
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small cave. All around you, animal hides have
been made into very large beds. The walls are covered with primitive 
art and soot.
   To the north, the cave connects to an east-west passage.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in the southwest corner of a large cavern. Scattered piles of
ashes lie everywhere as do several piles of shattered bones, some of which
appear to be human.
   A passage opens up to the south.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in the southeast corner of a large cavern. Scattered piles of
ash lie everywhere as do piles of broken bones, some of which appear to be
human.
   The cavern continues to the north and west.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use.
   To the west, the caves lead into a frozen valley, while the passage
continues to the east.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use.
   The passage north of you opens into a large cavern and continues to
the west.

rooms.name: The Field of Mars
rooms.desc:
You stand within the Campus Martia, the Field of Mars.
Martial statues and ivy-draped columns impart a sense of 
imperial majesty and splendor.  Chariots of gold and silver
and the arms of a thousand legions wait within the massive walls
of this godly field.

rooms.name: A field of wheat
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of the estate of Cedric the Saxon, just inside the gate.
A field of wheat lies here, sorted into carefully cultivated rows.  Filthy
farmhands toil about in quiet solemnity.  Wind whistles through the wheat,
across the still and endless prairie.  To the east, the gate leads to
freedom from this place, and in all other directions lie Cedric's lands.

rooms.name: Among the fields
rooms.desc:
The wheat field extends north here.  Overseers walk along the palisade,
keeping serfs in line.  Hands work the land, harvesting a petty crop.
Grains of wheat sway in the breeze, in their timeless prairie dance.
The palisade curves around to the west from the south here.

rooms.name: A peaceful vineyard
rooms.desc:
You stand within a great assortion of grapevines, arranged in
perfect rows by the peasantry.  Stands have been erected to guide
the vineyards to their ultimate growth.  The air smells of sweet grapes,
fermenting in the golden sun.  A thorny palisade to the north keeps the
peasants working the fields without hope of a better life, hemming in their
dreams by blocking the thought of freedom outside the walls.

rooms.name: A grazing pasture
rooms.desc:
You stand within a pasture fit for grazing animals.  Chaffs of
wheat flop tro and fro, swaying in harmony with the quiet prairie
breeze around the pasture.  Animals feed upon the long grasses and
from a community trough, basking in the sun in contentment of their
simple lives.

rooms.name: At the gate of a feudal manor
rooms.desc:
This is the outer gateway of a lordly manor house to the west.  A
sturdy palisade wall bristles with menacing wooden spears to the west.
running north and south past the gate.  Over the wall, you can see serfs
toiling at the earth and harvesting crops.  A dirt path leads through the
gate to the manor, but the gate itself is shut and locked, indicating
that the lord is not accepting visitors.

rooms.name: An apple orchard
rooms.desc:
A rustic apple orchard lies here in the corner of Cedric's estate.  The
trees are aligned in 3 straight rows of ten, and burst with a bounty of
fruit ripe for the picking.  The palisade curves to the west from the north,
extending toward the manor.  This is a nice, shady respite from the rest of
Cedric's crude estate.

rooms.name: A chicken coop
rooms.desc:
It is rather fowl in here, and rather foul as well.  Chickens are
unceremoniously arrayed in cages around a rectangular shed.  Hay lines the
floor, which is slathered with a slimy white ooze of chicken crap.  The noise
of clucking chickens, outraged and pleading their case to the world for rescue,
is palpably obnoxious.

rooms.name: A field of rutabagas
rooms.desc:
Turnips are aligned here in linear rows of fastidious design.
They smell of earthy freshness, and are in fine season.  The field
of sumptious rutabagas is fenced in by a palisade running east to west
from the south, ending in the stone wall which comprises the castle of 
old Cedric.

rooms.name: An orchard of tangerine trees
rooms.desc:
You stand within an orchard of tangerine trees, complemented by a
series of cumquat trees.  Red colored citrus fruit grows in abundance
among the trees of the orchard ready to be hand picked by various serfs.
The palisade runs north and south here, leading toward the gate which
extends into the castle of Cedric to your west.

rooms.name: Entranceway to the manor
rooms.desc:
The fields of Cedric end here in a small grassy patch before an
iron portcullis to the west which leads into Cedric's castle.  Sturdy
walls of stone run north and south, and above the portcullis lies the
coat of arms of Cedric's family.  Two stone lions flank the gate,
and a smattering of men stand here guarding it.  To the north, south,
and east are the manorial lands of Cedric.

rooms.name: Inside a lordly courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand within the courtyard of the castle.  The area is abuzz with
merchants, peasants, and tradefolk walking to and fro toward their assorted
tasks.  The courtyard features several small gardens and trees to spruce up
the otherwise cold stone layout.  A stairway leads toward a guard tower above
the portcullis, and doors lead into the castle to the west, north, and east.

rooms.name: A fortified barbican
rooms.desc:
You stand within a barbican constructed over the entranceway into
Cedric's manor.  The room is circular and consists of solid stone,
except for a series of murder holes in the eastern wall which provide
a vantage point for archers to defend against potential attackers.
The furnishings are sparse, in typical military fashion.  Exits lead
north and south along the wall, and a ladder leads down into the courtyard.
Two powerful ballistae have been stationed at large murder holes for defense.

rooms.name: Along a crenellated wall
rooms.desc:
This is a well fortified stretch of wall in Cedric's castle.  Extending
thirty feet over solid ground, the stone walkway offers an unobstructed
view of the lands to the east.  Merlons have been cut into the walls,
offering areas for defenders to fire arrows or drop stones or burning
objects upon besiegers, Upon a pair of parapets, two mangonels
rest in menacing readiness.  The walkway along the wall extends to
guard towers in the north and south.

rooms.name: The Northeastern Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is a circular tower of stone, like the seven others posted around
the walls of Cedric's fortified country manor.  Slats in the wall reveal
the meeting of mountains and forest in the distance.  Exits lead
west and south along the wall, and a ladder leads downward.
Someone jotted an interesting carving in the wall with a blade.

rooms.name: On top of the wall
rooms.desc:
This stretch of wall connects the barbican above the portcullis and the
guard tower to the south.  The ramparts are strong here, several layers of
stone able to resist even mangonels.  Although modest in size, Cedric's
quadrangular castle is compact and sturdy.  A sweeping view of
the plains beyond Cedric's walls is offered from this spot.

rooms.name: The Southeastern Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
You stand within a circular tower among the walls of Cedric's
manor.  Sparse surroundings of a table and pair of chairs accompany
the circular room of stone, which features several murder holes for
defenders to view and attack potential attackers.  A ladder leads
down into a storeroom, while exits lead west and north along the walls.

rooms.name: The chapel of Our Lady Saint Torres
rooms.desc:
In the crowded interior of Cedric's manor house, only this humble
space could be spared for worship.  The pews consist of four benches in
two rows, before which a pulpit of carved wood is presided over by the
chaplain. The chapel is modest, with a packed dirt floor and old
pictures of canonized saints hanging about.  The scullery is north,
the courtyard lies south, and a door leads west to
the scalding house.

rooms.name: The scullery room
rooms.desc:
This is just a space used for facilitating the many hard
tasks of the busy kitchen.  Spread about are round basins
of hot water, being scrubbed by maidservants.  Bottles of
agents used for general cleaning lie on crude shelves nailed
into the wall.  A smaller basin of water is filled with
dirty clothes. The scullery opens into the adjacent kitchen
to the west, a ladder leads downward to the larder, and a
door opens south into the chapel.

rooms.name: A bountiful pantry
rooms.desc:
The fruits of Cedric's enforced slave labor abound in this
corner of the manor complex.  Bales of wheat and sacks of oats,
grains, and starches are stacked in a chaotic manner about the
wooden floor, leaving nary a space for proper walking.  There's
enough food here to last the manor for months if besieged.
A pulley and a ladder lead up to the scullery, and doors open
west to the spicery, east to the poultry, and south to the
saucery.

rooms.name: The Saucery
rooms.desc:
This is a small area responsible for the preparation of sauces.  The
ingredients, mixing bowls, and vats of the finished product fill the
meager open spaces of the room.  Kitchen hands scurry about,
assisting the saucerer in preparing for the next feast.  The saucery
smells strongly of ripened herbs, and the air is hot and thick from 
the smoke of boiling gravy.  Doors lead north to the larder, west to
the wine cellar, and east to the poultry.

rooms.name: The Poultry
rooms.desc:
This is where Cedric's favorite food is kept.  The purchase and
preparation of poultry is done here by the poulter.  Chickens hang
in rows along the walls, having been skinned and cleaned.  The room
is kept cool by its subterranean location, preventing the chickens
from spoiling.  Exits lead north to the chandlery and west to the
saucery.

rooms.name: The Chandlery
rooms.desc:
This area in the underbelly of Cedric's manner is responsible for making 
candles, and storing candles and wax.  The air is thick with an 
indistinguishable chemical smell, and dried drops of wax litter the
floor. All manner of candles rest unlit on the walls, ready to be placed in 
candelabra throughout the manor, serving the crucial role of providing light 
in the otherwise dark mansion.  Openings in the wall lead west to the larder 
and south to the poultry.

rooms.name: The Main Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This is one of the larger rooms in Cedric's manor, and the
culmination of the ancillary food preparation rooms.  Here,
the ingredients assembled below are cooked in cauldrons over
open flames and prepared on a long counter by several kitchen
hands.  The floor is tiled, clean, and swept frequently.
    A wonderful assortion of smells waft up from the various
dishes being prepared.  The area is incredibly busy, with
most of the traffic coming and going through the buttery to the
west toward the main dining hall.

rooms.name: The Spicery
rooms.desc:
This is the area from which spices are called by the main chef to
be used in the dish du jour.  Racks and racks of spices, both from
Cedric's fields and imported from abroad, line the walls on all four
sides of this quaint room of wood and dirt.  
The air is resplendent with fragrance from the spice racks,
shifting from an eastern to a northern to a western theme as you
move about the room.  The spices are stored on the racks in small
glass bottles and beneath in large wicker baskets.  A table in the
center of the room serves to apportion the spices as requested by
the chefs above.

rooms.name: A well stocked wine cellar
rooms.desc:
This room abounds in racks of wine, aged to perfection by
years of patience.  Some of finest vines of Cedric and his
ancestors have been resting in the bottles in this cellar for
decades.  Newer choice selections from every season, climate,
and vineyard from across the realm complement the aged wines
in this fine stone cellar, which could well suit the banquet
of any king.  A wooden wine rack rests against the wall.

rooms.name: The Scalding House
rooms.desc:
You stand within a house of blood and meat and carcasses, a
slaughterhouse worthy of simultaneous praise and scorn.
The great animals collected from the plains are butchered
here, sliced up into portions and stored in cooled trunks
in the confines of this already chilly room.  Vents in the
walls prevent putrefication, and monkey boys scurry about,
wiping the blood from the floor and walls.  Doors lead
north and east to the kitchen and chapel.

rooms.name: Along the walls
rooms.desc:
You stand along the crenellated walls of Cedric the Saxon's
manor house.  They tower over the fields below, able to be
easily defended due to their prominence and strength. A
cobbled stone walkway extends east and west toward guard
towers.

rooms.name: Along the walls of Cedric's manor
rooms.desc:
You stand atop a mighty wall of stone which provides the
exterior protection for the manor of Cedric the Saxon.
The ramparts along the walls extend outward to project
maximum firepower upon any besiegers who think themselves
capable of capturing these noble walls.  The walkway
exits into guard towers to the east and west.

rooms.name: A garlic field
rooms.desc:
You stand within an overgrown field of garlic.  Rows and rows
of cloves and those of rose propose to enclose and impose upon
you and those with droves of blows in the pose of grows and not
a bit mo's.  You can walk east to a mushroom pasture, west to a
grassy knoll, or you can just sit here and contemplate being.

rooms.name: The Marshalsea
rooms.desc:
This is the area in Cedric's manor where law and order are centered.
The layout is all business, designed for functionality over comfort.
The floor is cold stone, and a desk rests in the center of the room.
Four jail cells line the western wall, locked tight.  Deputies help
the Marshal to keep track of the prisoners and their sentences.  To
the north, a door opens into the courtyard, and a door also leads
south.

rooms.name: Inside the holding cell
rooms.desc:
This room is filthy and the stale air is rank with the stench of
unwashed men and feces.  Even for a prison cell, this room is
especially offensive to the senses.  Not a single thing has been
provided for the comfort of the men held here; no toilet, nowhere
to rest or sleep, and extremely meager servings of food.  Clearly,
to come afoul of Cedric's temper is a costly choice.

rooms.name: A Peaceful Green Streamside
rooms.desc:
This is a small area of greenery and shade between the manor to the
south and a stream to the north, flowing alongside the mountains. Men
fish along the stream, joking and talking.  Serfs have fallen to
sleep under the cool shade of a few dogwood trees.  You can hear a
gentle tune being played by a duo somewhere nearby with a mandolin
and pan flute.  The smell of flowers, the beauty of light reflecting
off the water, and the grass blowing gently in the wind make you a tad
inclined toward a rest as well.

rooms.name: A mushroom pasture
rooms.desc:
You stand ankle deep within a pasture of many a mushroom,
cultivated for use in local cuisine and export abroad for profit.
The soil is damp, black, and warm from the sun's glow.  The palisade
continues around from the southeast to the northwest, and the
interior of Cedric's manor is barely visible over the stone walls
to the southwest.

rooms.name: Map Room
rooms.desc: There's a map here for immortal use.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone corridor curves east and south here. From somewhere in the
distance, you hear the sound of a large roaring, as if from some great
beast.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridor turns sharply to the west, and continues eastward. It's
dark as pitch, and every hall looks the same.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The hallway continues east and west, and the sounds of your boots ring
loudly on the stone floor.  The sound carries well, as you can hear the
sounds of other creatures moving elsewhere in the darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone hallway leads east and west into darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor stretches interminably, yet seems to be leading due east
and west, though it's hard to tell after being down here for any length of
time.  Your sense of direction is lost in this darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor stretches interminably, yet seems to be leading due east
and west, though it's hard to tell after being down here for any length of
time.  Your sense of direction is lost in this darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor stretches interminably, yet seems to be leading due east
and west, though it's hard to tell after being down here for any length of
time.  Your sense of direction is lost in this darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridor opens into a large room to the east, and continues back
into darkness to the west.

rooms.name: A Large Room in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This large room is seemingly hollowed out of solid stone, but by whose
hand is unknown.  The craftsmanship looks nothing like the careful work of
dwarves, nor does it look like it was done by any type of tool you've ever
seen. It almost looks CLAWED out by something. Eyeing the debris on the 
floor in front of you, you feel like this is the home of that something.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone hall turns eastward to the north, and continues southward
into darkness.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone corridor curves east and south here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This hallway is strewn with garbage and bones, most of which are so
old that they don't stink - much.  The hall leads east and turns south
west of here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The garbage-lined hall is quite long, leading east and west. The trash 
gets deeper to the east.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The trash and debris in the hall are about knee-deep here. The rough stone
walls are turning slimy and black from all the rotting garbage.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The garbage reaches crotch-deep levels in this part of the hall. You probe
gently ahead for pitfalls.  Sinking into this mess would be like bathing in
a toilet.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
Wading through the waist-high garbage, you suddenly think of MANY things
you'd rather be doing. Actually, you can't think of anything much worse. 
The hall continues east and west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The maze of halls continues into deep trash to the west, and turns
southward east of here. The level of stench and refuse is less in that
direction.

rooms.name: A Turn In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The slimy, rough rock tunnel turns south and west here, both ways as
dark as a bat's wings.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The rough stone walls of the labyrinth allow you to continue north and
south.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The rough stone walls of the labyrinth allow you to continue north and
south.

rooms.name: The Noisy Cave
rooms.desc:
The source of the screeching that echoed through the labyrinth can be
found here, in the midst of its own waste and corpses of tons of rats.
The exit is to the east.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
A loud screeching fills your ears from the west. The rat population
seems much less dense here.

rooms.name: In the Labrinth
rooms.desc:
The rats that have milling about your feet seem to disperse at some
unseen signal. Suddenly, a loud screech fills your ears from the west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone corridor that entombs you leads east and west. A loud animal's
screech pierces the air from the west, and the tunnel makes a sharp turn to
the east.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The corridor turns here, leading south and west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This long stone corridor turns just north of here, and continues south
past the extent of your light.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The rough stone walls of the labyrinth allow you to continue north or
south.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
A large junction of passages is to the south, and the current hallway
continues north.

rooms.name: A Furnished Room In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
Strangely out of place, this room is lit by the soft glow of candles,
and is home to a bed, chair, table, and several other domestic necessities.
A fresh pot of rat stew boils over a small fire that fills the room with
acrid smoke.

rooms.name: In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
Smoke rolls out of a lit room to the west.  The labyrinth continues to
the east.

rooms.name: A Junction In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The tunnel splits east, south, and west here. Smoke fills the chamber
and becomes thicker to the west.

rooms.name: In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
There is a split in the tunnels to the west, and the corridor dead-ends
to the east.

rooms.name: A Dead End In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridor comes to a end here, at a large pile of refuse teeming
with rats and other vermin.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone tunnel turns to the north, and opens into a junction south
of here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads north and south into darkness.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This large junction has passages leading off in all directions but west,
yet none of them look more inviting than another.  To the east there may
be another junction but it's just too dark to tell.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This huge room has exits in all directions - large openings to the north
and east, and two smaller ones to the south and west.  Huge rats, although
fearless of humanoids, still skitter away from your light.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridors lead south and westward here. The steady sound of dripping
water rises from the south (along with a horrid stench), and a large series
of junctions opens to the west. A steady tide of rats run from your light
as you approach, and nip at your heels as you pass.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labrinth
rooms.desc:
The tunnel opens into a junction to the north, and turns southward east
of here.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads west and south here.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads east and south here.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The tunnel branches off north, west and south here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads north and south into darkness.

rooms.name: A Narrow Corridor in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This tunnel is more narrow than others you've seen, and seems to narrow
into no more than a crack to the south.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This small tunnel is packed with fat rats, all scampering over each other
to get out of your way. A junction opens up to the north, and southward the
tunnel continues.

rooms.name: A Wet Corridor in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This north-south corridor is filled with the stench of raw sewage.
Unfortunately for you, its also filled WITH raw sewage. Brown muck
covers your boots and leggings. The rats everywhere seem to love it.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor runs north and south. The scent of smoke fills the air from
the north.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The tunnel stops abruptly here at a dead end.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: This corridor runs north and south. There's a junction to the north.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor runs north and south - or are you walking in circles?
It's too dark to tell.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The already narrow rock tunnel narrows down to just a slit in the wall
here.  You can continue back north, or squeeze into the misty blackness to
the west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The labyrinth turns sharply just south of here, and continues back north.
The endless chittering of the rats is beginning to grate on your nerves.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
A steady stream of liquid waste flows from a hole in the ceiling here,
much too small for you to crawl through, even if you could stomach it. A 
pool of sludge fills the room, serving as a great breeding ground for the
denizens of the labyrinth.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The tunnel suddenly ends here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth

The dismal swamp suddenly erupts in a cacophony of noise as a flock of
hawk-billed birds swoop from a nearby tree, disturbed by your passing.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The inky blackness of the swamp waters hides whatever it is that keeps
nibbling on your boots. The darkness around you is still and complete.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp stretches out in all directions, each as unappealing as its
neighbor.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A giant igauna, its scales glinting off of the meager sunlight, reminds
you momentarily of its great ancestor the dragon, hoarding its treasure
somewhere not quite as uncomfortable as this swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
Your entire body seems to be inundated with the grainy slime of the swamp.
You crave a warm bed and cold bottle of ale.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
To the east you spy a crudely carved stone obelisk. The swamp stretches
in all directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A small stone totem pole sticks out of the damp ground. You can make
out runes of healing engraved into it's surface. This seems to be a good,
if not safe, place to rest.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp seems alive with life, but all of it hides, as though afraid
of you, or more likely, silently stalking you.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The sun seems to struggle to push its light this far; the very air
around you absorbs the heat of the meager rays.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The swamp is almost still here; water striders the size of your fist
glide effortlessly across the mirror-like surface of the black water.

Raucous cries of swamp birds fill your ears, but you can't see anything
in the trees around you.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

Something under the murk of the swamp slithers between your boots. You
hope it doesn't have any bigger siblings.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A small corpse hangs from a noose tied high in a tree here. It looks very
old, and judging by the stature, it could be dwarven. You wonder why someone
was hanged here - or perhaps he hanged himself?

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A sudden current of water and sludge sucks you under, but you manage
to surface, disoriented and half-drowned.

Petrified tree trunks are packed so close that travel east or west is
impossible. The natural "alley" created by the formations leads you north
and south.

Thick scrub and intertwined tree limbs bar all further progression.
The only path is back south.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The waters are very peaceful here, and you feel a strange electricity
in the air to the west.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
A flurry of movement out of the corner of your eyes causes you to glance down,
and you see a mass of lizards, slithering over each other in a frenzy. The
living ball slowly sinks in the murk of swamp...

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness
rooms.desc:
The black waters of the swamp tug at your spirit almost as hard as it tugs
at your boots; sucking you lower in the quagmire.
