your boots. The murky waters of the swamp swirl deeper to the east.

The muddy swamp water rises to knee depth here, and seems even higher
to the south. To the west your prodding reveals higher ground.

rooms.name: Lost In The Swamp of Sadness

A steady current stirs the water, pulling it slowly south. Bits of
debris and rotting vegetation float by.

raft made of their peers, floats by you. You keep a sharp eye out for
other such tiny hazards that could make your days of adventuring much
shorter.

A slurping sound alerts you to an opening beneath the surface of the

the ground beneath your feet. It seems much to narrow for you to traverse, 
but looks none-too-appealing even if you could.

find an escape.

A petrified tree trunk snags on your boot just beneath the surface of
the swamp. You fall to one knee, cursing the desire that brought you into
this accursed place.

rooms.desc:
The swamp is impassable in all directions but west here; petrified trees
stand at strange angles to the swamp floor, barring your way and blocking out 
the meager light of the sun far above.

ire.

skeletal fingers. Every shadow seems to be alive, and nowhere seems
to lead to an exit from this unending murk.

rooms.name: The Swamp of Sadness

here where the waters of the swamp pour down a narrow opening in the swamp
floor.

rooms.name: Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
This is Aralius's new zone.
Map and/or Descrip goes here.
Dont forget to REDIT SAVE 47, MEDIT SAVE 47, etc. when done editing.

rooms.name: Entrance to Sulfur Fur Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the base of a tall, rocky mountain.  A winding trail
leads northward, up the slope, into the mountains beyond.  Around you,
thin, brown grasses sway in waves, driven by a sulfurous wind which seems
to come from the mountains.

rooms.name: Dense Underbrush
rooms.desc:
You are being torn apart by wild roses and thorns.  All around you, wild
vines and foul-smelling flowers curl and wind their way around the pines
and rocks.  You cannot travel any further to the south or west, so thick
are the trees and growth.  The brush to the north and east seems to offer
some relief from the tearing vines.

rooms.name: Thick Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing among tall pines.  Firs and hemlocks tower silently
above you, blocking out both the wind and the snow that may be above
the branches.  On the ground, you see sulfur-yellow moss on some of
the rocks nearby while on the trees themselves, pale green patches of
lichens add contrast to the dark terrain.  Forest surrounds you on all
sides, but proves impenetrable to the south where tall rocks intermingle
with the trees.

rooms.name: A Mossy Cliff
rooms.desc:
You stand in a forest surrounded on two sides by tall cliff walls.  Pale
yellow moss hangs like sulfurous fur off the sheets of vertical rock
which impede your progress to the east and south.  To the north, the
pine forest continues, while to the west, underbrush and rocks clutter
the space between the trunks of the firs around you.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
and ash which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.
To the north and east, this strange cavern of debris continues, while
to the west, the cavern wall blocks your progress with impassable rock
formations.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
and ash which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.
To the north and west, this strange cavern of debris continues, while
through a crack in the cavern wall to the east, you can see an ash-
covered valley floor.

rooms.name: A Smoldering Valley
rooms.desc:
Ash covers the moist gound here.  All around you, the haze and smoke of
recent volcanic activity make you cover your mouth to breathe. To the north
and east, the valley floor continues, while to the west, a break in the
canyon wall seems to lead to some sort of open cavern.  To the south, 
a massive cliff wall extends sharply out of the ground.  Bits of patchy
yellow moss cling to its surface.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:
You are standing on firm ground, surrounded by walls of hardened lava.  It
appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the northeast.  To the north and east, boulders left by the former
glacier litter the terrain, while to the west, ash and smoke follow the
air currents inthe valley.  The south boasts only a cliff of basalt and
obsidian.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:

appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the northeast.  To the north, east, and west, boulders left by the
former glacier litter the terrain, while to the south, an enormous cliff
of basalt shelters you from the volcanic winds,

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket

appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the north.  To the north and west, boulders left by the former glacier
litter the terrain, as they do here, all around you.  To the south and
east, enormous cliffs of basalt protect you from the volcanic winds.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the slope of a mountain.  To the north, the path
you are resting on splits, separating into a trail leading north into
higher mountains and west, around a glacier on the slope.  To the south,
the mountain trail descends to the lowlands while on either side of you,
high cliffs of ice and snow impede your progress to the east and west.

rooms.name: Underbrush
rooms.desc:
You are standing in thick, dense scrub.  Woodland vines and rocks make
walking treacherous here as twigs and stumps rise from the yellow moss
on the ground.

rooms.name: A Forest Trench
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small depression in the forest.  Tall evergreens
and rocks surround you as the scent of sulfur and decay mixes with the
pines to make you dizzy.

rooms.name: A Forest Trench
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small depression in the forest.  Tall evergreens
and yellowish rocks surround you.  To the east, a tall mountain wall 
rises, impeding your progress in that direction while the forest continues
to the north and south.  To the west, the trench continues.

which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.  To the
north, south, and east, this cavern continues, while to the west, the
cavern wall blocks your progress with impassable rock formations.

To the north, south, and west, this cavern continues, while to the

the haze and smoke of recent volcanic activity make you cover your mouth
to breathe.  To the north and south, the valley floor continues, while to
the east and west, cliffs of basalt and hardened lava impede your travel.

to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far

glacier litter the terrain, as they do here, all around you.  To the north
and west, solid walls of hardened lava rise against you.

to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far

former glacier litter the terrain, as they do here and all around you.
To the north, a wall of hardened lava forms upward from the ground.

rooms.name: A Glacial Pocket
rooms.desc:

appears as though a massive glacier was here at one time, giving its life
to stop the flow of lava from the volcano which you can hear roaring far
to the north.  To the south and west, boulders left by the former glacier
litter the terrain, as they do here, all around you.  To the north and
east, enormous cliffs of basalt protect you from the volcanic winds.

rooms.name: A Mountain Fork
rooms.desc:
Here, three mountain trails converge on a snowy plateau.  To your north,
the trail continues, flanked on both the eastern and western sides by 
tall faces of rock.  To your east, the trail descends down a slope into
a pine forest, while behind you, the trail leads down into the lowlands.
You can smell ozone, as if there was a recent lightning storm.

rooms.name: Entry to Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the base of an enormous pine forest.  Evergreens and
hemlocks stand silently, offering their subtle, woodsy scent to the crisp,
cold air.  Scattered here and there across the ground, a yellow, almost
furry moss grows in heaps on rocks emitting the faint scent of rotten eggs.
To the north and east, this forest continues while to the west, a tril
leads up the slope.  To the south, a few rocks and underbrush slow and
eventually impede your progress.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, thick pine
branches intertwine to block out much of the mountain sunlight and cast
the forest floor into shadow.  The forest surrounds you on all sides, 
though a trench appears to the south, disrupting the smooth terrain.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing amidst a grove of thick pines and shrubs.  Scurrying
animals and birds rustle fallen cones and leaves here, searching for 
grubs and other edibles.  To your north, south, and west, the forest
continues, while to the east, a massive mountain wall extends abruptly
from the forest floor.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.  To the
north, a trickle of water breaks through a crack in the wall while to the
south and east, the cavern continues.  The western wall seems unstable,
as though the debris could topple at any moment.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a closed canyon.  At one point in the past, this
place obviously had a ceiling, but much of it appears to have collapsed
into the stalagmites around you.  Above you, you can see the dark smoke
which blots out the sunlight, leaving the area in eternal dusk.  To the
north, a trickle of water breaks through a crack in the wall while to the
south and west, the cavern continues.  The lichen-covered wall to the 
east looks smooth and unmarred by the collapse.

rooms.name: A Smoldering Valley
rooms.desc:
Ash and patches of yellow moss cover the moist gound here.  All around you,
the haze and smoke of recent volcanic activity make you cover your mouth
to breathe.  To the north, a canyon extends out of the reach of the haze.
To the south and east, the valley floor continues, while to the west, a
solid face of rock impedes your travel.

rooms.name: Smoke and Ash
rooms.desc:
You are standing on unstable, volcanic ground.  To the north, a river of
lava seems to come out of the mountains and flows eastward, cutting off
most of your travelling options.  To the south, a wall of hardened lava
and pumice forms a barrier for the flowing molten rock, forcing it to
travel eastward, away from you.  Ash and smoke spout upward from flares
of fire in the ground.  The ground could give way at any moment.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Vent
rooms.desc:
You are standing before a vent in the volcano.  Rivulets of lava
stream from the hole which seems to lead deep into the mountains.
   Clouds of ash and dust choke you as you avoid the deadly puddles
of molten rock while gusts of superheated air rush from within the
mountain to blast you at the vent.
   You can enter the mountain to the east or return toward the cooler
climes to the west.

rooms.name: A Trodden Mountain Path
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a snowy mountain pass.  Smooth, white snow and ice
blanket the ground in an even layer of rime.  The cliff walls which 
surround you on both the east and west drip with frozen water, forming
slalactites of frigid ice.  To the north, the trail continues to a bend
while to the south, the trail descends down the mountain.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north and west, mountain walls
impede your travel while to the south and east, more of the forest
allows easy passage.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, thick pine
branches intertwine to block out much of the mountain sunlight and cast
the forest floor into shadow.  The forest surrounds you on the east, west,
and south, while a mountain cliff blocks any travel to the north.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing amidst a grove of thick pines and shrubs.  Scurrying
animals and birds rustle fallen cones and leaves here, searching for
grubs and other edibles.  To your north, south, and west, the forest
continues, while to the east, a mountain lake appears, catching the 
water runoff from the peaks to the southeast.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Lake
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the surface of Sulfur Fur Lake.  The cold, clear
waters from the the mountains around you have drained off to create this
body of water.  Below you, down in the depths of the lake, you can see
piles of pale yellow stones.  The lake continues to the east, while dry
land rests to the north and west.  To the south, a waterfall drops out
of the mountain, impeding your progress in that direction.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Lake
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the surface of Sulfur Fur Lake.  The cold, clear
waters from the the mountains around you have drained off to create this
body of water.  Below you, down in the depths of the lake, you can see
masses of pale yellow rocks.  The lake continues to the west, while dry
land can be seen to the north.  To the south and west, tall mountain
walls form the edges of the lake.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north, the canyon seems to stretch forever, while to
the south, the canyon seems to open into a smoldering valley.  The heat
is almost desert-like in that direction, though the ash seems to thin
out, allowing easier travel.

rooms.name: The Bend in the Trail
rooms.desc:
Here, it appears that someone has been trying to remove signs of travel.
Pine branches have been used to smooth over footprints in the snow, 
leaving evergreen branches and needles across its too-smooth surface.
The cliff walls bend sharply here, forming an impassible wall to the
north and west.  To the east, a well-trodden path exposes a rocky ground
while to the south, the trail proceeds between the cliff faces, down the 
mountain.

rooms.name: The Antali Gate
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a cul-de-sac.  Tall, ice-covered cliffs block your
progress to the south and east, while an enormous iron gate stands closed
to the north, built into the cliff itself.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north and west, mountain walls
impede your travel while to the south and east, more of the forest
allows easy passage.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north and west, mountain walls
impede your travel while to the south and east, more of the forest
allows easy passage.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees.  Around you, high
mountain walls and pine branches meet to prevent light and heavy winds
from touching the ground here.  To the north, mountain walls impede
your travel while to the east and west, more of the forest allows easy
passage.  To the south, you spot a large body of water.

rooms.name: Sulfur Fur Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand below a canopy of tall hemlock trees at the exit of the forest.
To the north, a mountain valley opens between two enormous cliff walls,
while to the east, a solid face of rock impedes your progress.  To the
south, you see a lake which seems to extend back to the southwest and the
forest.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north and south, the canyon seems to stretch
forever.  You feel tired as you plow your way through knee-high 
sulfurous ash.

rooms.name: An Antali Home
rooms.desc:
This stone and mortar dwelling serves as a small fortress against the
cold and the driving winds that tend to ravage the village.  Skins of
snow leopards and tigers almost completely cover the cold stone floor
of this one-room house whose walls display the trophies of those whose
skins blanket the floor.  A lone hearth stands against the western wall,
its fire within cracking cheerfully.

rooms.name: An Antali Village
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside the gate of an Antali village.  These northmen
seem to have fortified a small settlement among the peaks and cliffs 
and forged a tight bond of unity.  The village appears to be small
with shops and guardhouses lining the main street which seems to end
at some sort of ceremonial temple.  To the north, the street continues
while to either side of you, buildings stand solidly against the cold.
To the south, you see the exit from the village.

rooms.name: An Antali Home
rooms.desc:
This stone and mortar stronghouse serves as resistance against the
cold and driving winds that tend to ravage the village.  Skins of
snow leopards and tigers almost completely cover the cold stone floor
of this house whose walls boast the heads of those beasts whose skins
blanket the floor.  A lone hearth stands against the eastern wall, 
stone cold.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a mountain valley.  To the west and 
south, solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east
and north, the valley continues to wind among the peaks.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the north and south,
solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east and west, the
valley continues, leading you higher into the peaks.  You can see a few
prints here in the snow.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the north and east,
solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the west, the mountain
valley continues, leading you higher into the peaks.  To the south, tall
trees form the beginning of a forest.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north and south, the canyon seems to stretch
forever.  You feel tired as you plow your way through knee-high 
sulfurous ash.

rooms.name: An Antali Shoppe
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a stone fortification.  Thick, solid stone walls
shelter you from the blasting winds outside as well as protect the 
goods within.  Around you, thick skins and stone hunting weapons line
the floor and walls, indicating that the inhabitants of this village
care only about survival, not conquest.

rooms.name: An Antali Village Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the main streeth of the Antali village.  Shops and
guardhouses line this street which ends further to the north at some
sort of religious establishment.  To the south, you can see the entrance
to the village.

rooms.name: An Antali Guardhouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a massive stone fortification.  High walls of dark
stone surround you.  Several Antali guards are here, talking quietly and
stoking the hearth which rests in the southern wall.  The walls and floors
are spartan, as though the guards need only the chairs and the tables
they converse at to fulfill their duties.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a mountain valley.  To the west and
north, solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east
and south, the valley continues to wind among the peaks.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the north and south,
solid walls of rock impede your progress, while to the east and west, the
valley continues, leading you higher into the peaks.  A single jawbone of
some animal is here, sticking out of the ground.

rooms.name: A Mountain Valley
rooms.desc:
You are standing between two high mountain cliffs.  To the south and east,
solid walls of ice-covered rock impede your progress, while to the west and
north, the valley continues.

rooms.name: A Canyon Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of an ash-filled canyon.  Smooth yellow
cliff walls rise high to the east and west, forming a smooth north-
south path.  To the north, you see a trail bend sharply up a mountain
as it breaks away from the canyon while to the south, the canyon seems
to continue forever.

rooms.name: The Tower
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the base of a locked tower.  A circular staircase
ascends to a locked and barred door just above you.  Around you, a few
pieces of wood and debris litter the floor as though no one has visited
this place recently to clean it.

rooms.name: An Antali Village Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the main streeth of the Antali village. A tower and
some homes line this street which ends here at an enormous temple.  To 
the south, the street continues back toward the entrance to the village.

rooms.name: An Antali Home
rooms.desc:
This stone and mortar stronghouse serves as resistance against the
cold and driving winds that tend to ravage the village.  Skins of
snow leopards and tigers almost completely cover the cold stone floor
of this house whose walls boast the heads of those beasts whose skins
blanket the floor.  A lone hearth stands against the eastern wall, 
stone cold.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous clawmarks mar the exposed stone
of the cliff walls, as though they had been scratches by an enormous
beast who wished to keep its claws in prime condition.  To the west,
the trail continues into the mountains, while to the north, the trail
winds its way through snow and ice as it climbs higher into the peaks.
Everywhere else, ice-covered stone walls prevent your progress.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous clawmarks mar the exposed stone
of the cliff walls, as though they had been scratches by an enormous
beast who wished to keep its claws in prime condition.  To the west, 
the trail continues into the mountains, while to the east, the trail
meets a junction of other paths.

rooms.name: A Mountain Junction
rooms.desc:
Snow is really beginning to pile up here in drifts.  To the west, the
mountain valley ascends to a plateau before narrowing into a simple
mountain trail.  To the south, the valley descends down the mountain.
Strangely enough, the mountain wall to the west has a crevasse in it
which seems to rapidly descend down a slope.  The scent of sulfur is
strong and you can see yellowish moss on the mountain wall by the
crevasse.

rooms.name: The Base of the Cliff
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of a steep cliff.  A climbable trail curves
up the cliff face to the west to an opening in the cliff.  All around you,
sulfurous moss grows on pale trees and shrubs.  You feel very, very warm,
and the ash on the ground indicates some volcanic activity nearby.  An
outcropping of rocks, perhaps the face of a new mountain, blocks the way
to the east, while clear trails run north and south from here.

rooms.name: Snow Mage's Sanctuary
rooms.desc:
Skulls and bones litter the floor around you as you step through the
cluttered room of parchment and skins.  An enormous cot rests against
the northwestern corner, providing a comfortable resting place for
the holy mage of the tribe.
To the north lies a door made of ice -- you guess it to be at least
three feet thick.

rooms.name: The Mead Hall
rooms.desc:
You are standing in both the cultural and religious center of the village.
Here, ceremonies and rites of passage are conducted as are feasts and
other village functions.  On the floor, an enormous glyph rests, painted
in red, the symbol of snow magic.  Similarly, a matching symbol appears
on the door to the east and above the steel door to the west, which appears
to lead outside.

rooms.name: The Training Yard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a pile of snow.  Here, outside the Mead Hall, young
warriors practice their skills on animated snowmen with wooden weapons.
Occasionally, you see the scurrying of an enchanted snow rabbit which is
a common target for young Antali archers.  Around you, three stout cliffs
wall you inside the training yard.  The only exit lies back to the west.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous clawmarks mar the exposed stone
of the cliff walls, as though they had been scratches by an enormous
beast who wished to keep its claws in prime condition.  To the west,
the trail continues into the mountains, while to the south, the trail
winds its way through snow and ice as it descends the peaks into the
valley below.  Everywhere else, ice-covered stone walls prevent your
progress.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
You are on a snowy mountain path that winds its way northward into the
peaks above.  Here and there, enormous claw and tooth marks blemish the
exposed stone of the cliff walls.  There is a strong scent of decay 
here which seems to come from the north, over the mountain wall.  To the
west, the trail continues down the mountain while to the east, it bends
northward around the next peak.

rooms.name: A Mountain Trail
rooms.desc:
Deep snow makes this part of the trail almost impassible.  All around you,
tall white mountains and ice blanket the terrain in a frozen sheet.  To
the north, the trail continues to the peaks while to the west, the trail
begins to slope gently back down the mountains.  All other directions are
blocked by ice.

rooms.name: A Sulfurous Canyon
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a canyon.  To both your east and west,
tall, even walls block your progress as bits of ash and dust rain down
upon you.  The Sulfur Fur, the yellow moss on the canyon walls, seems
to glow a bit as the ash falls upon it.  To the north, the canyon bends,
while to the south, the canyon opens into a broad field of trees and
shrubs.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Lair
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the lair of a white dragon.  You can see little
that is different from the outside chamber, save the scattering of 
coins on the cavern floor and the enormous piles of snow all around
you.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: A Mountain Lair
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the lair of an enormous beast.  Crushed stalactites and
stalagmites litter the floor and bases of the cavern walls.  Further to the
west, you can make out something white and glittering, as though a vast
chandelier was hanging from the chamber ceiling and refracting the light.
To the east, the cavern continues toward the exit, while to the north and
south, solid cave walls block your progress.

rooms.name: A Mountain Cavern
rooms.desc:
The cavern seems to be getting cooler as you travel to the west.  Pools
of frozen water tell you that the air is below freezing.  Solid walls and
stalagmites impede your travel to the north and south, though you can
travel westward, deeper into the cave or eastward, toward the cave exit.

rooms.name: A Mountain Cavern
rooms.desc:
The cavern seems to be getting cooler as you travel to the west, though
pools of water on the floor tell you that it is not quite freezing.  
Solid walls and thick stalagmites impede your travel to the north and south,
though you can travel westward, deeper into the cave or eastward, toward
the entrance.

rooms.name: A Mountain Cave
rooms.desc:
The frigid winds of the mountains outside are absent here among the
stalactites of ice and stone.  Around you, bones and scraps of fur
litter the cavern floor.  There are solid walls to both the north and
south, impeding progress in those directions.  To the west, the cave
leads deeper into the mountain, while back to the east, the cave entrance
is becoming covered with snow.

rooms.name: A Mountain Peak
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the top of a tall mountain.  Strong winds and sleet
pelt your face and hands as you strain your eyes to examine your surroundings.
To the north and east, snowdrifts impede your progress.  To the south, the
trail continues down the mountain.  There seems to be a hole in the snow
to the west.  Its angle suggests that it slopes down, into the mountain.

rooms.name: A Canyon Bend
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a canyon.  To the north and west, tall
canyon walls impede your progress while to the south and east, the
canyon continues under the rain of ash and dust.

rooms.name: A Canyon Bend
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bend of a canyon.  To the north, south, and east,
tall canyon walls impede your progress while to the west, the canyon
continues under the rain of ash and dust.  There appears to be some sort
of crevasse in the wall to the south, but debris and the sheer narrowness
of the opening make searching it futile.

rooms.name: In Space
rooms.desc:
You step through the door and into inky blackness. The doorway behind you
is gone, and to the north is the only way your body is allowed to move.

rooms.name: The Docks of XiXieqi
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the docks of an active seaside village.  Fishmongers
and fishermen haggle over the prices of the seafood in their junks as they
inhale the saline stench of the ocean and the sea life.  Everywhere, 
citizens rush to make purchases of fresh food and imported goods to take
home to their awaiting families.  To the south, east, and west, the docks
continue, while to the north, the open sea invites you for a long sea
journey.

rooms.name: Xixieqi Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the midst of a busy dockyard.  Burly men carry
barrels and crates about the yard while both loading and unloading
cargo from incoming ships and junks.  The scent of fish and seafood
is overwhelming here, making the dockside shops to the east seem very
inviting.  To the north, the docks of Xixieqi meet the open sea, as
ships sail past to dock immediately to the west where the sea foam
comes up over the open pier.  To the south, the street continues, 
toward the heart of Xixieqi city.

rooms.name: Qitiexi Street At The Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the southern end of a dockyard.  Horsedrawn carriages
trot past you as their yellow-skinned drivers scream at you to get out of
the way.  Beneath your feet, you can see where the street that creeps in
from the south disseminates into the common dockyard around you.  To the
north and east, the dockyard surrounds you, while to the south, a street
leads into the city.  You notice the dock end just footsteps away to your
west and opt not to go for a swim in the churning waters.

rooms.name: Qitiexi Street
rooms.desc:
You are dodging fast-moving people and carts in the middle of a busy
street.  Beneath you, the gravel is worn into depressions where many
years of travel along this lane have left their indentations.  The
street continues to the north and south, while shops line the eastern
side of the road.  To the west, a few fishing stalls have opened up 
along the seaside.

rooms.name: Qitiexi Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing just north of a populated city square.  All around
you, yellow-skinned men and women bustle about their daily duties, 
scrambling about their business.  The street to each side of you is 
lined with busy venders; each trying to hawk his valuables on passers-by.
The street continues to the north, while to the east and west, an
herbalist and a fishmonger's stall invite you to examine their wares.

rooms.name: Maoqi Square
rooms.desc:
You stand before an enormous monolith.  Here, three streets converge
as if to pay homage to the black spire which seems to stab at the sky.
Oddly enough, you feel a rhythmic pulsing coming from the spire.  As
you look up at it, you notice thick grey clouds gathering at its tip,
as though they were being drawn into its peak.  To the north, south,
and east, shop-lined streets and shacks invite you to explore this
city.

rooms.name: Dinxi Street
rooms.desc:
You seem to be standing in the residential section of the city.  Here,
older ladies and children converse and play, discussing complaints of 
their daily lives and plans for the future.  To the east and west, shacks
and other small dwellings which house the population line the streets,
while to the south, the street continues further into the residential
part of the city.  To the north, a city square hosts an enormous black
monolith.

rooms.name: Dinxi Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a garbage-strewn street.  It appears
as though the residents of this city care little for the conditions of
the city outside their homes as is evident by the amount of old cloth,
crumpled paper, parchment, and other garbage which lines the streets
on both sides.  To the east and west, you can see homes, while to the
north and south, the street continues.

rooms.name: Dinxi Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a garbage-strewn street.  It appears
as though the residents of this city care little for the conditions of
the city outside their homes as is evident by the amount of old cloth,
crumpled paper, parchment, and other garbage which lines the streets
on both sides.  To the east and west, you can see homes, while to the
north and south, the street continues.

rooms.name: The Corner Of Dinxi And Maojeng
rooms.desc:
Here, the residential district of the city of Xixieqi ends at a
sharp corner.  No alleys provide any space to the west and south, 
though the streets continue to the north and east.  All around you, 
you can hear the noise of screaming mothers and wailing children.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: Xixieqi Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a busy dockyard.  Burly men carry barrels and crates
about the yard while both loading and unloading cargo from incoming ships
and junks.  The scent of fish and seafood is overwhelming here, making the
dockside shops to the east seem very inviting.  To the north, the docks of
Xixieqi meet the open sea, prohibiting your travel as there is no dock
to greet you, while the dockyard continues to both the west and south.

rooms.name: Xixieqi Dockyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a busy dockyard.  Burly men carry barrels and crates
about the yard while both loading and unloading cargo from incoming ships
and junks.  The scent of fish and seafood is overwhelming here, making the
dockside shops to the east seem very inviting.  To the north, the docks of
Xixieqi meet the dockyard, while to the west, you see a main street enter
the dock area.  You notice yet another dockside shop to the south.

rooms.name: Soo Lin Tao's Distillery
rooms.desc:
All around you, bottles of distilled water, brewed rice wines and
whiskeys, and fermenting fruit juices rest in barrels and kegs which
line the walls.
   A single proprietor, Soo Lin Tao looks at you as you enter and
inspect the bottles of alcoholic items he has stored on his shelves.

rooms.name: Hrenchao's Herbs And Potions
rooms.desc:
You stand dizzily as this room's powerful scent of cloying herbs
and sweet roots assail your senses.  All around you, flowers, pollen,
odd leaves, and vapourous potions line shelves and fill open crates
that occupy this tiny shop.
   There is a door to the west, leading to the street and a smaller
one to the east, most likely leading to this shop's storeroom or
second floor.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and sacks as they
rush about their business.  
   You can see an herbalist shop to the north, as it evident by the
sign which bears a twisted ginseng root resting against a pale blue
bottle of liquid.  To the south, you see the wall of someone's two-
level home.  The street continues to the east, and terminates to your 
west where a tall monolith springs from the junction of three streets.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the west is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the west is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the west is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.  This east-west street appears to 
turn sharply to the west, around the side of the home to the north.  To
your south, a locked wooden gate prevents you from entering what appears
to be a ruined temple of some kind.

rooms.name: Temple Of The Sands
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a ruined temple.  A cracked statue lies sideways
on a perched and diased marble altar against the southern wall while
threadbare tapestries lie half-eaten by insects on the floor.
   There is an exit to the north.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a marvelous inn and restaurant.  Tables and
benches line the walls and surround the tables which are covered
with fine seafoods, dumplings, and goblets of wine.
   To the west, you can see the dockyard, while to the east and south,
the restaurant continues.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a marvelous inn and restaurant.  Tables and
benches line the walls and surround the tables which are covered
with fine seafoods, cold sushi, and bottles of fine brews.
   To the west and south, you can see painting and tapestries cover
the walls, while to the north and east, the inn and restaurant
continues.

rooms.name: Distillery Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the back room of a distillery.  Here, barrels of
wine and casks of ale stand open, ready to fill glass bottles for sales
to common patrons.  An enormous crate of bottles stand open, corks
resting in a small box beside them.
   There are no windows here, and the only exit you see lies to the
west.

rooms.name: The Herbalist's Back Room
rooms.desc:
Here, herbs and plants hang in clusters from the ceiling.  Bitter
and foul-smelling roots and garlic seem to overwhelm the more pleasing
scents of ginseng and powdered orangeseed which occupy bottles on the
floor.
   The only apparent exit from this room is back to the west.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and sacks as they
rush about their business.
   You can see the wall of an herbalist's shop to the north, as it evident by
sign off to the west by its door.  To the south, you see the entrance
to someone's home, while the street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A Sage's Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the house of a kindly, old man.  Around you, wicker
and reed furniture invites you to relax and read the tomes of lore on the
shelves of this room.
   As ashtray on a central table shows evidence of burnt opium and a pale
green tobacco.
   The exit is to the south.

rooms.name: A Sage's Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing comfortably in the house of a kindly, old man.
Around you, wicker and reed furniture invites you to relax and listen
to the wise one's legends and tales.
   Smoke from his pipe fills the room with a thick, almost nectar-like
aroma.
   You notice an open doorway to the north while the exit lies to the
south.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a stout, solid house of wood and bamboo.
The place appears to be well-tended and is obviously more than just a
home.  To the south, a warehouse blocks most of the street in shadow,
though as you try the door, you find it solid, as if the door was false.
   The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Warehouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an enormous square room.  All around you, mouse
droppings and rats scuttle about the bare wooden floor, seeking out
any available tidbit of food.
   There are no windows here and only the solid door to the north
provides any exit.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights Common Room
rooms.desc:
All around you, yellow-skinned men and women partake in the feast
which is spread across each table.  To the east, a set of stairs leads
upwards to the sleeping rooms, while to the west, the inn continues.

rooms.name: Lin Chao's Brine Delights Bar
rooms.desc:
Before you stands the bar.  A lanky, yellow-skinned man stands
behind the bar, pouring rice and wheat whiskey into a small class.
On the bar is a registry book.  It appears that the barman is also
the innkeeper here.
   To the north and west, the inn continues, while to the east, 
behind the bar, you can hear the sounds of sizzling food and 
clanging pots.  The southern wall is solid, but boasts an elegant,
if not tattered, silk tapestry.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a damp, musty chamber below the herbalist's shop.
Here, mushrooms grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus
which appears to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming
from somewhere, as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   To your west, you can see a stone wall whose bricks are stacked in
columns and not the usual center-on-edge form.  To the south and east,
the basement of the shop continues.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing below the herbalist's back staircase.  Here, mushrooms
grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus which appears
to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming from somewhere,
as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   The stairs you came down are above you, while the mushroom chamber
continues to the north and east.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and sacks as they rush
about their business.
   You can see a wall to the north, probably part of a house.  To the south,
you see a newly-renovated home, perhaps that of a merchant.  The street
continues to the east and west along this cobbled lane.

rooms.name: An Elegant Home
rooms.desc:
Unlike much of the bamboo city around you, you stand in a home of
wood, brick, and mortar.  Apparently, the owner of this place is
sufficiently wealthy to invest in better, longer lasting materials.
   A lone fireplace rests against the southern wall, and as you 
investigate the home, you find similar hearths in each of the rooms,
all apparently connected to a central chimney overhead.
   The only exit appears to be to the north, the way you came in.

rooms.name: The Channeling Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in a dark room whose shelves are lined with ancient tomes
and bottles of captured wispy gases.  In the center of the room, an
old, wrinkled man in stained robes sits at the head of a wooden table.
   Suddenly, the table begins to rattle, as though it was being lifted
by an unseen force.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the south is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a decrepit house, while to the south, you 
see the local law enforcement facility.  The street continues to the 
east and west.

rooms.name: The Constable's Office
rooms.desc:
You have just entered a busy room.  Here, clerks and other petty
bureaucrats issue and stamp licenses, keys, and permits to foreigners,
tradesmen, and nomads who wish to peddle their wares within the city.
   The constable himself is in the back of the room, mercilessly berating
one of his underlings for some infraction.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the landing of the inn's stairwell.  The hall
extends on wooden floors to the east, where many doors can be seen
lining its southern wall.  Below you, you can see the main room of the 
inn and smell the crispness of chilled and frozen sushi as well as
the steam rising from the shellfish in the kitchen below.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the midst of a busy kitchen.  Yellow-skinned
men and women shout at each other in this crowded room, demanding
more space for their dishes and more wood to keep the cooking pots
and fires hot.  All in the kitchen notice your presence and none 
appear to be happy with you for adding yet another body to the
crowd.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a damp, musty chamber below the herbalist's shop.
Here, mushrooms grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus
which appears to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming
from somewhere, as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   To your east, you can see a stone wall whose bricks are stacked in
columns and not the usual center-on-edge form.  To the south and west,
the basement of the shop continues.

rooms.name: Below The Herbalist Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a damp, musty chamber below the herbalist's shop.
Here, mushrooms grow in herb-treated compost, adding potency to the fungus
which appears to be ready for picking.  You can feel a cold draft coming
from somewhere, as though you were standing in a cave, and not a basement.
   To your east, you can see a stone wall whose bricks are stacked in
columns and not the usual center-on-edge form.  To the north and west,
the basement of the shop continues.

rooms.name: Mito Avenue
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a busy street.  Around you, people, mules, horses,
and some strange six-legged pack animals bear boxes and crates as they rush
about their business.
   To the north, you can see a red-brick wall, which strikes you as quite
out of place in this city of mortar and bamboo.  The brick seems to extend
to the building to the northeast.  To the south, a small, modest home bears
the signs of neglect, as though the owner had died or been too old to tend
it.  The street continues to the east and west, meeting a junction of three
streets just off to the east.

rooms.name: An Unkempt Home
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small wooden hut.  Only one large room comprises this
structure which houses a simple cot, small coal-burning brazier, and a
dry larder.
   Dust is everywhere and appears that no one has been in this place for a
very long time.

rooms.name: Yao Tai's House of Channeling
rooms.desc:
You appear to be standing in an antechamber.  A lone woman is here,
staring at the ceiling as if she hears voices coming from it.  As you
cast your gaze upon her, you notice that she seems to exist in some
different place - as though she were really a projection of the person
she appears to be.
   The room is spartan, with only eastern and western doors.

rooms.name: Nijen's Glass and Lamps
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a glassblowers shop.  Piles of
white sand occupy most of the floor as it spills from holes in burlap
sacks on the floor.  A broad chimney in the northern wall apparently
houses the molten glass which the master craftsman blows into bulbs
for lamps and fashions into shotglasses.
   The exit to this shop is to the south.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a shop of some sort, perhaps a glassblower's
shop judging by the amounts of stained glass and windchimes in the front
of the shop.
   To the south, you see a guardhouse, obviously used to monitor traffic
in and out of the southern gates of the city just to the southeast.
   The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Guardhouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a guardhouse.  Through the eastern window, you
see yellow-skinned guards inspect and question those who enter and exit
the city.
   Here, in the shade of the guardhouse, guards sit around a table, 
playing bones, polishing weapons, and swearing as they gamble and lose
to their companions.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: Ping Xiao's House Of Pleasure
rooms.desc:
You are being pushed around in this massive crowd of drinkers.  Around
you, yellow-skinned men serve food, drink, and hot, moist towels to the
seated patrons who anxiously await their meals.
   Before you is a polished bar.  Spilled rice whiskey and wine add spots
of discolour to the otherwise well-maintained serving area.
   As you look around, you can see that the only way out of this place is
to the south.

rooms.name: Ping Xiao's House Of Pleasure
rooms.desc:
You stand amidst a crowd in this busy tavern.  All around you, yellow-
skinned men serve food, drink, and hot, moist towels to the seated patrons
while avoiding the occasional trip from a stray foot or outset chair.
   To the north, you can see tables, rowdy people, and gamblers playing
around a bar, each here to enjoy themselves in whatever activity they can
participate in.

rooms.name: Qing Crossing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the junction of three streets.  Here, a strange red-brick
tavern greets you with the sounds of fluted songs and the clinking of
glasses coming through its door to the north.
   To the east and south, roughly cobbled streets extend into city,
while to the west, the street runs smoothly on crushed gravel and well-
maintained cobblestone slabs.

rooms.name: Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the crude cobbles of a well-travelled street.
All around you, burly men seem to be coming from alleys and side streets
to enter and exit the building to your east.
   Judging by the number of sweaty, yellow-skinned men leaving the place,
and the sheer size of those who do, it appears to be some sort of sparring
hall or arena.
   The street continues to the north, where it neets a junction at an odd
brick building and to the south, where it extends toward the southern
city gates.  To the west, you see a sturdy fence separate you from an
old hut.

rooms.name: Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the crude cobbles of a well-travelled street.
All around you, burly men seem to be coming from alleys and side streets
to enter and exit the building to your northeast.
The street continues to the north, where it meets a junction at an odd
brick building and to the south, where it extends toward the southern
city gates. To the east and west, you see shops, though barred and
closed windows offer no information as to what they may be.

rooms.name: Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the crude cobbles of a well-travelled street.
All around you, yellow-skinned men and women walk with their sacks
and goods, each eyeing the other suspiciously, as if their wares
were prizes worthy of jealous guarding.
   The street continues to the north and south, while the walls of
buildings prevent travel to the immediate east and west.

rooms.name: Maojeng At Wen Tan Lane
rooms.desc:
You are standing at a busy intersection.  Caravans from the desert
and dry plains to the south come northward from the city gates to the
south, all laden with goods from distant lands and the desert itself.
   Streets lead off in all directions, though the gate to the grasslands
and the desert lies to the south.

rooms.name: Xixieqi City Gate
rooms.desc:
You are standing among a crowd of people.  Merchant caravans and nomads
speak to the gateguards, occasionally slipping them a few coins as they
pass into the city from the south.
   Just outside the southern gate, you see a lush grassland, but the dry
wind that blows through the gate tells you that the desert is not too far
beyond it.
   To the north, you see an intersection, while you notice you are flanked
by guardhouses to the east and west.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, foul-smelling room.  Crates of bones lie
beside sacks of pestels used for crushing bone shards into powder.  The
stench in here is overpowering and reeks of decay.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Ta'lon Chao's Mystic Marvels
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a foul-smelling shop.  The shelves on the walls
boast a variety of snuff bottles, each containing some powdery substance,
while the wooden counter to the north boasts several strips of glowing
bamboo and other hardwoods.
   There is a door to the north, probably a storage room, while the exit
lies to the south.

rooms.name: Chiang Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on crude cobblestones in the middle of the street.
A few people ignore you as you walk by, though most look upon your odd
skin colour and wonder about your origins.
    To the north, you can see the entrance to some sort of shop.  Its
window boasts stained glass depictions of dragons and its sign appears
to bear some sort of compact bottle.  To the south, a tall establishment
boasts a wide set of wooden, not bamboo, doors.  No signs appear near
nor on the door itself to give a clue as to what the place is.
    The street continues to the east, where it offers more shops, and
west, where it appears to meet a junction.

rooms.name: Martial Artists Training Facility
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an enormous square hall.  Yellow-skinned men as
well as a few women and feisty children spar here with staves, blades,
and bare hands.  All seem to be advancing their level of fitness rather
than their combat abilities, however, as only a few of the fighters
appear to be true masters of combat.
   There are exits to both the west and north.

rooms.name: Moo Shi's Banded Scales and Armours
rooms.desc:
You have entered a well-lit workshop.  All around you, suits of armour
made from sewn metal scales rest on wooden dummies, while scale gloves and
bootcovers hang from strong iron hooks on the walls.
   There is a counter against the eastern wall, where a powerfully built,
yellow-skinned man hammers and shapes tiny metal plates into shape.

rooms.name: Yui Gui Pan's Hides and Tanning
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a tanner's shop.  Hides of desert cattle and
grassland livestock covers the walls, awaiting tailoring into fine
suits of defensive clothing.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a shop of some sort, a cold smithy or
leatherworker's place, perhaps, judging from the yakhide on the sign in the
front of the shop.
   To the south, you see a guardhouse, obviously used to monitor traffic
in and out of the southern gates of the city just to the southwest.
   The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Guardhouse
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a guardhouse.  Through the western window, you
see yellow-skinned guards inspect and question those who enter and exit
the city.
   Here, in the shade of the guardhouse, guards sit around a table, 
playing bones, polishing weapons, and swearing as they gamble and lose
to their companions.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, cramped room.  Crates of daggers, darts,
and similar weapons rest here, stacked to the ceiling while bundles of
bamboo staves lean slanted against the iron walls.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Claw
rooms.desc:
You stand in an arsenal.  Blades, bows, staves, and other deadly items
line the walls and rest on the floor as a large yellow-skinned man stares
cautiously at you from behind the counter against the northern wall.

rooms.name: Chiang Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on crude cobblestones in the middle of the street.
A few people ignore you as you walk by, though most look upon your odd
skin colour and wonder about your origins.
    To the north, you can see the entrance to some sort of shop.  Its
window shows two hanging daggers and its sign bears a small wooden
shield.  To the south, you notice a windowless warehouse with a sturdy-
looking door.

rooms.name: A Dark Warehouse
rooms.desc:
At first, you think this is nothing more than an old warehouse with
forgotten crates of mouldy goods.  As you look further, though, you notice
that the crates are stacked in defensive positions, to give both seclusion
and secrecy for those behind them.
   In the blink of an eye, a cutthroat appraches you, dagger in reach and
asks you what you are doing here.

rooms.name: Guild Of The Katana
rooms.desc:
This is a featureless room with no windows.  You suspect that there
are secret panels among the wooden walls and floors, but can see nothing
other than the woman standing before you.
   As you look at the woman, you know immediately that she is a thief. A
small knife rests comfortably in her belt while a small set of darts
protrude from the side of her high boots.

rooms.name: Grain Storage
rooms.desc:
You have entered a grain warehouse.  Sacks of grains, both local
and imported, lie in large sacks here, awaiting the owner of the 
warehouse to pick them up.
   You see little of value here and the exit to the south looks like
its about to collapse.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a warehouse, though it could easily be
an enclosed stadium, so high are the walls, while to the south, you
see a very old hut.  The street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: An Old City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into two small rooms, both separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of rotted bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: An Upstairs Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the inn's upstairs hall.  Doors to each of the
available rooms line the southern wall.  To the north, the windows
look out upon the sea and the incoming ships which ceaselessly enter
and exit the harbour below.  The hall continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through a southern window, you can look out into the city, while to
the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, cramped room.  Crates of imported threads
and yarns rest here, stacked to the ceiling while bolts of silk and 
other cloth hang from clotheslines across the walls.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Yuang Li Tao's Fine Silks and Yarns
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a clothing store.  Kimonos, vests, robes, hose,
and slippers adorn wooden models and shelves in an attempt to catch your
eye.  A haggard old woman stands behind a counter, knitting a blanket
with some obviously imported woolen yarn.
   She smiles a gap-toothed grin at you, gesturing to the wares around
her.

rooms.name: Chiang Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on crude cobblestones in the middle of the street.
A few people ignore you as you walk by, though most look upon your odd
skin colour and wonder about your origins.
    To the north, you can see the entrance to some sort of shop.  Its
window shows nothing but its sign bears a bobtail cat playing with
some yarn.  To the south, you notice a small temple of some kind, though
to which deity it may be dedicated to is beyond you.
    The street continues to the east and west, though you notice a sharp
southward bend to it in the east.

rooms.name: Temple of the Ice Dragon
rooms.desc:
You appear to be standing in a cult temple.  Here, yellow-skinned men
kneel, cloaked in white robes, bowing before an obsidian altar.  The room
is domed, clearing showing constellations of the familiar summer sky on
its curved ceiling.  
   You notice one constellation in particular: that of the Ice Dragon, a
mythological beast that swallows worlds with hellish flames and searing
gases.
   All around you, carving and statues of Pan-Lung, the fabled dragon
adorn the statues, walls, and even the exit door to the north.

rooms.name: A City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into four small rooms, each separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the east is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of fire-hardened bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: A Monument
rooms.desc:
When the first nomads settled this town, they were victims to heavy
winds which toppled their homes and salty breezes which rusted their
equipment.  To prevent these losses, this stone house was constructed
from sea stones and clay.
   Currently, there are no doors on this building, a monument open to
all who reside in Xixieqi City.

rooms.name: Maojeng Lane
rooms.desc:
This is little more than a crudely gravelled road which runs towards
the seedier section of town.  Homes continue to line the streets, though
here and there, a warehouse appears between them, throwing shadows on
the smaller dwellings around them.
   To the north, you can see a stone structure.  Stone.  In a city of
bamboo and reeds, you question the origin of such a building.  To the
south, you see an old building.
   The street continues east and west, turning sharply north as you go
east.

rooms.name: An Old City Home
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the main room of a typical city dwelling.  The
place is divided into two small rooms, both separated by bamboo walls
and tapestry door curtains.  The door to the north is the only exit to
the outside and appears to be made of rotted bamboo stalks.

rooms.name: The End Of The Hall
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the end of the upstairs hall.  A door in the south
wall sits opposite the open window to the north, when a warm, briny
breeze blows in.  An additional window looks over the rest of the city
to the east.  To the west, the hall continues back toward the stairs.

rooms.name: A Rented Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a rented room in the upper floor of the inn.
Through the southern and eastern windows, you can see into the city,
while to the north, a bamboo door provides the only exit to the room.
   You look around at the furnishings in satisfaction.  The straw
and burlap mattress appears to have been recently stuffed, while
the hooded lantern and table appear well-polished and sturdy.

rooms.name: A Storeroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark, cramped room.  Crates of common items
such as torches, waterskins, and sacks rests here, stacked to the ceiling
while lanterns hang from dozens of hooks high on the walls here.
   There is an exit to the south.

rooms.name: Meng's General Wares
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a room full of boxes.  Backpacks, large sacks,
chests, beltpouches, and torches fill the crates and shelves of this
little shop.
   To the north, you see a set of curtains leading to another room,
but it appears to be off-limits to patrons.  To the south, you see
the entrance to the shop.

rooms.name: Corner Of Chiang And Misa
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the corner of two streets.  To your east, you see
the city wall rising high before you.  To the north, you see a shop of
some kind judging by the sign and the backpacks hanging in the glass
window.
   The streets split off to the south and west from here.

rooms.name: Misa Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the eastern wall of the city.  You can hear
strong winds whistling across the desert and dry plains just outside
the wall.
   To the north and south, this lane continues, blocked to the east and
west by both a city wall and a temple's courtyard fence.

rooms.name: Misa Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the eastern wall of the city.  You can hear
strong winds whistling across the desert and dry plains just outside
the wall.
   To the north and south, this lane continues.  A small home is to the
west, and the east is blocked by a city wall.

rooms.name: Misa Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the eastern wall of the city.  You can hear
strong winds whistling across the desert and dry plains just outside
the wall.
   To the north and south, this lane continues.  A stone home is to the
west, and the east is blocked by a city wall.

rooms.name: Corner of Maojeng and Misa
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the corner of two streets.  To the east, the
city wall protects you against the heavy winds that whip about outside
town, while to the south, a large home, obviously in disrepair, slowly
falls to pieces.  You notice with dismay that most of the roof has 
collapsed, blocking the front door with tons of broken reeds and bamboo.
   The street continues to the north and west.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a steam-filled vent.  Walls of sulfur and pumice
converge in a dome above you to form a rough ceiling.  The floor of the
vent hosts a small rivulet of dark, impure lava no more than a hand's
breadth wide which runs westward into the open air from the south.
   The vent continues to the south.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Vent
rooms.desc:
A trail of lava burns into the igneous floor here, winding its way
northward from the bend to the east to exit the chamber in a rivulet of
molten rock.  The walls to the west and south emit a sulfurous steam,
obscuring your vision in the vent as hot air blasts by you, rushing to
escape to the outside.
   Your ears are beginning to pop a bit, and you know that the pressure
will only get worse as you venture deeper into the volcano.

rooms.name: A Street Corner
rooms.desc:
You stand at the junction of two tiled streets.  A few elemental beings,
ooze elementals judging by the muddy texture of their bodies, shamble past
you in their lumbering gait, completely ignoring the lesser beings in their
path.
   The street continues to the south, where you can see the wall of the
fortress keep at the end, and to the east where beings stroll in and out
of a gaming house.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a street of crushed basalt between the wall of a 
dark building and the tall sloping edge of the cavern itself.  Here, the
clawed tracks of some sort of beast mar and scatter the gravel beneath 
you.
   To the north, the street turns sharply eastward around a corner, while
to the south, the street continues to the main keep of the fortress.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You stand just to the west of a huge bazaar.  There, daemons and all
manner of undead lords as well as elemental beings haggle and negotiate
for each other's valuables.
  The bazaar extends to the east and southeast, while the street you stand
on continues north and south.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the cavern wall which rises hundreds of feet
above you to the west.  To the east, daemons and other creatures have
set up stands and wagons to trade their native goods.
   Occasionally, you see a fight break out, perhaps a daemon with too
little patience arguing with an elemental lord.  Wisps of smoke and a
few shooting streams of yellowish blood streak from the scene of the
brawls, mostly ignored by the others in the bazaar.
   To the south, the street bends sharply as it meets the main keep
of the fortress.

rooms.name: Before The Fortress Keep
rooms.desc:
You stand at the corner of the fortress street where the cavern wall
meets the main keep.  Looking above you, you can see great black blocks
of volcanic stone comprising the wall of the keep, its pitch sheen, 
probably obsidian, absorbing the flickering torchlights and wispglows
of the bazaar.
   To the east, the street continues toward the main gate of the keep,
while to the north, the street leads past the bazaar.

rooms.name: Chamber Of The Undead
rooms.desc:
Fleshless undead daemons stand in uniform ranks here, each quiet and
lifeless, awaiting enchantment of undead life.
   The smooth walls of this obsidian chamber reflect the images of the
undead, making the dozen or so in here seem like an army of hundreds,
each gazing in a different direction and leaving no part of the room
unseen.
   Only the monstrous beings appear to inhabit this room which lies
bereft of furniture or similar items.  Fortunately, they show no signs
of animation.
   The exit lies to the south.

rooms.name: A Smithy
rooms.desc:
Strips of dead flesh hang from the lifeless guards as they lie
suspended over a vat of tanning solution.  You can see from the
suits of leather skins around the room what the strips are used
for.
   The chamber is obviously a leatherworkers shop, and his talents,
though macabre, must be admired judging from the craftesmanship.
   The exit lies to the south, while to the north, you see an open
hall.

rooms.name: Dead Guards
rooms.desc:
This corner of the fortress seems to be inhabited with the corpses
of dead daemon guards.  Lined along the wall here, the dead stare out
from behind glassy, dry eyes, no longer exuding fire, frost, or toxic
gases as they did in life.
   Still, you feel as though they may come to life.
   Tearing for gaze from them, you notice a large chamber to the north,
a portcullis of wrought iron forbidding your passage, while the hall 
entends back to the east toward the shouted orders of other guards.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a smoking tunnel of the active volcano.  The
stream of molten rock flows from out of the northern wall here, 
heading south toward the exit of the mountain.  To the east, the
tunnel continues.
   As you stand still to check the air, you notice a faint breeze of
cooler air coming from the eastern tunnel, as though the heart of the
mountain itself was dormant.
   To the north and west, cave walls of hardened lava stand before you,
while to the south, the rivulet streams toward the exit.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You cover your mouth and nose as you enter this tunnel of volcanic
smoke and ash.  The smooth walls bear the scars of intense heat which
blackened the stone itself as magma flowed eastward here from the north.
A trickle of lava flows in the middle of the tunnel, streaming eastward
toward the exit.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
An unremarkable city street, this place seem to be a path of low
traffic.  To the south, you see an open building from which the rancid
scent of burning flesh and rotten meat wafts over you, making you weak
and naseous.
   As you look west, you see the street bend southward, around the odd
building, while the street continues toward the main gate to the east.

rooms.name: A Guard Post
rooms.desc:
Though this place smells more like a carnal house, it appears as though
only brutish daemon guards inhabit this place, each sharing what appears to
be the leg of a fellow daemon or similar beast.
   Each of the guards stand well over eight feet in height, their horns
glistening and their tails swishing in delight as they devour their meal.
   The only exit appears to be to the north.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the east and south, stretching across the area
to the southeast as well.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the east and north, stretching across the area
to the northeast as well.  To the south, a street cuts in from the east,
running across the keep's gate to the south.

rooms.name: The Fortress Gate
rooms.desc:
Though unimpressive, the wrought iron gate leading into the castle's
main keep appear to be both sturdy and functional.  Flanked by two guards
on each side, the gate remains tightly closed and, judging by the stern
looks you receive from the guards, off limits to anyone who is uninvited.
   The keep rises high above you to the south, while to the north, the
bustling activity in the bazaar seems to be a delightful distraction from
the terrors and risks of living in the undermountain.  
   Beneath you, the street runs to the east and west, away from the keep.

rooms.name: Inside The Keep
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark foyer.  Obsidian slabs have been sheared
to form the tile walls and floors of this palacial fortress.  A single
black chandelier hangs from above you in this entranceway, apparently
burning a black flame that combats the light from your own source.
   To the south, the hall continues to a set of doors, while to the
north, you can exit the keep.

rooms.name: Dark Doors
rooms.desc:
You are standing before a set of double doors which have been mounted
into the southern wall.  Regal carvings have been burned into the black
doors which seem to exude an unnatural chill.
   The walls to the east and west glisten a bit as well, as though the
cold from behind the door escaped only to condense with moisture in
this hall.
   The hall continues to the north, back toward the exit.

rooms.name: A Fortress Hall
rooms.desc:
Immediately, you are assaulted by the stench of daemons.  The bodies
