of the beasts line the southern walls, watchful, though not conscious
of any intruders as they stare directly ahead.
   The hall continues to the east and west, and exits to the north 
toward the bazaar.

rooms.name: A Carved Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Strangely enough, this tunnel seems to have been carved to square
corners to form a corridor.  Obsidian flakes and stone fragments litter
the floor of the area where the lava to the west could not consume them.
   The corridor continues to the east into the darker, cooler regions
of the undermountain, while to the west, the natural tunnel bends to
the south.

rooms.name: In The Cavern Wall
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a natural fissure in the cavern.  Here, a slab
of stone has fallen neatly to form a secret stone panel leading into
the city to the south.
   All around you, the scents of rusting metal and burning sulfur fill
this area.
   The fissure leads to the east, where the terrain seems to slope a
bit downward.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are shoving your way past hideous beasts and ghastly monsters.
A few strange animals serve as mounts for their owners as they pass you
by, obviously uninterested in your coins, as it appears that gems and
blood are the currency of transaction here.
   To the north, the high walls of the cavern rise above you to form
a dome, while to the east and west, this street continues.
   To the south, however, you see a strange sort of establishment.  It
sounds as though the occupants of this city are gambling.  Judging by the
snarls, and the occasional flying body that soars out the door, it appears
that many are losing.

rooms.name: The House Of Bones
rooms.desc:
Bone dice, bone darts, and bone dust are the three biggest games
of activity in this gaming house.  Looking around, you see creatures
of all levels of existence here, each gambling vials of blood and
rare gems against one another on the next roll of the dice or toss
of a dart.
   A few burly guards, both over nine feet tall, flank the only exit
to the place to the north, while some sort of overseer, a fire daemon
from the look of him, wanders from table to table, apparently looking
for cheaters.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the west and south, stretching across the area
to the southwest as well.

rooms.name: An Infernal Bazaar
rooms.desc:
Like most bazaars in the overworld, this one features different beings
from foreign lands coming together to trade their native goods.  Here,
gems, silks, rare stones, vials of blood, bones, and other interplanar
wares are bought and sold, each item bringing a fair price to its seller.
   The bazaar extends to the west and north, stretching across the area
to the northwest as well.  To the south, a street cuts in from the east,
running toward the gate to the southwest.

rooms.name: Before The Fortress Keep
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the base of the keep's front wall.  A few spires
add decorations to the otherwise stark fortress, but the entire structure
still looks as though it was carved from the soul of an evil god.
   To the north, you can see the bazaar where trading and bickering seems
to be the rule, while to the east and west, the street continues.
   Off to the west however, you notice the main gate to the keep.

rooms.name: Pit Of Blackfire
rooms.desc:
You have entered a black room.  The obsidian walls and floors absorb
your light, leaving you in near-total blackness.
   As your eyes adjust to the dim light, you can begin to make out a
few details in the chamber.  Before you, a large, deep pit has been
carved into the floor.  In it, you can hear the crackling of blackfire
as it consumes what appears to be the phosphorescent bones of dead
fire daemons.
   Looking around you, you realize that you can see nothing in any 
direction, save for the few torchlights that occupy the hallway to
the south.

rooms.name: A Royal Hall
rooms.desc:
Fine silks and hides of extradimensional beasts adorn the obsidian walls
of this marble-tiled corridor.  Easily a hundred feet long, a patrol of ice
daemon guards stroll along this corridor, their furred tails swishing
in tune to their steps.
   To the north, the hall seems to empty into some sort of private room,
though with no door to enclose it, it must have some other function.  To
the south, a door lies set into the obsidian wall.

rooms.name: A Council Room
rooms.desc:
A large bone-legged table dominates the center of this circular chamber.
All around it, incorporeal mists shout at each other, mentally ordering
their subordinates to search and seize potential enemies of the Daemon Lord.
   It appears as though you are glimpsing through a window to a different
dimension as the beings do not seem to notice your presence and appear to
be mere images of their true selves.
   A door rests in the north wall, exiting the large, domed chamber,
while a corridor cuts in from a curved doorway to the west.

rooms.name: A Carved Corridor
rooms.desc:
Smooth, flawless obsidian surrounds you on all sides of this long
corridor which grows cooler as you travel deeper into the mountain.
Shards and flakes of obsidian lie here, obviously remnants of a time
when the walls and ceiling were more uneven.
   Standing quietly, you can hear a deep rumbling coming from below
you and can feel slight vibrations as plates shift deep below the 
surface of the mountain.
   The tunnel extends to the east and west.

rooms.name: In The Fissure
rooms.desc:
You stand among fallen slabs of rock, victims of the volcanic tremors
which tend to occur with regularity in these caverns.
   Above you, out of the reach of your light, you can hear the chirping
of blood bats who have obviously been awakened by your presence.  Still,
the tiny flying rodents shouldn't bother with what they cannot swallow.
   The fissure widens and grows deeper as you travel east, narrowing as
you look back to the west, toward the exit of this part of the cavern.

rooms.name: Inside The Fortress Gate
rooms.desc:
Daemons, devils, and a few beasts of elemental origin carry their wares
past heavily armed daemon guards and the spiked gates here.  A few of the
smaller daemons appear to have been detained for inspection by the guards,
ever wary of smugglers and illegal items.
   All around you, odd creatures seemed to have set up shop in this tiny
courtyard, a few bartering with their neighbors while others absorb the
dark splendor of the fortress and the shadowy keep off to the south.
   Streets branch off to the south and west, away from the busy main
gate.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a street that leads southward, toward a large
keep.  Daemon guards walk along the fortress wall to the east, staring
down at you occasionally, apparently recognizing you as not one of the
more advanced races.  
   A bazaar of sorts appears to the southwest and you can see the main 
gate of the fortress to the north.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You stand just to the east of a huge bazaar.  There, daemons and all
manner of undead lords as well as elemental beings haggle and negotiate
for each other's valuables.
  The bazaar extends to the west and southwest, while the street you stand
on continues north and south.

rooms.name: A Fortress Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing along the fortress wall which rises some thirty feet
above you to the east.  To the west, daemons and other creatures have
set up stalls and wagons to trade their wares.
   Occasionally, you see a fight break out, perhaps a daemon with too
little patience arguing with an elemental lord.  Wisps of smoke and a
few shooting streams of yellowish blood streak from the scene of the
brawls, mostly ignored by the others in the bazaar.
   To the south, the street bends sharply as it meets the main keep
of the fortress.

rooms.name: Before The Fortress Keep
rooms.desc:
You stand at the corner of the fortress street where the outer wall
of the fortress meets the main keep.  Looking above you, you can see
great blocks of volcanic stone comprising the wall of the keep, its
black sheen, probably obsidian, absorbing the flickering torchlights
around the city.
   To the west, the street continues toward the main gate of the keep,
while to the north, the street leads to the fortress gate.

rooms.name: The Overlord's Chamber
rooms.desc:
Piles of gems, chests of valuables, and stacks of rare carpets and
tapestries blanket most of this vast chamber.  Measuring some fifty feet
square, the long obsidian walls of this domed chamber absorb your light,
dimming the room to a dusky orange, making the gems seem dull and
lackluster.
   A grand central table dominates the room, though it is empty and 
seems to have been carved from mahogany.
   You can see only the exit you came from here.

rooms.name: A Misty Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a secret tunnel deep within the fortress.  Strange,
swirling mists float around you, stinging you with their energy which sets
your hair on end.  The walls here seem to be whispering for you to turn
back.
   Heavy breathing seems to be coming from the south, as though some old
dragon was deep in slumber.

rooms.name: At Death's Door
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the doorway to the Astral Plane.  Only the dead
float beyond the gateway to the south, thus you cannot enter in your
current living state.
   As you look into the glassy portal, you can see spirits being 
escorted by deva and similar angel-like beings who legends say have
been assigned to protect them for eternity.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Carved Corridor
rooms.desc:
Here, the tunnel turns markedly cooler, enough so that the obsidian
under your feet begins to flake and chip as you walk across it.  The walls
are similarly flawed, though you can clearly see that they were once smooth
and whole.  
   The tunnel extends to the east and west.

rooms.name: Deep Within A Fissure
rooms.desc:
You are tripping over fall rocks as you negotiate a path through the
rubble here.  The area is warm, probably heated by volcanic activity
from further in the fissure below.
   A few slithering animals reside here, sidling away from the foreign
scent of your body.
   The fissure continues to the west, where it rises steeply and to the
east, where it seems to drop off sharply.

rooms.name: Outside The Fortress Gate
rooms.desc:
You can hear nothing though the murmurings and shouts of the daemons
and otherworldly creatures around you.  Tails and wings slap lazily at 
you while a stray horn or spike prods you to move on from behind.
   The cavern seems to end here, with only the gate of the fortress
to break the monotony of solid walls rising above you to the north and 
east.  You can also escape the pack by bolting to the south, though
the beasts around you form an almost impenetrable barrier to pass.

rooms.name: Amidst The Crowd
rooms.desc:
You are being bounced and buffeted against leather-skinned creatures
that rush past you as they go about their own business.  Before you,
an ice daemon slaps a forked, lizardlike tongue against your cheek,
stinging you with its cold, as though telling you to get away from
him.
   As you look around, trying to exit the crowd, you notice that the
cavern wall rises high to the east and slopes above you to form the
dome of the undermountain itself.  To the west, the fortress wall
stands tall, patrolled by tailed, weaponed beasts at its peak.
   The street continues to the south, away from the beings and the
mob that threatens to crush you under their scaly heels.

rooms.name: A Busy Street
rooms.desc:
Burly daemons of all types mingle here, pushing past each other to
enter or exit into the main gates of the undermountain fortress.  In
the distance to the north, the functional double doors of the fortress
entrance stand open, though heavily guarded as odd, perhaps even
extradimensional, beings bear sacks and crates of unknown cargo through
them.
   To the north, you can enter the crowd of beings or head south and
get away from the rush.

rooms.name: Checkpoint
rooms.desc:
You stand at a guard's checkpoint.  Dark stone forms an arch that leads
northward toward some loud noises and sounds of activity.
   To the north the tiled street continues along the western wall, flanked
on its eastern side by the wall of the cavern.  To the south, the street
continues back toward the exit of the undermountain cavern.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a street that is bordered to the west by a
massive stone wall.  Horned, devilish guards sport tridents on the
minarets above you, watching you carefully as you walk past.
   To the east, a tall tower juts high from the cavern floor, though
no door is apparent on this side.
   The street continues to the north, where enormous demon-like beings
patrol the streets, each wielding exposed weapons.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a street that is bordered to the west by a
massive stone wall.  Horned, devilish guards sport tridents on the
minarets above you, watching you carefully as you walk past.
   To the east, a crude street, perhaps an alley curves around the
stone structure to the northeast.
   The street continues to the north, where enormous demon-like beings
patrol the streets, each wielding exposed weapons.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a street that is bordered to the west by a
massive stone wall.  Horned, devilish guards sport tridents on the
minarets above you, watching you carefully as you walk past.
   To the east, a small windowless building stands with a missing door.
The scent of burnt leather and oiled steel emanates from within.
   The street continues to the north, where enormous demon-like beings
patrol the streets, each bearing broadswords the size of a human leg.

rooms.name: A Tiled Street
rooms.desc:
Carved basalt has been cut into slabs and placed on the ground to 
create this street.  Wheel treads can be seen marring the crude tiles,
giving the impression of heavy carts being pulled down this lane and
out the courtyard to the east.
   To your west, a wall, perhaps that of a building or defensive
structure, stands high above you, partially melding with the ceiling
almost thirty feet above you.
   The street continues to the north and exits to the courtyard east
of here.

rooms.name: A Flawed Corridor
rooms.desc:
Clearly, an earthquake is responsible for the partial collapse of this
tunnel.  Powered flakes of obsidian litter the floor amidst the boulders
of igenous stones that once help up the ceiling.
   A small crawlspace extends through the rubble to the east where you can
hear a soft moaning.  The corridor leads back toward the exit to the west.

rooms.name: Stairs
rooms.desc:
Someone has carved a set of crude stairs into the otherwise steep walls
of the fissure here.  Below you, at the base of the long staircase, you 
can hear the rushing of air, as though an underground vent exited into the
chamber below.
   Darkness surrounds you, making the exit to the west seem very inviting.

rooms.name: Tower Overlook
rooms.desc:
You are prone on your belly as you peer out over the tower's edge.
The entire undercity seems to be visible from here, including the dark
outbuildings and the well-lit bazaar that rests behind the fortress
wall.
   As you look out from your perch, some 200 feet above the cavern floor,
you notice the abundance of guards at the fortress gate far to the
north, as well as the patrols that monitor the activity within.  Far
over the western wall, you can see daemons haggling the prices of their
goods as they set up stalls in a bazaar.
   The only non-fatal way to leave here is east, across the top of the
tower.

rooms.name: A Relief Door
rooms.desc:
Odd carvings depict a circular object streaking across the sky on
the door here.  Perhaps a comet, the door displays an astronomical map,
but from which celestial position you cannot be certain, particularly
since you know this place to be deep within the undermountain.
   The only exit from here is down, all other directions blocked by thick
stone walls.

rooms.name: Stone Stairs
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a large niche in the wall of the Chamber of the
Rifts.  Here, a stone stairwell ascends above the chamber and into a
damp darkness above you.
   You can hear nothing other than the rushing of winds which seem to
emanate from the east.  The southern and western walls here are slick
with moisture as are the stairs that lead up.
   Oddly enough, a greenish moss seems to grow on the walls in patches
here, apparently lacking the need for sunlight to grow.

rooms.name: On the Tower Stairs
rooms.desc:
Bleak stairs and dark shadows face you as you traverse the steps of
the tower.  An odd mist appears to rise from somewhere nearby, perhaps
that landing to the east.  
   Only black rock and faint whispers from above share your company
here, making the exit below you seem very inviting.

rooms.name: The Tower Floor
rooms.desc:
Gravel covers the floor of this monolithic tower which seems to rise
endlessly into the darkness above you.  A set of stone stairs ascend the
tower along the western wall where the gravel seems to pulse and shift,
perhaps just a trick of the light. 
   This circular room boasts only the exit to the east.  No doors or
windows allow any type of light to enter and even sound seems muffled
in here.

rooms.name: An Alley
rooms.desc:
You stand on the crushed basalt and sand of an alley between two
large structures.  To the south, the wall of the building seems to be 
made from great slabs of volcanic rock which have been raised to lean
against each other to create a solid foundation.
   To the north, an odd tower rises from the cavern floor to stare
westward over the guarded wall.
   The alley continues to the east, where it bends sharply northward,
and west to the main street.

rooms.name: A Guard Post
rooms.desc:
You stand within the crude walls of a dark guardhouse.  A few strange
beasts stand here staring at you from behind sickly yellowish eyes, a 
putrid stench emanating from the bare, leathery flesh which ripples as
they move.
   They don't seem to wish to bother with you however; perhaps thinking
you are not worth the trouble to trounce.
   The exit lies to the west.

rooms.name: A Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an underground volcanic cavern.  At some point long
in the past, a pocket of magma drained away from this place, leaving a flat
cavern floor and a domed ceiling nearly two hundred feet above you.
   Towers and structures of basalt, obviously constructed rather than natural,
have turned this cavern into a subterranean city.  Clawed footprints mar
the courtyard where you have entered, indicating that this is a high-traffic
area for the inhabitants of this city.
   To the north, you can see the side of a building, while to the south,
smooth cavern walls rise and slope above you.  As you look west, you
see the street continue, then turn sharply as it meets the side of another
building to the west.

rooms.name: Rubble
rooms.desc:
You are crawling through a narrow crawlspace.  Sharp slabs of pumice
and obsidian scrape against your face and hands as you maneuver through
the tunnel.
   To the west, the crawlspace opens to an open corridor, while to the
east, you feel a cool draft and smell the faintest scent of ozone.

rooms.name: The Base Of The Fissure
rooms.desc:
Sulfurous gases and vapours rise from a volcanic vent in the western 
wall, choking you as you struggle for breath.  You quickly become dizzy,
almost sick, as you stumble about, looking for an exit.

rooms.name: The Tower's Peak
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a raised dias from which you can look over the
fortress wall to the west and see bustling activity.  Daemons and other
extra-dimensional beasts seem to be haggling and arguing, negotiating
and threatening, pushing and dealing, all in attempts to barter their
wares from their own native lands.
   The tower top dips slightly to the east and west, both offering 
different views of the fortress below.

rooms.name: The Master Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in the darkest chamber you have ever seen, as though some
evil god created a hole in the shadows themselves.  Through your feeble
light, you can make out almost no details, other than a few stone tables
and shelves which stand along the circular stone walls.  
   A circular dias on which an altar of some sort has been built rests
in the center of the room, a black crystal floating above it, seemingly
absorbing the light and emitting its own inky colour around you.
   Through your searching, you come across a door set into the eastern
wall, its stone hinges set to last an eternity.  Its twin, carved with a
relief of stars and other celestial objects lies in the western wall,
where a damp, almost humid, scent of vapour originates.

rooms.name: Chamber Of The Rifts
rooms.desc:
Swirling mists and strange gases surround you in this chamber.  Voices
whisper around you, mixing warnings to turn back with wailing pleads for
help.
   You can see little but mists around you, as though you were standing
behind the splash of a waterfall.  A rushing of air deafens you, but
does nothing to clear your vision through the vapour.

rooms.name: A Landing
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a wide landing in the dark tower.  A deathly cold
chill rises from the stone beneath you and the sounds of heavy breathing
come from somewhere very near.
   Through your light, you peer over a guardrail - the only defense against
a fatal fall from the stairs - and see nothing but dust drift past you
from above.
   The stairs ascend to the east, along a circular path and descend back
to the west.

rooms.name: Cul-de-sac
rooms.desc:
You have entered a dead-end cave.  Flawed, unnatural stone walls
rise above you to the north and west, a few cracks betraying the 
outlines of a door in the eastern wall.
   To the west, a solid steel door provides entry into a tower that
scrapes the cavern ceiling above you.  The dark stone of the tower
seems to blend in suitably with the surrounding cavern walls.

rooms.name: A Bend In The Alley
rooms.desc:
Here, the alley bends sharply northward into a cavelike cul-de-sac.
The shadows here are thick, lacking the natural phosphorescence of the
cavern walls around you, making you think twice about entering the area 
to the north.
   To the east and south, the walls of the cavern are marred with large,
claw-like scratches, evidence of some daemon's hostility and rage, while
to the west, the alley continues toward the main street.

rooms.name: A Guard Post
rooms.desc:
You stand within the crude walls of a dark guardhouse.  A few strange
beasts stand here staring at you from behind sickly yellowish eyes, a 
putrid stench emanating from the bare, leathery flesh which ripples as
they move.
   They don't seem to wish to bother with you however; perhaps thinking
you are not worth the trouble to trounce.
   The exit lies to the west.

rooms.name: A Rift
rooms.desc:
Swirling gases engulf you as you enter this semi-ethereal corridor.
There appears to be no floor, no walls, no substance to this vortex
of mists and vapours.
   To the west, huge bands of magically cold iron reinforce a magical
door of solid light, preventing entrance from the material world into
what lies beyond.
   To the east, the corridor seems to lead back to the material world,
and though you are not certain of your location, you feel sure that 
you stand in a rift between worlds.

rooms.name: An Antechamber
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a very cold room.  The walls, like the floor, are
made of obsidian slats which seem to reflect the chill that freezes the
air around you.
   A solid iron door stands firmly attached to the eastern wall and is
deathly cold to the touch.  Its iron bands reinforce its strength while
a solid handle of wrought metal stands firmly in the left center of the
door.
   Pausing, you catch the faintest scent of old decay and an almost
electric sense of apprehension.
   The only other exit lies through the rubble to the west.

rooms.name: A Noxious Cave
rooms.desc:
Molten sulfur bubbles up from the fissure floor here, suffocating you.
The gas coming from the pool is already starting to thicken and swirl,
following the air currents of your exhalations.
   Death will come quickly here should you linger.

rooms.name: The Top Of The Tower
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the top of the black tower.  To the west, you can
see the rest of the tower peak which stands just out of hand's reach from
the ceiling of the cavern.
   A few footprints have scuffed the stone on the floor here - guard tracks,
perhaps, or maybe a curious onlooker who wished to get a better view of
the cavern from above.
   Looking for exits, you notice that only the west and the stairs back
into the tower do not offer fatal falls.

rooms.name: A Stairway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a dark stairwell.  Black stone steps lead above
you to fresher, warmer air past the stone walls that compose most of this
tower.
   The only other exit is through the door to the west.

rooms.name: Tower Stairs
rooms.desc:
You appear to have arrived on the tower's main floor.  As you look
over the rail, you can see the stairs that descend over a hundred feet
below into darkness.
   Here, the stairs have opened onto a small landing blocked with a solid
stone door which seems to radiate an intense, biting cold.  An iron handle,
wrought and twisted from what appears to have been a dull blade, rests
firmly attached to the stone, obviously meant to be pulled outward, rather
than pushed.
   The stone wall of the tower lies unblemished as you cast your eyes
southward and to the east, while the gaping darkness seems to hold some
secret as you look over the handrail to the north.

rooms.name: Tower Stairs
rooms.desc:
Reptilian footprints mar the otherwise undisturbed dust on the stairs
here.  A few dried scales have flaked off some unknown creature as it
molted, leaving its ovular dead skin behind.
   The stairs wind around the tower, ascending in their circular climb
which seems to turn southwest as you go upward.  A landing can be seen
just west of here, still in the range of your light.

rooms.name: An Acid Cistern
rooms.desc:
A deep well seems to naturally erupt from the floor here, spattering
the walls within with a sizzling acid.  The stench of sulfur is powerful
here, no doubt an ingredient in the well's contents.
   A tunnel trails off to the south, leading away from the acrid, stinging
fumes that airse from the acidic pit, while a door of stone, pitted and
etched with acid, exits this place to the west.

rooms.name: A Dark Hollow
rooms.desc:
This non-descript hollow seems to have been carved out by acid washes
over the passage of many years.  Smooth walls and curved floors form an
almost perfect cylinder in this cave which leads south, further into
the undermountain.

rooms.name: Bones And Scales
rooms.desc:
You seem to have stumbled into a cemetary of some sort.  Acid-washed
exoskeletons and scales of dead daemons litter this place, a dead-end
in an acid-carved tunnel.
   A small altar rests in the southern wall, obviously a carved niche
into which a daemon skull rests, its hollow eye sockets gleaming yellow
as it watches over the dead.
   The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are walking in a high-ceilinged cavern.  No stalactites hang from
above as these tunnels show evidence of volcanic activity which long
since dissolved any limestone formations had they been present.
   The tunnel continues to both the east and west, growing misty and
clouded as you head away.

rooms.name: Chamber Of The Pits
rooms.desc:
Glyphs and magical wards adorn the smooth walls and ceiling of this
frigid chamber.  In the floor, five shallow pits have been carved, each
a semi-spherical bowl in which sigils have been scribed.  Power, dark
power, radiates in this room.  
   A single door lies in the southern wall while a small crevasse can
be seen flawing the glyphs on the eastern wall.

rooms.name: A Burning Corridor
rooms.desc:
You are standing in what could only be a volcanic vent.  Smoke and fire
rises up from the smouldering floor, filling the air with a burning, choking 
ash.  The walls themselves boast crystals of hot sulfur and seem to melt
in the intense heat.
   The corridor continues to the south, where it grows even hotter.  To the
north however, a cold mist seeps from under the door, creating a vortex of
roiling steam at its base.

rooms.name: A Searing Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Smoke billows from the streaming lava that bubbles and flows backwards
into the heart of the mountain.  The eastern and western walls show strong
signs of melting and molten sulfur drips onto the tunnel floor, creating
a toxic gas as it splashes into the lava streams.
   The tunnel continues to the south, though it seems to look more stable
to the north.

rooms.name: A Flame Geyser
rooms.desc:
Bluish fire spews upward from a vent here in the floor, boring a small
chimney in the tunnel ceiling.  Molten sulfur drips into the flame, creating
a yellowish gas which chokes you despite your magical protection from the
hellish elements.
   The tunnel continues southward through the flames and northward into
an unstable tunnel.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Chimney
rooms.desc:
You stand at the top of a chimney.  Superheated air mixes with ash here
to create a thick smoke which blinds you as you stare down into the depths 
of the hole.  The walls, dripping with molten sulfur and other minerals,
form rivulets into the pit that get spewed out during the updrafts from 
below.
   The exit of the tunnel lies to the north, where the tunnel gradually
melts away like the southern, eastern, and wested walls here.

rooms.name: In The Chimney
rooms.desc:
You are floating, buffeted by streams of superheated air and ash.  As
you rise and fall, you feel that you can manipulate the currents, riding
the cooler ones to descend into the chimney while floating on hotter ones
to rise.
   All around you, the walls of the chimney are scarred with a blackened
crystal amidst the dense black rock that composes the core of the mountain.
   Below you, you can see nothing but are aware of the occasional geyser
of ash that disrupts the currents and spins you around.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Chimney
rooms.desc:
Flames erupt from below you, shooting past you in yellow spears of
light.  The walls of the shaft seem to drip inward, streaming into the
heart of the chimney below.
   The winds are powerful here and you find controlling your movements
is becoming more difficult as you soar upwards on hot currents or
plummet on cold ones.

rooms.name: A Volcanic Chimney
rooms.desc:
Flames erupt from below you, shooting past you in yellow spears of
light.  The walls of the shaft seem to drip inward, streaming into the
heart of the chimney below.
   The winds are powerful here and you find controlling your movements
is becoming more difficult as you soar upwards on hot currents or
plummet on cold ones.

rooms.name: Searing Flames
rooms.desc:
You are floating above a massive pool of magma.  Through the waves of
heat, you can make out the enormous mass of fiery liquid which bubbles and
shoots forth flames below you.
   Oddly enough, you notice a cavern opening up below you to the south,
just beyond the range of the pool.  The reddish glow of the magma lights
the area in a hellish crimson.
   Above you, ash and smoke roil in the currents of air.

rooms.name: Magma Pool
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the southern end of a high-walled magma pool.  A
path here curves around the pool to the west, skirting the wall that holds
back the molten rock.
   The air is strangely breathable here and almost tolerable aside from 
the constant scent of sulfur that seems to dominate the walls and floors 
of the hellish cavern.

rooms.name: A Shaft
rooms.desc:
A cold mist rises from a deep shaft here which leads deep into the
base of the mountain.  Screams and shouts of agony whisper their faint
torments on the vapours which brush your ears, making you wonder if you
imagined the horrid calls of distress.
   Above you, a single stalactite points into the shaft, standing a
silent vigil over the frigid fog.

rooms.name: A Shaft
rooms.desc:
You can hear nothing as you negotiate the powerful air currents which
scream past your ears.  Your clothes, wet with the cold mist which rises
from within the shaft, cling to you, freezing you as the moisture in the
sodden fabric rubs into your skin.
   The walls of the shaft are smooth and slick with water, making purchase
impossible.
   Staring down, you notice a faint glow.  A pale, almost sickly, blue
light seems to radiate from deep within the shaft below you.

rooms.name: Deep Within The Shaft
rooms.desc:
You are quite literally several hundred feet below the top of the shaft.
Drenched with moisture, you stare below and notice the faint blue glow 
growing larger as yellow tendrils of mist swirl around the light below.
   The wet walls prevent you from getting a foothold in any direction.  
You can only travel up or down the shaft.

rooms.name: Deep Within The Shaft
rooms.desc:
You are surrounded by a yellowish mist which sems to drag you down
toward the bluish light.  The sky-coloured luminescence seems to grow
a sickly green as you descend and the stench of sulfur begins to mix
with the ozone scent of the surronding mist.
   You are easily a quarter mile or more from the top of the shaft and
judging from the congealing moisture on the shaft walls, you have the
odd sensation that you are no longer within the mountain.
   You can descend toward the greenish light or ascend toward the 
dark top of the shaft.

rooms.name: Blood Runs Red
rooms.desc:
You are fighting turbulent air currents as you travel this vertical
shaft.  The wet walls, once slick with cold moisture, seem to drip with
a bloodlike liquid, as though the sides of the shaft themselves were 
bleeding from the abusive wind currents that shoot upwards from the
putrid greenish glow below.
   Tendrils of foul-smelling mist wind and twist around you, somehow
still cohesive despite the strong constant air currents from below.
   You can continue up or down the tunnel.

rooms.name: Blistering Cold
rooms.desc:
Frozen red liquid hangs in slanted streaks on the shaft walls, victim to
the gusts which blast from the sickly yellow-green light below.  The misty
tendrils are still writhing here, oblivious to the winds and to your touch
as you pass through them.
   The glow beneath you turns pale yellow as you grow closer to it.
   Examining your options, you know that you are half a mile below the
top of the shaft which is far out of sight in the darkness above you.
Below you, you can see the mists swirl and you catch a strong scent of
sulfur.

rooms.name: Blood Ice
rooms.desc:
The reddish ooze on the shaft walls have frozen into a blood-coloured
ice here tinting the yellowish tendrils to an ethereal orange.  Below you,
perhaps a half mile or more, the swirling, pulsing glow grows more intense.
Already, the sickly fog is becoming more luminous, changing into a bright
yellowish ochre.
   The shaft continues upwards, far out of sight and descends into frigid
winds below you.

rooms.name: Blood Mist
rooms.desc:
The ethereal wisps glow with a deep burgundy color as they surround you,
chilling you with icy fangs.  The walls of the shaft, encrusted with an 
icy blood-coloured rime, seem to fluoresce with the illumination from
below.
   Above you, perhaps a mile or more, the top of the shaft lies far out of 
sight and reach.  Below you, the burgundy mists seem to solidify and you
can swear you hear faint shrieks of pain coming from them.

rooms.name: Eternal Screams
rooms.desc:
Just below you lies an enormous circular field of light.  Swirls of
luminescent pink swim with and consume streaks of blood crimson as
wispy tendrils of yellow mist take vague shape here.
   Around you, the tentacle-like wisps form humanoid faces, each one
gaping a soft, near-silent scream as it escapes from the light below.
   The cold here is unbearable and you are quickly losing feeling in your
extremeties.  Below you, the circle of light mesmerizes you and invites
you closer, though above you, the shaft grows warmer and seems far less
dangerous.

rooms.name: The Gate
rooms.desc:
Ethereal beings are trying to escape out of this multi-coloured rift.
Clearly, the pain on their transparent faces is all that needs to be seen
to know that travelling through the rift is much more costly than a simple
jaunt through the lights.
   From below the rift, you can feel a frigid cold pass though the field
of light, as though a glacier was housed beneath it.  The being seem to be
anxious to escape more than the cold however, judging by the looks of mixed
terror and relief as they soar past you.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands just southwest of
the walled city of Xixieqi.
   Here, an occasional scorpion digs itself out from the sand to chitter
at other insects while eyeless desert voles leave ridged paths just beneath
the surface of the sand which extends in all directions.
   To the north only burnt-sienna sands can be seen, making travel in that
direction rather pointless, as it appears to be only a wasteland and dump
for the city to the northeast.  To the south, the desert stretches into wave
like dunes, matched only by the stetches of desert to the east.  A beach 
appears to the west, leading into the ocean.

rooms.name: Burning Coastal Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for the white, eyeless desert voles
that live within the spiny, pulpy interior.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while to the west,
the burnt-sienna sands stretch toward the ocean, where the salt-saturated
waters pound the sandy coast and destroy any plant life.

rooms.name: Searing Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for the white, eyeless desert voles
that live within the spiny, pulpy interior.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while off to the
northwest, the burnt-sienna sands stretch toward the ocean, separated only
by a tall cliff that continues to rise above the ocean surface to the south.

rooms.name: Desert Overlook
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for the white, eyeless desert voles
that live within the spiny, pulpy interior.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while off to the
northwest, the burnt-sienna sands stretch toward the ocean, separated only
by a tall cliff that overlooks the ocean to the west.

rooms.name: Searing Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for scorpions and voles that hide
in their shade during the day and offer protection from the wind at night.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while off to the
west, a tall cliff rises over the ocean, offering a spectacular view of
the waters below.

rooms.name: Searing Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for scorpions and voles that hide
in their shade during the day and offer protection from the wind at night.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while off to the
west, a tall cliff rises over the ocean, offering a spectacular view of
the waters below.

rooms.name: Searing Sands
rooms.desc:

a few desert cacti provide meager shade for scorpions and voles that hide
in their shade during the day and offer protection from the wind at night.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while off to the
west, a tall cliff rises over the ocean, offering a spectacular view of
the waters below.

rooms.name: Saltfall
rooms.desc:
You are wading through a sandfall.  Here, flowing salt from the heat-
risen flats to the south and east flow over the cliff and into the water
to the west, forming an enormous white sandfall.
   The flats continue to the east and south while the desert becomes more
sandy to the north.

rooms.name: Saltfall
rooms.desc:
You are wading through a sandfall current.  Here, flowing salt from the
heat-risen flats to the north and east flow over the edge of the cliff here
to the west to form an enormous white sandfall.
   The flats continue to the east and north while the desert becomes more
sandy to the distant north.  To the south you can see some grass emerging
from the lip of the desert salts.

rooms.name: Ghant's Hillock
rooms.desc:
You are standing on what appears to have once been an ancient desert
outpost.  Here, a large grass-covered mound stand surrounded by a crumbled
wall that has been swallowed by the lush grasses that obscure it from view
from afar.
   No matter what may have changed, the view is spectacular.  To the far
northwest you can see clearly into the ocean and the cliff that forms
the desert border, while to the north and east you can see the great desert
of Xixieqi.  Behind you to the south, foothills rise high and gradually blend
into a tall row of snow-capped peaks.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands just southwest of
the walled city of Xixieqi.
   Here, an occasional scorpion digs itself out from the sand to chitter
at other insects while eyeless desert voles leave ridged paths just beneath
the surface of the sand which extends in all directions.
   To the north, only burnt-sienna sands can be seen, making travel in
that direction seem pointless.  To the south and west, the desert stretches
into wave-like dunes while to the east, you can barely make out a caravan 
road several miles away.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for the eyeless desert voles that
live within their spiny, pulpy interiors. 
   The desert sands continue in all directions.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, searing sands of Xixieqi.
A few prickly pear cacti dot the sandy ground, offering some small
amount of protection for snakes, scorpions, and desert rats that 
live beneath the spiny leaves.
   In all directions, the desert continues, stretching infinitely
and offering little in solace against the desolation.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, searing sands of Xixieqi.
A few prickly pear cacti dot the sandy ground, offering some small
amount of protection for snakes, scorpions, and desert rats that 
live beneath the spiny leaves.
   In all directions, the desert continues, stretching infinitely
and offering little in solace against the desolation.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:

A few prickly pear cacti dot the sandy ground, offering some small
amount of protection for snakes, scorpions, and desert rats that 
live beneath the spiny leaves.
   In all directions, the desert continues, stretching infinitely
and offering little in solace against the desolation.

rooms.name: Dunes
rooms.desc:
Sands shift and move in waves here as the strong desert winds pile
the burning grains into shapeless dunes.
   There is no sign of life here, only bleak, burnished sands and dead,
rotting tumbleweed.
   The desert continues in all directions.

rooms.name: Dunes
rooms.desc:
Sands shift and move in waves here as the strong desert winds pile
the burning grains into shapeless dunes that blend with the salt flats
to the south.
   The desert continues all around you.

rooms.name: Salt Flats
rooms.desc:
Here, the desert sands and silt have given way to broad flats of
natural salt.  Chunks of the hardened stones lay caked across the
desert, some cracked and rising above the surface to form obstacles
through which you must walk.
   The desert continues to the north while the salt flats continue
in all other directions.

rooms.name: Salt Flats
rooms.desc:
Here, the desert sands and silt have given way to broad flats of
natural salt.  Chunks of the hardened stones lay caked across the
desert, some cracked and rising above the surface to form hazardous
obstacles across which to walk.
   A grassy field marks the border of the flats to the south, while
the flats continue to the north, east, and west.

rooms.name: Grassy Fields
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a grassy field, where the desert to the north meets
the foothills to the far south.  The breezes are both warm and damp here,
clear indications that this place receives a fair amount of downhill rains
and runoff.
   Immediately to the north salt flats have made plant growth impossible
as it forms an effective barrier against flora for the desert, while lush
grasses span the fields to the east and west at the base of the southern
foothills.

rooms.name: Dunes
rooms.desc:
Sands shift and move in waves here as the strong desert winds pile
the burning grains into amorphous dunes.
   Beneath the moving dunes, a few desert rodents leave raised paths
that make the surface of the sands apear to be alive with pulsing
veins and arteries.
   To the north, you can see an overturned wagon.  Sand has sloped gently
against it, forming an artificial drift, a haven for scorpions and other
hazards.  You quickly decide to avoid it.  To the south and west, the
desert stretches into near-infinity, while far to the east, a caravan
trail leads into the city to the northeast.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, searing sands of Xixieqi.
Here, a few desert cacti provide meager shade for the white eyeless
desert voles that live within their spiny, pulpy interiors.
   In all directions, the desert stretches to the horizon, offering
little change in scenery.

   Far to the north, you can see a walled city.  The desert sands 
sloped against it, giving the appearance of a city rising from the
desert floor.  The desert continues in all other directions, while
a caravan trail cuts through it to the east.

rooms.name: Dunes
rooms.desc:

   Beneath the moving dunes, a few desert rodents leave raised paths

veins and arteries.

rooms.name: Outside The City Gates

inward to deflect the sand from settling within.
   Tanned guards patrol around you as they inspect desert caravans
that come in from the south, occasionally taking a bribe as they allow
a few black-market items into the city.
   All around you, the desert spans as far as you can see, an errant
whirlwind or dust devil whipping about the sand.
   To the east and west, the desert stretches without limit, while
to the south, a worn caravan road leads into the desert.

rooms.name: Caravan Road

rooms.name: Caravan Trail

rooms.name: Parched Sands

city wall appears, and the west, where a caravan trail that leads

rooms.name: Sandstone Monoliths
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a desert valley.  All around you, gigantic pillars
of weathered sandstone spike high into the air, casting cooler shadows
on the groundling pear cacti beneath them.
   Looking around you, you notice that water-weathered rocks line this
valley, as though this was an ancient streambed that was consumed by
desert heat.
   The monoliths themselves are wonderous.  Rising nearly a thousand
feet in the air, these red and yellow-banded titans are all that
remain of a prehistoric mountain range, judging by the symmetry of the
remaining spires.  Time, weather, and wind appear to have blown
holes through these ancient mountain walls, leaving the banded monoliths
you see throughout the east.
   To the north the desert gives way to the ocean, where more of the
monolithic spires rise against you, while to the south and west, the
sandstone pillars decay into the desert sands.  The scent of the sea is
powerful here.  The ocean must lay to the north, behind the sandstone giants.

blankets the interior of this internal spire.
   Above you, a tediously long series of carved steps rises hundreds of
feet to a narrow, conical chamber that overlooks the floor you stand on.

form the border between the rugged sandy desert and the scrub of the
grasslands.  The sounds of groundling birds and animals seem to offer
the last signs of life before entering the western desert.
   To the north the ocean nurtures the coastal grasses and clashes
against a large sandstone monolith, as it soothes the reeds and grasses
from the harsh, hot desert winds to the southwest.

You are wading through a field of tall grass.  The air is dry here,
the moisture absorbed by the plants around you.  A few patchy mounds
lie nearby, probably insect-constructed and offering nothing in terms
of elevation or interest.
   The savanna continues to the east, west, and south, growing more
colorful as you head north toward the coast.

rooms.name: Watering Hole
rooms.desc:
This secluded pool appears to have been hidden by nature as there was
no indication of its existence when viewed from afar.  The water is warm
and murky but offers sustenance against the arid surroundings.
   A tree, no higher than you are tall, sprouts from the far edge of the
pool, its leafy green limbs contrasting nicely with the yellow reeds of
the savanna.
   The savanna continues in all directions, growing drier as you head west.

rooms.name: Savanna Mounds
rooms.desc:
You are standing amid buzzing insects that seem to be digilently
adding mud to the already tall spires of their nests.  There seems
to be plenty of moisture around here as the grasses grow rich and
green while the savanna shrubs give way to the first of the trees
that offer refreshing shade from the daytime sun and shelter from 
the cold nighttime winds.
   The savanna continues to the north, growing arid as you head to
the west.  To the east the grasses seem to retain their color, while
to the south, the foliage becomes thicker and more temperate.

rooms.name: Thickening Foliage
rooms.desc:
You are standing in some waist-high brush and scrub on the border
of a dense jungle to the south and the savanna lands to the north.
To the east the grasses seem to retain their color as they grow against
the backdrop of the wall of a keep, while to the south, the foliage
becomes extremely dense and jungle-like.

rooms.name: Jungle Foliage
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the border of a tropical jungle.  Tall, leafy
trees - typical of rainforests - drip their condensing moisture on the
ground here, forming small puddles of water.
   The elevation seems to rise a bit to the south, as the savanna lands
to the north give way to the mountainous rainforests to the south.  
   From somewhere off to the south, behind impenetrable foliage, you can
hear the rushing of water.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just south of a hillock that shows
evidence of long-waged battles.  The yellow-green reeds of grain grow tall
here, and seem to deepen into a richer, brighter hue as you head south, up
the face of the sloping hills and into the wilderness beyond.
   Hills of greenery continue all around you, save north, where a defensable
hillock looks out over the northern desert, and west, where outcroppings of
basalt appear to have been blasted out of the ground at odd angles.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, lost in the reeds and waving 
mass of wild grains that sway with the wind.  The ground is steep here,
and ascends into the hills to the south.
   The hills continue all around you, growing less steep as you head
north.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just west of a road that splits
these foothills into separate tracts of land.  Though the grass and reeds
around you are chest-high, you can make out the desert to the south and
catch the faintest whiff of carrion on the breeze.
   The hills continue all around you, save east, where a road offers some
sense of direction.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
The road widens here into a large circular lot as the northern caravan
trail through the forest meets this lane that comes straight out of the 
hills to the south.
   A few empty, broken crates litter the ground here, perhaps evidence of
an accident, or a past enchange of goods between those who dwell in the
mountains and those who live on the coast and in the desert.
   Hills and fields span to the eastern and western horizons, while the
road continues north and south.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills

these foothills into separate tracts of land.  Though the grass and reeds

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a hill of high grass, just west of a dense thicket
of impenetrable undergrowth.  It appears that this is the eastern border
of the grassy foothills, where it stops amid a cluster of tall, leafy
trees and mountain-rainforest-type shrubs.
   To the north you can see the hills merge with rich savanna fields, 
while to the south, you can barely make out a path through the densely
covered hills as they rise.  The hills continue at this elevation to the
west.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just east of the site of a tectonic
shift, where plates far below you have pushed masses of granite and basalt
to the surface to form an effective barrier against travel.
   The reeds below your feet crunch with dryness and you realize that even
a single bolt of lightning could set the fields alight.
   The hills continue all around you, growing steeper as you head south.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are travelling along an oft-travelled road that splits the hills
as it climbs higher into the mountains to the south.  Shrubs and tall
grasses spring from the moist ground, perhaps tapping some unseen water
source deep in the ground and away from the harsh desert heat to the
north.
   The road continues to the north and south, while the hills extend far
to the east and west.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:

   The hills continue all around you, growing less steep as you head
north.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, lost in the reeds and waving 
mass of wild grains that sway with the wind.  The ground is steep here,
and ascends into the hills to the south.
   The hills continue all around you, growing less steep as you head
north.

rooms.name: Grassy, Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just west of a road that splits
these foothills into separate tracts of land.  Though the grass and reeds
around you are chest-high, you can make out the desert in the far, far
distance to the south.
   The hills continue all around you, save east, where a road offers some
sense of direction.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a gravel road that winds though the rolling hills
all around you.  Greenery and a few shady trees mar the otherwise seemless
terrain to the east and west, while the road ascends into the higher slopes
to the south.
   Far to the south, you can make out a desert that flanks the road.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just east of a road that splits
these foothills into separate tracts of land.  The grass is dry here and
could definitely use some rain to prevent field fires.
   Grasses sway all around you, save west, where a road offers some sense
of direction.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, lost in the reeds and waving 
mass of wild grains that sway with the wind.  The ground is steep here,
and ascends into the hills to the south.
   The hills continue all around you, growing less steep as you head
north.

mass of wild grains that sway with the wind.  The ground is steep here,

   The hills continue all around you, growing less steep as you head

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, lost in the reeds and waving 
mass of wild grains that sway with the wind.  The ground is steep here,
and ascends into the hills to the south.
   The hills continue all around you, growing more dense and covered
with underbrush to the east.

rooms.name: Some Wooded Paths
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a hill of high grass, just west of a dense thicket
of impenetrable undergrowth.  It appears that this is the eastern border
of the grassy foothills, where it stops amid a cluster of tall, leafy
trees and mountain-rainforest-type shrubs.
   To the north you can see the path wind through down the shrub-covered
slope toward more open ground, while to the south, you can barely make out
the trail that continues through the sloping hills.
   The hills continue at this elevation to the west, though you have to
hack your way through some brush to get through it.

rooms.name: Cliff Face
rooms.desc:
You are standing atop a hill, just below a near-vertical cliff face.
The view from here is extraordinary, as you look out over the rolling
hills to the south and east.
   To the west outcroppings of tectonic plate shifts have thrust up from
the surface and prevented traveling in that direction, while to the south,
the cliff face provides an even more impassible climb, as the faint rushing
of gusting winds prevent you from even flying to the top.

rooms.name: Cliff Face
rooms.desc:
You are standing atop a hill, just below a near-vertical cliff face.
The view from here is extraordinary, as you look out over the rolling
hills to the south and east.
   To the east and west, the tall hills continue to roll across the
region, while to the south, the cliff face provides an impassible climb,
as the sounds of powerful winds resonate off the rock above you.

rooms.name: Cliff Face
rooms.desc:
You are standing atop a hill, just below a near-vertical cliff face.
The view from here is extraordinary, as you look out over the rolling
hills to the south and east.
   To the east and west, the tall hills continue to roll across the
region, while to the south, the cliff face provides an impassible climb,
as the sounds of powerful winds resonate off the rock above you.

rooms.name: A Carved Cliff
rooms.desc:
You stand below a vertical cliff, looking out over the northern
horizon, across fields and rolling hills of tall grass.  
   Here, someone has taken the time to chisel into the rock the head
of a serpent - a companion to the one across the road to the east.
It appears that gems or glass were once in place in the carving's
eyes, but have long since vanished.
   The hills continue to the west and north, while a road appears
to scale the mountains to the east.  Only the cliff face appears to
the south and there seems no way to scale it.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a gravel road that winds though the rolling hills
all around you.  Trees and shrubs dot the grassy terrain while patches
of moss and lichens adorn their trunks and stems.
   The hills continue to the east and west, while the road ascends to
the south and flows through the rolling terrain to the south.

rooms.name: A Carved Cliff
rooms.desc:
You stand below a vertical cliff, looking out over the northern
horizon, across fields and rolling hills of tall grass.  
   Here, someone has taken the time to chisel into the rock the head
of a serpent - a companion to the one across the road to the west.
   The hills continue to the east and north, while a road appears
to scale the mountains to the west.  Only the cliff face appears to
the south and there seems no way to scale it.

hills to the south and east.
   To the east and west, the tall hills continue to roll across the
region, while to the south, the cliff face provides an impassible climb,
as the sounds of powerful winds resonate off the rock above you.

rooms.desc:
You are standing on a hill of high grass, just west of a dense thicket
of impenetrable undergrowth.  It appears that this is the eastern border
of the grassy foothills, where it stops amid a cluster of tall, leafy
trees and mountain-rainforest-type shrubs.
   To the north you can see the path stop abruptly at a tall shelf of 
rock, while to the south, you can barely make out the trail that winds
through the sloping hills.
   The hills continue at this elevation to the west, though you have to
hack your way through some brush to get through it.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a rough gravel road where the sloping hills begin
their ascent into the snow-capped peaks to the south.  Rocks and tall,
leafy trees blanket the terrain and surround the road while offering a
bit of shelter to the noisy groundling birds and squirrels that chitter
at your approach.
   The hills continue to the east and west, while the road ascends to
the south and flows through the rolling terrain to the south.

rooms.name: A Mountain Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a steep road, surrounded by tall pines.  The view
from here is lovely and to the north you can look out and see the desert
across the northern horizon.
   Mossy rocks lie to either side of the road, their green faces showing
which way is north, while their lichens point out the western direction
of the mountain.
   The road descends into the lower elevations to the north and climbs
high into the clouds to the south.  Rocks and trees lie too dense to 
travel anywhere else.

rooms.name: A Mountain Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a steep road, surrounded by tall pines that block
the rushing winds you hear whipping their green tops.  The view from here
is extraordinary and to the north you can look out and see the desert and
the ocean beyond it.
   Mossy rocks rest to either side of the road, the grooves at their base
showing signs that they had been moved from the ascending trail to allow
easier passage up and down the mountain.
   The road descends into the lower elevations to the north and climbs
high into the clouds to the south.  Rocks and trees lie too dense to 
travel anywhere else.

rooms.name: A Mountainous Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a rock-strewn road that ascends the icy mountain
below you.  The air is growing thin and your breath is starting to become
labored.
   The road ascends to the south and descends to the north.

rooms.name: A Mountainous Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a rock-strewn road that ascends the icy mountain
below you.  The air is thin here and you find yourself taking two heavy
breaths just to keep your vision from becoming blurred and your head 
from swimming.
   The air smells of rich pine, and its heady scent is only reinforced
by the jumbles of pine cones that litter both the steep road and the 
forest flanking it.
   The road ascends the mountain to the south and slopes downward to the
north.

rooms.name: A Mountain Pass
rooms.desc:
You are standing at a gusty, snowy mountain pass.  A narrow road cuts
through a break in the peak before you to the south, slicing through a
large jumble of fallen stones that flank the open road.  The way south
seems to level off a bit into a plateau-like smoothness into the peaks
before turning steeply upward after a few hundred yards while the road
bends sharply down the face of the mountain to the north.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Huge trees tower above you, blocking out most of the sky's light.
The brush all around you is rustled by things unseen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Nothing stirs in this section of the forest, although you can hear 
things - many things - moving farther out all around you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Dead leaves crunch under your boots as you weave your way through the
endless trees of the forest.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
You see something scamper though the trees above your head, then vanish.
The nagging thought of something dropping down on you makes you keep your
head up.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The trees all around you seem to be normal ironwood - hard as steel and
stretching out into the sky.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large stump is here, ages old. Looking around, you see other stumps
spread out in the surrounding woods. You wonder who would go to such 
lengths of cutting an ironwood tree - and how.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves suddenly rain down on you from above. Something is definitely
up there, but you see no easy way to get there.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Dead leaves whip around you as a sudden breeze springs up. It makes
the coldness of the forest seem more oppressive.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A tree before you stands out because it is totally bare, almost as if
something had shaken all the leaves off. But what could be that strong?

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Wind whispers through the trees, almost sounding like voices.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Eyeing the treetops above, you see two red eyes glaring out of a dark
canopy.  You wonder how many other living beings inhabit the treetops.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A tree just ahead of you has been stripped of its bark.  This boggles
your mind since ironwood bark is one of the hardest substances on the
earthly plane.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Shadows deepen all around you as move further into the forest.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Dead branches rain down on you from above, knocked into the air by an 
unseen traveler in the treetops.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Old legends of this forest scared you as a child, and seeing it now you
know why.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The smell of rotting leaves beneath your feet coupled with the noises
of the forest make you wonder if you are the only first person to walk
here.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
To the east a section of the forest seems to be swaying madly in the
wind, but here, all is calm.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A tangle of vines cling to your boots for a moment, tightening as you
move. You hope that the other, larger vegetation in the forest is not as
hungry.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Your trek through the forest stirs up a nest of brush birds, who startle
you with their loud squawking before flying up into a nearby tree to watch
you pass by.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
An exceptionally large ironwood tree stands here. It is easily ten feet
in diameter and probably thousands of years old.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves crunch under your boots as you work your way through the maze
of trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves crunch under your boots as you work your way through the maze of
trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves crunch under your boots as you work your way through the maze of
trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Rotting leaves under your feet assault your nostrils, and the forest's 
cool breeze seeps through the chinks in your armor.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: The forest stretches out around you in all directions.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A deep fog rolls in about your ankles. The woods, before shrouded in
shadows are now steeped in darkness.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: All about, the shadows move, unaccounted for even in the slight breeze.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tall ironwood trees surrounding you are suddenly still as the breeze
dies.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Your boots crunch in the dead leaves below you boots, but below the leaves
lies a soggy morass of swamp. You look about warily for sinkholes.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Trees, trees, and more trees. All around you are trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Eyeing the trees nervously, you get the definite feeling you're being
watched.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: All around you the tall ironwood trees stand like silent guardians.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves and branches shower down upon you from above. Looking up, you
see nothing.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: A small ring of mushrooms grows here, but nothing else seems out of place.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A wave of evil washes over you from the east. The trees here seem darker
than elsewhere in the forest.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Ironwood trees surround you on all sides, but you are able to push through
them with only a little difficulty. The forest is alive with noise all around
you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: The trees all around you seem to stretch on endlessly.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Peering through the trees, you keep catching glimpses of movement out
of the corner of your eye.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The rotting leave are thinner here, as is the space between the trees
where the sky shows through.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tree canopy above you is almost fully blocking the sky now. The
shadows around you deepen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: There really are a great many trees around here.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Darkness reigns supreme in this section of the forest. The tall ironwoods
around you block all light from above and amplify the sounds of the creatures
that you now know surround you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest is turning into a bog. Water seeps up between the dead leaves
at your feet, and mushrooms grow abundantly.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Red eyes glow from behind the trees all around you, then wink out all
at once as if by some unheard signal.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: You are pretty sick of seeing trees. They seem to go on forever.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The mist around your ankles almost obscures the leaves over which you
walk. You look carefully ahead for sinkholes.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest's mist is thicker here, obscuring your view for all but a
few feet ahead of you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The thick rolls all around you, leaving you with your hand in front of
your face to protect you from stray branches.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Leaves fall down all around you, disturbed from above by something unseen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
All around you, you suddenly hear whispered voices in an unknown language.
There is much more hidden here than what stands before you from time to time.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Pools of water form around your footsteps, erasing them as soon as you
pass. You begin to wonder if you aren't lost.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a darker section of the forest, smothered by 
shadows and choked by the mists that surround you.  Crumpled leaves
litter the ground, damp from the moisture that seems confined to the
forest floor.
   You can hack through the forest in any direction.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The mist swirls around you, making the land seem hazy and dreamlike. 
The towering dark trees make it seem more like a nightmare.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tall ironwood trees around you suddenly echo as if struck; a harsh
metallic 'clang' reaches your ears, but you can't tell where it comes from.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large branch the size of your arm crashes down beside you. You swear
up at the treetop, yet thank fate that you weren't knocked out.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tall ironwood trees around you suddenly echo as if struck; a harsh

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: The forest thickens here, becoming almost impassable.

rooms.name: The Forest

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large totem pole is stuck in the ground here. It pictures a giant
of a man worshipping - what else?  A tree.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A small space has been cleared off here, even the stumps of the ironwood
trees have been uprooted and cleared away.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large totem pole is stuck in the ground here. It pictures a giant
of a man worshipping - what else?  A tree.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
An exceptionally large ironwood tree grows here. It must be thousands
of years old.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: To the west grows an exceptionally large ironwood tree.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large sinkhole has filled with stagnant water here. It smells like
rotten meat.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large pool of muddy water has formed to the west. Elsewhere you see
only more trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The mist that has followed you for so long starts to thin out here, 
but the barrage of trees stays the same.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest seems unending, and the haunting shadows that tail you
begin to grate your nerves.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Leaves and branches fall down on you from above, cast by an unseen force.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest is beginning to thin here, but you still can't see far between
the trees.

The forest is beginning to thin here, but you still can't see far 
between the trees.

rooms.desc: The edge of the forest is just ahead, thankfully leading into open land.

rooms.name: The Silent Tower
rooms.desc:
You stand inside a room-within-a-room in the silent tower. Once a terrible
punishment for magii, a room where magic is impossible, yet now the home of
Antryg. It was he who crushed the power of the church Witchfinders and made
this place his palace.

rooms.name: The Air Elevator
rooms.desc:
The limestone walls of this chamber have been worked smooth. At the center 
is a 5' round flat wood platform circled with a broad band of silver. Ivory 
runes and glyphs are inlaid into the silver band. Ten feet up in the center 
of the ceiling is a 10' wide dark circular opening. This chimney reaches 
upward into the rock as far a you can see. On the east wall is a large brass 
plaque in the common tongue.

rooms.name: Northern End of the Beach
rooms.desc:
The beach ends here as the plateau juts out into the sea.  As you stand 
at the base and look up, you think better of trying to climb it.  Sea spray 
fills your nostrils as the waves continue their relentless assault on the rock
invading it's domain and the roar of the collisions makes hearing difficult.
To the east are more cliffs, to the west a heavy surf.  There is a sign 
attached to a rock here.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark tunnel, the gold no longer lines the walls, just a
pervasive dampness.  The rivulet still meanders down the sandy floor of
the tunnel.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark tunnel, the gold no longer lines the walls, just a
pervasive dampness.  The rivulet still meanders down the sandy floor of
the tunnel.

rooms.name: In the Surf
rooms.desc:
You are up to your chest in the surf and the water is cool.  The sand 
swirls beneath your feet and the waves suck at you ominously causing you 
to continually adjust your balance.  There is a large sign with bold 
lettering sticking up from the edge of the surf.

rooms.name: Middle of the Beach
rooms.desc:
You stand at the base of a very steep cliff on a wide sandy beach.  The 
beach stretches to the north and south and to the west the beach slopes
downward reaching out into a pounding surf.  Along the base of the cliff
is chaotic piles of driftwood and storm debris indicating the high-tide 
line.  It looks like you would be safe but might make for an uncomfortable
night as there isn't much legroom at high tide.  The cliff itself is very rough 
and is filled with numerous small cave openings all along the beach, both at 
beach level as well as higher up on the cliffs.  Birds fly in and out of 
many of them.

rooms.name: Beyond the Golden Way
rooms.desc:
Huge chunks of gleaming gold encrust the walls, ceiling and floor for the 
first 10' of this gloomy cavern. A gurgling rivulet of water meanders along 
the sandy floor from the darkness ahead and out of the entrance.

rooms.name: Gate of Iron
rooms.desc:
A badly rusted and corroded iron gate reaching from floor to ceiling and
wall to wall stands here blocking your way inward. The rivulet escapes 
from beneath the decaying portal with scant inches to spare. The floor
here has changed from the sandy floor to hard bedrock.

rooms.name: Inside the Gate
rooms.desc:
Your are on the other side of the now defunct gate. A cool moist breeze
comes from the south and the rivulet is less discernible here, more like a
sheet of water than any organized flow.

rooms.name: The Brass Door
rooms.desc:
A heavily tarnished thick door of brass prevents passage beyond here. 
The door has a keyhole halfway down its left side and no visible handle 
or hinges.

rooms.name: Southern End of the Beach
rooms.desc:
The beach ends here as the plateau juts out into the sea.  As you stand 
at the base and look up, you think better of trying to climb it.  Sea spray 
fills your nostrils as the waves continue their relentless assault on the rock
invading it's domain and the roar of the collisions makes hearing difficult.
To the east are more cliffs, to the west a heavy surf.  There is a sign 
attached to a rock here.

rooms.name: Rain and Moss
rooms.desc:
Cool drops of water rain down from thickly clustered stalactites 
suspended from the ceiling. Dark clumps of moss cling to cave formations
on the floor and wall of the north side of this small cavern. Dark exits
can be seen in the east and north walls.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc: To the west can dimly be seen a large cavern.  To the north the tunnel continues.  The dampness on the walls here seems slightly less.

rooms.name: A L O N G F A L L!!
rooms.desc:
AAAAAIIIIIEEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!

S        P        L        A        T        !        !        !

You should be more careful around dangerous precipices next time!

rooms.name: North End of Surf
rooms.desc:
You are waist deep in the surf and the rocks underwater are very slippery.  
Combined with the wash of the surf from the base of the cliff, footing is,
shall we say, treacherous. To the north the cliff base still blocks your 
way.  To the west is certain death, to the east is the relative safety of 
the beach.  Maybe you'd better turn back now.

rooms.name: South End of Surf
rooms.desc:
You are waist deep in the surf and the rocks underwater are very slippery.  
Combined with the wash of the surf from the base of the cliff, footing is,
shall we say, treacherous. To the south the cliff base still blocks your 
way.  To the west is certain death, to the east is the relative safety of 
the beach.  Maybe you'd better turn back now.

rooms.name: Deep Surf
rooms.desc:
As  the undertow sucks you down and your lungs 
fill with water, you realize what an ...

I D I O T!!

... you were not to take the warning advice.  Maybe in 
your next life you will use the brain your god gave you.
