rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
Along the west wall of this room is a table with cupboards above and below.
Along the south wall is a thick wood table with several knives and cleavers
stuck in it. Discarded chunks of vegetables litter its top. Recessed into 
the north wall is a large fireplace in which hangs an iron pot above a fire.
The pot gives forth the pleasing aroma of simmering vegetables and spices.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You've reached the end of the hallway.  There are doors to the east 
and West.

rooms.name: The Larder
rooms.desc:
Running the length of the east wall from floor to ceiling of this room
are shelves stuffed with boxes and tins. From the north wall protrude three
spigots with symbols painted above them. In the south wall are several bins
also painted with symbols.

rooms.name: Circle of Battle
rooms.desc:
A thirty foot in diameter ring of silver and gold glyphs is inlaid into the
floor here. At the center of the circle is a 3 foot square iron grate. From
beneath the grate comes a red glow.

rooms.name: Bottom of the Pool
rooms.desc:
You are at the bottom of the pool.  It's pretty murky down here.  Did you 
remember to hold your breath?

rooms.name: The Pool
rooms.desc:
A square pool of murky water covered by seaweed is found here. The pool is
fed by streams of water issuing from the mouths of large exquisitely carved
green jade frogs at each corner. The smell of brine and decay hangs heavy in
the air.

rooms.name: Main Store Room
rooms.desc: Many kegs and barrels are neatly stacked in this room.

rooms.name: In the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a short hallway.  The hallway continues to the 
North and south and doors are on the east and west walls.

rooms.name: Guests Dining Hall
rooms.desc:
A 30' long 5' wide table surrounded by chairs runs down the center of
this room. A lone still figure stands stooped over the table. At the east
end is a window showing the forest outside.

rooms.name: Warning Message
rooms.desc:
A message in common tongue has been carved into the stone above the lintel
of the door at the end of this hall. The message reads "CIRCLE OF TESTING
Authorized personnel only. You are entering a restricted zone"

rooms.name: A Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short hallway that turns to the east and dead ends.  The 
hallway continues to the south and there is a door in the north wall.

rooms.name: Conjurers Quarters
rooms.desc:
The door to this room opens a few inches and then something stops it.
At the foot of his bead in the NE corner is a chest.

rooms.name: Student Evokers Quarters
rooms.desc:
Lying in a bed in the NE corner of this room is an elf with his head 
propped up on a pillow. He holds before him a large open book. His eyes
stare wide open at the book. Hanging over the end of the bed is a robe.

rooms.name: At a Hallway Intersection
rooms.desc:
You are at the junction of two hallways. The Hallways lead east and North.
To the south is a door.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You've reached the end of the hallway.  You can return to the west or there
is a door to the south.

rooms.name: Domed Chamber
rooms.desc:
A milky white translucent substance forms a 20' high domed ceiling here.
At three equidistant points on the floor along the walls are small concave
mirrors pointed at an upward angle toward the center of the room. 
Protruding from each mirror face is a small and delicate, empty, silver 
wire basket.

rooms.name: The Face of Fear
rooms.desc:
You've climbed nearly 70' high when strong winds begin to swirl about. 
Soon a multicolor maelstrom centers itself in the room above you. From its
middle grows larger and larger until it fills the area the visage of an 
angry dark-haired man. He speaks in a booming ominous voice which crackles
with power "Turn back defilers of this place! Or suffer my wrath!"

rooms.name: Halfway Up the Stairs
rooms.desc:
You are halfway up the set of stairs.  The fact that there is no visible 
means of support for the stairs and that there is no railing makes you kind
of uncomfortable.

rooms.name: Lower Tower Chamber
rooms.desc:
A series of marble slabs form steps suspended in mid air and rise upward 
in a spiral along the walls of this chamber. A hidden door in the east wall
slowly opens and from it steps a large manlike creature. An iron band 
encrusted with gems encircles its head. The creature stands at the bottom 
of the stairs mute and unmoving.

rooms.name: Exercise Hall
rooms.desc:
There are two men in nightclothes frozen in fighting stances and wielding
longswords near the middle of this room. On one of the mens head hangs at an
odd angle a jeweled iron ring. A drab curtain covers an area 30' wide 10' 
out from the west wall. There is a door in the north wall and an archway in
the NW corner. A bedraggled looking bearded old man peeks out from behind 
one of the men laughs hysterically and says "The ring of battle is what you
seek. You'll gain a pretty bauble if you be not weak." and points to the 
archway.

rooms.name: Hallway Intersection
rooms.desc:
You are at the intersection of two hallways.  The hallways continue to the 
North, East, and South.  To the west is a door.

rooms.name: A Door Lined Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short door-lined hallway.  There are doors to the north and
South.  The hallway continues east and West.

rooms.name: A Door Lined Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short door-lined hallway.  There are doors to the North, East,
and South.  The hallway continues West.

rooms.name: Top of the Shaft
rooms.desc:
The platform stops gently at floor level and in the center of a 30' square
room. As soon as you step off the platform, it silently drops back down 
the chimney. Peering over the edge, you decide you might want to be very
careful about where you step. There are brass-bound oak doors at the center
of the north, south and west walls.

rooms.name: Lounge Area
rooms.desc:
A large fireplace with flames cheerily dancing within covers the west wall
of this room. Above the fireplace are three dusty portrait paintings and
near it on the north side of the room sits an overstuffed armchair.  Down 
the center of the room lies an oriental rug.  To the north and south are 
single doors and to the east is a set of double doors.

rooms.name: A Short Flight of Stairs
rooms.desc: A short flight of stairs leads down to another set of doors.

rooms.name: Sealed Exit
rooms.desc:
Two windows are in the north and south walls of this room. Through them 
can be seen a pinewood forest not far in the distance. At the center of 
the east wall is another set of double doors.

rooms.name: Doorstep
rooms.desc:
This is the doorstep to Orsilon's house.  You can go no further
than here due to the forcefield.

rooms.name: Guards Quarters
rooms.desc:
Two unmade empty beds are in the far opposite corners of this room. There 
is a wood chest at the foot of each. Above the beds on the wall hangs a small bullet shield embossed with a white sword.

rooms.name: Student Prestidigitators Quarters
rooms.desc:
An empty bed is in the SE corner of this room. Hung by a hook on the North
wall is a robe beneath which is a pair of worn leather shoes. A prone form 
can be detected beneath the covers on the bed.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is the Western end of a short hallway. There are doors to the North
and South.  The hallway continues East.

rooms.name: A Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a short hallway.  There are doors to the north and
South.  The hallway continues both east and West.

rooms.name: East End of a Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are at the Eastern end of a short hallway.  There is a door to the 
South and the hallway continues West.

rooms.name: Captain of the Guards Quarters
rooms.desc:
A full suit of field plate armor hangs on a wood rack in the NE corner. In
the SW corner is a small table littered with wood shavings and various shaped
small knives. In the opposite corner is a large empty bed.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of a hallway.  To the north is a hallway intersection.  
To the east is a heavy door.  To the west in another door.

rooms.name: Prison Cells
rooms.desc:
The door to this area is double thick and stands open. There are three 
doors spaced 10' apart on the south wall and a like door is at the end of 
the hall.

rooms.name: Prison Cells
rooms.desc:
The door to this area is double thick and stands open. There are three 
doors spaced 10' apart on the south wall and a like door is at the end of 
the hall.

rooms.name: Prison Cells
rooms.desc:
The door to this area is double thick and stands open. There are three 
doors spaced 10' apart on the south wall and a like door is at the end of 
the hall.

rooms.name: Time Stopped Man
rooms.desc:
Inside the cell is a time stopped man on his knees holding a bowl to his
lips.

rooms.name: Slagged Door
rooms.desc:
You stand in the entrance to an overgrown garden. Beyond the door is a
large chamber choked by a thick tangle of thorny rose bushes. The door 
lies in a pile of slag on the floor and is torn off its hinges.

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: There is a well made bed, a table and a chair in this room.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: There is a mussed bed, a table and a chair in this room.

rooms.name: Empty Cell
rooms.desc: The cell is bare and empty.

rooms.name: Empty Cell
rooms.desc: The cell is bare and empty.

rooms.name: Empty Cell
rooms.desc: The cell is bare and empty.

rooms.name: Short Flight of Stairs
rooms.desc:
You are on a short flight of stairs that goes down to the south and ends
at an ornately carved door.

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: Small Clearing
rooms.desc:
You are in a small clearing in an overgrown garden.  Rose bushes run 
rampant.

rooms.name: West End of a Long Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are at the western end of a long hallway. A door blocks progress to the
West and the hallway stretches off to the east.

rooms.name: Council Hall
rooms.desc:
This area was obviously constructed as some sort of grand hall or
council chamber. The left and right walls angle away from you a 45
degrees for 30' where they meet the back wall which curves outward for
another 30'. At the end of the west wall is a door. Two highly
polished wood benches are ahead to the left and right. At the southern
end, up a short flight of curved stairs is a large oak throne. On its
back posts are two brightly glowing globes which illuminate the entire
area. Some indistinguishable script can be seen carved into the upper
back of the great chair.

rooms.name: Circular Stone Staircase
rooms.desc: A series of stone stairs spiral downward into the darkness here.

rooms.name: Gem Cutting Room
rooms.desc:
A stout and heavy wood table is against the west wall. In front of the 
table is a chair. On the table are some small hammers and several other 
metal instruments. Above the table hanging on an iron chain is a brightly
glowing ball which lights the area effectively.

rooms.name: Burned Out Library
rooms.desc:
Charred and blackened books fill the burnt remains of shelves along the 
West and North-West walls. The bookshelves and their contents to the 
south are unaffected. In the NE corner is a desk scattered with many 
rolls of parchment. At the center of the north wall, between the burnt 
book cases is a small, dark, arched alcove above which is a stone lintel 
with an inscription carved into it. Near the center of the room is a very
odd sight. A small dark man in faded and worn orange robes is seemingly 
imprisoned in a cage of shimmering bars. Near the cage on its east side 
stands a man with a longsword raised as if to strike. The man is dressed 
in nightclothes and has an iron keyring hanging off his sash.

rooms.name: Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short hallway.  To the north and east are doors, to the west 
is a burnt out library.

rooms.name: Magical Components Storage
rooms.desc:
A confusing array of neatly stacked boxes, bins, bottles, vials, tins 
and various assorted other containers fill a glass cabinet running the 
length and height of the west, north and south walls.

rooms.name: Glassblower Workshop
rooms.desc:
At the center of the east wall of this room is a fireplace. In the middle
of the room is a large 10' square table. A barrel of fine sand sits in the 
NW corner.

rooms.name: A Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short connecting hallway.  To the north is a door, to the 
South and intersection.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You have reached the end of this short hall.  To the north and south are
doors, to the east is the laboratory.

rooms.name: Alchemy Laboratory
rooms.desc:
A long table scattered with sheets of parchment runs along the south wall
between two doors. Running east and west down the center of the room are two
more long tables each cluttered with a confusing array of glass receptacles,
tubes and strangely shaped bottles filled with a manifold display of colored
liquids, some bubbling and frothing.

rooms.name: Four Ways to Go
rooms.desc:
You enter a 30' across octagonal chamber. To the north and south are 
identical doors. To the west is a 10' wide 30' long passage ending at a
door.

rooms.name: Underground Garden
rooms.desc:
The air here is fresh and clean. A bright spheroid of golden light emits 
from the ceiling casting a warm glow all about. A carpet of thick green 
grass dotted here and there with colorful flowers covers the floor. Several
bushes grow in the area. At the center is a 10' wide circular, raised stone
receptacle. Crawling along its top is a large, golden eyed snake like 
creature with green/gold scales and a human like head. The creature stares 
at your party attentively.

rooms.name: Potters Workshop
rooms.desc:
In the NE corner of this room is a large, round barrel. At the center of 
the west wall is a large brick oven. Near the center of the room is a small
round table with a half formed, dried out clay pot lying on it. A wood 
cabinet is in the SE corner.

rooms.name: Mordains Quarters
rooms.desc:
A good sized bed unmade and rumpled is in the NE corner. On the floor is
a badly worn persian rug.

rooms.name: Hidden Lair
rooms.desc: You have entered a small lair of some sort.  The room is rather cramped.

rooms.name: Entrance to Secret Chamber
rooms.desc: You are in a small square room.

rooms.name: The Family Treasure Vault
rooms.desc:
There are two large chests bound in platinum and three large urns chased 
with gold along the north wall of this room.

rooms.name: Seascape Painting
rooms.desc:
Thinking you'd get a better look at the seascape painting, you stepped
a bit closer.  As you approach it, the seascape came to life. You are
now standing on a beach, complete with the smell of the ocean, the cry of
gulls and the feel of sand beneath your feet.  The only way out is back 
East to the bedroom.

rooms.name: Orsilons Quarters
rooms.desc:
A huge sumptuous bed of powder blue satiny material embroidered with 
gold thread floats at knee height centered between the east and west 
walls. At the four corners of the bed, holding it down are golden chains
attached to the floor. The west wall has a lifelike seascape painted across
its entire surface. Next to the wall is a small wood dais atop which rests 
a large conch shell. To the south a series of steps plunge into a half 
circle pool of clear water.

rooms.name: Fourth Level Teleport Room
rooms.desc:
You appear in a small rounded alcove at the center of a wall in a 20' 
square room. There is a waist high stone pedestal with a red gem in its 
center before you. Straight ahead, to the left and to the right are doors.

rooms.name: The Inner Sanctum
rooms.desc:
You have come into the bottom of a triangular room measuring 30' on a 
side. At its center on indistinct wavering form of a robed man can be seen.
He holds in his hands before him a softly glowing globe. The apparition 
floats a few inches above the floor. The man raises his hand, points to the
door behind you and mouths the word go.

rooms.name: Magic Den of the Yeti
rooms.desc:
Suddenly your surroundings have drastically changed. You appear near the
center of a 30' across round room. Snow covers the floor and huge icicles 
hang from the ceiling. The temperature here is very cold. Before you is an 
ice encrusted low stone pedestal. You don't have time to examine it however
as a huge hulking white furred beast is charging toward you.

rooms.name: Magic Den of the Troll
rooms.desc:
You suddenly appear in a 30' in diameter room. Bones litter the floor. At
the center is a low stone dais atop which has been placed a small pile of 
gnawed bones. You don't have time to examine the room more thoroughly as 
there is a huge mottle-skinned green troll is advancing toward you, slavering
jaws agape.

rooms.name: The Bronze Guardian
rooms.desc:
You appear at the far end of a 40' wide 80' long hall. Six stone columns,
three on a side, spaced 20' apart and reaching to the ceiling 20' above 
run down the hall. On each pillar is an iron sconce hold in a lit torch. At
the opposite end is a 20' wide 10' deep alcove. Standing in the alcove is a
tall muscular manlike bronze statue with the head of a dragon and holding a
huge curved scimitar. In its forehead is a brightly glowing yellow stone. A
few paces in front of you is a low round stone pedestal with a large 
gleaming diamond set in its top.

rooms.name: MIMIC LOAD ROOM, DON'T DELETE.
rooms.desc: The mimic loads here, used in the couch special.

rooms.name: On the Platform
rooms.desc:
The limestone walls of this chamber have been worked smooth. You stand in 
the center of a circular wooden platform in the middle of the room. Above
you in the ceiling is a 10' wide dark circular opening. This chimney reaches 
upward into the rock as far a you can see. Looking down, you see a moving shape
through the cracks in the boards.

rooms.name: Entering The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a rather dense forest.  You are
surprised to find that you do not feel any dread at entering such a 
forest, but you actually feel drawn to the forest.  There is an exit 
to the south.

rooms.name: Now Entering The Midlands
rooms.desc:
Well, welcome to Scythe's second creation and hopefully not
my last.  This area is based on a trilogy of fantasy books I am reading
called the Sword of Truth Trilogy by Terry Goodkind.  I admit that it
is not entirely my creation, but it will make a very interesting area.
This will be one of the biggest areas on the mud, and it consists of 
about 5 separate parts.  There are mobs ranging from all levels as
well as equipment ranging from all levels.  There are a couple of
REALLY good pieces of equipment in here that should be worth the trouble
of getting them.  If you have any questions or comments, good or bad, 
just post them and I will respond.

rooms.name: In The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You are now standing in a forest with a very thick canopy.  You
can hardly see where you entered the forest from due to the fact that
the canopy blocks out all light from overhead.  The trees around you 
look to be very old.  Exits lie in all directions.

rooms.name: A Path Through The Hartland
rooms.desc:
You continue on the path, noticing the size of the trees all
around you.  You feel dwarfed next to these creations of nature.  Their
sheer size and age amazes you.  You notice a hole in the ground off to
your right.  The paths continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Worn Path In The Forest
rooms.desc:
The path continues yet deeper into the forest, you are starting
to wonder if you would be able to find your way out of here if you go
much deeper.  You have noticed that there are many creatures that are
scurrying about, none that are threatening though.  The path turns so 
that it heads south or west.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Forest
rooms.desc:
You are going deeper and deeper into the forest.  You begin to
get a faint feeling of magic in the air.  You can feel a powerful source
of magic is nearby, you just hope that whatever it is, it is friendly.
The path leads north, east or south.

rooms.name: Entrance To An Old Cabin
rooms.desc:
You stand before an old cabin.  From the looks of it this cabin
has been here for a hundred years.  There is a porch and on the porch 
you see a rocking chair that looks in perfect condition.  There are two
windows to the cabin, but they are so dirty that you can't see into the 
interior of the cabin.  The cabin lies to the north and a path leads off 
to the east.

rooms.name: Further In The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You can tell that the forest is growing more dense with every
step you take.  It looks as though soon you will not be able to continue
walking through the forest.  A path leads to the east and a similar
path heads off in a westernly direction.

rooms.name: The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You notice that the trees in this particular area are much 
larger than the ones you have previously seen.  You feel like a dwarf
as you continue to walk along this path.  The path leads to the north,
south and the west.

rooms.name: End Of The Path
rooms.desc:
You seem to have come to the abrupt end of the path as the path
has been completely swallowed up by nature. The only way out is back to 
the south.

rooms.name: An Abrupt End To The Path
rooms.desc:
The path here seems to have disappeared.  Try as you might, you 
cannot seem to find the path.  Your only exit is back to the north.

rooms.name: Zedd's Log Cabin
rooms.desc:
You are now in the old cabin.  You notice a sign on the wall
which indicates that this is the humble abode of Zeddicus Zu'l Zorander,
a wizard of the First Order.  You notice a large table, some shelves
with many books and suck on them.  There is a fire going in the hearth
and a pot of stew cooking on it.  You wonder where this wizard was and
if he would mind if you took some of his food.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You now stand at the edge of the pass which goes through the
boundary.  You aren't sure why, but you feel the presence of spirits 
nearby.  The path leads north or south.

rooms.name: In The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest canopy is not quite as dense here and you find that
you can see much better now.  The wildlife has been friendly enough
in the forest, you hope that it stays that way.  You can follow the
path east or west.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You have moved deeper into the forest and you find that the
canopy has sealed off the ceiling of the forest again and there is
once again no light coming through.  There are huge, ancient trees
all around.  You wonder at how old they must be.  You can head to
the east or to the south.

rooms.name: A Clearing In The Forest
rooms.desc:
You suddenly emerge from the thickest part of the forest and
you are now standing in a large clearing in the forest.  You notice
a circle of rocks at the center of the clearing indicating that other
people have been here before and camped.  For some strange reason, you 
feel safe and secure in this clearing.  There are entrances back into
the dense forest to the east and the north.

rooms.name: In The Forest
rooms.desc:
You are once again in a dark and dense part of the forest.
It is difficult to see where you are headed.  You hope that you 
don't walk into, BAM!! Too late, you just walked into a tree.  You can
head west or north.

rooms.name: Further In The Hartland
rooms.desc:
You are walking on a path that is rather clear for right now.
Looking ahead of you, you can tell that the forest gets much thicker
and you begin to wonder how long you can follow this path.  You can 
head to the north or the south.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Hartland
rooms.desc:
You are now into the thick of the forest.  The canopy seals out
all light in here.  You notice that the trees are growing larger and 
older as you move deeper.  You can go east, west or north.

rooms.name: The Darkest Part Of The Forest
rooms.desc: It's too dark to see anything at all!

rooms.name: At The Fringe Of The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of the boundary, or more to the point,
the pass that goes through the boundary.  You can see a glowing green 
wall that marks the division of the boundary from the pass.  You can 
continue on to the south and the west.

rooms.name: In The Pass Through The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are now on the pass that will take you through the boundary.
Here the pass is rather wide so you are not that close to the boundary
yet.  You can see the green wall from here, but it is a distance away.
You can head east or north.

rooms.name: At The Large Boulder
rooms.desc:
You notice that the pass heads uphill here.  There is a large
boulder here that almost blocks the path.  With all of the boulders and
rock formations here in the pass, it is very difficult to see what lies 
ahead.  The pass leads in all directions.

rooms.name: Past The Boulder
rooms.desc:
You are now past the large boulder but you are now much closer
to the boundary.  You don't think you want to hang around here for long.
You can head east or west.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are now so close you are almost in the boundary.  You can
see many spirits of the people you love and hate calling you to join 
them in there.  You know if you enter you will never come back.  You 
can go to the west or the south.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are still just along the edge of the boundary.  You hear 
the longing calls of the spirits through the wall and have to give all
your concentration in order to keep from heeding their calls.  You can
continue downhill to the south or head back to the north.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
At the green wall to the boundary, you can feel yourself being
drawn in and do not think it would be wise to remain here for long.  
It could be a matter of life and death if you remain.  The pass leads
north and west.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are moving away from the boundary, but you are still too
close for comfort.  The calls from the spirits are still rather loud
from here and it is still taking you quite a bit of concentration not
to go running to them.  You can continue on to the east and the west.

rooms.name: Crossroads In The Pass
rooms.desc:
You have come to a crossroads in the pass.  You notice that
all the paths look the same and that there are not really any traces
of life here.  Paths lie in all directions.

rooms.name: Entrance To A Cave
rooms.desc:
You stand before a rather large cave.  It does not appear to
have life of any kind, but since you can't see in there, you cannot
tell.  The pass leads north and south, and the cave lies to the east.

rooms.name: The Cave In The Pass
rooms.desc:
The cave is rather large.  You can see a huge pile of skeletons
in the dirt against the wall of the cave.  It doesn't appear that there
is anything in here right now, but obviously something lives here.  You
begin to wonder if it would be wise to wait for them to return.  The 
only exit is to the west.

rooms.name: Another Pass In The Boundary
rooms.desc:
This pass is a bit steeper than the others.  You can feel the
strain on the muscles in your legs as you begin to hike up the pass.
You have a constant feeling of uneasiness in this place.  The pass
leads east and north.

rooms.name: The Top Of The Rise
rooms.desc:
After hiking up the slope you appear to have reached the top,
only to find yourself closer to the boundary.  You can once again hear
the beckoning of the spirits.  You can go back down the slope to the
south or continue on the pass to the west.

rooms.name: Next To The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are now standing directly next to the boundary.  You are 
so close to it that you can feel the magic and the death emanating
from it.  The pass continues to the south or to the east.

rooms.name: Next To The Boundary
rooms.desc:
Still walking right next to the boundary, you continue on a 
path sloping downward.  The eerie green color is really starting to
annoy you along with the voices of the spirits.  You feel you might
go insane if you stay here to much longer.  You can continue on to
the south or head back up the slope to the north.

rooms.name: The Bottom Of The Slope
rooms.desc:
You are now at the bottom of the slope, and a little farther
away from the actual boundary, but you can still hear the spirits
calling to you.  The pass heads north up the slope or to the east.

rooms.name: Away From The Boundary
rooms.desc:
Now that you are a little farther away from the boundary, the
call of the spirits is not as loud and you feel you might actually
remain sane a while longer.  The pass continues east or heads back west.

rooms.name: Entrance To A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand before a narrow but long cavern.  It is the narrowest
part of the pass, and it is where the sides of the boundary almost meet.
You can see a faint light on the other side of the cavern.  You can go in 
all directions.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You notice that the path has leveled off here and that the 
boulders do not block your view here.  You can follow the path east
or west.

rooms.name: Death At The Hands Of The Keeper
rooms.desc:
You know as soon as you walk in here that all is lost.  The 
Keeper smiles down at you wickedly.  Using his Subtractive magic, he 
slices open your abdomen to read your entrails.  You try to scream but
no sound escapes as he has ripped your vocal cords out.  He then begins
to tear your limbs off one at a time, as if he were picking an insect
apart.  You never thought you would ever wish for death.

rooms.name: In Between The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You have entered the cavern's passage and you realize that
the walls of the boundary are on both sides of you.  In fact, they
are so close together at this point that you have to keep your arms
in close to your body to keep from touching the boundary on either
side.  You may continue on through the passage south or head back 
north.

rooms.name: Lost In The Cavern
rooms.desc:
Looking back, you can no longer see the light from outside the
cavern to the north or the south.  You realize that you really don't 
know which way you are headed.

rooms.name: Almost Through The Cavern
rooms.desc:
You can now see light up ahead and it looks to be the way out
of here.  Looking back all you see is blackness and the greenish color
of the boundary walls.  You can exit the cavern to the south or head 
back into it to the north.

rooms.name: Through The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are finally out of the boundary.  You have decided that
you will be happy if you never have to go back there again in your
entire life.  As you look around, you realize how much smaller the 
trees are in this forest compared to the trees in the Hartland forest.
Something about this forest warns you of great danger.  Paths lead off
in all directions.

rooms.name: In The Midlands Forest
rooms.desc:
Standing in the forest, you almost feel at home again now that
you are out of the pass in the boundary.  There is a tree that stands
out to your right, it has many things carved into the bark.  You have 
noticed that there really are not any of the smaller, harmless creatures
such as the ones in the Hartlands Forest.  The path heads out of the
forest to the west or continues deeper to the east.

rooms.name: A Crossroads In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You are now standing in a crossroads of some sort with the path
splitting off in many directions.  There is another tree with something
cut into the bark in front of you.  As you look up a large branch falls
off of one of the trees to crash right next to you.  Another inch or two
and you would be underneath of it.  The path turns to the north and the
south.  You can also head back to the west.

rooms.name: In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You are heading deeper and deeper into the forest.  For some
odd reason you are getting the feeling like you are being watched by
someone or something.  You decide that haste would be in order as you
are sure you don't want to meet up with whatever is out there.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path now turns in the forest.  It heads to the east or back
to the south.

rooms.name: Continuing On The Path
rooms.desc:
Looking around you, you notice that the trees and underbrush 
are more sparse here and the path is a bit more visible.  Even though
the growth here is not as thick, you still feel as though you are being
watched or possibly even hunted.  The path turns to the south or goes
back to the west.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Midlands Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest has almost completely disappeared here, and so has
the path.  Most likely the path has disappeared because no one ever
travels this way.  Despite that thought, you are still glad to be 
moving away from the forest and that eerie feeling of being watched.
The path looks to continue to the east and to the north.

rooms.name: In The Hills
rooms.desc:
The hills here are much steeper and rockier than the ones that
you traveled through in the pass.  As you look around, you notice no
immediate signs of life in these parts.  This area is actually quite 
steep and appears to lead to a mountain off in the distance.

rooms.name: Climbing The Rocky Terrain
rooms.desc:
You are still heading up and the terrain is much rockier here.
You are beginning to sweat from the work of climbing.  It looks as 
though soon the path will be almost unclimbable, or at least what little
bit of a path you can see.

rooms.name: Up The Slope
rooms.desc:
You continue to head up the slope.  All of a sudden, a boulder
comes rolling down the slope.  You just barely dive out of the way as
it rolls by you down the slope.  Now you wonder if someone pushed that
at you or if it just rolled on it's own.  You can continue climbing to 
the south as the path to the east is completely blocked or you can head
back to the west.

rooms.name: A Sharp Rise In The Path
rooms.desc:
You are now before a sharp rise in the path.  It is some kind
of plateau and it looks climbable from here.  Guess you won't know
until you try.  You can climb the rise or head back down the path.

rooms.name: On The Plateau
rooms.desc:
After finally reaching the top of the plateau, you realize that
you have climbed a good twenty feet or so.  From this height you have a
breathtaking view of the forest and hills below.  Looking around you
you notice a skeleton lying in the dirt.  It looks like he has drawn
something in the dirt.  You can go back down the plateau or you can 
continue to the west.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Plateau
rooms.desc:
You have reached the far side of the plateau.  Your view of
the forest is obscured by massive boulders.  You can now climb down
this side of the plateau or head back towards the other edge.

rooms.name: The Foot Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You finish climbing down from the top of the plateau without
any major injuries.  You are now standing at the base of the mountain
you could see off in the distance earlier.  As you look at the mountain
you realize that the climb to the top is almost straight up.  You can 
head south to the base of the mountain or you can climb back up to the
top of the plateau.

rooms.name: The Base Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
Standing below the mountain, you conclude that it would be
one hell of a climb to reach the top.  It appears to head almost
straight up right into the clouds.  The view from the top must be
quite breathtaking.  You can climb the mountain or head back down 
to below the plateau.

rooms.name: Climbing The Face Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You are now climbing the face of this great mountain.  You 
cannot believe you are even thinking about doing this, much less
actually doing it.  You now know you will always regret doing this.

rooms.name: Climbing The Face Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You continue on your climb up the face of this outrageously
high mountain.  You are wondering if you will have the energy to finish
the climb.  You better have!

rooms.name: Climbing The Face Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
Nearing the end of your endurance, you wonder how much higher
you will have to climb as you have not found a place to rest yet.  It
had better be soon or you will be eternally resting at the base of the
mountain.

rooms.name: The Cave At The Top Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You are now inside the cave.  At the back of the cave is a
rather large egg sitting in a very large nest made out of straw.  
Whatever laid that egg, you surely don't want to meet it, especially
if it is a dragon's egg.  Everyone knows how fiercely protective
dragons can be of their young.

rooms.name: Another Crossroads In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You leave one crossroads and come to another.  The paths here
are a bit worn down indicating that others besides yourself come through
here.  The paths lead off in three directions, east, west and north.

rooms.name: A Small Clearing
rooms.desc:
This clearing in the forest seems odd because all around you
the forest is so dense that you cannot exit the clearing except by
the way you entered it.  For some strange reason you feel safer here
than you have the entire time you have been in this forest.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Forest
rooms.desc:
The path begins to wind a bit at this point.  The path has
been growing a bit narrower as you continue into the forest.  At 
least the forest isn't so dark here that you can't see where you
are going but it is still dense enough that you really can't see
what lies beyond the forest.  The path turns to the south and it leads
back to the east.

rooms.name: A Split In The Narrow Path
rooms.desc:
The path has split off in two directions.  There is a small
clearing in the forest here where the path lies indicating that this
must be a well used path.  You also notice that both the eastern and
western paths are much wider than the ones you have been traveling on
up to this point.  The path splits off, heading east, west or back to 
the north.

rooms.name: Another Turn In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path turns yet again so that it leads off to the south or
you can head back to the west.

rooms.name: The Main Crossroads
rooms.desc:
You are standing in what is obviously a major crossroads as
it is very worn and wide.  There are hoof prints and footprints all 
over and they are relatively fresh.  It would not be advisable to 
wait here long since many people pass through here.  The path goes
off in all directions.

rooms.name: The Main Northern Road
rooms.desc:
This is the major road that heads north through the midlands
forest.  It is rather wide, wide enough to march an army on and it
looks to head directly north for a little ways.  The road continues
on to the north and the south.

rooms.name: A Split In The Western Road
rooms.desc:
The western road splits here, so that it leads north, east or
west.  There are still many tracks in the dirt, whatever came through
here, came through here in quite a hurry.  They appear to have been
running from something.

rooms.name: A Wide Path
rooms.desc:
This path is quite wide, but not to the scale of the western
road.  The trees line the path on both sides with some underbrush 
sprouting up here and there.  This path must be used often, for there
is nothing growing in the path.

rooms.name: The Path Splits Four Ways
rooms.desc:
Here the path splits off in all directions.  Off in the distance
you think you here the sounds of a small village of some sort.  It would
appear from the path to the west that not too many people travel to or
from whatever lies in that direction.

rooms.name: Entering Agaden Reach
rooms.desc:
The forest extends into a valley of some kind that appears to
be rather large.  The forest here is much darker and you feel as though
you are being watched as you walk through this valley.  For some reason
you get a terrible feeling of danger about this place.  The valley 
extends to the north or you can reenter the midlands forest to the south.

rooms.name: In Agaden Reach
rooms.desc:
Walking along the path through the valley, you feel your fear
beginning to rise inside you.  It almost looks like the trees have eyes
but then you realize that that is silly, or is it?  The valley extends
to the north and the south.

rooms.name: The Fountain In The Reach
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large, open area in the shape of a circle.  
There are vines growing on the trees all around this circle.  
The path appears to end here at this circle.  The trees completely 
block out the light from the sun or the moon in this clearing.  Your 
only options are to remain here or head back south.

rooms.name: In The Plains
rooms.desc:
Traveling through on this path through the plains is quite a 
change from the deep, thick forest you have been traveling through.  
This is a rather narrow path through these plains and fields, indicating
that the people who live near here do not use animals or equipment to
do their farming.  The path continues through the fields to the west and
back into the forest to the east.

rooms.name: In The Fields
rooms.desc:
The plains have gradually disappeared and now there are only
cultivated fields around you.  These fields are well taken care of but
strangely enough you haven't seen anyone guarding them yet.  The path
continues to the west and the east.

rooms.name: Entrance To The Village
rooms.desc:
You are on a muddy path that leads to a small village.  There
are huts all around you.  Except for a few things you see here and 
there, everything looks to be covered in mud, including the inhabitants.
To the west you enter the village and to the east you enter the fields.

rooms.name: In The Village
rooms.desc:
Looking around you, you notice many small huts with smoke coming
out of an opening in the top of the huts.  Walking through this small
village you see many people, all covered in mud.  They are giving you
strange looks as if to say, "What are you doing here?"

rooms.name: Turn In The Village
rooms.desc:
The huts are becoming fewer in number as you continue further
into the village.  You can see a slightly larger hut off to the east.
The path continues into the village to the south and the west.

rooms.name: Within A Large Hut
rooms.desc:
You now stand inside of one of the larger huts.  There are many
items strewn about and a few beds arranged around the fire at the center
of the hut.  This is obviously the hut of an important person, probably
an elder of the village.  From the looks of the smaller clothes and the
few "toys" in the hut, he is a family man as well.

rooms.name: A Crossroads In The Village
rooms.desc:
From the looks of the people in this village, you are beginning
to understand why they are called the Mud People.  Every inhabitant of
this village is covered in mud from head to toe, including their hair.
The path through the village splits off in all directions, with huts
on all sides of you.

rooms.name: The Spirit Hut
rooms.desc:
You now stand within a very large hut that appears to be some
kind of gathering place for the elders.  There is a bowl full of some
weird looking frogs and another bowl with a strange type of paint in
it.  This appears to be some sort of spirit gathering place.  Your
only exit is to the south.

rooms.name: A Small Hut In The Village
rooms.desc:
This is a much smaller hut with many weapons lying about as well
as many tools.  There is a bed in the corner and a small campfire in the
center, beyond that there is nothing else in this hut.  It is very
spartanesque.  This is probably the hut of a hunter or a warrior.

rooms.name: In The Village
rooms.desc:
The village continues along this road.  The huts are spaced
apart in increments of about ten to twenty feet.  The people are
walking about, minding their business, almost as if they don't even
notice you at all.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Village
rooms.desc:
The path turns here so it is now heading east and north.  The
amount of mud in this village is quite amazing, considering that people
actually live here.  It's no wonder they came to be known as the mud
people.

rooms.name: A Split In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path now splits off in three directions, north, south and
west.

rooms.name: The Busy Center
rooms.desc:
You are standing in what looks to be a main center of the village
with many huts around it and a large open area at the center of these
huts.  There are huts of all types in all directions.

rooms.name: The Village Store
rooms.desc:
You are standing within a shop that appears to carry just about
everything possible.  You see weapons all around you, as well as armor
and magical items of all sorts.  The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Small Hut
rooms.desc:
This hut is really plain.  There are a couple of furs and some
spears around the hut, other than that there isn't much in here.  Your
exit is to the west.

rooms.name: Another Hut
rooms.desc:
There is a small fire burning at the center of the hut with
the smoke coming out of the top of the hut.  There is a bow lying in
the corner and a quiver with many arrows in it.  The exit is to the
east.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Midlands Path
rooms.desc:
The path through the forest turns here.  You are no longer
on a main road, but on a much smaller path that splits off of the
road.  The exits lie to the north and the west.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
The forest is growing much more dense as you continue along
this path.  The trees obscure the light a bit more this deep in the
forest and the path is a bit narrower.  You can follow the path to
the east or the west.

rooms.name: Another Split In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path splits here so that it heads north and south.  You
notice that there are many footprints here as though someone had a
struggle here.  You hope that a similar fate does not befall you.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
The forest is not quite as dense here.  The path has widened a
bit and the trees do not appear to be as large as they are in other parts
of the forest.  The path turns here so that it now leads east or south.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Midlands
rooms.desc:
Amazingly, you continue on the path and just when the path looks
to be at it's end, you are at the edge of the forest.  The trees have
almost completely disappeared here.  You can see the faint marks where
someone was dragged down this path.  The path now leads east and north.

rooms.name: In The Deep Midlands
rooms.desc:
The forest is much deeper here.  It almost seems as if the forest
has swallowed up all light from the "outside" world.  You can barely see
the hint of a path.  You are getting the idea that no one travels this
way much anymore.  You can go north or south.

rooms.name: Deep In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You have now lost all signs of a path and you are not even sure
which way would lead you back out of here.  The forest to the south and
east is so thick that you cannot even think of going in that direction.
Your only options are to go east or north.

rooms.name: Lost In The Midlands Forest
rooms.desc:
You are beginning to get dizzy after walking through this forest
because you are lost.  You can't see much and you hurt your nose when you
walked into a tree.  There is a faint light to the south.

rooms.name: Out of The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You are finally out of that forest and can get some feeling of
where you are going now.  You are relieved to finally be out of that
forest and back in the light again.

rooms.name: Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc: Look map to see slums layout.

rooms.name: Entering a Dim Street
rooms.desc:
While most city streets are clean and well maintained, the street here
has taken a turn for the worse. Looking ahead, you can see that the street
doesn't get any better, worse in fact. There is a sign fastened securely
to the wall of a building.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
Proceeding deeper into the slums, the street narrows and begins to
twist and turn. Rubbish lies strewn about randomly, sometimes threatening
to topple down upon you. It would be easy to get lost here.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
It is said that this section is the oldest part of town. It certainly
looks like it now. Poorly constructed houses line the street, sometimes
two stories high, and garbage is a continual threat to life.

rooms.name: A Blocked Street
rooms.desc:
As the road continues, little changes beside the direction you are 
going.  Ahead, the burnt remains of a building are piled in the street
blocking your way south. From all appearances, houses have been built
haphazardly upon the ruined foundations of others.

rooms.name: In a Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
Charred bricks and wood lay scattered about in small pieces. It feels
weird walking through the remains of this building.  You wonder what caused
the fire and more importantly why it didn't consume this entire section of
town.

rooms.name: In a Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
This building apparently had a basement judging by the hollow thunk of
your boots on the floorboards. Or maybe it's the creak of the rotting
floorboards.  Best not to dally too long.

rooms.name: A Clean Street
rooms.desc:
The street here is clean, meticulously swept by someone. There is no sign
of rubbish anywhere.  There is a light to the south.

rooms.name: A Clean Street
rooms.desc:
Like the street to the north, this area has been swept clean and there
is a lantern hanging from a lamp post. To the east is the entrance of some
sort of establishment.

rooms.name: The Plated Ingot
rooms.desc:
In direct contrast to the rest of this part of the city, this room is 
clean, warm, and well lit. The lighting is provided by what appears to be
magical globes hung on chandeliers. On the north wall is a fireplace that
blazes heartily.  To your right, a bar lies along the west wall.  Across
many tables and clouds of pipe and other smoke is a doorway through which
you can hear occasional snatches of conversation. The bar continues south.

rooms.name: The Plated Ingot
rooms.desc:
Most of the people in the tavern have congregated in this end of the
room. The lighting here is a bit dimmer. Given the nature of this part
of the town, you would expect the patrons to be more wary, yet most look
fairly relaxed. The bar along the west wall is made of sturdy ironwood 
from the surrounding forests of Kir Drax'in. Behind the bar is a doorway
through which the smells of fine foods waft. On the east side of the room
is a closed door. Along the south wall a set of stairs leads up.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
As you guessed, this is the kitchen. Pots and pans hang from the ceiling.
Various kettles sit bubbling jovially upon fire pits which line north and
south walls. In the center of the room is a large preparation table upon
which a huge slab of spiced meat lies steaming. On the west wall is a medium-
sized hole with shutters on either side.

rooms.name: Gambling room
rooms.desc:
Low-hung, dim lights hang over assorted small gambling tables. You can
see a variety of card games going on, a game of sherpa, as well as several
dice games. It's hard to make out any faces in the crowd due to the precise
positioning of the lighting in addition to the volume of smoke. The little
conversation you hear seems sporadic and muted, with only occasional rowdy
outbursts.

rooms.name: Conference Room
rooms.desc:
A long table surrounded by high-back wing chairs takes up most of this
room. Along the walls are narrow tables laden with food and drink. The
combination of dim lighting and dark paneling makes identification of
people difficult.

rooms.name: Madame Isabel's
rooms.desc:
This room takes on an entirely different feel.  Soft couches and plush
chairs line the walls and fill the floor. Several books rest upon end tables.
To the west, north, and east are rooms cordoned off by silken walls.

rooms.name: Silk Partitioned Room
rooms.desc:
Silk partitioning has divided this room into many sub-compartments.
Sounds of ah, well, errr, pleasure come from many of the rooms.  If
possible, the lighting here is even dimmer.

rooms.name: Silk Partitioned Room
rooms.desc:
Silk partitioning has divided this room into many sub-compartments.
Sounds of ah, well, errr, pleasure come from many of the rooms.  If
possible, the lighting here is even dimmer.

rooms.name: Silk Partitioned Room
rooms.desc:
Silk partitioning has divided this room into many sub-compartments.
Sounds of ah, well, errr, pleasure come from many of the rooms.  If
possible, the lighting here is even dimmer.

rooms.name: Private Quarters
rooms.desc:
Bookshelves line the walls of this room and several layers of rugs
cover most of the floor. Along the east wall is all sorts of experimental
magic paraphernalia. A soft feather bed occupies the northwest corner and
an over-stuffed wingback chair sits beside an end table in the center of
the room. A small dining table sits against the south wall.  A narrow 
staircase leads upwards.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. Long, low chairs are
scattered about the roof as well as several strange instruments.  A low
wall protects you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.
Scattered about the roof are several plants of unknown variety. There
appears to be some sort of force field just above this area.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. A low wall protects
you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.  Scattered about
the roof are several plants of unknown variety.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. A low wall protects
you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.  Scattered about
the roof are several plants of unknown variety.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.desc:
You stand upon the rooftop of the Plated Ingot. A low wall protects
you from stumbling off the edge to the street below.  Scattered about
the roof are several plants of unknown variety.

rooms.name: A Clean Street
rooms.desc:
Like the street to the west, the way here is clear of debris.  It has
been swept clean by someone.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
The street here has reverted to the filth strewn path you have seen
elsewhere. Shadows are long and buildings tower around and over you, 
many hanging almost unbelievably over the street.  A broken wall forces
you north.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
Piles of refuse force you to wind your way through the street.  The
smells here cause you to plug your nose - difficult to do while keeping
hand on your weapon and one on your money pouch. The street cuts back 
to the east.

rooms.name: A Dim Street
rooms.desc:
The ever-present garbage persists while rats chew at the carcass of
something about the size of a dog. The light here is much darker as the
buildings seem to be growing over the street.

rooms.name: An Intersection
rooms.desc: The street diverges here and is relatively free of debris.

rooms.name: Dead End Alley
rooms.desc:
The street ends here in a huge pile of garbage.  Many sets of ferral eyes
stare at you from the darkness.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Almost all light is blocked out by the towering buildings crowding the
street. In addition, the street has narrowed considerably, though it does
not seem as filthy.  However, for what the street lacks in refuse, it makes
up in smell. A mixture of urine, vomit, and congealed blood make even the
heartiest stomachs turn sour.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Darkness flits about you like ghosts and footing is a bit treacherous.
Bile rises in your throat at the smells assaulting you.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
The street ends here in almost complete and utter darkness.  Dark
doorways yawn insolently around you.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Darkness drapes around you like an ill-fitting glove.  Puddles of unknown
fluids makes footing tricky.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
Light filters down more here and a bit of a breeze flushes the acidic
smell of vomit away, much to your relief. Despite the relief of being out
of the pressing darkness, you don't feel safe here. Best to move on.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
The street is cleaner here, still the ever-present refuse, but not so
much in the way of vomit and other fluids.  The east is blocked by a solid
brick wall that seems out of place here.

rooms.name: A Dark Street
rooms.desc:
You've reached the end of the street.  To the east still is the strange
brick wall and to the west is the remains of a building.

rooms.name: Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
The building here has been neatly cleared, decidedly different from the
surrounding area. To the north the building continues. To the south the way
is blocked by the remains of a brick wall. To the west there is a door with
a sign on it.

rooms.name: Ruined Building
rooms.desc:
Like the previous room, the rubble has been neatly cleaned away here.
However, it is a dead-end.  Nowhere to go.

rooms.name: A Dismal Hovel
rooms.desc:
Home to many by the appearance of this single room makeshift building.
The walls are constructed of many different materials: the floor is dirt.
Bed rolls lie scattered about the room and there is a fire pit in one corner.

rooms.name: A Pitch Black Building
rooms.desc:
If you thought the smell was bad outside, it's much worse in here.
Scattered about the room are remnants of once beautiful furniture, 
puddles of fluids and used drug paraphernalia.

rooms.desc: This room is devoid of anything, including dust.

rooms.name: Second Floor
rooms.desc:
Despite the awful condition these two story buildings are in, it's easy
to see that they once were houses for well-to-do aristocrats.  Now they are
lotus dens, harboring those hiding behind the false security of drug-induced
stupor.

rooms.name: Narrow Plank
rooms.desc:
You teeter upon a wobbly narrow plank which spans the short distance
between buildings. Looking down into the blackness causes your gluteus
maximus to pucker, your liver to rise into your throat, and your vision
to dance a nifty number. Walk nimbly! The plank ends abruptly at a brick
wall to the west.

rooms.name: Gutted Hotel
rooms.desc:
The entire place has been gutted and turned into a lotus den. The stench
is overpowering to those with any sense left.  Of course those with any
sense wouldn't be here anyway.
