The black sand at your feet jumps into the air as a freak storm suddenly
springs right on top of you. The air is dark with gale force winds to the west
while a short distance east it is calm and peaceful, though still hellishly
hot. You almost fall to your death as you perch perilously on the edge of
deep canyon south of you.

rooms.name: Outside the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The crest on the doors before you shows this to be the ancient Citadel, used
by the Knights of Solamnia as a meeting place for strategic planning against
the forces of the dark pagan hordes. History says that evil magic besieged the 
Citadel with their magical arts, forcing it open and slaying all within.
When the last tortured scream of the knights died out, they perversed their
spirits with the forces of the entire black coven, and banished the Citadel 
here as a last insult to the brave knights that tried to defend their homeland.

rooms.name: Inside the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The ceiling is cracked and blackened, and the very stone of the walls seems
to be warped from the terrors and magics that were worked here. The desert
lies through the great doors to the west, and an enormous spiral staircase is
northeast of here.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
A great stone spiral staircase is north of here, and the exit to the west
leads into the abandoned citadel. The air seems to echo with the spirits of the
dead.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
A great stone spiral staircase is east of here, and the exit to the south leads
into the citadel south. The air seems to echo with the spirits of the dead.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The spiral stairway rises above you, fading into darkness before you can see
the roof. An enormous pile of bleached bones has built up in the middle of the
stair's spiral, obviously having been flung down from above. Insects crawl all
about, living off of this macabre spectacle.

rooms.name: On the Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
The stairs spiral upwards to the roof of the Citadel. The individual steps
are so large it takes two paces to cross them, and the craftsmanship that
keeps them from crushing under their own weight astounds you.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The spiral staircase continues to rise here. You can see sunlight shining into
the level above you.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
This corner of the landing houses a remarkable tapestry preserved by the
desert heat. It pictures Knights of Solamnia battering down the ferocious
Jun Horde. The spiral staircase heads down to the north, and upwards west of
here.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The floor seems unstable here, crumbling beneath your feet. Obviously the dark
magics transportation of the Citadel caused considerable strain to the 
structure.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The stairs make a landing here, continuing upwards to the southwest and
heading back down at this point to the ground level.

rooms.name: On the Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
The stairs spiral upwards to the roof of the Citadel. The individual steps
are so large it takes two paces to cross them, and the craftsmanship that
keeps them from crushing under their own weight astounds you.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The wall to the west has a gaping hole in it, giving a terrific view of the
rolling sand dunes of the desert below. A great sand storm brews on the
horizon, and you hope that it quickly dissipates and does not head this way.
The spiral stair continues to the northeast.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
You see a shadow cast from above cross the stairs to the north. Battle fear
creeps slowly into your system, heightening your senses and quickening your
pulse.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The stone walls of the Citadel are hot to the touch, obviously being
baked from outside by the blistering sun. The stairs leads up to the east
and down to the south.
   Something shakes the ceiling above you, bringing dust down onto your
head.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
A loud scuffling on the floor above you is suddenly quiet as you approach
the base of the stairs. Only your party's measured breathing can be heard.

rooms.name: On the Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
The stairs spiral upwards to the roof of the Citadel. Sunlight glinting from
below seems to fade into blackness as you concentrate on surviving the monster
above you.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Dragon
rooms.desc:
This corner of the room is obviously the Brass Dragon's sleeping quarters.
The floor is littered with treasures mingled admist fleshless skeletons.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Floor
rooms.desc:
Solamnic runes cover the walls, denoting this as the floor belonging to the
most powerful magic-users among the Knights. Scratch marks from dragon's
talons mar the stone floor.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Floor
rooms.desc:
Solamnic runes cover the walls, denoting this as the floor belonging to the
most powerful magic-users among the Knights. Scratch marks from dragon's
talons mar the stone floor.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Floor
rooms.desc:
A huge Brass Dragon eyes you from across the room. He has evidently set up
residence here in the absence of a suitable cave, and seems angered at your
intrusion into his home.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Lair of the Blue Dragon
rooms.desc:
Harsh sunlight pours down on your head from above, but does not reach into
the cavern hollowed out of the earth to the south. No sound can be heard
from within.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Blue Dragon
rooms.desc:
The black rock walls reflect no light, and the sand floor absorbs all sound.
The blue dragon seems to come at you from all directions.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Blue Dragon
rooms.desc:
A rustle in the dark makes you curse your eyes, struggling to adjust to the
darkness. Light filters in from the north, but doesn't illuminate anything
but your companions.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Blue Dragon
rooms.desc:
The black rock walls reflect no light, and the sand floor absorbs all sound.
The Blue Dragon seems to come at you from all directions.

The Blue Dragon seems to come at you from all directions.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Horde
rooms.desc:
This must have been the dragon's treasure room.. sapphires and gold lie all
around.

rooms.name: The Maharajah's Quarters
rooms.desc:
You see an elegantly decorated room with many finely made tapestries of the
Brown Dragon hanging on the walls. Many scantily clad Rakshasi consorts
surround the Maharajah and succumb to his every desire.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You stand just east of a worn trail. The sun burns hot on the desert in all
other directions.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Dracolich
rooms.desc: All is dark here....

rooms.name: Outside the Abandoned Lair
rooms.desc: A deep pit opens into the ground before you. Within is total darkness.

rooms.name: In a Strange Cave
rooms.desc:
You stand in a cave seemingly carved from solid rock. Loose desert sand sifts
down  in through the opening above your head. To the south, a dark hole
opens into a gigantic cavern. Tracks beneath your feet can only be those of a
dragon.

rooms.name: In the Dragon's Lair
rooms.desc:
Bones and bits of armor litter the floor here, and the rock walls are scarred 
from the centuries of abrasion against the dragon's diamond-hard scales.
The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: The Temple of Serapis
rooms.desc:
A bloodstained throne rises before you between black onyx columns. The
vaulted ceiling rises out of sight, but half-rotted corpses dangle down to
eye level on silver hooks. Great tapestries line the walls: a picture of
Pagan and Chalkara fighting a huge lich in Market Square; a picture of a
broken corpse in the baker's stall; and a huge picture of the Goddess Tresia
lounging on a bed surrounded by sleek-furred tigers.

rooms.name: The Well of Souls
rooms.desc:
Serapis' most horrific creatures are sprung into existence here, in the depths
of the brackish pool that fills the center of the room. A ball of light hangs
suspended by magick in the air above the pool, filling the room with a soft
glow that seems to make more shadows than it dispels. The entrance to the west
seems to have disappeared.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Crystal Temple
rooms.desc:
Before you a huge building towers over the horizon. It looks ancient beyond
belief, and the signs of the altar and holy flame above the door and on the
gables show it to be a temple. The entire building is made of some slick black
stone, possibly onyx.

rooms.name: The Secret Room
rooms.desc:
The southern wall of this room is dark onyx which shows up like a dirty stain
against the other three clear crystal walls. The door that was hidden from the
outside is plainly visible on this side, leading south out into the
keeper's lair.

rooms.name: In the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
The dark stone that makes up this room is cold to the touch, and reflects back
no warmth. Your boots tap eerily against the flawless smooth floor.

rooms.name: In the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A cold breeze blows out from under the wall to the north, and a huge door
takes up most the wall to the south. The vaulted ceiling rises high above your
head, and the cold floor completes your crystal encasement.

rooms.name: In the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
The dark stone that makes up this room is cold to the touch, and reflects back
no warmth. Your boots tap eerily against the flawless smooth floor.

rooms.name: Inside the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A huge door in the southern wall to the east leads out into the bright crystal
hallway, but this room is molded of the same dark stone that made up the
outside of the temple. No light reflects off its dark surface, and you wonder
what, or who, could live here.

rooms.name: Inside the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A huge door to the south leads out into the bright crystal hallway, but this
room is molded of the same dark stone that made up the outside of the temple.
No light reflects off its dark surface, and you wonder what, or who, could
live here.

rooms.name: Inside the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A huge door in the southern wall to the west leads out into the bright crystal
hallway, but this room is molded of the same dark stone that made up the
outside of the temple. No light reflects off its dark surface, and you wonder
what, or who, could live here.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
A large transluscent door is set into the southern wall here, and the tunnel
leads back east.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
You travel down the hall, one hand out in front of you to make sure you don't
run into a clear wall. The soft glow of your armor is obnoxiously bright in the
reflection of the crystal around you.

rooms.name: A Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
The enormous door in front of you extends far up into the vaulted ceiling of
the temple. There are no visible keyholes, but it swings partly open at your
touch, seeming very light on its hidden hinges. The marble hall branches east
and west, and leads to the exit door to the south.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
You travel down the hall, one hand out in front of you to make sure you don't
run into a clear wall. The soft glow of your armor is obnoxiously bright in
the reflection of the crystal around you.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
A large transluscent door is set into the southern wall here, and the tunnel
leads back west.

rooms.name: A Twisting Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns from the north abruptly back to the east, where you can see
it bend southward again. There's something moving around the corner to the
southeast.

rooms.name: Before the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
A bright light burns beneath the door to the south. The already bright hallway
is bearable to the west.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
Doors exit this narrow passage to the north and south. On either side of you
you dark shapes are blurred by the crystal walls. Something or someone is
definitely moving on the other side of the walls to your east and west.

rooms.name: Before the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
A bright light burns beneath the door to the south. The already bright hallway
is bearable to the east.

rooms.name: A Twisting Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns from the north abruptly back to the west, where you can see
it bend southward again. There's something moving around the corner to the
southwest.

rooms.name: At the Top of the Stairs
rooms.desc:
A stairway leads down into the depths of the temple here. The crystal steps
look thin but sturdy, and as you test your weight on them, you hear the
curious noise of stone-on-stone coming from below.

rooms.name: On the Dais of the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
Stepping up on the dais you notice the walls, floor and ceiling of this place
not only reflect back the light radiated in the chamber, but give off some
sort of bright light of their own. The hall leads out to the north.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage continues north and south, and on either side of you dark shapes
are blurred by the crystal walls. Something or someone is definitely moving on
the other side of the walls to your east and west.

rooms.name: On the Dais of the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
Stepping up on the dais you notice the walls, floor and ceiling of this place
not only reflect back the light radiated in the chamber, but give off some
sort of bright light of their own. The hall leads out to the north.

rooms.name: The Base of a Crystal Stairway
rooms.desc:
Above you rises an exquisite spiral staircase. Sunlight gleams in from the
room above you, glinting of the stairs like fine jewels. At the top of the
stairs you see a small room containing an even smaller door.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
You almost walk into the wall before you notice it is there. The hallway bends
north and east here; to the north you see a stairway.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
Your boots tap eerily on the clear crystal, and looking down, you notice shapes
moving under the floor... something is alive in the rooms below you. The
passage continues east and west.

rooms.name: Inside the Crystal Temple
rooms.desc:
This grand hallway is a exact reversal of the dismal walls outside. Made of
clear crystal, it's hard to tell where the hall end and walls begin. The
hallway leads in all directions here; passage south is blocked by a gigantic
crystal door leading outside.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
Your boots tap eerily on the clear crystal. Looking around, you notice shapes
moving above the ceiling - something is alive in the rooms over you. The
passage continues east and west.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
You almost walk into the wall before you notice it is there. The hallway bends
north and west here; to the north you see a stairway.

rooms.name: The Landing
rooms.desc:
To the east a small door is barely wide enough for you to crawl through. It
looks extremely out of place next to the enormous staircase on which you stand.

rooms.name: A Short Hall
rooms.desc:
This short hall leads east and west and has a door at either end. The door
here is so tiny you would have to crawl through on your hands and knees.

rooms.name: A Short Hall
rooms.desc:
This short hall leads east and west and has a door at either end. The door
here is gigantic, taking up the entire wall.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside. To the west is a door leading back inside the temple.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of the Stairs
rooms.desc:
Crystal steps lead up to the main floor here, and a solid-looking door blocks
your passage south. From behind the door you hear the sound of stone hitting
stone.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply south here, and continues to the east.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply to the west, and you see a door in the north wall to the east.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. A large door
leads north to a crystal stairway, and the passage leads east and west.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The tunnel curves here, heading to the south. There's a door to the northwest
that spans the height of the wall. You see flitters of movement reflecting
from the walls all around you.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The tunnel twists sharply here, heading east and north. The sound of stone
hitting stone that reverberates throughout the temple is extremely loud here,
obviously caused by the crystal golem's footsteps on the stone floor.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply to the west and to the east.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply south here, and continues to the west.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc: The tunnel ends at a door to the south, and curves westward just north of here.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
A small door in the southern wall is unlocked and opens at your touch. The
tunnel leads eastward from here.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc: To the west the tunnel ends at a small door, and continues back eastward.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The tunnel seems to end at a small door to the west, and continues its
twisting path to the north.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The Tunnel heads of the north from here. In the south wall you see a small
door that seems to be unlocked.

rooms.name: The Slanting Room
rooms.desc:
This room slopes sharply downward to the east. The crystal floor is quite
slick, but not so much that you can't stand and fight with confidence. A small
door is in the north wall here.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here
has a small plaque at its base.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here
has a small plaque at its base.

rooms.name: The Slanting Room
rooms.desc:
This room slopes sharply downward to the west. The crystal floor is quite
slick, but not so much that you can't stand and fight with confidence. A small
door is in the north wall here.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here
has a small plaque at its base.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here
has a small plaque at its base.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here
has a small plaque at its base.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here
has a small plaque at its base.

rooms.name: The Alcove
rooms.desc:
This small room is no larger than a broom closet. On the wall hangs a long
tapestry.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Flames lick up on both sides of the path. The yawning chasm beneath
your feet promises certain death should you fall.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Ahead lies the end of the path. The flame roaring below obscures any sound,
and its smoke obscures your sight of what lies before you.

rooms.name: A lair above the lava
rooms.desc:
The path to the south ends here on a smooth stone pedestal. All around you
fire leaps and crackles fiercely.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Ahead lies the end of the path. The flame roaring below obscures any sound,
its smoke obscures your sight of what lies before you.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Ahead lies the end of the path. The flame roaring below obscures any sound,
e obscures your sight of what lies before you.

rooms.name: In the endless chasm
rooms.desc:
An endless chasm doesn't really seem plausible.. Perhaps you'll hit
bottom in a few weeks, if you don't starve to death or burn to a crisp
first.
In any case.... You're dead.

rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room of Haven
rooms.desc: There is a huge map here.

rooms.name: The Gates of Haven
rooms.desc:
A set of iron gates to the south marks the entrance to the coastal town
of Haven, renowned for its trade prowess, sea-fairing population and chance
to make some quick gold. Looking to the north, you can see a dirt road
disappear into the surrounding forest. A cobblestone road begins at the gates
and extends well into the town.

rooms.name: A Cobblestone Road in Haven
rooms.desc:
The cobblestone road you are on starts at the gates to the north and
travels south, providing the main thoroughfare for Haven's mostly pedestrian
traffic. However, a number of wagons pass by, heavily laden with goods on their
way to the cities of Kir Drax'in and Alaozar. A group of fishermen stare at
you intently but say nothing.
   The sounds of laughter drift across the road from the open doors of a
double story building to the west, a small sign proclaiming it as the Drunken
Jig Inn. The Haven Customs House is on the eastern side of the road.

rooms.name: The Drunken Jig Inn
rooms.desc:
You are greeted by both the sound and smell of a number of drunk sailors
who treat this inn as a second home. Dirty tables are scattered around you
while the bar occupies the center of the room. In the darker corners, whispered
conversations continue despite the noise and merriment.
   Stairs to the west lead up to the sleeping accommodation while the main road
is to the east.

rooms.name: The Drunken Jig Inn
rooms.desc:
The noise dies off as you approach this corner of the room which must be
a relief for those wishing to sleep upstairs. Torches along the wall mark
the stairs leading to the sleeping quarters above, the odd two or three sailors
comatose on floor.

rooms.name: The Drunken Jig Inn
rooms.desc:
Bloodshot eyes look up from various tables as you make your way around the
inn. A few of the more sober patrons offer you a glance before returning to
their conversations. A small scuffle breaks out near the bar but is quickly
sorted out by the inn keeper. The second floor can be accessed by stairs to the
north while you can see the exit from the inn to the north east.

rooms.name: The Drunken Jig Inn
rooms.desc:
A small group of merchants sits in deep discussion in this corner of the
inn but unfortunately the noise from the drunk patrons prevents you from
hearing what is being said. You almost trip over one of the tables as you
attempt to get closer and decide in the end it's not worth the trouble.
To the north, sailors continue to stream into the inn from the town and it
won't be long before it will be standing room only.

rooms.name: The Customs House
rooms.desc:
This small structure is sparsely furnished and serves as the Customs House
for the town. In earlier times, traders leaving to travel abroad would stop
by here to detail the goods they carried in an effort to prevent theft along
the way. However, the town is now controlled more by the pirates and merchants
who frequent the port rather than the appointed officials who govern here.
As such, the Customs House is rarely used.
   The doorway to the west exits onto the main street.

rooms.name: The Town Square
rooms.desc:
The town square is central to Haven and provides a meeting place for the
local inhabitants, as well as a social area for the many creatures that
frequent the area. Several benches on the perimeter of the square form a loose
circle around a small, wooden platform in the middle of the street. A number
of traders have set up makeshift stalls along the edge of the street, each
trying to get your attention in an effort to sell their goods.
   A signpost on the corner of the square points southward to the town docks
and east to Guild road.

rooms.name: The Upper Floor of the Drunken Jig Inn
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small foyer with doors to the north, west and south which
lead to sleeping quarters within the inn. The owner of the inn long ago
waived the need to pay for these rooms as many of the patrons often ended up
collapsed on the floor below. Stairs lead to the bar down below.

rooms.name: The Sleeping Quarters
rooms.desc:
You would be better off sleeping in the street below! This room was, once
upon a time, probably the best in the inn...now it's got to be the worst.
Rubbish is piled high against the far wall and covers the majority of the
floor, a broken window overlooks the forest and has allowed a number of birds
to make this room their home. A filthy mattress can just be seen poking out
of the rubbish. The only exit from the room is to the south.

rooms.name: The Sleeping Quarters
rooms.desc:
With the lack of use, the inn keeper no longer pays for the upkeep of these
rooms which is evident by the rubbish which litters the floor and the filthy
mattress in the corner of the room. It's a wonder that anyone would chose to
stay here at all but you are unlikely to be disturbed should you wish to do
so. The only exit from the room is to the east.

rooms.name: The Sleeping Quarters
rooms.desc:
This room is littered with rubbish and contains only a mattress which
lies in the corner. The inn keeper has put some minor effort into keeping this
room presentable, obviously it used more than the other two, but it certainly
is well below average. The only exit is the door to the north.

rooms.name: The Guild Road
rooms.desc:
Although relatively small, the town of Haven is well known for the amount
of goods that travel its roads. As such, a group of merchants long ago created
a merchant guild, a place to relax away from the hustle and bustle of sea
life and to exchange both tales and trade routes. Second only to the tavern
in size, the guild is a large building and can be entered through a door to
the south.
   A small building to the north houses the town public works officer.

rooms.name: The Guild Road
rooms.desc:
Sandy footprints from the east travel past you and head towards the town
square. Looking to the east, you cannot clearly see the source of the sand
but being a coastal town, it's only logical that there would be some around.
The guild of the merchants is to your south, although you can only enter it
through the door to the south west. A small shrine has been created in the
building to the north as a place of worship for the town's residents.

rooms.name: The Guild Road
rooms.desc:
The road deteriorates here into nothing more than a sandy path that slopes
down to the east.  This is clearly the outskirts of Haven, as the edge of
the small town blends seamlessly into the surrounding wilderness.  
   There are similar buildings to the north and south, each with a sign
above the doorway.  The Guild Road continues in its cobblestone form to the
west.

rooms.name: The Guild of the Merchants
rooms.desc:
Lanterns fixed to the wall create shadows that dance wildly around the
guild. No expense has been spared as can be seen by the foyer to the west.
Large, comfortable chairs have been arranged in a circle in this corner of
the room, created from the finest of fabrics. You feel quite safe and could
afford to sleep if you wish.

rooms.name: The Guild of the Merchants
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small foyer which marks the entrance to the Guild of
Merchants, a collection of traders from various ports around the world. Your
intrusion into their lives is tolerated as your explorations are well known
by the guild members.
   The guild is well furnished and contains all manner of artwork, fine
pottery and exquisite hand woven rugs, obviously collected from long voyages.
Small groups of merchants are huddled around the room deep in conversation
about the next journey to be undertaken. The Guild Road lies through the door
to the north.

rooms.name: The Guild of the Merchants
rooms.desc:
As you walk around admiring the art that hangs from the walls, you bump
into three of the guild members in a heated conversation. You quickly back
away as the look you receive from them is not a welcoming one. The entrance
to the guild is to your north and you can see a door further to the east.

rooms.name: A Shrine
rooms.desc:
The shrine has been created by the residents of Haven as a place of worship
and to provide something of an escape from the visitors to the town. An altar
constructed from coral sits against the far wall and is decorated with
numerous offerings, perhaps in an attempt to protect the town from the harsh
sea weather or more often than not, the frequent pirate attacks.

rooms.name: The Guild of the Merchants
rooms.desc:
It's as if you've done something you should not have...you stand in the
corner of the room and all eyes are focused on you, conversations coming to
an immediate halt. You look around you to make sure you haven't broken one
of the many items of pottery within the guild, but the only thing you can
see is the door to the east.

rooms.name: A Cobblestone Road in Haven
rooms.desc:
The cobblestone road you are on extends to the north towards the town
gates and also to the south where the docks stretch into Haven bay. Large
warehouses either side of the road are used to store trade goods before they
are transported out of the town.

rooms.name: A Cobblestone Road in Haven
rooms.desc:
Merchants pass you by as you walk along the cobblestone road, some of them
more concerned with the storage of their goods than with harassing you. To
the east and west, a large warehouse holds the trade goods before they are
transported out of the town and to the south, you can see the docks of Haven,
the backbone of the town.

rooms.name: A Large Warehouse
rooms.desc:
The warehouse has been constructed from clay bricks and has a thatched
roof to prevent damage to the goods stored within. There appears to be no
way of controlling what goods belong to what merchant, but perhaps the fear of
death from the more unruly elements of this town keeps most of them safe.
   The warehouse opens onto the main road to the west and continues to the
south.

rooms.name: A Large Warehouse
rooms.desc:
Everything from fine silk to barrels of fish have been stored here,
apparently left unguarded by the merchant owners, although some roam around
taking inventory of their cargo. The warehouse provides shelter from the
weather with a thatched roof and has been constructed using clay bricks. It
opens onto the road to the west and continues to the north.

rooms.name: A Large Warehouse
rooms.desc:
As with most of the buildings within the town, this warehouse has been
constructed from clay bricks and has a thatched roof to prevent possible damage
to the goods stored here. Merchants enter from the road to the east with their
wagons, removing the latest shipment from the far corners of the world. Other
less respected traders wander through eyeing the merchandise carefully, in
some aspects ensuring it is not stolen.

rooms.name: A Large Warehouse
rooms.desc:
As with most of the buildings within Haven, the warehouse has been
constructed from clay bricks and has a thatched roof to prevent damage to the
goods stored here. This area has been set aside for a number of tools, mainly
those used in the repair of the various ships that dock here. A broken wagon
has been abandoned at the eastern entrance to the warehouse.

rooms.name: The Boardwalk
rooms.desc:
You stand at the beginning of one of three main docks in the port town
of Haven. A wooden boardwalk to the west and east joins the three docks
together and provides a shop-front for merchant stalls where some of the
less expensive goods can be sold to the local citizens. Several large ships
are anchored out in the bay, preferring to dock here only to unload cargo.
   A cobblestone road begins to the north and forms the main road through
the town.

rooms.name: The Boardwalk
rooms.desc:
Merchants, sailors, pirates, fishermen...they're all here. The docks abound
with life, each profession going about their duties in preparation for their
journey across the waves. Seagulls sit perched on the dock pylons, hungrily
awaiting the scraps of fish that will ultimately be discarded here by the local
fishermen. The docks of Haven are to the west and east of here, or you can
access a large warehouse to the north.

rooms.name: The Boardwalk
rooms.desc:
This is the western end of the boardwalk, one of the docks extends into
Haven bay to the south of here. You are almost knocked into the water by a
group of sailors in a hurry to spend their well-earned shore leave at the
local tavern. The smell of spices wafts through an open door to the north.

rooms.name: The Boardwalk
rooms.desc:
The boardwalk creeks under your weight as you travel along and you wonder
who is responsible, with the amount of activity the docks must see, for keeping
it in a decent state of repair. Two of the docks lie to the west and east of
you respectively, while a fishmonger hawks his wares to the north.

rooms.name: The Boardwalk
rooms.desc:
The eastern dock extends into Haven bay to the south of here, while the
boardwalk continues to the west. A set of stairs connects the boardwalk to
a secluded beach further to the east while another merchant's store lies to
the north.
   Waves splash into the dock pylons, shaking the boardwalk ever so
slightly.

rooms.name: The Office of Public Works
rooms.desc:
Despite the magic that abounds in this world, the town of Haven was built
by hand and also requires constant maintenance if the town's income is to
prosper. Tools rest against the walls and you have some trouble in getting
from one side of the room to the other. A lone desk and chair are the only
items of furniture in the room.

rooms.name: A Spice Store
rooms.desc:
Spices, spices and even more spices. These items have been brought here
from afar in an attempt to liven up the otherwise staple diet of fish that
the majority of the citizens and visitors to Haven are treated to. The
merchant is very enthusiastic about his goods and does everything except
steal from you to get you to stay in his store. The docks of Haven are through
the doorway to the south.

rooms.name: The Fishmonger's Store
rooms.desc:
The majority of fish bought into Haven is packaged here and taken away to
be sold in other cities. Old crates have been left around the floor, filled
with those fish deemed unacceptable for sale elsewhere. You can see no sign
of refrigeration or preservation and can only assume these fish are fresh,
although judging by the odor you're not so sure. You can walk back onto
the boardwalk through the door to the south.

rooms.name: The Pawn Shop
rooms.desc:
This store is full of little trinkets and pieces of jewelry that have
been "acquired" by the merchant, most of them cheap and damaged in some
respect. Sailors wander in, most of them drunk, looking for something that
could possibly be sold elsewhere for more gold than it was purchased with.
   The sounds of the dock enter through the door to the south as another
ship arrives to offload cargo.

rooms.name: The Vault within the Guild
rooms.desc:
You can see why the guild members where uneasy as you approached the door
to this back room...it's full of loot! Unfortunately, most of it is contained
in locked chests and you wouldn't have time to grab any of it before you
were forcibly removed from here. There are a few loose items that you could
hide on your possession, however.

rooms.name: The Mariners Roost
rooms.desc:
It is here that sailors and pirates alike come to purchase new ships.  The
walls are covered in large parchments detailing the latest in designs and
a single desk sits in the corner of the room.  You take a moment to glance
at an open book on the desk and learn that due to an infestation in the supply
of wood, the production and sales of ships has ceased temporarily although
a number of small one-person boats are available.

rooms.name: The Ocean Supplier
rooms.desc:
People wander in and out of this store quite regularly, stocking up on
those last minute supplies before heading out to sea. The store specializes
mainly in products used to store food and trade goods. Barrels and crates
are stacked in random piles around the room, possibly in an attempt to
allow the customers to view the wares before purchase.

rooms.name: On the Docks of Haven
rooms.desc:
As you walk out onto the western dock, Haven bay splashes by below you.
Seagulls float around on unseen currents of air, enjoying the attention they
will soon be getting when old fish are thrown out to make way for new stock.
The dock continues to the south while the town's boardwalk is to your north.

rooms.name: On the Docks of Haven
rooms.desc:
From the end of the dock, you can barely see the town even though it sits
only a few hundred feet from you. As was intended when Haven was first built,
the integration between the forest and town buildings has been accomplished
to such a degree that you would not realize it was there until you arrived
at its gates.
   Haven bay stretches out in front of you while the dock leads north back
to the town.

rooms.name: On the Docks of Haven
rooms.desc:
You weave your way around nets which are scattered all over the dock. This
area seems to be reserved for the fishing vessels as it is the closest point
to the town's warehouses. Crates lined with dried seaweed cover the area,
reeking of rotten fish.
   The boardwalk lies to the north while the dock continues to the south.

rooms.name: On the Docks of Haven
rooms.desc:
The natural anchorage of the bay before you makes Haven one of the best
port towns, and the many coves and inlets that dot the coast make it a good
base for the less savory characters of this world. From the end of the dock,
you can see a large cliff face jut out to sea to your west, providing a
barrier from the open ocean.

rooms.name: On the Docks of Haven
rooms.desc:
Sailors fill this stretch of the dock, hauling large crates and bales full
of unknown goods. Seagulls swoop down and scavenge every morsel of food that
is carelessly dropped. To the north, merchants line the boardwalk trying
to sell enough to keep there stores open. The dock continues to the south.

rooms.name: On the Docks of Haven
rooms.desc:
The end of the dock marks the eastern most point of the town of Haven.
Further to the east, you can see numerous rocks and boulders which have
been painstakingly moved here to form a breakwater and thus protect the
shipping fleet within the bay.

rooms.name: Walking Down the Back Streets of Haven
rooms.desc:
It looks as if this area of the town was merely added on in haste as the
population grew. The streets are made of uneven cobblestone that has been
forced into the clay-soil base, creating a dangerous walking surface. The
buildings lean in one direction or another, having been constructed with just
as much haste as the street.

rooms.name: A Gambling Den
rooms.desc:
You've never seen a larger group of pirates, thieves and general unlikable
characters. Of course, you can't see that well at all given the layer of smoke
that descends from the roof. The room is packed to the rim with tables,
rowdy groups of men and women playing gambling games of some sort at each.
   It would be wise to keep an eye on that coin purse of yours as it could
easily disappear as you move throughout the room. You spy a door on the
eastern wall.

rooms.name: A Private Room
rooms.desc:
The door opens to a small back room with only a few tables, all of them
empty except to your left. There are no windows here, only the torches mounted
on the walls provide any light and even then it is minimal. You can't be
certain but it looks as if there are blood stains both on the plush carpet
and walls, perhaps an indication of how intense the gaming is in here.
   As you look around further, you realize that this room has been set aside
for those patrons who like to spend big! The table to the left is laden with
gold coins, the chairs are cushioned and the carpet feels spongy as you walk
around. The only exit is via the door to the west.

rooms.name: In a Dark Alley
rooms.desc:
The back streets twist and turn and you find yourself in a narrow alley
behind a few of the buildings within Haven. Garbage blows in here and without
a path to escape has collected over time. It is here that the vermin of the
town have made a home.

rooms.name: Walking Down the Back Streets of Haven
rooms.desc:
On more than one occasion, you trip and fall on the uneven street. You
are more concerned with keeping your footing than really watching where you
are going, but you look up to see that the street heads east as well as to
the south. A disused store is to the west.

rooms.name: A Store of Maps
rooms.desc:
Maps, maps and even more maps. You can hardly move past the door without
having to wade through rolls of them scattered all over the floor. You pick
up a few and glance at them, most of them appear to be trade routes of some
kind. The store is deserted; apparently the merchants simply come here, find
what they need and leave. With most of the trade routes long established,
there is little need for such a store anymore.

rooms.name: A Sandy Path
rooms.desc:
You trudge your way along a sandy path that initially heads east towards
the coast before sloping down to a small beach to the south. A cobblestone
road to the west simply begins and marks the eastern entrance to the port
town of Haven.
   At times, you are forced to cover your face as sand is whipped up by 
strong gusts of wind. The piercing shrieks of seagulls are the only sounds
you can hear above the wind.

rooms.name: A Sandy Path
rooms.desc:
The path winds between two large dunes before reaching the beach to the
south. The sand is starting to slow you down and you can feel your muscles
burn as it becomes an effort to walk, although it looks like the path flattens
out further to the north which should make it easier to move.

rooms.name: On a Beach
rooms.desc:
Waves lap softly at the shore of this small beach, only a quick walk from
the town of Haven. It is not used for recreation, although the waters of
Haven bay are both warm and sheltered. To the north, two large clay dunes
provide raw building materials and it is for this reason the beach exists.
Over time, enough clay has been removed to reach a layer of sand upon which
you now stand.
   To the west, you can see the port area of Haven which can be accessed by
a wooden boardwalk.

rooms.name: On a Beach
rooms.desc:
With the activity you can see above you on the boardwalk, it's a wonder
no one has bothered to come down and enjoy a swim in Haven bay. Perhaps the
lack of fish within the bay is a result of something unknown to you that
keeps everyone out of its waters, but nothing obvious strikes you. Stairs
provide access to the boardwalk and dock area while the beach follows the
water's edge to the east.

rooms.name: On a Beach
rooms.desc:
A collection of rocks and boulders have been brought here to form a
breakwater, separating the ocean from the bay and providing a sheltered
area for ships to anchor safely. However, the breakwater looks unsafe and
you decide against climbing along it.
   The beach heads westward to Haven's port area.

rooms.name: Walking Down the Back Streets of Haven
rooms.desc:
The further you walk down the street, the less used and more hastily
prepared the area becomes. Pooling water has turned the street into a mud-
like substance that clings to your boots and clothing. To the south, a
curtained doorway prevents you from seeing into the building that is there.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Building
rooms.desc:
Looking around you could be forgiven for simply walking straight back
out. The place is an absolute mess! Sunlight hasn't entered this place since
the roof was put on and a thick layer of dust has settled on the floor. Crates
are littered throughout, surrounded by a number of footprints that all lead
to the doorway to the north.
   The curtain covering the doorway must have a purpose, but you cannot see
an immediate one.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
The waters of the bay are warm and inviting, despite the light chop caused
by the wind. The docks of Haven, teeming with life, lie to the east while
the ravages of the open ocean are further to the south. From here, you can
see the coastal inlet in which Haven was built. An almost vertical cliff
face to the west provides a natural barrier against wind and waves...it also
will prevent travel in that direction.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
Seagulls fly over head as you float in the shallows of Haven bay. The
water is just deep enough to prevent you from touching the bottom but you
are within arms reach of the end of one of Haven's three docks to the east.
The swell starts to pick up here as a result of the ocean to the south.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
Something in the water brushes past your leg and you spin around wildly
trying to see what it was. Unfortunately, the murky depths keep it hidden
from sight. Ships sail awfully close by as they berth at one of Haven's docks
which you can climb onto to the north.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You find yourself paddling in Haven bay between two of the Haven docks.
Sailors with no care for the environment have tossed garbage into the bay
over the years and the majority of it is now floating alongside you. Seagulls
dive down to pick the more tasty morsels from the bay's grasp before returning
to their heights.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
Towards the entrance of Haven bay to the south, the sea floor drops away
to allow easy access and departure for the many ships that frequent this
port town. Sailors standing on the docks look at you strangely, wondering
why you chose to take a swim in such a dangerous area.

rooms.name: Deep In Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
The entrance to Haven bay lies just to the south, a wide gap between the
cliffs to the west and the breakwater to the east. Spray from the ocean waves
flies high into the air as they crash into the rocky opening to the bay.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You have reached a point just to the south of the central dock in the
town of Haven. Whether you intended to or not, that has brought you to the
waters of the bay. From your position, you can clearly see the underside of
the docks and realize that perhaps they are not in as good condition as you
might have thought traveling along the upper side. The entrance to the bay
lies further to the south.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You are almost knocked out as a barrel falls from the dock to the east.
A stevedore peeks over the edge and with a sheepish grin, waves at you in
apology. Not wishing to be killed by any further cargo, perhaps you should
float somewhere else.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You could float here all day, the soothing bay waves lapping at you softly.
You have to be careful not to get pushed too close to the docks east and
west of here with all of the loading and unloading of cargo. Glancing down
into the depths of the bay, you can see where several crates and barrels have
fallen from above and settled on the sandy bottom.

rooms.name: Deep in Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
The swell intensifies the closer you get to the open ocean to the south.
Some of the larger ships to visit Haven have anchored here, just within the
confines of the bay but far enough away from the dock to prevent looters from
considering a venture onto the decks. You find some shelter alongside one of
the ships before a crew member notices you and sings out to others. Perhaps
you should move on.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You can almost stand here as the bottom of Haven bay comes up to meet the
surface. Beyond the dock to the north, you can just make out a secluded beach
to the north east. You notice the swell has taken you closer to the docks
which given the amount of ship traffic in the bay, may not be such a wise
place to stop.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You splash around in the small waves that find their way onto the beach
to the north. With a little effort, you can climb onto the dock to the west
or continue to swim in the shallow waters of the bay which extends to the east
and south.
   Further to the east, you can see the breakwater which protects the ships
within the bay.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
Pieces of driftwood float by, the remnants of a ship that strayed too close
to the breakwater. You notice a small school of fish beneath you which is
quite rare given the lack of such creatures within the bay. The eastern dock
can be accessed to the west.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
If only you had the time to lounge around in the shallows of Haven bay
all day...but surely you have other things you could be doing! As you approach
the breakwater to the east, you can hear the sound of the ocean waves crash
into the other side, grateful that the bay is protected from such harsh
conditions.
   You can wade out of the bay if you wish and relax on the beach to the
north.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
A strong wind picks up from seemingly out of nowhere and begins to whip
the tops off the ocean waves which are not much further to the south. The
swell has also increased and you are being tossed around like a small cork.
The relative safety of Haven can be reached to the north.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
As you wade through the shallows, you drift closer to the breakwater to
your east. Although the majority of the rocks have been smoothed over time,
the odd one or two is still quite sharp and poses some risk. The bay stretches
away to the west or you can return to land to the north.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You float in probably the most sheltered area of Haven bay apart from
that between the docks. The breakwater extends from the beach to the north
and prevents travel to the east or south. Waves crash into the opposite side
to remind you that the ocean is not that far away.

rooms.name: Walking Down the Back Streets of Haven
rooms.desc:
The street abruptly ends here, becoming a narrow dirt path that winds its
way to the south and up towards the entrance to Haven bay. A lighthouse can
just be seen at the very end of the path although it doesn't appear to be
operating at this time. You have one of two choices; continue onwards to the
lighthouse or return to the streets.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The dirt path follows the land as it slopes upwards towards the lighthouse
and follows the western edge of Haven bay well below you. You can see now that
the town was built in a coastal inlet, this piece of land providing some
shelter from the ships anchored in the bay. Further south, if you should stray
from the path, you will fall down one of the cliff faces to the east and
west.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The path takes a quick turn to the west and ends at the foot of an
abandoned lighthouse. From this height, you have a fantastic view of the
ocean to the south and of Haven bay and the town itself to the east. People
scurry about on the docks and if weren't for the color of the roof tops, you
may not even have noticed the town was there. It blends in almost perfectly
with the surrounding forest which perhaps was the intention when Haven was
first built.

rooms.name: At the Foot of an Abandoned Lighthouse
rooms.desc:
It has been many years since this lighthouse saw action, judging by the
condition of the building and the fact that the door before you is boarded
up to prevent people from entering. The lighthouse probably saved many a ship
from crashing into the rocks and would have prevented countless deaths. You're
not sure why it's no longer used, but the ships continue to sail to this port
without hitting trouble.
   The dirt path leads back down to the town.

rooms.name: A Gambling Den
rooms.desc:
The smoke is less dense in this area of the establishment, due to some
unknown source of air circulation. You observe a few games of cards and it
becomes apparent that everyone is cheating, from the players to the dealers
themselves. For your own safety, perhaps you shouldn't involve yourself,
especially given the daggers you can see that people have tried to conceal.

rooms.name: A Gambling Den
rooms.desc:
You have to push and shove your way past a wall of creatures just to see
what all of the commotion is about in this part of the den. A small fenced
arena has been set up in the center of the room, two reptile-like fighters
battling it out to the amusement of the assembled crowd.

rooms.name: A Gambling Den
rooms.desc:
You wander around the casino amidst a mass of frenzied people shouting
at each other in a myriad of different tongues. In this corner of the room
there are several craps tables set up, all of them surrounded by eager
patrons gambling their money away. You can't help but keep checking for your
coin purse every few minutes or so, thinking that it may have gone missing
with all these seedy characters around you. Maybe you are too paranoid...maybe
not.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the churning surface of the water. As you try
to swim around, eddies crash into you forcing you to pay closer attention
to the water's motion. You are now completely disoriented although you can
see a large cliff face nearby and what looks like a small cave.

rooms.name: Haven Bay
rooms.desc:
You swim around in the pleasant waters of the bay, the open ocean directly
to the south and west. A dock juts out into the bay and you could probably
climb onto it if you traveled to the north or east.

rooms.name: In a Marsh
rooms.desc:
The ground becomes ever softer and yeilds and springs with every step.
Mosquitoes buzz in your ear and find even the smallest chink in your armor to
bite at the tender flesh underneath. A nauseating stench comes from the 
south, heralding the start of a swamp. To the east and west huge ironwood 
trees can be seen rising up into the sky.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The solid ground of the forest gives way to a wet spongy terrain. The
ground squishes under each footfall and the thoguht of falling through is
first in mind. The trees are becoming slightly more spread out, but the
maze of roots coming from them more than makes up for any difference in 
ease of passage. The sounds of moving water come from the east. To the south
the swamp seems to be getting more dense.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river takes a turn to the east here, and stretches as far as you can see
to the north. To the west the swamp thickens with fog.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river runs south from here, sweeping in from the west toward the great
forest to the northeast.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The swamplands border the forest here; the tall trees block your view of the 
horizon to the north and west. Southeast of here the dismal swamp beckons
to you with the hoarse cries of bullfrogs... and strong sense of evil.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The fast flowing niche to the east deposits you into this relatively 
slow flowing pond. Everywhere small tributaries deposit their loads from 
the river into this area. Every direction is open for travel. To the north
it looks as though it may get drier.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The fast flowing water to the east seems to have carved a small canal
into the swamp at this point. The water funnels into this canal bringing 
you along for the ride. The movement through this passage is quite fast and
keeping from tipping over on slightly submerged roots is of top priority. 
After the small passage the water opens into the stillness of the open swamp

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The raging river runs due south here, marking the border between the forest to
the east and swamp to the west.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A tangled growth of lush forest opens to the north and west, but here the
ground is swampy and deep with grainy black water.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west the tall spires of trees saturate your view, it looks as 
thought the swamp borders up to a forest in that direction. Every other 
direction seems to look the same, swamp. Here and there a small frog pops 
its head from the water and croaks at you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Razor grass is everywhere, it's tall stalks coming from under the dark
surface of the water. It limits your sight to a few feet.  Exits are in
every direction.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The water here begins to slow and calm itself now that it's out of the fast-
moving river. The shores are made up of floating algae deposits between roots
of trees. The closer you get the more dense the foliage hanging from the trees
becomes. Branches are slapping you in the face as you try to push them out of
the way.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river twists madly, coming in from the north and curving to the south
just east of here. The swamp looms to the southwest.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river runs south and west here, bordering the swamp. Tall trees twice the
diameter of your reach block out the sun to the northeast.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Here ground and water meet once again. To the west lush trees and 
foilage begin to grow with renewd vengence as the marshy land gives was to 
solid soil. Birds twitter in the trees letting you know that the desolation
of the swamp lays behind you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Razor grass is everywhere, it's tall stalks coming from under the dark
surface of the water. It limits your sight to a few feet.  Exits are in
every direction.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river running in from the north makes you fight to keep from being carried
southward. The forest east of here is a mirror opposite of the gloomy swamp
to the west.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the north and west a forest marks the edge of the swamp. Dark waters
swirl lazily about to the southeast.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.desc:

becomes. Branches are slapping you in the face as you try to push them out of

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river makes a boundary between the swampy marsh to the west and the
luscious green forest to the east. The water flows swiftly in from the north   
and threatens to sweep you southward.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west lies firmer ground housing a vast forest, but in all other 
directions only the sight of black swamp water meets your eyes.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The dark waters beneath you are teeming with life, most of it hungry. In
all directions the swamp extends.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The dark waters beneath you are teeming with life, most of it hungry. In
all directions the swamp extends.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The dark waters beneath you are teeming with life, most of it hungry. In
all directions the swamp extends.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Beneath you, swamp water suddenly boils with noxious swamp gas. Holding your
nose, you continue on.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The water here is relatively calm, and the insect life is beginning to
outnumber you by about a hundred to one. Pulling your cloak tight over your
unprotected skin, you keep moving.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The water here begins to slow and calm itself now that its out of the fast
moving river. The shores are made up of floating algae deposits between roots
of trees. The closer you get the more dense the foilage hanging from the trees
becomes. Branches are slapping you in the face as you try to push them out of
the way.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river borders the swamp to the south and west, coming in from the north
and continuing on to the east.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc: The river twists south and west, flowing past you in a foam-flecked rage.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You stand on the edge of a vast swamp. North and west of here the land is
firmer, and giant ironwood trees rise into the air. The stench of rotting
vegetation fills the air.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Every now and then the boat runs up against
underwater debris of some sort. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Every now and then the boat runs up against
underwater debris of some sort. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east you hear the sounds of rushing water. The area you are entering
looks as thought it is just begining to regrow. From the burnt husks of trees
new life springs forth. Besides the sound of water from the east there is no
noise that greets your ears. The swamp is suspiciously silent.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the north and east a river flows by, almost covering the sound
of the the swamp creatures moving through the underbrush all around you.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The dark depths of the river flow under beneath you. To the west a swampy swath
of land dominates the horizon, and to the east a great forest bathes the
land in towering green foliage. The river continues north and south of here.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west a forest lies, but in all other directions the bleak waters of
the swamp boil with hidden life.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc: To the south foxfire ignites as it escapes from beneath the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Razor grass grows up from the depths of the black swamp, and rotted stumps
make passage difficult. You long for dry land.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A slight draft of warm wind brings the smell of ocean air to your nostrils. 
All around you the swamp opens up into murky depths.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc: You push through the dark swamp, searching for land.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the roof of a small wooden shack. In all other
directions lies only the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the roof of a small wooden shack. In all other
directions lies only the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east you can hear the sound of moving water, and to the southwest
appears to be some sort of dwelling.  All is silent in this part of the
swamp, and fire damage is evident.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east a river marks the boundary between the swamp surrounding you
and the forest on the other bank.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river makes an 'S' curve here, bending southward just east of here, and
flowing in from the north in a foamy white torrent.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river bends here, flowing in from the west and heading southward into a 
murky swamp. North of here a forest of gigantic proportions stretches into
the sky.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but there's a faint scent of
salt water in the air.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The black water flows slowly beneath you, sometimes swirling faintly as 
something disturbs the debris-dotted surface.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The black water beneath you suddenly boils as a noxious gas bubbles to the 
surface. Licks of foxfire burst in and out of existence.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the southeast lies a stilt shack, and beyond it can be seen other dwellings
of the same type. Nothing moves in the deserted village.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south the side of a shack, built on stilts, blocks your passage. Beyond
it can be seen more buildings, though you see no signs of life. In all other
directions lies only more swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south lies a desolate village, not much more than a bunch of shacks
built on stilts. All is silent within.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south lies a deserted shanty town made of several wooden shacks built
on stilts. No movement can be seen, and the swamp is deathly quiet here.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the southwest lies a deserted shanty town, composed of several wooden
buildings built on stilts. In all other directions lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You are between a rier to the northeast and a deserted shanty town to the
southwest. In all other directions the stagnant swamp waters lie calm.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A river borders you to the north and east, winding its way to the ocean
far to the south.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river takes a turn south of here, heading east and picking up speed.
The swamp on either side of you makes you want to stick to the clear river.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The broken stumps of rotted trees thins to the south; through the fog you
can see a clear blue ocean.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You stand in the middle of a vast swamp. Rotted tree stumps rest in the
putrid quagmire beneath your feet.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east lies the back of a small stilt shack, and beyond it you can see
several buildings of the same type. Nothing moves in the deserted shanty town.

rooms.name: In a Stilt Shack
rooms.desc:
Light filters in from the doorway to the east and the cracks in the boards
all around you. Once a human dwelling, you now see that this building is a
nest of some kind... a nest for something very large.

rooms.name: Desolate village
rooms.desc:
All is silent in this seemingly deserted village. To the south a small patch
of land marks the center of "town". A stilt shack opens to the west.

rooms.name: Desolate village
rooms.desc:
To the south lies the side of wooden shack. Ankle-deep water flows here, but
to the southwest the ground is a little higher.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west lies a deserted shanty town, made up of a few wooden stilt
shacks grouped around what obviously used to be a fresh-water spring. Nothing
moves within.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the northeast you can hear the sound of a running river, and to the west
can barely be seen the top of some sort of dwelling. All around, the swamp
is silent.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east a river rages, bordered on it's other side by a thick forest. In
all other directions lies a forbidding swamp.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river takes a turn here, coming in from the north and heading east
out of the swamp and into a seemingly endless sea that looks quite inviting,
even from this distance.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river sweeps eastward into a clear blue sea, pouring in from the west
and spilling over its banks to create a boggy marsh to the south.

rooms.name: River Delta
rooms.desc:
The river pours madly into the ocean east of here, churning wildy until
it disperses among the calmer waves of the sea. A swampy marsh lies to
the south, and to the west the river continues.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A warm ocean breeze wafts in from the southwest, where you spy a vast expanse
of ocean. To the north and east lies more black swamp land.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the clear blue water of the ocean. In all other
directions the swamp surrounds you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you spy a glimpse of a clear blue ocean. In all other directions
lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you spy a glimpse of a clear blue ocean. In all other directions
lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you spy a glimpse of a clear blue ocean. In all other directions
lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A snake, about as long as you are tall, slithers through the shallow water
and disappears into a clump of peat. Around, the swamp is silent. To the east
lies the back of a stilt shack.

rooms.name: In a Stilt Shack
rooms.desc:
Light filters in from the doorway to the east and the cracks in the boards
all around you. Once a human dwelling, you now see that this building is a
nest of some kind... a nest for something very large.

rooms.name: Desolate village
rooms.desc:
This looks like it used to be the center of the small, ruined village. A pile
of stones marks where the well the inhabitants used to get clean water from. 
It's cover is still intact. Wooden stilt shacks stand to the northwest, west
and east. To the south you can catch a glimpse of ocean.

rooms.name: In a Stilt Shack
rooms.desc:
Light filters in from the doorway to the west and the cracks in the boards
all around you. Once a human dwelling, you now see that this building is a
nest of some kind... a nest for something very large.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west lies the back of a wooden shanty, built on sturdy wooden stilts
that are now splintered with age. In all other directions lies the bleak swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west you spy the roof of some sort of dwelling. A hot sea breeze blows
by constantly, warding off the odor of the stagnant swamp all around you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the northeast lies a river, across which you can see a lush green forest
that contrasts well with the bleak swamp surrounding you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the north a river makes a sharp bend eastward. Dismal swamp surrounds
you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You are just inland on a penisulu jutting out into the sea. TO the north a
river pours into the ocean that surrounds you to the northeast and south.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
You are just south of the river delta that is formed as the river pours into
the ocean to the east. West of here the light is sucked into the blackness
of the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc: The swamp meets the ocean here, the murky water spilling into clearer depths.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The coast stretches out the east and west, forming an indistinctive border
between the ocean to the south and the swamp to the north.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc: To the southwest the ocean surf placidly laps the murky swamp water.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A small peninsula of land is formed to the south, a jut of swamp land sur-
rounded by clear blue ocean.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the ocean. The swamp leers at you dismally from the
north.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south a break in the fog-laden trees of the swamp reveals a sparkling
blue ocean.
To the northeast several wooden shacks are built on stilts.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
