sense of direction.  Your nostrils sting as the spray shimmers 
you, bringing tears of pain to your eyes, and clouding over the
small raised platform that rises over the water to the north.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the water. 
You marvel at the schools of sharks that streak through the water 
as though they were birds coasting in the air.
   To the north a raised platform rises from the ocean surface,
offer a chance to land and put your feet under something solid.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the listless surface of the water.  As 
you venture across the water's surface, you note your shadow 
below, waving with the waves.  Gusts rush past you, blasting you 
with foam and bits of driftwood.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and terns float, splashing intentionally into the 
sea.  As you float across the sea's surface, you note your shadow 
below, fading and distorting with the waves and eddies.
   The ocean continues to all horizons.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
The wide sea spans across your sight to the north, east, and west,
momentarily disorienting you.  Your ears sting as the mist whips into
into you, bringing tears of pain to your eyes, and blurring the rocky
coast to the south.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, whales and sea lions sail, splashing purposely into the 
sea.  Your ears sting as the spray highlights you, bringing tears 
of pain to your eyes.  In the distance, you can see the foam of a 
broken ocean eddies and waves smash into the rocky southern coast.
The force of the gales and the waves prevent you from any kind of
safe landing to the south.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and gulls float, splashing purposely into the 
ocean.  As you float above the surface, currents crash into you, 
forcing you to pay attention to the water's motion.  In the 
distance to the south, you can see great waves smashing against
a rocky, sheer cliff that appears impossible to dock with.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and terns circle, splashing happily into the 
ocean.  You marvel at the schools of perch that streak through
the ocean as though they were birds sailing in the air.  Gales 
rush past you, pummeling you with spray and bits of flotsam. 
   To the south a rocky coast emerges, boasting a small city
that rises high on top of it.  The coastline appears to be 
dangerous, and impossible to dock upon, however, especially
from the height of the crashing waves.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the listless surface of the water.  You 
marvel at the schools of salmon that streak through the sea as 
though they were birds coasting in the air.  Gales rush past you, 
spraying you with wavecrests and bits of seamoss. 
   A rocky coastline lies to the south, upon which a small city
has been built.  There appears to be no place to dock, however,
as the waves are powerful and the winds extremely dangerous that
close to the coast.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and terns sail, splashing happily into the water.  
As you voyage across the ocean's surface, you note your image 
below, fading with the currents.  Gales rush past you, blasting 
you with mist and bits of kelp. 
   A small dock lies to the west, jutting out from the abrupt
coastline that stretches along the southern horizon.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the water. 
You marvel at the schools of bluefish that streak through the
ocean as though they were birds sailing in the air.  In the 
distance, you can see the foam of a broken ocean currents.

rooms.name: In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You now stand inside the entrance to the mine.  The interior is
extremely dark and there is a rather pungent odor within the confines of
these mines.  You notice many footprints scattered about the floor of the
mine, indicating that you are not alone in here.  To the west is the exit to
the desert, and to the north and south lie passages that continue on into
the depths of the mine.

rooms.name: In The Mines
rooms.desc:
The passageway here feels as if it is sloping downward but it is
impossible to tell because of the vast darkness that seems to engulf
everything.  The passage heads north while a side passage leads off
to the east.

rooms.name: The End Of The Passageway
rooms.desc:
You appear to have reached a dead end as the passage ends at a solid
wall of rock.  The only exit leads back to the south.

rooms.name: In The Mines
rooms.desc:
This passage seems a bit more narrow than the previous one and it appears
to be closing in just a bit.  This place definitely is not for one who is
claustrophobic.  A passage leads back north.  A small passageway heads towards
the south.

rooms.name: In A Small Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are now in a much smaller passage than earlier, with there only
being a clearance of about a couple of feet above your head.  The path turns
now so that it heads north or east.

rooms.name: A Cavern In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You emerge from the small passageway into a very large cavern.  As
you gaze around the cavern you notice several large holes in the walls of
the cavern.  You manage to look up and notice thousands of bats sleeping
and you hope like hell that they don't wake up.  To the north lies a
passageway and to the west lies a small passageway.

rooms.name: Another Passage
rooms.desc:
Once again, you stand in a passageway.  There is plenty of clearance
on all sides in this passageway and there seem to be some more signs of recent
life in here.  There are several large holes scattered about in the walls of
the passage.  There are also some mining instruments lying around on the
floor.  You wonder if the owner is still around...  Exits lead to the west
and to the south.

rooms.name: A Wide Passage Through The Mines
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a wider passage that continues on to the north.  A smaller
passage heads back to the west.

rooms.name: Yet Another Passage
rooms.desc:
You now stand in yet another passage in the mines.  You are beginning
to wonder if there is an end to this tunnel system.  There appear to be no
holes or other signs of life in this passage.  There are exits leading west
and south.

rooms.name: A Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
As you emerge from the passageway, you notice you are in a small
cavern.  In the corner there are some beds of straw and in the center of
the cavern is a smoldering campfire.  Whoever was camping here was here
VERY recently.  Exits lie to the east and to the north.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You now enter a much larger cavern.  After looking around the cavern,
there appear to be no signs of life.  There ARE several holes in this cavern,
however.  These holes indicate someone has been mining here recently.
Exits lead in all directions.

rooms.name: A Passage Through The Mines
rooms.desc:
You now stand within another passage.  You feel the passage getting
a bit narrower as you walk down it.  Exits are to the east and the south.

rooms.name: A Very Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in another small cavern, this one being the smallest yet.
As you stand in this cavern, you feel as if you are being watched by someone.
You seem to be drawn further into the mine by some mysterious force. Lucky
for you there are no bats in this cavern.  You hope that this trend continues.
There are passages to the east, west and the north as well.

rooms.name: A Junction In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large cavern that seems to be some sort of 3 way
junction with exits leading west, east, and south.  There are many supports
helping to support the weight of the tunnels.

rooms.name: A Small Passageway
rooms.desc: The passage now turns so that it leads north or west.

rooms.name: The Entrance To The Demon's Lair
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large cavern in front of what looks like a lair of
some sort.  You feel EXTREMELY uneasy standing here.  The evil power
emanating from this lair is very strong.  It feels as if it is going to
engulf you.  There are many skeletons littering the area indicating that
you are not the only person ever to think of entering this lair.  Obviously
for these past adventurers that was probably their last thought ever.
Exits lead to the west and the lair or to the south and back into the passage.
It is too dark to see into the lair.

rooms.name: The Demon Knight's Lair
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a lair of some sort and immediately you
notice that the room is littered with hundreds of bones of all types.
Obviously you are not the first to enter this room.  The walls are red
with blood stains and in fact, some of it is still wet!

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in the center of a large cavern that strangely enough,
is very smooth.  To the north, you can see an eerie glowing light and a
figure standing before it.  The passage continues on to the north towards
the light.  Another passage leads off to the south back to a large cavern.

rooms.name: The Idol Chamber
rooms.desc:
Upon entering the room, you immediately notice that the chamber 
is lit with an eerie glow.  There are many ancient carvings on the wall 
that look like warnings of some kind.  Lining the room are several statues 
that resemble apes.  At the center of the room there is an altar that is
slightly elevated.  As you look up at the altar, a man turns around to 
face you.

rooms.name: Another Passage In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You stand in yet another passageway through the mines.  You are again
amazed at the extensive tunnelwork in this mountain and wonder who or what
built these tunnels.  You can head back to the west or continue on to the
east.

rooms.name: A 3-way Junction In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You are now in a junction with passages leading off in three
directions: north, east and west.  There are no bats or any other signs of
life in this cavern.

rooms.name: A Small Passageway
rooms.desc:
As you look around this passageway you notice footprints scattered
about in the dirt, indicating that some kind of a fight occured here.  You
look in the corner and see what appears to be the loser of this fight as
there is nothing more than a skull lying in the dirt.  Exits lead to the
east and to the west.

rooms.name: A Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in another small cavern with more footprints scattered about
the room.  You notice several broken mining instruments lying about and a few
skeletons.  The exits lead to the north and to the west.

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
As you enter this particular cavern you see a couple of straw beds
and a smoldering campfire.  You do not see anyone around in the immediate
vicinity, but you feel as though you are being watched...  The only exit is
to the south.

rooms.name: A Passageway Through The Mines
rooms.desc:
You emerge from the large cavern into a rather large passage.  The
walls are somewhat smoother here and it feels as though this tunnel is 
sloping downwards ever so slightly.  Exits lead to the west and the east.

rooms.name: The Passage Continues
rooms.desc:
You are still traveling in the same passageway.  You look around but
do not notice any signs of life.  The tunnel now turns so that it heads to
the north or the west.

rooms.name: A Medium-Sized Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in a moderately large cavern.  As you gaze up you notice
thousands of bats perched up there.  On the floor of the cavern you see
many footprints.  Littering the floor are small pieces of wood and many
rocks that were probably chipped off of the walls by miners.  You can exit
to the north, south or east.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc:
You are in a tunnel that has been closed off where the tunnel has
collapsed in on itself and completely blocked passage.  The only exit leads
back to the south.

rooms.name: In A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You stand in a tunnel that does not look like it will continue
standing for much longer.  The supports here are buckling badly.  You feel
that staying here much longer would be unadvisable.  Exits lead to the east
and west.

rooms.name: Another Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in yet another cavern except this cavern is different from
the rest.  You notice several footprints in this cavern as you have in
previous ones.  As you look to the east you notice a large door.  The exits
lead north, south, and east.

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in a cavern that is littered with skeletons and small pieces
of wood and rock.  There appear to be no other signs of life.  You look up
but notice no bats in this cavern.  The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Very Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in a VERY small cavern.  You have to duck in order to keep
from hitting your head on the top of the cavern.  There are no signs of life
in this cavern.  You notice that the tunnel that leads out of this cavern to
the north has collapsed leaving no exit except the one to the south.

rooms.name: The Entrance To The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a room of sorts with some of the walls being solid
rock and other walls appearing to be manmade.  These walls consist mostly of
large blocks of rock stacked upon each other.  You wonder how it is possible
to stack these inside of a mountain.  Exits lie to the north, south and to
the west.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You notice a skeleton in the corner with an evil smile on it's face.
You wonder what happened to this poor man when he died.  The dust on the
floor is very thick indicating to you that no one has come this way in a LONG
time, and probably for good reason.  There are spider webs that litter the
walls and the passage.  You will have to walk through them in order to
continue on to the east, YUCK!  Exits lead to the east and the north.

rooms.name: The Picture Room
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a room with hundreds of pictures littering the
walls.  These pictures cover all sides of the room, including the ceiling.
The room is also covered with skeletons.  You can now see why no one has
come this way in many years.  You wonder what could have killed all of these
men.  To the east lies a small door, to the west a bend in the passage, and
to the south lies a door.

rooms.name: A Small Room
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a small room with no decorations or pictures of any
kind on the walls.  You notice that for some strange reason the room is
free of any type of life.  There are no webs and a minimal amount of dirt and
dust built up on the floor.  You wonder if some type of magical force is
causing this.  You are surprised to find that you do not need a light in
order to see in this room.  Strange, strange indeed.  The only exit lies to
the west.

rooms.name: The CryptKeeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
You stand in the CryptKeeper's lair.  As you look around you notice
many skulls lined up on a bookshelf, obviously his trophies.  There is also
a large table at the back of the room that is somewhat elevated.  A chair
stands behind the table.  There are other shelves with many weird looking
concoctions on them and very old books.  You look up and notice an odd
looking skeleton standing before you.

rooms.name: In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You stand in a tunnel in the tomb.  You notice a large spider web in
front of you and you do not relish the thought of having to walk through
that.  The exits lead south and north.

rooms.name: In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You stand in another room in the tomb.  You are now covered in spider
web after walking into this room.  You notice footprints in this room and
wonder who could have come through here recently.  There is a hole in the
wall and there are snakes crawling out of it.  You don't think you want to
stay near them too long as they are beginning to cover the entire floor.
To the east and south lie the exits.

rooms.name: The Cockroach Room
rooms.desc:
You walk into the room and notice that the floor appears to be moving
because it is covered with cockroaches!  You are now walking on cockroaches.
You can hear the CRUNCH! CRUNCH! as you walk on them.  You should leave here
before these cockroaches are swarming on you!  Exits lead west and south.

rooms.name: A Large Room In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
This room is rather large and rather empty.  There are no signs of
life except for some footprints leading through a door.  You wonder what
passed through there recently and if it is still alive.  To the east lies a
large steel door and to the north lies the cockroach room.

rooms.name: Through The Steel Door
rooms.desc:
You have now passed through the steel door and stand in a much
smaller room than you were just in.  The walls here are littered with
pictures.  To the north lies a room, to the south lies another room and to
the west lies a steel door.

rooms.name: A Small Room
rooms.desc:
There are no pictures on the walls here, instead there are a number
of shelves lining the walls.  On these shelves there are various forms of
pottery and utensils made from clay.  These must have belonged to whoever is
buried in this tomb.  The only exit lies to the south.

rooms.name: Another Small Room In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
This room is lined with pictures much like the ones in the previous
room.  You see pictures depicting hunting, ruling, eating, and many other
actions.  These must represent some of the accomplishments of whoever is
buried here in this tomb.  The exits lead to the north and to the east.

rooms.name: The Guardian Room
rooms.desc:
You are now in a large room with pictures lining the walls.  Standing
before you is a large statue that appears to be guarding the small room
directly behind it.  You wonder if it is just a decoration or if it is
actually guarding the room.  The only way you could find out would be to try
to walk past it.  The exits are to the west and the east.

rooms.name: King Solomon's Tomb
rooms.desc:
You are now in a room lined with gold.  A wise and decrepit 
looking old man stands before you adorned all in gold.  He does not 
appear to be living and yet he is standing in front of you. There are 
no spider webs, animals or insects of any kind in this room.  Amazingly 
there is also no dust or dirt in this room, the walls and floor are 
perfectly clean.  There must be some type of magical force that is
causing this, you wonder what it could be.  The only exit is west.

rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
This is the extension zone for the city of Kir-Oshi (zone 182).
This zone includes the following areas:

	o	Liu'she Ch'uan Tong Headquarters

rooms.name: A Dimly Lit Foyer
rooms.desc:
You can barely see in the dim candlelight of this foyer, but you can 
make out dark, arched passageways which lead in all directions except 
south, where a narrow flight of stairs leads up to a reception of some 
sort.  Although this room appears to be very old, with walls made of 
rough-cut stone, it lacks a sense of decay which tells you that this area 
must see regular use.  You shudder to think by what.

rooms.name: A Dark Hallway
rooms.desc:
The limited lighting that the foyer received from the upstairs 
reception is gone now, forcing you to provide light sources of your own.  
The walls and floor here are rough-cut stone, which is cold to the touch.  
You find yourself having to walk slowly to avoid tripping on any nooks 
in the rock floor.  At first, this hallway appeared to be a mine tunnel of 
some sort, but now you notice the lack of man-made structural support.  
Whatever made this tunnel carved it through solid rock.  The passage 
turns north here, and east returns you to a dim foyer.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passageway begins to slope downward here, and continues to do 
so to the north.  You can sense that the air is cooler in that direction as 
well, but with a stale smell to it, as if the passage ahead dives deep 
underground.  The rock here is dark gray and cool to the touch, the 
passageway leads north and south into inky darkness.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The air is still and cool in this section of passageway, and the rock 
walls seem to be somewhat more smoothed out and defined than those 
walls further south of you.  There is a heavy oak door set into the 
western wall, it appears to have swelled with moisture, as evidenced by 
the poor condition of its iron bindings. You might be able to force it 
though.  The passage leads north and south into inky blackness.

rooms.name: A Training Area
rooms.desc:
The floor here is lit by braziers sunk into the rock floor, which seems 
abnormally smooth in comparison to the earlier sections of the 
complex.  This is apparently where the Liu'she Ch'uan tong practices 
their martial arts skills - in fact, some tong members appear to be 
practicing them right now...

rooms.name: A Training Area
rooms.desc:
There is a large red mat made of out some type of heavy cloth spread 
out on the ground here, and many weapons line the walls.  You surmise 
that this area is used by the tong to train their initiates in weapons use.  
Gazing at the vast arsenal of hand-to-hand weaponry, you realize that 
these are not merely training weapons, these are the real thing!  
Suddenly, you remember the cloth mat underneath your feet.  With 
horror, you realize that you now know why it is colored red.

rooms.name: A Training Area
rooms.desc:
This room looks like it was once used for storage, but now the boxes 
and other bulky items have been moved next to the walls, and the center 
of the room cleared for sparring matches.  There is a thin cloth sheet 
covering the doorway to the room south, and you can see the glow of 
many candles from within.  The training area continues to the north.

rooms.name: A Meditation Room
rooms.desc:
One of the Liu'she Ch'uan ideologies is that one must have a clear 
and focused mind to be a great warrior, and thus focus part of their 
training in meditative skills.  As you enter the room however, you 
realize that these students are more interested in doing what they do 
best, which in this case would mean killing you.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passage makes a corner here, running from south to east.  You 
hear noises, but due to the echoing in the tunnels it is hard to tell the 
source or the nature of them.  Some sound like footsteps, some like faint 
mumbled voices, but they are all too indistinct to make out.  The air has 
a stale, clammy feel to it, making you realize you must be pretty deep 
underground.  The passage leads into inky blackness to the north and 
west.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance of a long hallway that seems to extend 
straight in front of you.  It is, however, completely dark here, with no 
torches on the walls, and so you find yourself stumbling about on the 
nooks in the rough cut stone floor as you attempt to walk in semi-
darkness.  The walls here seem to be made of cut stone that has been 
smoothed and polished.  You notice that they are cool to the touch.  
There is also a chamber directly to your south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
Wandering down this hallway, you notice that the air here seems to 
be cooler and slightly stale.  There is also a dampness and moisture on 
the walls that seems to indicate the presence of water somewhere 
nearby.  Could this passage actually extend out underneath the ocean?  
The passageway extends into darkness to your north and south.

rooms.name: An Intersection
rooms.desc:
This is a T-intersection in a labyrinth of cool, dark passageways. 
Tunnels to the west, south, and east lead into darkness, while there is a 
heavy iron-bound oak door to your north.  The dampness in these 
passages has caused the oak to swell in the door frame, leaving it 
cracked and blistered.  It has also managed to rust the iron bindings, the 
heavy iron knocker, and the iron keyhole. Cool, still air hangs heavily 
around you.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passageway seems to even out here, continuing west and east into 
utter darkness.  To the south, there is a heavy looking iron door.  The 
doorframe for it has a moderately high lip on it, as if it were designed to 
keep liquid from the other side of the door from entering this passage.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passageway makes a sharp corner here, turning into another 
passage and even more darkness.  You notice that the passage slopes 
downward slightly to the north and west, the still, clammy air hangs 
about your person.  The passages continue in darkness to your south 
and west.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You stumble about in the darkness of this cold, black passageway 
occasionally bumping into the rough-hewn stone walls.  You also notice 
that there is some sort of linear impression in the stone floor, like 
treads.  Its almost as if something very heavy had been pushed back and 
forth over this floor many times. 
The passage continues to your north and south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You stare off into seemingly infinite darkness as you attempt to 
navigate down this tunnel, the side walls and floor barely illuminated 
by your light.  The cold, damp air is beginning to press against you, its 
staleness heavy on your nostrils.  There must be virtually no circulation 
down here.  The passage continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passage here curves to run west to north, and you almost don't 
see the change in topography and nearly run smack into a wall. You 
notice that the passage seems to slope downward to the north, while it 
seems to open up slightly to the west.  You notice that there are no 
cobwebs or signs of any non-humanoid life at all, perhaps the cold air 
keeps all the insects and animals away.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
This is a somewhat open passage that leads eastward into complete 
darkness.  To the west, dim candlelight beckons you out into what 
appears to be a larger chamber.  The air here is very calm, as if it has 
been undisturbed for ages, but the lack of musty smell tells you that that 
cannot be so.  In what little light there is, you think you can make out 
what appears to be parallel grooves in the rough stone floor that lead 
into darkness to the east.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand inside a massively cavernous room whose expanse opens 
up before you to the north.  This place seems to defy logic, what would 
a room as big as this be doing under here?  The walls are smooth, 
polished stone and extend up into darkness; you can barely make out 
the cathedral ceiling at the top.  In the centre of the room two massive 
stone pillars also extend to support the ceiling, their buttresses the only 
hint that they connect with it.  You deduce that you indeed must be far 
underground, because a room this high would be impossible at any 
other altitude except for one below sea level.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You are directly in front of one of the stone columns here.  From this 
vantage point you can see most of the goings on in this huge room.  
This is apparently the centre of operations for the Liu'she Ch'uan Tong 
-- a sophisticated group of thieves, assassins, and smugglers.  The room 
extends to your west and east, your passage south being blocked by the 
stone wall of the room, and the north blocked by the column.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the southeast corner of the room, your view of the rest of the 
room is concealed by the massive stone pillar which is now to your 
direct northwest.
It is very, very dark here. Is there something moving in the shadows?

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in the shadow of one of the massive columns in this room, 
which is just to your west. Various shady characters are moving around 
in here, going about the secret business of the Tong.  Perhaps it would 
be best if you stayed concealed.  You are concealed, aren't you?

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the northeast corner of the this massive room.  Many men in 
exotic clothes walk around here, obviously high ranking Tong 
members.  There are also many men clothed completely in black, 
sharpening weapons. Obviously they are high ranking Tong assassins.  
Obviously, you probably shouldn't be here.  The room continues to your 
west and south.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You are now just south of the leftmost pillar in this massive room.  To 
your west, important looking Tong members in elaborate clothes 
discuss something in whispers.  The way to your west is lighted with 
braziers, to your east there is only darkness.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the back centre of the entire cavern, the walls sweep upwards 
to your north, and the two stone columns frame the room to the south.  
This section of the room is well lit and furnished, and several tall 
oriental men dressed in elaborate clothing sit here smoking and 
discussing something in a language you do not know.  They seem 
unaware of your presence, as if preoccupied by something else.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
The light in this section of the room is almost nonexistant, blocked by 
one of the giant stone columns directly to your south.  There seems to 
be quite a lot of light just to your east however.  You could walk over 
there or to the west, where the corner of the room blends into darkness.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the northwestern corner of this immense room.  There is 
virtually no light here at all, and you find yourself maneuvering around 
figures in the near darkness -- who knows what they might be doing 
here.  The room continues around the pillar to your east, and also to 
your south.  The air here is very still, and you can hear people 
whispering in the darkness in a language you don't comprehend.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand just west of the leftmost column in this massive cavern.
The walls sweep upward into blackness to your west.  The columns and
black stone walls absorb what little light there is in here, making it
very difficult to see, even with your own light sources.  The cavern
continues to your north and south.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
The pillar to your northeast shields you from virtually all of the light
sources in this cavernous room, and the flat black stone that makes up
the wall to your south and west does its part in absorbing your own
light sources.  This room expands to your north and east.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand just to the east of the doorway into this massive cavern, 
black stone walls sweep up behind you into darkness.  One of the 
massive pillars that no doubt support the ceiling of this structure is 
directly to your north, obscuring what little light there is in this room.  
You can walk either east to the door or west into a darkened corner.

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
This room is completely damp, dominated in its centre by a perfectly 
circular surface pool.  The pool glows slightly, you suspect because it 
has been lit from underneath.  The large amount of open water in this 
room has caused significant amounts of moisture to accumulate on the 
stone walls and floor, making walking around quite a challenge.  This 
pool must be how the Tong smuggles black market goods into Kir-Oshi.  
It must lead out to the harbor somehow.

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
As you continue around this room, you notice that the floor is really 
rather slick; you should watch you step so that you don't fall head first 
into the pool with all your armor on.  Looking into the pool you notice 
that it is indeed lit from the bottom by two caged light sources.  It also 
appears to turn into an underwater tunnel of sorts several feet below the 
surface.  The tong must have some sort of device to transport black 
market goods under the water and bring them here.  You notice several 
mechanical apparatus to your south, perhaps they have something to do 
with the actual transportation of the goods?

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
There is a mechanical winch and metal chain coiled loosely on the 
ground here, as well as some other mechanical apparatus whose 
purpose you do not immediately recognize.  You surmise that this series 
of hand operated winches and chains is designed to pull something 
heavy out of the pool.  All of this machinery looks slightly rusted, 
having been exposed to these damp conditions for awhile it seems.  The 
pool continues around the room to your west and north.

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
There are two metal hooks drilled into the floor here at the edge of 
the pool, on closer inspection you find that they attach a rope ladder 
with wooden rungs to the floor here.  The ladder extends down the side 
of the pool wall, hanging loosely against it.  There appears to be a large 
winch and some other machinery just to your east, and to your north 
there is the entrance to this room.  You suppose that you could also go 
down into the pool, but the water looks pretty cold.

rooms.name: In the Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
Brrrrr! The water IS cold! And it appears very deep as well.  You can 
just about hover on the surface, but your attempts to dive down deep 
and inspect the tunnel fail -- you just can't hold your breath long 
enough.  You can get on to dry land by swimming over to that ladder 
again, as every other shelf around this circular pool is too high for you 
to pull yourself out on.  Aside from the fact that you can see in the 
water pretty clearly because of the two caged lights just underneath you, 
there really isn't anything else interesting here.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
As you continue to feel your way down this stale, musty passageway 
you notice that the passage seems to be sloping downward to the north 
ever so slightly.  The stone that makes up the passageway seems to be 
changing as well, from soft limestone to a harder, slick stone, possibly 
granite.  You must be further underground that you previously thought.  
The passage continues into blackness to your north and south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are definitely further underground than you were before; the air 
here feels like it hasn't been disturbed for a century or more, yet there is 
no dust, no cobwebs.  No evidence of life at all, as near as you can tell.  
Only blackness perfected.  The cold stone passage continues to the 
north and south, with no trace of an ending.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
This section of the passage slants downward to the north at a 
noticeable angle.  The walls here seem to be smoother than the ones to 
the south, as if the texture of the cut rock was changing.  In fact, the 
walls and floor are noticeably slick, as if moisture had accumulated on 
them.  The stale air in the passage doesn't feel like it carries any water 
at all however.  The passage continues in darkness to the north and 
south.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the centre of the massive cavern, situated between the two
cyclopean pillars.  The lights you possess seem unnaturally dim in the vast
blackness of this room, it seems to stretch on forever in the edges where
your light can not reach.  Shadowy figures move about in the darkness,
speaking an unmistakably foreign language.  There seems to be a bit of light
to the north, which appears to be the nexus of activity.

rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room to Dun Liu
rooms.desc:
Type 'look sign' for the Fortress Map
Type 'look poster' for the Terrain Map

rooms.name: The Throne Room
rooms.desc:
You stand among the nobles and knights of Dun Liu. Servants hurry by you 
and nobody pays much attention to you. Against the back wall stands a huge 
throne, made plush and comfortable for the King's oversized arse. Fron here
you can watch the bribes and blackmail merge all over the world. The only
exit is to the north.

rooms.name: The Ante Chamber
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the Ante Chamber. It's just another word for waiting
room, but everyone who wants to see the King must pass through it. Servants
scuttle by you in their rush to serve the King and the nobles about you. As
you walk around you notice all the expensive tapestries and artwork hanging
and begin to wonder if the King is spending the people's money on himself
instead of his people. What appears to be the throne room lies to the south,
while a great deal of noise comes from the north.

rooms.name: A Heavily Guarded Room
rooms.desc:
For some reason this room is heavily guarded. The guard rooms were well
guarded, but this room is amazing! Guards stand at their posts in a wall of
weapon-wielding maniacs. How insecure could a King be to have so much defense
within the walls of his own fortress? There are exits to the east, west, and
south.

rooms.name: The Royal Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is just another lavishly decorated room, built and decorated by the
King to make him feel more 'at home' in the lands of Dun Liu. You notice many
fine pieces of art and jewelry here. Sculptures stand tall against the walls
while expensive paintings hang behind them. It's begging to look more like an
art gallery than a castle. The Royal Hallway continues east and south.

rooms.desc:
This is one of the many guard rooms of Dun Liu, instituted by the paranoid
King to make sure no assassins could sneak in and kill him. As you walk past
the guards, one of them notices your weapons and calls his comrades to arms.
The are exits south, west, and east with the sound of rattling armor coming
from all of them.

rooms.name: The Outer Hall
rooms.desc:
As you walk down this hallway you note the elaborate textures and designs
hanging on the wall here. As you stroll by the various works of art you
admire the colors and general appearance of the finely carpeted and furnished
hallway. Aside from the occasional angry guard, this is a beautiful place.
There is a guard post to the east, while the outer hall continues west.

The are exits north, west, and east with the sound of rattling armor coming
from all but the north... odd.

rooms.name: On the drawbridge
rooms.desc: You stand on a great drawbridge crossing over the moat of Dun Liu.

rooms.name: The Gatehouse
rooms.desc:
You are at the gatehouse to Dun Liu. Stretching to the south are the tall
walls of Dun Liu. The drawbridge is usually down and today is no different.
The orange brick road lies to the north.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People hustle and 
bustle around you as you walk by. A humungous building spans to the north-
east, while the gatehouse lies just south of here, the King has only one 
guard stand watch, a tall man in shiny black armor. The orange brick road
continues north.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People hustle and 
bustle around you as you walk by. There is an incredibly tall building to
the north-east and a gatehouse is just a few paces to the south now, the
entrance to the great castle Dun Liu. The orange brick road continues north
and south.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People hustle and 
bustle around you as you walk by. As you walk you can see the castle itself
growing larger in the horizon to the south. A deep forest grows to the north-
east, and Gandalf's Spells and Sorcery, Ltd stands before you to the east.
The orange brick road continues north and south.

rooms.name: A strange laboratory
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a odd-looking room. Across from you sits an odd-
looking man in an odd-looking chair with an odd look on his face. Perhaps
something odd is going on here... Apparently the only exit is back down the
staircase.

rooms.name: Scrolls and Sorcery, Ltd.
rooms.desc:
You have wandered into the best magic store this side of Kir Drax'in! Gandalf
stands at a counter, greedily counting his profits and grinning at you in a
way that sends a chill down your spine. As you walk about the store you
notice loads of staves, scrolls, and other little trinkets with plump price 
tags. Just in case you run out of money, there is an ATM mounted on the wall
next to the counter. The only exit is back out onto the Orange Brick Road.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. Shops and cafes line 
the street all around you, and an especially large building stands to the 
south-east, with the letters S&S Ltd on the side, while the fortress grows
larger to the south. A peculiar dirt road stretches off the the east and the
orange brick road continues to the west and south.

rooms.name: A dirt road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a dark, winding road. The roadside is filled with
dark, ominous trees and sounds of feirce animals. There is a dark, densly
forested area somewhere off to the north. The dirt road continues east,
while the orange brick road lies to the west.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People bustle and
bustle around you as you walk by. Stretching high over the buildings you 
can see a mighty castle to the south-east. Just down the road to the east
a forest of tall oaks and pines reaches into the horizon. The city gate is
to the west.

rooms.name: A dirt road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a dark, winding road. The roadside is filled with
dark, ominous trees and sounds of feirce animals. A large, eerie thicket
lies far ahead to the north, while Dun Liu lies just to the west. The dirt
road continues north and west.

rooms.name: The King's Bedchamber
rooms.desc:
Here is where thte King E'douird spends his long nights. As you look around
you notice that it is very defendable and has guards walk by regularly. In 
fact, it sounds like the guards now are coming now...

rooms.name: A dirt road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a dark, winding road. The roadside is filled with
dark, ominous trees and sounds of feirce animals. There is a strange thicket
to the north, growing creepier and scarier. The dirt road continues south
and west.

rooms.name: A winding staircase
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a dark, dank staircase. As you climb up step by step
all you can see is a tiny light comming from the top. All sorts of insects
pass you on their way to forage for food. As you climb you dodge various
spider webs and disgusting little insect nests that would make any other
person vomit uncontrollably. Whoever is at the top must have a strong stomach.

rooms.name: A dirt road

lies somewhere off to the north, grownig creepier the longer you
look at it. The dirt road continues east and west.

You are in a deep, dark sewer. You are standing at in a chamber that
spreads in almost every direction. Slime and sludge ooze all around
you. Rats and vermin spread through the tunnels like a disease. The
only exit is to the south.

rooms.name: A dark thicket
rooms.desc:
You are in a very dark thicket. All around you different trees and plants
sprout up, making everything feel like it's closing in on you. Strange noises
come from deeper into the thicket, made by some tortured animal... There
appears to be no way out of this hellish place, all the paths look the same!

rooms.name: A dark crevice
rooms.desc:
You have entered a deep, dark crevice. There is an eerie lack of light
here, destroyed the instant you enter. Apparently there is little or no life
down here... as if anything could actually be disgusting enough to survive
down here anyway. The tunnel continues below you and it empties into a
passage above you.

rooms.name: A back room
rooms.desc:
You stand amid piles and piles of miscellaneous junk. Scrolls, potions,
staves, wands, anything you can imagine. There is a door on the west wall,
leading back into some shop, if you could only figure out how to use it...
There is a door to the west and east.

rooms.name: A slimy passage
rooms.desc:

here, destroyed the instant you enter. Apparently there is little or no life
down here... as if anything could actually be disgusting enough to survive
down here anyway. The tunnel continues above and below you.

rooms.desc:

sprout up, making everything feel like it's closing in on you. Strange noises
come from deeper into the thicket, made by some tortured animal... There
appears to be no way out of this hellish place, all the paths look the same!

rooms.name: A dark crevice
rooms.desc:
The dark crevice ends abruptly here. There is a horrible stench, much
worse than any other smell in all of the tunnels. There is an eerie lack
of scum and rats in this room, making in very quiet... too quiet.

rooms.name: The Cheese Chamber
rooms.desc:
Welcome to the Cheese Chamber.  Here lies the various tasks Phondew set
out to complete but never has, including this area!  You notice packages
of cheese strewn about without any order in this room of chaos.  An orange
couch lies in a corner and there is a area of the room devoted to worshipping
the Sacred Cow, whom resides in the very room at all times looking to convert
others to the Way Of The Cow.

rooms.name: An Immortal Room
rooms.desc:
This is a starting point for all of us who don't need doors or walkways to get
around.  There is a map floating in the nothingness here for some guidance.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are on a large, serene beach. To the west lies the ocean, from which waves
occasionally raise up from to lap against the sandy shore. To the south you see
a line of tropical trees, where the tropical forest is. The beach extends to
your north.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are currently positioned on a large beach. The sandy ground is soft, making
moving difficult. Far to the south you can see a line of trees signifying the
tropical forest. The beach stops close to the east, marking the normal terrain.
Someone has written something in the sand here, in giant letters.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are on a big, sandy beach, it would be a great place to go if you ever took
a vacation from adventuring. The waves lap against the shore, creating soothing
sounds, and you begin to relax. The beach runs north and south and the edge of
the tropical forest begins to the east.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
This part of the beach curves softly to the south and to the east, forming a
kind of wall around the tropical forest. The sandy ground is soft, and it is
a little hard to walk on with all your weight, but you are sure that, if you
were attacked, it would not hamper you in any way.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
This part of the beach seems more weathered, and there are many footprints that
have been left here by previous passerbys, some abnormally large, some insanely
small. Someday the waves will reach up to the highest part of the beach and
wash it all away, and there will be no evidence of any passing. The edge of the
tropical forest is south of here, and the beach runs east and west.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
You are on a large, sandy beach which runs east and west. To the south you see
the edge of a tropical forest, which is the only shelter you can see. The white
sand is soft and you walking through it is hard, but you feel that if you were
forced to defend yourself, your experience would overcome the terrain. To the
east the beach starts curving north.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
This part of the beach is wider than the other parts, reaching at least double
the length of the rest of the beach towards the mainland. The sand here is
soft, the result of being so distant from the water, which constantly laps at
the shore.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The beach here is littered with sharp, jagged rocks. The sand has partially
buried most of them, leaving only the cruelly razorlike edges poking out of
the ground, ready to impale your feet. The waves crash against the rocks with
tremendous force, and you know one day the rocks will be eroded down to small
pebbles.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The ground here is tougher than the rest of the beach, making your footing
stable. The beautiful blue ocean spreads out for miles to the north and west,
and to the south and east the beach continues.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
From your current position you can look north and see the miles and miles of
endless sea. To the east and west the beach continues, and to the south is the
edge of a tropical forest.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The beach here is loud and noisy, a combination of the waves slamming
themselves against the sandy shore and the violent river a little to the east.
To the south lies the edge of a tropical forest, and the beach continues to
the west.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
The sound of a raging river comes from west of here. That, combined with the
waves forever crashing into the beach and the occasional strange noise emitted
from the south make this part of the beach very noisy. To the north you can
see a sand bar, to the west you see a river, and the beach continues east.

rooms.name: A sand bar
rooms.desc:
This is just a little mound of sand that stands above the water level. There
is room to move around and you could lay down and relax and listen to the
sounds of the ocean surrounding you for a while. All in all it is a very serene
spot.

rooms.name: A large beach
rooms.desc:
Here the waves have carved out a large pool in the sand. In the pool you can
see all sorts of tiny organisms moving around, making the pool look like some
sort of soup. The beach continues east and west and the edge of the tropical
forest is to the south.

rooms.name: A violent river
rooms.desc:
This is the part of the river that feeds into the oceans, the fresh water here
will eventually become completely absorbed into the sea, tainted with salt and
other materials that will make it a totally different water. The river runs
south from here, and the beach lies to the west and east.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
Directly to the east is a dense tropical forest, and a large beach stretches
out to the west. Lush, green bushes grow here among the tall grass that grows
between the beach and the tropical forest, forming somewhat of a buffer zone.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of a dark tropical forest. It stretches for miles
to the east. There is a long beach to the west of you and the lush green
bushes and shrubs you are in continue to the north and south. Strange noises
emanate from the tropical forest and the strange wildlife within.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the corner of the barrier between the thick, tropical
forest which begins south east of here and the beach that stretches out in
all other directions. From here you can see past the beach and out to sea.

rooms.name: The edge of a dark tropical forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the tall grasses and lush green bushes that make up a
barrier between the large beach to your north and the thick, tropical forest
that begins directly south of you. You can hear the waves crashing against
the shore far away.

rooms.name: The Begining
rooms.desc: Not much here.

rooms.name: East Gate of the "Lion's Mouth" Arena
rooms.desc:
A thick wooden, iron-reinforced gate rises about sixty feet high directly
west of here.  It is the only thing seperating you from one of the best-known
gladiator arenas in the world--and perhaps one of the most dangerous. A brave
man leaves surrounded by wealth and fame, a foolish man surrounded by a crude
coffin--there is no second place.  Atop the gates is a roaring lion's head of
solid gold, beckoning any would-be challengers to face the perils within.  An
oval plaque above the head reads, "The Lion's Mouth Arena."

rooms.name: Gladiators' Preparation Chambers
rooms.desc:
Those who dare to brave the arena begin here, where lame but full equipment
is provided for free to registered gladiators.  It is hard not to notice the
various bloodstains and rips in some of the armours, suggesting that perhaps
the equipment provided here was recently taken off of a fallen challenger's
body.  There are some others here though, not minding the torn suits.  They
polish their various weapons silently, but with an air of confidence around
them.  It is almost like awaiting an execution, but the gladiators have a
chance to not only live but to gain fame and fortune.  Through a large arch
to the north you see the arena gate, where new entries are introduced.

rooms.name: The "Lion's Mouth" Arena
rooms.desc:
You are just inside the gladiators' entrance to the arena, and your body
is already pumping adrenaline like mad.  The decapitated head of a man rolls
in from the north, and you try to scream -- you scream -- but the spectators'
bloodthirsty yells muffle every sound you make.  The confidence you had built
up just a few minutes ago has died away, eclipsed by feelings of mortality
and pure, unadulterated fear.  The arena gates are just to the east, and you
could escape if you wanted to and could face the shame.  The arena surrounds
you in all other directions, and layers of enraged spectators are above every
wall, waiting for the sight of your death.

rooms.name: The "Lion's Mouth" Arena
rooms.desc:
This is the north end of the arena, where beasts are released.  It may not be
the center of the arena, but it certainly is the center of the action!  A
huge storing area is to the north, probably full of cages, but it is too dark
to see clearly.  Every once in a while, a roar comes from the storing area,
and it would not be surprising to find out the arenakeepers have a dragon or
some other marvelous creature in there.  To the south, at the southern end
of the arena, you see the exit, a much more compelling option than becoming
dinner for the next monster released.  The spectators overhead let out
deafening waves of screams and cheers, not caring who or what dies as long as
it is a bloody fight.

rooms.name: Arena Storage
rooms.desc:
Hey!  How'd you get in here?  Guards!  Put this man in a cage! :)
(This room is not meant for mortals.  It is here to hold monsters which
are released to the arena.)

rooms.name: Temple and Crypt Map Room
rooms.desc:
Type look crypt for a map of the crypt.
Type look temple for a map of the temple.

rooms.name: The Entrance To Paphoset's Temple
rooms.desc:
A pair of matched, semicircular projections, each about 50 feet high and
pierced by long, thin windows provides entry to the structure. Sand enters the
chamber through the base of these windows, spilling into the foyer like a vast
waterfall.

rooms.name: The Foyer Of The Temple Of Paphoset
rooms.desc:
The vast width of this chamber is difficult to determine, even in daylight,
and the shadowy reaches of the far walls are not revealed by torches. The
air is thick with dust, making breathing difficult.
   A massive stone head can be seen below against the opposite wall of the
chamber, partially covered by sand. Most features of the grim countenance are
worn away, but the figure still reflects great power, and the enormous
statue is and awe-inspiring creation, indicative of the advancement of the
culture that created it.

rooms.name: The Atrium
rooms.desc:
The most prominent feature of this cavernous chamber is the set of eight
huge columns, the bases of which are statues of kneeling gods, and wonders
of design and craftmanship. Climbing to twenty feet in height, each base
features a figure with a beastly head atop a human body, with hieroglyphics
identifying the figure. A set of stairs leads down.

rooms.name: The Trophy Room
rooms.desc:
The contents of this room are a testament to the peak of Paphoset's power
before his descent into madness. Lining the walls are spears, shields and
other spoils of battle, all of unusual, antiquated design. The heraldry
and weapon-craft of dozens of long-dead cultures are preserved here. A set
of stairs leads up.

rooms.name: Archives
rooms.desc:
This chamber was designed to house books, scrolls, and artwork glorifying
Paphoset, and to preserve detailed records of his words and deeds as a god.
Obviously, this room was not used for long, for Paphoset never reached his 
goal of divine ascension. All books glorifying the king at the expense of Set
and other gods were destroyed long ago. The room is now barren.

rooms.name: The Chapel
rooms.desc:
This was the most heavily used chamber in the temple complex before the
cataclysm, and was the first to be completed. Continuous prayers to Paphoset
were once uttered here by his priests. Ruins of a marble altar line the west
wall.

rooms.name: Corridor
rooms.desc:
This ten foot wide hallway is filled with dust, cobwebs, and crumbled rock,
appearing to have been unused for many years. The walls feature faded,
cracked paintings of Paphoset's great achievements, portrayed in both literal
and symbolic fashion. While the specifics of these scenes are not discernible,
a common theme seems to be powerful beings of varied types paying homage to
a human king.

rooms.name: The Gallery
rooms.desc:
This long hall is lined with tall columns covered with dozens of slithering,
jet-black snakes. They seem to regard you with interest but whenever you
approach a patch of them, they disperse.

rooms.name: Receiving Room
rooms.desc:
This chamber, once used by Paphoset to greet important worshipers and 
other dignitaries, is dominated by an obsidian platform atop which rests a 
heavy wooden chair, ornate in design and decoration.

rooms.name: The Shrine
rooms.desc:
In the center of this semicircular, domed chamber stands an empty, 8'-high
pedestal. Atop the pedestal is a circular depression designed to hold the
base of a statue. Paphoset intended his likeness to be placed here, where
statues of the divinities, like vassals, would bow their heads in homage,
there is a message carved on the front of the pedestal.

rooms.name: Paphoset's Sanctuary
rooms.desc:
This lavish, columned room was built to accommodate great lethargy, for the
most distinctive features are a plush divan and many soft, silken cushions,
all set on a large, raised platform at the far end of the chamber. This
luxury is in stark contrast to the room's repulsive inhabitant.

rooms.name: The Treasure Vault
rooms.desc:
Designed to be Paphoset's treasury, this secret room now serves as his
sepulcher. His petrified corpse rests against the northwest corner, 
surrounded by his riches.

rooms.name: Entry Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is designed as the entry into the crypt. It is made of marble
and has faded paintings, depicting some of Lothar's lesser deeds, along the
walls. Two marble benches, one along each wall, are here, to allow those
who would come and pay their respects to Lothar the chance to rest and
compose themselves before they continue.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This room is decked out as a great banquet hall, a place for Lothar and his
noble companions to have great feasts in the afterlife. There is a long
table in the center of the room with twelve stout, wooden chairs. The table
and the chairs are all lavishly decorated with carvings of wild game. The 
walls contain displays of weapons and shields. The displays are old and
rusting, and it is obvious that there is nothing of any value there.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This room is decked out as a kitchen. Why a crypt needs a kitchen is a
mystery. The kitchen contains a fireplace, storage cabinets, pots and pans-
everything that a real kitchen would have.

rooms.name: The Ballroom
rooms.desc:
Apparently, whoever designed this crypt thought that dead men entertained,
because this room is set up as a nice ballroom. Giant candle chandeliers 
dangle from the ceiling. The candles are unlit but the candle holders 
glow with an unearthly, dark light. There are no furnishings in this room
but the walls are decorated with more faded paintings, showing more of
Lothar's brave deeds.

rooms.name: Storage
rooms.desc:
This room is used for storing goods one would need to host a party. Punch
bowls, food trays and the like.

rooms.name: Storage
rooms.desc:
This room holds all the rotting musical instruments that a group of 
minstrels might need to make dance music.

rooms.name: The Dressing Room
rooms.desc:
In keeping with the house motif, this chamber is appointed as a dressing
room. To the left of the door is a table and a dresser with a mirror hung
over the table. A small stool is near the table. On the left side of the door
is a chest of drawers and a wardrobe.

rooms.name: The Bed Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is set up as a bed chamber. This is a very large room, perhaps
100 feet by 100 feet. All the way at the end is a bed with a body lying on it.

rooms.name: The Hall of Mirrors
rooms.desc:
You suddenly find yourself in a brightly lit room surrounded by hundreds of
people. You feel dizzy and disoriented. As your eyes adjust to the brightness,
you realize that you are actually in a room filled with mirrors and the other
figures you thought you saw are only reflections.

rooms.name: The Pause That Refreshes
rooms.desc:
In contrast to the hall of mirrors, this room is gloomy and dark. As your
eyes adjust to the dim and mistly light radiating from the walls, you see a
very large room. Your attempts to orient yourself to your surroundings are cut
short by the sight of movement a far corner.

rooms.name: Crypts
rooms.desc: Empty

rooms.name: Treasury
rooms.desc: Empty

rooms.name: A Narrow Space Between Mountains
rooms.desc:
You are on a thin trail that lies between two mountains. If attacked here, the
space would be hard to defend, but you feel safe here, and for some reason
believe that the danger is all ahead. To the north the trail continues and to
the south lies the forest.

rooms.name: A Wide Space Between Mountains
rooms.desc:
The trail between the mountains widens here, and ahead you can see a large,
open area, though you can't see it that well, you think you see people there,
moving. To the south the trail continues, to the north the trail runs into
an open field.

rooms.name: Inside the Bell Tower
rooms.desc:
You are in a small tower made from stone. An ancient staircase spirals down into
the darkness. The stairs are slick with algae and slime, making your footing
treacherous. You don't even want to think about what would happen were you to
fall. The walls are covered with a dark green slime and there is nothing to hold
on to. Above you is the belfry where the bells are held.

rooms.name: In Between Worlds
rooms.desc:
You stand on the surface of a large flat rock which seems to be floating
in misty space.  This is the astral plane, the place in between dimensions.
The surface of this rock is covered in runes the likes of which you have never
seen before.  There seems to be no escape from this rock save stepping
off of it into astral space, a move which certainly would be permenantly
fatal.

rooms.name: In Between Worlds
rooms.desc:
You stand on the surface of a large flat rock which seems to be floating
in misty space.  This is the astral plane, the place in between dimensions.
The surface of this rock is covered in runes the likes of which you have never
seen before.  There seems to be no escape from this rock save stepping
off of it into astral space, a move which certainly would be permenantly
fatal.

rooms.name: A Secret Passage
rooms.desc:
Claustrophobia is begining to set in as you continue to navigate down
this narrow crawlspace.  You gasp for air, choaking on the heavy dust.
Seperated from the rest of your party by the sheer narrowness of the tunnel,
your bravery seems to dim.  Ahead to the west, you think that you can feel
cool air passing over your sweat soaked skin.  Is there an opening there,
or are you begining to hallucinate?  Darkness engulfs you, waves of paranoia
wash over you.  This could be the end.

rooms.name: The Inner Chambers
rooms.desc:
You stand in a cramped, circular apsis which is dominated by an icon
of the anicent called Serapis. The rooms size and circular construction makes
you feel as if you are trapped in a shaft of some sort.  This room, like
the atrium to your south, seems to be abnormally clean, even though it has
been left undisturbed for thousands of years. Well, almost undisturbed...

rooms.name: The Atrium
rooms.desc:
The narrow crawlspace suddenly opens up in to this dimly lit atrium. 
This room is completely circular, with walls covered in heiroglyphs carved
in bas-relief.  The ceiling here is a smooth, unadorned dome, what little
light there is appears to come from recessed sources above the lip of
the walls and is reflected faintly by the dome.  What is most disturbing
about this place is the total lack of any signs of life.  It is eeriely quiet,
and the air seems cooler than that in the rest of the temple.  In stark
contrast to the rest of the temple, this room apears to be dust-free.
To the north, there appears to be another chamber whose entrance is covered
by a tattered velvet curtain.

rooms.name: A Secret Passage
rooms.desc:
You continue your crawl along this passage in the heart of the temple.
The dust here is as thick as sand, and small white worms writhe in it.
The walls and ceiling of this crawlspace have etchings on them that might
once have been heiroglyphs, but the erosion of the limestone walls has
left them unreadable.  The passage continues in darkness to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Secret Passage
rooms.desc:
You crawl on your hands and knees in this narrow passage behind a ruined
altar.  Even with your lights, its is so dark in here that you are forced to
feel along the walls in order to navigate the crawlspace.  The passage
continues into darkness to the west.

rooms.name: In the Corner of a Battlefield
rooms.desc:
You are in the corner of a large battlefield. Piles of corpses have been left
here so as not to make a disadvantage for the warriors who fight in the
battlefield. To the north and west are mountains, to the south and east lies
the battlefield.

rooms.name: On the Edge of a Battlefield
rooms.desc:
You are on the edge of a large battlefield. Piles of corpses have been left
here so as not to make a disadvantage for the warriors who fight in the
battlefield. To the north are mountains, and the battlefield lies in the other
directions.

rooms.desc:

what's happening in every direction. For some reason the ground here isn't
blood-soaked, and there's a silver plaque imbedded into the ground.
