rooms.desc:
From the parapet of this lofty tower, you can see for what looks like miles.
The vast blue sky resembles a sea of tranquility, as watchers make sure the
armies of darkness don't become foolhardy enough to attack Elysium.

rooms.name: A watchtower
rooms.desc:
From the parapet of this lofty tower, you can see for what looks like miles.
The vast blue sky resembles a sea of tranquility, as watchers make sure the
armies of darkness don't become foolhardy enough to attack Elysium.

rooms.name: A watchtower
rooms.desc:
From the parapet of this lofty tower, you can see for what looks like miles.
The vast blue sky resembles a sea of tranquility, as watchers make sure the
armies of darkness don't become foolhardy enough to attack Elysium.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand among huge black trunked trees that reach into a canopy of
leaves that rests like a huge upside ocean nearly forty feet above your
head. The underbrush here is thick with thorns and wiry vines.

rooms.name: A Small Trail in Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand on a small trail that winds through the dense undergrowth. The
path continues to the north, and you may be able to push your way through
to the east or west where a small stream cuts through the thorn bushes.

rooms.name: A Trail in Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
The trail continues to the north, thorns and rough branches rip at your
face and armor as you force your way through the dense undergrowth.

rooms.name: In a Small Stream
rooms.desc:
You stand about knee deep and a small stream that runs downhill to the
west. A small dirt path meets the stream to the north.

rooms.name: A Path Ending
rooms.desc:
You stand at the end of a small dirt path through the forest, a small
steam flows downhill to the west just south of here.

rooms.name: A Path in the Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
Your standing on a path that heads east and south through the dense
forest. It looks like you could probably force your way through the
brush to the west.

rooms.name: An Intersection in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
A trail heading north and south crosses a narrow dirt path here. This
place in the dark woods seems strangely quiet, and there is no sign of
any wildlife.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc: The trail becomes entirely overgrown with thorn bushes here.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Path
rooms.desc:
The path turns here running west and north.  There is something sinister
about the forest here, the deep shadows among the trees and brush seem
to shift and twist before your eyes, stretching strange darks ribbons
across the path around you.

rooms.name: On a Path Through Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is something sinister about the forest here, the deep shadows
among the trees and undergrowth seem to shift before your eyes, casting
strange dark ribbons across the path.

rooms.name: A T-Intersection in the Path
rooms.desc:
You stand at an intersection, the path continues to the west and east. 
The western branch of the path is almost entirely overgrown with thick
thorn bushes and vines.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The undergrowth here is barely thin enough for you to hack and force your
way along the path.  The forest seems a bit less dense to the east.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The path cuts a small hole through the brush to the south here, if you
kneel down and scrunch up your shoulders you may be able to crawl through.

rooms.name: A Small Clearing
rooms.desc:
The thorn bushes and vines have been cleared away here in about a fifteen
square foot area.  An old crumbling gore stained altar stands at the
center of the clearing on a small mound.  The whole area stinks of death
and decay.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc:
It's hard to tell if the path actually stops here or if over time the 
forest has just entirely overgrown it to the west. Either way the only
exit appears to be back the way you came to the east. A large vine
covered pit descends down into the darkness before you.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The dark forest here seems jagged, the strange twisted shadows of huge
skeletal limbed trees and thorn covered undergrowth tower over you
menacingly.  The path continues to the east and west from here.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The dark forest here seems jagged, the strange twisted shadows of huge
skeletal limbed trees and thorn covered undergrowth tower over you
menacingly.  The path continues through the darkness to the east and
west.

rooms.name: Along a Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The path turns to the north here. There is an eerie stillness to the
forest here, as if everything living suddenly disappeared..

rooms.name: An Intersection of Paths in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The path turns sharply to the west here. There is something strange
looking about the brush to the east.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank, just south of here a  
small stream runs into a wide churning river. You can hear the water as
it crashes into the banks and rocks that jut from it's foaming surface.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank, just south of here a
a wide river crashes against the banks. To the west you can barely make
out a rope bridge crossing the water.

rooms.name: At the Darkwood River Bridge
rooms.desc:
The forest opens up here a little at the edge of the river where a
rickety looking rope bridge is tied across the water to the south.

rooms.name: On the Rope Bridge
rooms.desc:
You stand on a rope and wooden plank bridge that teeters dangerously
over the rushing water below you. The planks look old and rotten.
you would be wise to get off this thing before you tumble into river
and drown.

rooms.name: At the Darkwood River Bridge
rooms.desc:
The forest opens up here a little at the edge of the river where a
rickety looking rope bridge is tied across the water to the north.
There is a small burned out campfire here.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank, just north of here a
a wide river crashes against the banks. To the northwest you see a rope 
bridge crossing the churning water.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank. You hear the sounds
of crashing water as the river smashes into the banks and rocks
to the north of here.

rooms.name: In Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is a small circle of grass and vines here where the brush is
mysteriously absent. You also notice that it's strangely quiet here
not even the crickets are making any noise.

rooms.name: In Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is a small mound of leaves and branches in the brambles here, you
realize on second glance that it is a small hut of some kind. the
undergrowth to the east and west is to thick to allow passage, the only
exit appears to be back the way you came to the north.

rooms.name: In the Goblin Hut
rooms.desc:
You have to kneel down to get through the small doorway, the roof of
limbs, leaves and vines is only about 5 feet above the ground.
Several animal skins and hunks of dried meat hang from the walls and
ceiling. A small hole in the roof allows smoke from a cook-fire to escape.

rooms.name: In the Dense Undergrowth of Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand in a narrow clear area in the ocean of thorny brush and vines
where a massive Darkwood tree has fallen.

rooms.name: In the Dense Undergrowth of Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is a small circle of grass and vines here where the brush is
mysteriously absent.

rooms.name: In the Dead-fall
rooms.desc:
You tumble down the rough rock and dirt covered wall of the dead-fall to
land with a painful crash at the bottom.  As you stand and dust yourself
off you notice several nasty looking spears stuck in the ground, their
sharp barbed tips pointing towards the sky.  Your lucky you didn't
disembowel yourself on one when you landed.

rooms.name: A Cave Entrance
rooms.desc:
A low dark cave is buried in the undergrowth the east.  A few small
wisps of smoke rise lazily from it's edges.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a damp mold and rotten vegetation filled passage that runs
east and west. There are a few tanned leather hides tied to poles here,
one with a gruesome image of a human skull with the side caved in,
the other with some unknown language scrawled across it in deep
red lettering.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns to the south here, and also leads back to the west.
The ground under your feet makes disgusting sucking and squishing noises
every time you take a step.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns to the east here, and also leads back to the north.
The ground under your feet makes disgusting sucking and squishing noises
every time you take a step.

rooms.name: In A Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
Some of the rotten vegetation and vines have been cleared away here.
Shadows cast by a few torches further down the hall to the east play
across the raw earth walls.

rooms.name: A Guard Post in the Passage
rooms.desc:
A few logs are here set on end for chair, along with a small cook fire.
The northern wall is entirely covered with various animal skins, one
stirs a little as if brushed by a slight breeze. Glancing at the
torches in the wall you can't help but wonder why these goblins would
have torches when they can obviously see in the darkness just fine.

rooms.name: A Gate in the Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage is blocked here by a large wood an vine woven gate. Furs and
various other animal skins cover the muddy floors and walls.

rooms.name: In a Secret Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a narrow passage leading north. The south wall is covered in
furs and vines.

rooms.name: In a Secret Passage
rooms.desc: The passage turns the the west here and heads back to the south.

rooms.name: A Small Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is littered with bones, hunks of flesh and several other things
that you can't quite figure out what are <or where>.  The walls are
decorated with several banners of tanned leather covered in strange
writing and symbols.

rooms.name: A Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins.

rooms.name: NE Corner of a Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins.

rooms.name: SW Corner of a Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins.

rooms.name: SE Corner of a Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins. There is
a dark tunnel opening in the south wall here.

rooms.name: In a Damp Tunnel
rooms.desc: You are in a damp tunnel than runs north and south from here.

rooms.name: In a Damp Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel comes to a stop here at a large black wooden door. A tanned
animal skin with a big caved in human skull drawn on it is nailed into
the wood with iron spikes.

rooms.name: The Goblin Lords Throne Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large dark room, a black wooden throne cut out of a big
tree stump is sitting in the center of the room. The walls are covered
with furs and skins depicting scenes of battle and destruction.
Two poles rise on either side of the throne with rotten elven heads
jammed on then ends.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
The narrow muddy passage runs to the east into a large chamber from here
and west to a gate of woven vines and limbs.

rooms.name: A Moldy Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a damp moldy tunnel which extends into the darkness to the
east. The smell of rotting vegetation and damp earth hangs in the air
here like a fog, it makes you want to gag.

rooms.name: A Moldy Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a damp moldy tunnel which extends into darkness to the west
and east. The smell of rotting vegetation and damp earth hangs in the
here like a fog, it makes you want to gag.

rooms.name: A Moldy Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
The tunnel comes to a halt here, a small wooden ladder leads up to
a trap door made of woven vines and tree limbs.

rooms.name: Guard Barracks
rooms.desc:
You are in the foyer of the barracks of the city guard.  A pair of
large iron-bound oak doors lead south into a room marked "Training area".
A large board with several recruitment posters hangs on the eastern wall
above a small wooden desk.  The rest of the barracks are off-limits to
civilians such as yourself.

rooms.name: The New Recruit Training Area
rooms.desc:
Several people are wandering around here, obviously new recruits 
waiting to be sent into training for the city guard. The large open
area extends to the east. A large set of oak doors is to the north.

rooms.name: The New Recruit Training Area
rooms.desc:
Several people are wandering around here, obviously new recruits
waiting to be sent into training for the city guard. The large open
area extends to the west and north where a wide stairway descends to
another level.

rooms.name: The New Recruit Training Area
rooms.desc:
Several people are wandering around here, obviously new recruits
waiting to be sent into training for the city guard.  The large open
area extends to the south, and a wide stairway leads down into the
guard training centre here.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One
rooms.desc:
Several recruits dressed in grey outfits with "trainee" stenciled on the
back are being trained in basic procedures here.  A wide stairway leads up
to the recruitment centre here.  The open training area extends to the west
and south.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One
rooms.desc:
Several recruits dressed in grey outfits with "trainee" stenciled on the
back are being trained in basic procedures here. The training area extends
to the west and north from here.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One
rooms.desc:
Several recruits dressed in grey outfits with "trainee" stenciled on the
back are being trained in basic procedures here. The training area extends
to the east and north. A wide stairway descends to another level here.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level One
rooms.desc:
Several recruits dressed in grey outfits with "trainee" stenciled on the 
back are being trained in basic procedures here. The training area extends
to the east and the south.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two
rooms.desc:
This is the northwest corner of the second level of the training centre.
A flight of stairs leads back up to level one, and the second level extends 
to your south and east.  The trainees on this level wear white outfits and
practice the basics of hand-to-hand combat.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two
rooms.desc:
This is the northeast corner of the second level.  Men in white outfits 
practice hand-to-hand combat here, assisted by large, burly instructors.  
The level extends to your south and west.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two
rooms.desc:
This is the southeast corner of the second level of the centre, a flight
of stone step leads down to the third level here.  The rest of the second
level is to the northwest, but all there is is open space with trainees in
white jumpsuits practicing hand-to-hand combat on straw mats which have
been placed on the floor.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Two
rooms.desc:
This is a corner of the second level of the guard training centre, where 
men in white jumpsuits practice beating each other up with their hands.  You
imagine that this is pretty good practice for the real world, unless their
assailant is armed, of course.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three
rooms.desc:
You stand at the bottom of stone steps which lead up to the second
level.  The third level of the training centre stretches out to your
southwest, with trainees in green outfits practicing combat with the
typical standard-issue Kir Drax'in Guard sabers.  You notice that the
sabers appear to have been dulled; they are clearly not meant to wound
the opponent, mortally or otherwise.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three
rooms.desc:
This is the northwest corner of the third level of the training centre.  
All around you, men in green armor attempt to slice one another with ill-
manufactured weaponry.  You notice, however, that some of the sabers are
sharp enough to cut, judging by the minor gashes on some of the men.
   These guys must be pretty serious about serving in the guard to go 
through this kind of exercise.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three
rooms.desc:
This is the southwest corner of the third level.  Here, a flight of stone 
steps leads down to level four, where you can hear the loud clanging of 
what sounds like real combat.  The third level extends to your northeast, 
amid a sea of green-armored trainees.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Three
rooms.desc:
This is the southeast corner of the third level.  Many trainees in green 
armor battle each other with sabers, while being instructed in the finer
points of bladed combat by large officers whose duty it is to train new
recruits.  The third level extends to your northwest.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four
rooms.desc:
This is the beginning of the fourth level of the guard training center, a 
flight of stairs leads back up to level three here.  This level seems to have 
split the men from the boys; you notice that all the recruits here seem to be
bigger and tougher looking than those on the floors above.  Their training
must be close to complete.  This level extends to the southeast.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four
rooms.desc:
This is the southwest corner of the fourth level of the Kir Drax'in Guard 
training centre.  This level is much the same as the ones above, except that
the men here are wearing brown armor are seem much more vicious than the
ones on the floors above.  These guys almost look like they could be members
of the church guard.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four
rooms.desc:
You stand in the northeast corner of the fourth floor.  All around you, 
men in brown armor are gritting their teeth in combat against one another,
using the standard weaponry of the church guard: polearms and sabers. The
sabers are pretty dull, of course, but the polearms look like they hurt,
and make a sickening smacking sound when they connect with one of their
opponents heads.  The fourth floor extends to your southwest.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Guard Basic Training - Level Four
rooms.desc:
This is the southeast corner of the fourth level.  There is a flight of 
stairs leading down to what must be the fifth level, and you notice that 
only the heartiest and strongest men are allowed to pass down them.  Maybe
you could sneak by and see what is down there?

rooms.name: The Fifth Level
rooms.desc:
The walls of this room have been painted matte black, and very little 
light reflects off them from the two large torches that barely seem to
illuminate this room.  Occasionally, a warrior from above descends the
stairs and enters through the doorway to the south.  However, the door
itself is guarded by a particularly menacing guard, and you doubt he'll
let you by if he doesn't think you are worthy.  Above the door there is
an inscription that reads: "Indoctrination Centre".

rooms.name: The Indoctrination Centre
rooms.desc:
This is apparently where the trainees become fully inducted in to the 
Kir Drax'in Guard.  There are trainees waiting in line to receive their
standard issue weapons to the east, and their armor to the west. The 
main centre extends to the south, and to the north through a heavily
guarded doorway.  This room is decorated with religious icons and 
candles, and some new initiates to the guard kneel in prayer before 
proceeding to the south.

rooms.name: Armor Depot
rooms.desc:
This is where the new members of the Kir Drax'in guard are fitted for 
their standard issue armor.  A young priest hands out the armor to the 
new initiates that are waiting in line. Written on the wall are the ten 
commandments of the Kir Drax'in guard, and other religious propaganda.
The centre continues to the east.

rooms.name: Weapons Depot
rooms.desc:
In this room a line of new guard members wait for their standard issue 
sabers. These men have been picked out of hundreds of trainees to defend
Kir Drax'in against the monsters of the Wyldlands.  They are chosen not
only for their ability to fight, but for their ability to be programmed,
zealous defenders of the church.  You sure as hell hope they are ready.
The centre continues to the west.

rooms.name: Indoctrination Centre
rooms.desc:
This is apparently the final room in the complex, as you see the new 
fully-armored guards of Kir Drax'in march through a stone archway and
ascend a flight of stairs to your south.  As they pass through this room,
a member of the clergy bestows their holy orders upon them.  You realize
that these new guards are not just guardians of the city, but guardians
of the church as well.

rooms.name: Guard Barracks
rooms.desc:
You are inside the Barracks of the Kir Drax'in Guard, just north of the
reception foyer.  This is apparently where the new initiates go to get their
assignments, although it seems rather vacant right now.  As soon as you
step out of the stairwell, some priests close and bar the door behind you,
to prepare for the next batch of initiates.  It appears that the only
way out is south into the reception foyer.

rooms.name: A large clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small clearing in a field. As you look
around you see you are in a enormous valley, all around you are
large leafy plants and trees. There is some large footprints
in the ground here, looks like they were made from some
gigantic beast.

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are in the northern end of the clearing birds and sound of
other animals are all round you. The jungle is just before
you, it is quite dark and mysterious. There is some bones a
flesh scattered around here.

rooms.name: Edge of the jungle
rooms.desc:
You have just entered the outer rim of the jungle, there is
many strange plants and little rodents scurring around as you
enter. This jungle is quite dark, except for some rays of
sinlight poking through the canopy. You think you see some
large outlines in the distance, they almost look like they are
moving.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You are now fairly deep into the jungle, there is strange
sounds comeing from all over the place it seems. You are able
to make out the outlines, they look like giant beasts of some
sort. There is dense foliage and lots of leaves and broken sticks
on the ground here making it difficult to walk.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You follow what seems to be a path, however you have no idea
hwere it leady, except into darkness. You can hear what sounds
like twigs snapping, and some of the tree's around here look as
if some giant beast has beeing grazing on them. There is also
large indentations in the ground here.

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the eastern edge of the clearing, the jungle is just
before you, you hear strange sounds comeing from it. There is some large ferns
and other plantlife around here, as you bend down to examine a shrub a small
lizard scurries out from under it, scaring the wits out of you.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You have just entered the dark jungle, strange vines and webs lash you in the
face, making it difficult to walk through. There is all sorta of plantlife
htat you have never seen before, and you notice some large footprints in the
ground here, perhaps made by some gigantic beast.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You have entered deeper into the jungle, not much light passes throught the
dense canopy far above you. The tree are covered with dense vines and ivy,
making them slick and slimey. An occasional ray of sunlight passes through the
treetops, helping calm your senses.

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the southern edge of a clearing, you can see the valley
extends far in all directions. You can catch glimses of snowcapped mountains
in the distance. The jungle begins to the south and is spooky and creepy,
you are beginning to wonder if this is a dream...

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the western edge of a large clearing, the dense jingle
is just to your west. There is some parge leafy plants and tall tree, almost
like a rainforest. You see that some of the plants are here have been uprooted
and the leave have been eaten off, you wonder what kind of animal did it.

rooms.name: Edge of the jungle
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of the jungle, and a strange jungle at that. It
almost seems alien, you don't reckonize any of the oversized ferns and other
plantlife that grows within it. You wonder what kind of animals would live in
such a place.

rooms.name: Swank's special room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a very special room, the only thing here is a very large
bookah type bong in the center of the room.

rooms.name: Vortex's Room
rooms.desc:
This room is in the shape of a hexagon. The ceiling towers many feet over
your head. Within the room there is a large desk with many books lying 
jumbled all over it. Off in one of the corners lies a trail backpack and
some camping gear. In another corner lies some piantball gear. The walls 
are covered in beautiful paintings of dragons which seem to move around at
their own will.

rooms.name: Entrance Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The lush vegitation of the surrounding area slowly vanishes as the 
trail you stand on ends at large hole in the mountainside,  Peering
within the hole you can hear and feel a strong wind flowing outward;
its force nearly enough to drive you back.
   The only exits from this area lead down the trail or into the hole,
though the trail looks far more inviting.

rooms.name: Inside the cave
rooms.desc:
The wind seems to increase for a moment as you step from the trail
onto the hard rock surface of the cave floor.  Listening closely, you 
think the wind may be saying something.
   The walls here, like the mountain itself, are made of a dark granite
that seems to pulse as you stare at it.  
   Above you, the cave steeps sharply upward, leading to the outside,
while to the north, the cave leads deeper into the mountain.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The last traces of light are left behind as you enter this section of the
tunnel.  Behind you, you can see the light at the end of the tunnel move
further away as you work your way deeper into the darkness.  The walls and
floor here seem to level out while scuffmarks on the floor indicate that
this place may have been visited frequently.
   The tunnels leads to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The floor gradually slopes downward as the walls smooth out to form
a refined corridor.  Scuffs from boots and scratches from weapon mar
the cave floor, evidence that this part of the cave gets quite alot of
use.
   It looks as though the cave ends to the north, where it dead-ends 
against a flat granite wall.  As you examine the granite, you notice
strange runes carved into it.
   The tunnel leads to the south, away from the runes.

rooms.name: Entrance passage
rooms.desc:
The passage behind you vanishes, leaving you staring into abysmal 
darkness.  All around you, the walls pulse with a inner power as it
absorbs the light from your source.  The floor is flat and smooth,
still marred with traffic while the walls bear sconces with unlit
torches.
   A thin layer of dust covers the floor, still bearing the prints
of recent passage.  The prints lead to the west.

rooms.name: A Long Passage
rooms.desc:
A passage spreads out before you, a large mosaic pattern etched into
the stone-tiled floor.  Faint light emanates from the between the tiles,
casting an eerie luminescence about the area.  The shadows cast by your
own movements makes the walls appear to move and sway.
   The passage leads to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Small Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small room with a very high ceiling.  The chamber
stretches some fifteen feet in diameter and upon every inch of the
curved wall cryptic symbols symbols have been etched.
   In the center of the room, a small dias holds a marble statue
of a regal woman.  Her long, waving hair cascades down her stone
back in sheets while her hands rise above her in a gesture of
worship.
   Corridors lead off from this chamber in all directions, the
sounds of whispers and wind coming from the north.

rooms.name: A Narrow Passage
rooms.desc:
The dark black rock walls seem to seep the light from your source as
you traverse this passage.  Natural in origin, the walls are rough and
the floor uneven as you stumble unsteadily through it.
   The walls slowly press closer together as you head north while the
exit to the south leads to some sort of chamber.

rooms.name: A Long Hallway
rooms.desc:
You stand in the center of a long, arched corridor.  The walls here,
obviously carved by a craftsman bear scenes and symbols of combat and
magic.  Small, canteloupe-sized holes rest in the walls just above the
floors of the corridor and appear to by symmetrically spaced at three
feet apart.
   The floor here is littered with all races of skeletons in varying
stages of decomposition while around them, broken weapons, armor, and
other equipment lies scattered about.

rooms.name: Dark Chasm
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a deep chasm.  The black, light-absorbing rock
surrounds you as you strain to peer into the gaping abyss.  From what little
light escapes your source, the chasm walls extend indefinitely below you.
   To the east lies a fatal fall into the the abyss while to the west, the
corridor leads into darkness.

rooms.name: Bottomless Chasm
rooms.desc:
As you step off the edge of the chasm into the inky darkness you pray 
something stops you from the really long fall that awaits you.
But
   you
      seem 
          to
            keep 
                falling
                       and
                          falling
                                 and 
                                    falling
                                           and
                                              falling
                                                     and
                                                        falling
                                                               and
                                                                  falling.

And just as you think you may keep falling forever you hit the ground with
a loud splat.

rooms.name: A Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
Upon entering this hallway a vast sense of lonliness assualts you. The 
feelings of death and longing are etched into your every step. The walls 
channel you in a westernly direction with the ground beneath your feet ever
so slightly grading downward. The walls here seem to swirl with an inner power
and from within the sounds of faint voices can be heard.
   The only exits from this room are to the east and west.

rooms.name: Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
This is the immortal enterance way into Kir Oshi.  There is a sign on the wall
that look like it may be a road map.

rooms.name: The Altar
rooms.desc:
This room is almost completely filled by a huge altar that has been
constructed to worship the gods.  You can tell that this place is
well respected because pilgrims leave money and other offering here
without fear that thieves will take them.  Behind the altar there
is a giant mosaic of a dragon flying through the clouds.

rooms.name: A Meditation Room
rooms.desc:
This room is simple, undecorated except for the few colored lanterns that
hang from the ceiling.  The purpose of this room is clear, to facilitate the
ancient art of Zanzen, the meditation.

rooms.name: The Temple Common Area
rooms.desc:
This is a large room with a vaulted ceiling, kept clean and spartan by
the monks that live here.  Travellers and students from abroad are resting
and loitering about, hoping to catch a bit of wisdom, but mostly taking in
the spectacular beauty and simplicity of this place.
   The entrance of the temple is to the south, while all other directions
lead to the internal sections of the temple.

rooms.name: The Alms Room
rooms.desc:
This is a place for those adventurers who have to give to those who are less
fortunate.  Please keep in mind the ones who don't have anything, not even
enough to stay alive.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
Here is the corner of the great wall of Kir Oshi.  From here you can proceed
east along the north face of the wall, south along the west face, or down onto
the ground level of the town.

rooms.name: North Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the north wall.  You have a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the north.  Off in the distance is a steaming
volcano.  The wall continues east and to the west is the north-west corner.

rooms.name: North Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the north wall.  You have a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the north.  Off in the distance is a steaming
volcano.  The wall continues to the west and to the east is the north-east
corner.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east corner of the great wall of Kir Oshi.  From here you can
go down to the ground level, head west along the north face of the wall, or go
south along the east wall.

rooms.name: Road to Temple
rooms.desc:
This is a small, winding road that leads from the city of Kir Oshi up to the
temple.  The pagoda itself sits on a small cliff overlooking the city.
The trail to the north leads right up to its gates.

rooms.name: West Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the west wall.  From here you have a
commanding view of all the surroundings.  To the north is the north-west corner
tower.  South of here is the tower above the west gate.

rooms.name: East Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the east wall. From here you have a
commanding view of all the surroundings.  To the east is the temple gardens,
you wonder why they are separate from the temple itself.  You can go to the
north-east guard tower or further along the east wall.

rooms.name: North-West Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is one of the four corner towers within the Kir Oshi wall.  The walkway
along the wall is up from here.  The wall road goes east and south from here.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
To your north is the great protective wall.  This road along the wall continues
east and west.  To your west is the North-West guard tower.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
The tall face of the northern wall looms over you here.  This road continues
both east and west along the wall.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are walking along the protective wall of Kir Oshi.  This is the western
side of the northern wall.  To your east is the north gate and the road
continues along the wall to the west.

rooms.name: The North Gate
rooms.desc:
This is the north gate of Kir Oshi.  Above you runs a great defensive wall,
although there is no way up to it from here.  A road heads east and west along
the wall, and south into the city.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the northern edge of Kir Oshi.  Directly to your north is the great
wall.  You can go east further along the wall, or west.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the road along the north wall in Kir Oshi.  You can continue east or
west along the north road.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the north-eastern corner of the wall surrounding the city. This 
street continues along the wall east or enters a guard tower to the west.

rooms.name: North East Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
The north-east end corner of the wall around Kir Oshi.  You can reach the walk
way on the wall by going up from here.  The wall road continues west and south.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
This is a very peaceful place.  The plants are well taken care of here.
Someone cares about the way this place looks.  The path continues south and
east.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
The is a T in the garden pathways.  There is a small nook of a garden to the
south, while the main path continues east and west.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
There is a curve in the path here.  The path goes east and south from here. You
see a small building to the southeast.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the northern side of the west wall.  To your north is a guard tower and
to the south is the west gate.

rooms.name: A Baker's Shop
rooms.desc:
All around you are the smells of a sweets shop.  Breads, rolls, and pastries
surround you.  There is a small sign on the wall.

rooms.name: A Flower Shop
rooms.desc:
It looks like spring here.  There are a huge number of flowers and other plants
here.  The smell of a great spring overwhelms you.  There is a small sign on
the wall here.

rooms.name: A Weaponsmith's Shop
rooms.desc:
This is a spotlessly clean shop.  There are weapons from famous battles all over
the place.  There is a large assortment of weapons for sale on display behind
the counter.  A small sign hangs on the wall.

rooms.name: Kero Row
rooms.desc:
This medium-sized road runs flush up to the northern city gates just
ahead of you and south into the center of Kir Oshi.  It looks like it
is well used, though it lacks the bustle of the pier.

rooms.name: Inside the Hsing-Hock'win
rooms.desc:
You stand inside the lobby of what apparently passes for accomedations in this
strange culture.  The living conditions are certainly spartan, I wouldn't be
expecting any room service if I were you.  There are, however, several nefarious
looking gentlement lounging around in the lobby, perhaps you could make some
new friends?

rooms.name: An Armorer
rooms.desc:
This is a small sheltered shop.  All around you are the gleaming metals of
protective gear.  On the wall is a small framed note.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are just north of the east gate, standing on a road which follows the
course of the wall. Just west of here lies the bank of Kir Oshi.

rooms.name: A Nook Garden
rooms.desc:
This a a very small clearing here.  It is very peaceful.  The main path is to
the north.  There is a small bench here.

rooms.name: West Gate Wall Tower
rooms.desc:
This is the main watch tower for the west facing wall.  From here you can
look far into the distance to see approching enemies.  You can north or south
along the west wall or go down into the the west gate.

rooms.name: East Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
You are over the east gate.  From here you can look into the temple gardens to
the east, into town to the west.  From here you can go down into the east gate,
north along the east wall, or south also along the east wall.

rooms.name: Before the Temple
rooms.desc:
You stand in front of the temple of Kir Oshi, which is located on a small cliff
overlooking the city.  From here, you have a rather panoramic view of Kir Oshi
and the surrounding countryside. Not to mention the ocean that stretches away
towards the horizon.  The view from the top of the pagoda must be spectacular.

rooms.name: The West Gate
rooms.desc:
Here is the main gate into Kir Oshi.  Above you is a great wall, which can be
reached by a set of stairs here.  West of here is the main road into town. To
the east is Yokki Way, the main commercial street of Kir Oshi. A road leads
north and south along the wall.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is the main commerce street of Kir Oshi.  To your north is a baker.  A 
tough looking tavern is to the south.  West from here is the west gate, and
Yokki Way continues to the east.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is the main commerce street of Kir Oshi.  There is a flower shop to your
north and Yokki Way continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is just west of the center of Kir Oshi.  To your north is a dealer in 
weapons and the famous Guiee's is to your south.  Just east of here is the 
market square.  You can head west along Yokki Way toward the west gate.

rooms.name: Market Square
rooms.desc:
Here is the central part of Kir Oshi.  From here you can head north or south
along Kero Row or east/west along Yokki Way.  Towering above you is a huge 
statue.  There is a plaque on the base of the statue.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is just east of the center of Kir Oshi.  Just north of here is a very nice
looking inn.  To the south is a strange store, a sign that has the word 
"Imports" hangs above the door there.  To the west is Market Square, or you can
continue east toward the east gate.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
You are on a major commerce street in Kir Oshi, although this section does not
look very nice.  You can go east or west along Yokki Way or go south into a
empty, abandoned warehouse.  There is a sign to the south partially blocking
the doorway.  There is some rope still crossing the door, but that seems to 
have fallen down a bit.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is the major road of Kir Oshi.  To your east is the East Gate and Yokki 
Way continues to the west.  North of you is an armorer and to the south is
another dark shop.

rooms.name: The East Gate
rooms.desc:
Here is the main east gate of Kir Oshi.  Above you is a great wall that can be
reached by a set of stairs here.  A road leads north and south along the wall.
To the west is Yokki Way, the main commerce street of Kir Oshi.  The temple
gardens are to the east.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
This is the entrance to the temple garden.  The main east gate is just west
of here. The path through the garden leads north and south.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
Here is a small clearing in the garden.  The path heads north and south from
here.  There is a small building to the east.

rooms.name: A Small Temple
rooms.desc:
This is a small stone structure on the eastern edge of the gardens,
a place for quiet reflection and perhaps prayer. In fact, there
is a wooden kneeler here for that very purpose.
The garden continues to the west.

rooms.name: Bars Crossed Tavern
rooms.desc:
This is a dark, mean looking tavern.  It looks like it is frequented by the
less-than-outstanding citizens, although the drinks probably won't be watered
down.  A small sign hangs next to the bar.

rooms.name: Guiee's Sushi Bar
rooms.desc:
This is a traditional sushi bar.  The smell of fish permeates the air here.
All around are the tasty fish treats you can order.  There is a large painted
sign hanging over the chopping block/counter.

rooms.name: An Imported Goods Store
rooms.desc:
This is a very strange store. All around you are fashions and other items
from far away lands. There is a piece of paper taped to the counter here.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Warehouse
rooms.desc:
This place looks like it was once a thriving business.  But something has gone
very wrong.  Looks like it might have been fire.

rooms.name: A Dark Building
rooms.desc:
This dark building is one of the strangest shops you've ever seen. Crude
drawings line the wall, all of them about the size of your fist: tattoos.
The tattooist sees you and says, "Be not fooled by the lack of detail;
the magick is strong."

rooms.name: A Nook Garden
rooms.desc:
This a a very small clearing here.  It is very peaceful.  The main path is too
the south.  There is a small bench here.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the southern side of the west wall.  To your south is a guard tower and
to the north is the west gate.

rooms.name: Weights and Measures
rooms.desc:
This small, busy office houses the Kir-Oshi office of weights
and measures, which takes care of all of the cities bookkeeping.
There are papers and permits for all kinds of regulated activities
here, and the stack of completed forms are arranged haphazardly
in a pile.
A small sign hangs on the wall.

rooms.name: Kero Row
rooms.desc:
This is the main north-south road in Kir-Oshi.  It is not as big or as
busy as Yokki Way, but most of its traffic tends to come from the pier.
To the north is the market square, to the west is a small, dimly lit
curio shop.  The side wall of a building blocks your way to the east.
To the south is the massive pier gate of Kir-Oshi.

rooms.name: A Secret Reception
rooms.desc:
Oops! Looks like you've stumbled onto the secret headquarters of the infamous
Liu'she Ch'uan tong. These guys don't look so friendly, maybe you should
get out of here before they get any weird ideas.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is near the south-east corner of the wall.  To the north is the east gate.
South of here is the south-east tower.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
This is a very peaceful place.  The plants are well taken care of here.
Someone spends a lot of time taking care of this place.  The path leads north
and east.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
Here is a T in the pathways.  To the north is a small nook within the garden.
The path also leads east and west.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
There is a bend in the garden here.  The path leads both west and north.  There
is a small building to the northeast.

rooms.name: South-West Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is one of the four corner towers within the Kir Oshi wall system.  From
here you can proceed east or north along the wall, or you can go up to the
walkway on the wall itself.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
To your south is the great protective wall.  This road along the wall continues
to the east or west to the south-west corner.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
The wall to your south towers over you.  This road along the base of the wall
continues both east and west.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are on the western side of the south gate just east of here along the wall
surrounding Kir Oshi.  The road continues along the wall to the west.

rooms.name: The South Gate
rooms.desc:
You stand inside the massive southern gate of Kir Oshi. Above you is a great
defensive wall, but you can not get up on it from here. A wide, paved road
runs south to the bustling pier, and a road runs east and west along the inside
wall of the city.  Kero Row leads north into the cities central area.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the southern edge of Kir Oshi.  To your west is the south gate and the
road along the wall continues east.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
To your north is the great wall surrounding Kir Oshi.  The road along this wall
goes both east and west from here.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are on a road along the south wall in Kir Oshi.  To your east is the south-
east guard tower.  The road along the wall continues west.

rooms.name: South-East Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is the most south-east portion of the wall surrounding Kir Oshi.  From
here you can go up to the wall walkway or you can go along the wall either 
north or west.

rooms.name: West Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the west wall.  From here you have a
commanding view of the entire city as well as the surrounding territory.
To the north is the West Gate Wall Tower.  The southwest corner of the
battlement is just to your south.

rooms.name: East Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the east wall.  From here you have a
commanding view of all the surroundings.  To the north is the East Gate Wall
Tower.  And to the west is south-east corner of the wall.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
Here is the corner of the great wall of Kir Oshi.  From here you can proceed
east along the south face of the wall, north along the west face, or down onto
the ground level of the town.

rooms.name: South Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the south wall.  You have a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the south.  Off in the distance is the 
Kir Oshi pier, reaching into the harbor.  The wall continues to the east and
the south-west corner is just to the west.

rooms.name: South Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the south wall.  There is a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the south.  Not too far south is the pier
reaching into the harbor.  The walkway leads both east, to the south-east 
corner, and west along the wall.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the south-east corner of the wall system around Kir Oshi.  From here
you can go down to the ground level, head west along the south wall, or north
along the east wall.

rooms.name: End of the Path
rooms.desc:
The path ends here, with the only exit back from where you came.  Maybe 
someday someone will finish where the path was supposed to go.

rooms.name: A Path Through the Woods
rooms.desc:
This is a fairly new, barely used path leading east west through the woods.  
There is not much to the west of here so you begin to wonder where it leads.

rooms.name: A Path Through the Woods
rooms.desc:
Here is the begining of a fairly new path leading east-west.  It connects to the
pier road just east of here.

rooms.name: Road to the Pier
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a wide paved trade road that connects the city of
Kir Oshi and its main pier.  Towering about you to the north is the great
protective wall of the cetral city.  A small path leads off to the west
from here.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
This the main wooden dock that connects the individual piers to the land and
roads.  To the south is the first pier.  The dock continues east and a road
leads north toward Kir Oshi.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
The main wooden dock continues east and west here.  There is another pier to
the south.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
The main wooden dock continues east and west here.  Yet another pier is to
the south.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
The main wooden dock continues east and west here.  There is also a pier to the
south here.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the end of the main dock.  There is a pier to the south here.  The main
pier heads off to the west.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
This is where the harbor meets the port city of Kir-Oshi.
Many vessels are loading and unloading wares on the docks
just east of here. The harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: First Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the first of the five piers that make up the Kir-Oshi
marina.  This is a major trade port, so all the piers are
well equipped for the trade ships and fishing boats that
dock here.  The sounds of a bustling seaport surround you.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: Second Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the second pier which branches off of the main dock to
extend far out into the harbor, which is just west of you.
Many trade ships unload thier cargo all around you, putting
it on carts bound for the south entrance to the city.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: Third Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the middle pier that extends from the main dock into
Kir-Oshi harbor, which is just to the west.  The pier is 
clogged with sailors and fishermen, among others, making
transit difficult at best.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: The Fourth Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the fourth of five piers that make up the Kir-Oshi
waterfront. All the piers seem to be equally busy, and this
one is certainly no exception, you can hardly see through
the throngs of people that are transacting business here.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: Fifth Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the final pier, furthest from the main road.  It looks
to be the busiest however.  There is a line of carts waiting to
head northwest to the city gates. The harbor is to your west.

rooms.name: An Old Dojo
rooms.desc:
There isn't much to see here, just and empty space that used to
be a martial arts center of some kind.  Its proprietors have 
probably moved on to bigger and better things.
A flight of wooden stairs lead down.

rooms.name: The Kir Oshi Bank
rooms.desc:
You are in a small but neat room where you can conduct your banking buisness.
There does not seem to be anyone here, but the place is spotless, obviously
someone takes care of it.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: An Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc: This is a map room of zone 183.  There is a map taped to the wall here.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-west corner of the board in a gleaming red tiled plaza.
There are exits to the east and south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-west section of the main plaza.  This particular section of
the plaza is made up of black tiles.  There is a wall to the north and exits 
lead in the other cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-west section of the plaza.  This section is made up of small
red tiles in an ornate pattern.  There is a wall to the north but there are
exits to the east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is basically the north-center of the main plaza.  This section of the
plaza is made up of semi-circular black tiles.  There is a wall to the north
north and exits lead in the other cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are basically about the center of the plaza right at the north wall.  This
area is made up of small, triangular red tiles.  Exits lead east, west, and
south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-east section of the of the plaza.  This area is made of 
a black streaked stone.  Exits lead east, south and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east section of the main plaza.  This little square is made up
of small, irregular red stones, much like little cobbles.  You can leave west,
south, or east.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east corner of the plaza.  This area has a smooth-as-glass,
gleaming black floor.  You can leave south or west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
Along the west wall in the north-west section of the plaza.  The floor is a 
rough black surface.  You can leave to the north, east, or south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-west section of the main plaza.  This area has a slick red
floor.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
The north-west section of the main plaza.  This small zone is made up of very
small black tiles.  Exits lead in all the cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-east corner of the plaza.  The floor is made of flat, red
stones.  Exits lead in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
You are in the north-east section of the plaza.  The floor here is covered by
a fine black gravel.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This small area in the north-east part of the plaza is made up of very large
slabs of dull red stone.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-east section of the main plaza, this square is made up of chunks of
mismatched black stone.  Exits lead in all compass directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
Along the east wall in the north-east of the plaza, this square's floor is made
up of a hard packed red clay.  Exits lead north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is along the west wall in the north-west area.  The floor here is made up
of small red beads that appear to be glued to the ground.  Exits lead north, 
east, and south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-west section of the plaza, this very plain looking square with a
black floor has exits in all of the cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
The floor of this room is some covered with some kind of pine needles, which is
strange because there are no trees on the plaza.  Exits lead north, south, east,
and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is moss growing on the ground here, covering the original color of the
floor.  This moss is a black, icky looking thing.  Exits lead in the four basic
directions from here.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a thick, red, shag carpet here.  Because of the carpet it seems
very quiet.  Exits lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-east section of the plaza, this open area is made completely up of
a single slab of onyx.  Exits lead in the four directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is in the north-east section of the main plaza.  The room is all done up
with red painted wood.  There are exits to the north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This room has a mute, black, indescribable feel to it.  Directly to your
east is the east wall.  Exits lead north, west, and south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
Along the west wall this square is made up of a fine black stone, inlayed with
a little gold.  Exits lead to the north, east, and south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
A richly ornated area, this place in the north-west portion of the plaza has
many comfortable items that are all done in a tasteful red.  Exits lead in the
four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
In the north-west area of the main plaza, this mini-plaza is done in a low pile
carpet.  It is a charcoal gray, almost black, in color.  Exits lead north,
south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This area is coated in a fine red powder.  It is in the air and dries
out your throat very quickly.  Exits lead in the four cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
It is very dark here, although the sun still gives its light.  It seems that
all the items are sucking up the light, making it have a black feel to it. 
Exits are to the north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This area in the north-east quadrant of the plaza is done in a gothic, but
tasteful decore.  Unfortunately, the only color is black.  Exits lead north,
south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This square looks like it could be a garnet mine.  There is little flakes of the
red stone imbeded into the walls and floor.  A wall is directly to the east
here.  Exits lead north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There are small red pebbles lying all over the place.  They fit nicely, 
thorough, and cause no problems walking or running.  There is a wall to the
west.  Exits lead north, south, and east.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is a dingy, dank, and dark place.  It is kind of surprising to see here
in the ordinarily bright plaza.  Exits lead north, south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
The walls and floor here are painted with a very gleaming red paint.  Why would
anyone actually do that to a place?  Exits lead in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a black tarp rolled out over this part of the plaza.  Maybe there is
some tile work they are trying to save from wear.  Exits lead in the four
cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
In the south-east section of the plaza, this area is covered with a plush red
material.  Exits head north, east, south, or west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a mixture of black, gray, and gold tiles here to form an ornate
pattern.  Exits lead in the basic four directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a finely crafted mural made of small stones with colors ranging from 
white to pink to a deep red on the floor here.  Exits lead north, west, south,
and east.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is along the east wall.  The ground is made of a fine crushed black powder.
There is a iron gate to the east and exits lead to the north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Gateway
rooms.desc:
This is a small platform in the middle of a vast ethereal light that leads up to
a heavy iron gate to the west.  There is a big sign posted here.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
A thin black mist rolls on the ground in this little square.  The wall is just
west of here.  Exits lead north, east, and south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a high slab of red streaked stone used as the floor here.  Exits lead
in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
The floor here is a very rough, broken mess of stones.  They are all black in
color which makes you worry about twisting your ankle or something.  Exits lead
in the four basic directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
In the south-west section of the main plaza, this room's floor is of a simple
tile pattern with little red tiles.  Exits lead in the basic cardinal 
dirctions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a tightly formed mosaic on the floor here.  It has black, gray, and
gold tiles forming it.  There is an exit to the north, the south, the east, and
the west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This is the south-east section of the plaza.  The floor here is made of a neat
circle and triangle tiles fit together with a gray morter.  Exits are to the
north, south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This floor is made of large black tiles fit together fairly loosely.  Exits 
lead north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This square is situated in the south-east section of the plaza, along the east
wall.  The floor here is made up of a strange red rock that is sort of gleaming.
Exits lead to the north, west, and south.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
This square is along the west wall.  The floor is made of a red stone that
looks rounded.  It is used in a cobbled fashion.  Exits lead north, east, and
south.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is in the south west section of the main plaza.  The floor is a smooth,
checker pattern with black and dark gray patterns.  Exits lead north, east,
south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a fine red gravel on the ground here.  There are exits to the north,
south, east, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is in the south-west section of the plaza.  The ground is covered in a
thick, black water like substance.  It is rather gross.  Exits lead to the
north, east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a red surface here, though you don't know what it is.  It is not
really stone or wood, but it is safe to walk on.  There are exits in the four
basic directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is an ornate pattern made out of tiny tiles here, it must have taken
ages to construct.  There are exits in the four basic cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a basic red tile floor here in the south-east section of the main
plaza.  The exits are in the basic four directions.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
The east wall is just to your east here.  The floor is made up of a simple
triangle pattern with black tiles.  Exits head north, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This is the south-west corner of the plaza.  The floor here is a simple black 
tile one.  Exits lead north and east.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
A wall is just to your south.  This square is made up a rough, red stone that
really doesn't look well cut or placed.  There are exits to the north, east,
and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
This square is along the south wall.  There is a clean, black slate for the
floor here.  Exits head east, west, north.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
On the floor here is a complex pattern painted onto a white stone floor.  A
wall is just to your south.  Exits are east, north, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
Someone has created a swirl pattern with the small black tiles on the floor
here.  Exits head off to the north, the east, and the west.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There is a spongy red material on the floor here.  Exits are to the north,
east, and west.

rooms.name: A Black Square
rooms.desc:
There is a strange soft black material covering everything except for a small
path in the square.  Could that be velvet?  There are exits to the west, east,
and north.

rooms.name: A Red Square
rooms.desc:
There a huge piece of red stone being used as the floor here.  There are viens
of gold running thru it.  To the east and south are walls.  Exits are to the
north and west.

rooms.name: Map Room for hill to labyrinth and checkers
The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the southeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the southeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. A small hill rises up here to stop
at a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the southwest
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the southwest
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. To the east you see a small shack on
a tall hill.

rooms.name: In a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. A small hill rises up here to stop
at a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: Outside the Wizard's Retreat
rooms.desc:
A small shack, it's doorway with the actual door  long since destroyed by 
age, opens to the north.  In all other directions a grassy hilltop travels 
down.

rooms.name: In a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. A small hill rises up here to stop
at a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. To the west you see a small shack on
a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the northeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the northeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. A small hill rises up here to stop
at a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the northeast
you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: The Edge of a Grassy Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a grassy clearing. All is silent here. To the 
northwest you see a small shack on a tall hill.

rooms.name: In the Wizard's Shack
rooms.desc:
A small table and fireplace fill the north wall, and the door to the south is 
missing, leaving a hole to the outside world. On the west wall is a glowing red
portal, while a matching black one takes up the eastern wall. The table before
you is covered with board games and puzzle books, all in remarkably good shape.
A red, leatherbound book glows faintly where it lies, but resists all your 
efforts to pick it up.

rooms.name: The HITEC Lab
rooms.desc:
You are in a really cool lab, that your tax dollars paid for :)  This
place is so cool that it even has a police car with working lights in it.
This is the kinda place that all us computer geeks want to call home.

rooms.name: Orodreth's Quarters
rooms.desc:
This is the sleeping chamber of a meticulous mage.  There is nothing out of
place here.  It almost looks as though the person who uses this room, does not
actually need to sleep here.  There is a doorway to the east with a sign
hanging over it.

rooms.name: Orodreth's Library
rooms.desc:
All along the walls are huge floor-to-ceiling bookshelves full of books.  Some
are the newest releases from ORA and some are novels as old as time itself.
The knowledge that is contained on these shelves... it is amazing...
There are two exits on back into the main room which is to the west and a
small door on the north wall leads somewhere.

rooms.name: The Coding Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a large room by its dimesions, but not by the looks of it.  It
is cluttered with printouts, manuals, and snack wrappers.  There are two
large tables along the two of the walls and a large painting on the other.
You see a wonderful colection of hardware, which is all connected with a lag-
free internet link, must be nice.  The only door is to the south.

rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
Here is an entrance way to a very interesting zone.  There is a lot of
trickery involved in the location of rooms and exits.  Please let me know
if there are any bugs or glitches.  There is no map.  This zone consists of
about 190 rooms that are fairly loosely connected, so I don't even want to
try and show it.  The best way to find your way about this zone is to do it
just as a mortal would, walk around and explore.  You can go down to the 
beginning room.  There is a sign floating here.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
You are in some kind of strange portal.  You are standing, but when you
look though the portal, you appear to be staring at the sky, almost as though
you were lying down.  You have to go up to climb out of here, or you can go
south to return to the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
This is a weird feeling.  You are standing on level ground, but when you look
directly in front of you you appear to be looking directly at the ground 5 feet
below you.  This is nearly nauseating.  You have to drop down to get onto a
grassy field or you can return south to the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
You are standing a some kind of doorway peering into the relative darkness of
a tunnel.  There is a flurry of activity ahead of you.  There are two pairs
of glowing eyes staring about the tunnel, but they do not seem to notice
you at all.  The tunnel is just north of here, or you can return south to
the hallway.

rooms.name: Beginning Of A Hallway
rooms.desc:
A strange light flickers around you as you stand at this dead end of a hallway.
You know you have been here before... this is where that portal was, the one
that is not here any more.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Beginning Of A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a strange place.  To your east is a long, stone hallway.  It is lit 
but you have no idea how, there are no torches or glowing balls of light.
There is an eerie fell to this place, the hairs on you neck are standing on
end.

rooms.name: The Hallway
rooms.desc:
The stone hallway about you is perfect.  The corners are square and there is
no sign of any stone mortar.  The source of the light is still unknown.  The
hallway leads on the east or returns to the west.  There are two wooden
doors, one to your north and one to the south.   There is a small plaque
embedded in the floor here.

rooms.name: The Hallway
rooms.desc:
The perfect hallway continues.  There is still no sign of the source of
light.  There is another pair of wooden doors here, and another plaque is
embedded into the floor.

rooms.name: End Of The Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is then end of the perfectly constructed hallway.  There are two more
wooden doors, one to the north, the other to the south.  There is also a
much larger wooded door to the east, perhaps a closer look is in order.  The
hallway leads back to the west.  There is another plaque embedded here.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
This doorway opens onto a dusty road.  Ahead of you is a small abandoned
town.  You can go south onto the road or head back north to the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
You are faced with a line of trees as you look to the south.  There is enough 
room for you to walk out of the doorway, but little else.  The path you could
step onto leads east and west, and you are guessing there is something to the
north of you, once you get out of this unusual gateway.  You can head back
north into the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
As you enter the doorway you are looking at a large courtyard.  The ground is
covered in a white powder like stone.  A huge black tower casts its shadow
over the open area.  You can also go back into the hallway to the north.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is the north-west corner of a smallish battle field.  You are betting 
that a war has been fought here for a very long time.  You can go south or
east from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is some kind of mini-battle field where soldiers can practice their
skills or more likely actually wage a war.  You can go east, west or south
from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are along the northern edge of this battle field.  There are woods to your
north so your only options in places to go are east, west and south.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east corner of the battle-field.  There is some sort of
castle to your east.  There is some kind of entry door south-east of here.
You can go south or west.

rooms.name: A Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This kitchen has not been used for what looks like hundreds of years.  You
bet those beings that live here do not need food to survive.  You can leave
to the east.

rooms.name: A Dinning Room
rooms.desc:
There is a huge table in the middle of this room surrounded by what was once
plush chairs.  Everything has fallen into disrepair and ruin.  It looks as
though many a battle have been faught, won, and lost here.  You can head east,
west, or south from here.

rooms.name: A Storage Closet
rooms.desc:
This is another room falling to pieces.  The shelves that are now collapsed or
caving in were once filled with all sorts of expensive goods.  There is
nothing of value here anymore.  You can go west back to the dinning room.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of a large battle field.  It looks as though some kind of
battle has been going on for centuries.  The grass basically non-existent and
the bones of people long ago killed are partially buried.  There is some
clanging in the air.

rooms.name: Middle Of A Field
rooms.desc:
You seem to be in the middle of a war.  There are bone shards and armor bits
from long-dead soldiers.  But the ground looks as though it has been beaten
down recently.  There is a castle off to the east of here.  You can go north,
east, south, or west.

rooms.name: Middle Of A Field
rooms.desc:
This is some kind of mini-battle field where soldiers can practice their
skills or more likely actually wage a war.  There is a castle not to far
east of here.  You can go east, west, north or south from here.

rooms.name: At A Castle
rooms.desc:
You are at the far edge of a field at the entrance to a once grand, but now
run down castle.  You can go east into the castle or into the field to the
west, north, or south.

rooms.name: The Entrance Way
rooms.desc:
You can tell this castle used to be grand by just looking at this entrance.
There are remnants of large wall tapestries and plush carpeting all around
you.  This place has been scarred by time and abuse.  You can go east into
the main part of the castle or west, back onto the field.

rooms.name: The Main Chamber
rooms.desc:
This must have been the king's throne room.  There is an altar-like dias at
the eastern edge of the room with a door beyond it.  A pile of broken wood
sits atop that platform.  There are doors to the north and south, and you
can go back to the entrance in the west.

rooms.name: The Anti-Chamber
rooms.desc:
This is a relatively small chamber, given that it was used by a king.  It is
in complete ruin.  You are surprised that the roof is staying up.  The main
chamber is west of here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is the south-west corner of a mini-battle field.  It is well beaten down
from man years of constant battle.  You can go north or east from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are along the southern edge of a battle field.  This place looks like it
is hell for the soldiers who fight here, no cover, no backup, no nothing.
Whatever they are fighting for better be damn importaint.  You can go east,
west or north from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are closer to the eastern edge of the battle field.  There is some kind of
castle to the north east of you.  You can go east, west, or north.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This si the south-east corner of the battle field.  There is a castle just to
the north-east of you.  It is reachable by going to an enterance way north of
you.  You can also go west from here.

rooms.name: A Show Room
rooms.desc:
At one time a great collection of armor and weapons was displayed here.  All
that is left is collapsed display cases and rusted hunks of metal.  A hallway
is to the east.

rooms.name: A Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This room is in the same condition as the rest of the castle - delapidated.
To the west is some kind of display area and some kind of quarters are to
the east.  The main chamber is just north of here.

rooms.name: Some Sleeping Quarters
rooms.desc:
This place is a mess.  It was probably a mess before the room basically caved
in on itself.  There are a few wooden beds and dressers rotting away here.
It is hard to imagine anyone ever living here.  The hallway is to the west.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This is the corner of a grassy moor.  It is a very relaxing place.  The only
exit is to the east.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
The grass of this moor has a very soft, relaxing feeling to it.  You can go
east south, or west from here.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
