rooms.desc:
You stand on the southern coast of the wooded island that holds up Noirwood
forest. To the south and east lies a clear blue ocean, while to the north the
forest opens up into darkness.

rooms.name: Reception
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an elegant room dominated by a large, mahogany desk.
Behind the desk is a large key rack and several wooden mailboxes. In the
corner of the room is a large, steel safe which guests of the inn can use to
store their belongings. The only exit is down a staircase back to the pub.

rooms.name: Donation Room
rooms.desc:
This is a rather large, undecorated room inside the Basilika. There are two
benches made of heavy marble here where people occasionally sit while they
wait for objects to appear. The only exit is to the south, into the main
cathedral.

rooms.name: By the Altar
rooms.desc:
You are standing before a large, golden altar. The ever-lit candles that sit
upon the altar and hang from mounts near the high ceiling flicker and cause
the polished gold to take on an almost surreal appearance. There is a long,
wooden railing which separates the main floor of the cathedral from the area
behind the altar, which is considered too holy for unordained worshipers to go.
To the west, row after row of wooden pews face the altar and, far in the
distance, there is a large double door leading to the road.

rooms.name: Atop the Northwest Watch Tower
rooms.desc:
You are standing atop the northwest watch tower. There is a small pit here
which guards sometimes build fires in, on very cold evenings. From this
vantage point, you can see far across the ocean to the north and west, and
can barely make out the volcano to the south-east. The only exit is down a
ladder.

rooms.name: Atop the Northeast Watch Tower
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the northeastern watch tower. A small fire pit has been cut
into the hard stone here so that the guards on duty could stay warm on cold
winter nights. At this height you are sure staying warm is difficult, for the
wind whistles by all around with a fury. As you glance out of the tower,
looking over the town below and commanding an excellent view of the jungle,
you begin to think of the valiant defenders manning this station when the
legions of the Dark One had surrounded Alaozar. The only exit from here is
down a long, wooden ladder.

rooms.name: Atop the Southwest Watch Tower
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the very top of the high, southwestern watch tower. This
is a small room made of black stone. There are openings in the walls at about
chest level through which the guards on duty can watch the jungle and beyond
for any signs of an advancing fleet. Someone has chiseled a fire pit into the
stone floor and you see evidence of small fires having been lit recently. You
suspect that it becomes very cold up at this height on cold or windy nights.
The only exit is down a long wooden ladder back to the road far below.

rooms.name: Atop the Southeast Watch Tower
rooms.desc:
It appears that this watch tower was once a prison, for, unlike the others
around town, it has bars across the windows. A fire pit has been cut into the
stone floor so that guards on duty can build small fires to remain warm. Arrow
slits have also been chiseled into the walls so that defenders of Alaozar can
rain deadly arrows upon their foes from above. The only exit is back down a
long, wooden ladder.

rooms.name: The Upstairs Coffee House
rooms.desc:
You are in a charming little cafe. There is a small bar covered with some kind
of coppery metal near one wall and several tables half-hazardly arranged
around the room. You look into the kitchen area and see coffee and tea
brewing. One the walls here are all kinds of strange pictures. From some
unknown source, jazzy music fills the air. The only exit is down.

rooms.name: Guard Quarters
rooms.desc:
You are standing in what appears to be a military barracks. Triple bunk beds
have been neatly arranged around this large room and there are several locked
chests at the foot of the beds. The walls are Spartan and undecorated and the
bunks are made so well that you suspect you could bounce a gold coin off one.
The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Northern Gate
rooms.desc:
You stand beneath the immense northern gate of Alaozar, the Holy City. The 
gate really consists of two gates; one to the north of your position and yet
another to the south. High above, you see a large, iron grate through which 
the defenders of the city can pour scalding oil down upon their foes. To the
west what appears to be a large barracks while to the east is a small sentry
post. The docks open up to the north while Main Street leads south, through
town proper.

rooms.name: Sentry Post
rooms.desc:
From this small room, town guards can watch the comings and goings at
the northern gate.  A small, wooden table rests on one side of the room
surrounded by wooden chairs while on the opposite side of the chamber, 
a weapons locker leans against the wall, awaiting use.
   The only exit is to the west.

rooms.name: Northwestern Corner
rooms.desc:
This is the northwestern corner of town, where Perimeter Road turns sharply,
continuing to the south and to the east. Your progress to the north and west is
blocked by the towering city walls however there appears to be a long, wooden
ladder leading up into some sort of structure high above. You may go south,
east or up.

rooms.name: North Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a wide, cobblestone roadway which runs parallel to
the northern walls of the Alaozar.  These tall walls block your passage to
the north, however this street continues both east and west.  There is also
a small building to the south with a picture of a book upon the wooden sign
above the doorway.

rooms.name: North Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are on Perimeter Road; the thick town wall blocks your way to the north
and a small building has been erected to the south.  Upon the sign that hangs
above the doorway of the building south of here is a picture of a bubbling
flask and a bottle of ale.  This roadway leads both east, towards Main Street
and the Northern Gate, and west.

rooms.name: Intersection of Main Street and North Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
This is the northern end of Main Street, the main road in Alaozar. To the north
there is a thick, iron gate and a tunnel leading under the walls. Perimeter
Road runs alongside the thick town walls to the east and west while Main Street
itself leads through the heart of town south of this point.

rooms.name: North Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
This is a broad street that runs parallel to the town walls.  You are on the
northern side of Alaozar and the city walls block your passage to the north.
Perimeter Road leads east-west while a small, stone building with a picture
of a scroll and a magic wand upon the sign can be entered to the south.

rooms.name: North Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
Perimeter Road is a paved, wide roadway that runs along the inside of the
city walls.  You are on the northern edge of town and the city walls block
your passage to the north.  There is a mid-sized building to the south of
here bearing the picture of a great dragon and a mug of ale upon the sign.
Perimeter Road continues both east and west.

rooms.name: Northeastern Corner
rooms.desc:
You have reached a turning-point in Perimeter Road; this is the northeastern
corner of Alaozar.  The roadway runs west and south from here as it follows
the high city walls.  You also notice a ladder bolted into the walls here.

rooms.name: Twice Sold Tales Bookstore
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a musty little bookstore that, despite its ratty
appearance and dusty air is quite charming.  The room is packed with dusty
wooden shelves crammed full of books.  You glance around at the selection
and are delighted to find everything from tomes of ancient lore to old volumes
of Elven romance poetry scribed overseas.  You do not doubt that the
proprietor of this establishment has some valuable ancient manuscripts tucked
away somewhere in this mess.  Nor do you doubt that you could come across a
real gem buried in these shelves -- maybe even a magical spellbook.  There is
a sign on the northern wall right next to the door.

rooms.name: Alchemist's Shop
rooms.desc:
This is a cross between a shop and a workplace.  One half of the small
building is devoted to merchandising space and is dominated by bottles and
potions filled with strange liquids all neatly labeled and organized. The other
half of the room is a work area with a large counter covered with bubbling
flasks, strange reference charts, and smoking potions. A sign has been mounted
next to the door on the northern wall.

rooms.name: Magic Shop
rooms.desc:
This is a large shop which specializes in magical items. A small bookshelf is
covered with different types of spellbooks while yet another is filled with
various types of scrolls. Common spell components can be found here as can
magical items like wands and staves. A sign has been mounted on the wall next
to the only exit, a door in the north wall.

rooms.name: The Green Wyrm Tavern
rooms.desc:
This is a bright, clean, cheerful little pub.  A long bar made of polished
wood dominates the room but there are also a few wooden tables about the
establishment.  The hardwood floor is swept and clean mugs hang from hooks
above the bar.  On the walls of the establishment are paintings of dragons,
both modern and ancient.  Two dart boards have been hung on the southern
wall and on the northern wall, next to the door, there is a sign.  A big,
old staircase also leads upwards.

rooms.name: West Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are on Perimeter Road on the western side of Alaozar next to the
towering walls that safeguard the Holy City.  This road continues both
north and south; your way is blocked to the west by the walls but to the
east there is a large dump.

rooms.name: The Town Dump
rooms.desc:
This is a lot set aside to be used as a landfill.  People come here to bring
items they no longer want and does it smell...!  I wouldn't stay here too
long lest you get ill; the only exit is to the west.

rooms.name: General Store
rooms.desc:
You are in a general store; neatly stacked provisions fill this medium sized
establishment, everything from sacks of grain to lights and packs.  All that
a traveler would need to make a long journey is here.  A sign has been
mounted on the wall near the door to the east.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on Main Street, the primary roadway through town.  Just north
of here you see a busy intersection where Main crosses Perimeter Road just
south of the Northern Gate.  Main Street continues to the south and on the
east and west sides of the street are various shops.  You can continue in any
direction.

rooms.name: Junk Shop
rooms.desc:
This place is cluttered and filled with everything and anything imaginable.
Shelves are crammed with trinkets and treasures.  It looks like the owner
of this place will buy almost anything!  You also suspect that you could
find almost anything in this mess, it would just take a while.  A sign is
mounted on the wall to one side of the door leading west, to Main Street.

rooms.name: Bakery
rooms.desc:
This is a little bakery. A large oven is cooking something that smells like
heaven and, in neat little rows, the baker has arranged her wares for you to
see. A sign has been mounted on the door. The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: East Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on a smooth, wide roadway that runs inside the eastern wall of
Alaozar.  There is a large grate wrought in black iron bolted to the ground
here and far below you hear the constant roar of water through the sewer
system.  There is what looks (and smells) like a bakery to the west and the
avenue itself runs north and south.  Your passage to the east is blocked by
the tall, strong wall.

rooms.name: West Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
This area of town is noticeably different than the rest of Alaozar. Locals call
this area the Old City -- a group of old buildings that survived the brutal
invasion of the Dark One's legions. The homes along this roadway are examples
of the early Lamonto style architecture. The roadway is composed of cobblestone
and mortar and continues both north and south.

rooms.name: The Weapon Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a large weaponshop run by the local weaponsmith. Around
the room there are locked cases filled with various weapons, both new and used.
A large sign has been mounted on the doorway leading east.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on Main Street, the main thoroughfare running through the
center of Alaozar. To the south you see the golden gates of the Ardyn Park and
the lovely fountains and wondrous trees beyond. Far north of here you see the
towering north gate of town. To the west is a large weapon shop and to the east
is what appears to be an armorer's shop. You may continue in any cardinal
direction.

rooms.name: The Armor Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a large shop filled with all sizes and makes of armour.
Everything from fine mithril coats imported, at great cost, from the elven
kingdoms across the sea, to crude, cheap, leather coats can be found in this
establishment.  There is a large sign by the door on the western wall.

rooms.name: The Tailor's Shop
rooms.desc:
This is a large room with various racks of clothing hanging on the walls and
thick rugs on the stone floor. Along one wall is a shelf with several bolts
of multi-colored cloth. A partially open door behind the counter reveals the
tailor's workplace.

rooms.name: An Unlit Shop
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a small shop that seems almost artificially
darkened, the blackness is so complete.  This shop seems to be actually
more of a laboratory, with the standard flasks and decanters, as well
as some other arcane-looking equipment you do not recognize.  
   A small black sign lies nailed on the back wall.
   The only exit is east, back into Ardyn Park.

rooms.name: The Pet Shop
rooms.desc:
This is a surpisingly clean shop filled with many different animals, all for
sale. A large sign hangs on the eastern wall, right next to the door.

rooms.name: Pet shop storage
rooms.desc: Pet store secret room -- where all your pets come from!

rooms.name: West Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a historic section of West Perimeter Road for it was here
that some of the heaviest fighting in the Great War took place between the
defenders of the Holy City and the legions of the Dark One. The cobblestones
still bear the scars of the powerful magicks that were unleashed here decades
ago and, if you look closely, you can make out the nicks and cuts made by iron
weapons and steel-tipped arrows. Perimeter Road leads both north and south. To
the east is an old walking cane shop.

rooms.name: Walking Cane Shop
rooms.desc:
This is a medium sized room devoted entirely to walking canes and wands. They
line the walls and crystal display cases of this store. Some staves are covered
with minute, fine carvings while others are wrought in strange metals. While
you are sure some are ordinary, you recognize a few as being powerful magic
talismans created by ancient wizards long dead. The only exit is back to the
west.

rooms.name: Mages' Guild
rooms.desc:
This is a rather large building which looks almost like a strange gymnasium.
There are magical symbols etched into the stone floor to protect the building
and inexperienced casters from dangerous magic gone awry.  The Guildmaster,
one of the last ancient wizards of the Old Age, has a fine mahogany desk
in the corner of the practice area.  There is a large slate mounted on one
wall, covered with arcane runes and magical formulae.  The only exit is back
to the south.

rooms.name: Thieves' Guild
rooms.desc:
This is a small, darkened room with a onyx desk near the door and practice
dummies positioned here and there.  Anatomical charts of the throat and back
are stained with dried blood and in a small bucket on the floor are trinkets
and pouches with which the students practice pick-pocketing and stealing.
You glance around the room, carefully, and think you see shapes carefully
hidden in the deep shadows.  The only exit is to the south, onto Guild Street.

rooms.name: Northern End of Ardyn Park
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the northern end of a large park in the center
of town.  Tall trees with leaves of silver and gold tower above you while
a small brook bubbles incessantly on its course through the park.  There
are benches and tables arranged about the park and a large statue of Ardyn
wrought in bronze dominates the scene.  The park continues to the south
and Main Street leads off to the north through wrought golden gates.
An old iron grate has been set into the ground here.

rooms.name: Market Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a narrow cobblestone street.  To the west of here you have
a clear view of Ardyn Park while this little street continues to the east. To
the north is a small building which houses the Tailor's Shop and to the south
is the city's cobbler.

rooms.name: Market Street
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a narrower east-west avenue.  To the east of here,
this street intersects with Perimeter Road next to the high town walls. Far
to the west, you can barely see the green trees and marble fountains of Ardyn
Park. To the north lies a well-lit tattoo parlor.

rooms.name: East Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a wider, cobblestone road which runs along the inside of
the high town walls. Perimeter Road leads to the north and south. Your way to
the east is blocked by the wall.

rooms.name: West Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a large, clean roadway which runs next to the town walls.
This cobblestone avenue continues to the north and south; to the east, a
narrower roadway called Guild Street leads into the center of town.

rooms.name: Guild Street
rooms.desc:
This is a narrower roadway than the other streets of Alaozar. North of here is
a large building that houses the Mages' Guild while to the south lies the
Clerics' Guild. Guild Street dead-ends into Perimeter Road just west of here
while it continues into Ardyn Park far to the east. You may go in any
direction.

rooms.name: Guild Street
rooms.desc:
You are on a narrow street that runs from Ardyn Park to the walls.  North of
here is the Thieves' Guild and to the south is the Warriors' Guild.  Just
east of here is Ardyn Park.

rooms.name: Southern End of the Ardyn Park.
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a large, beautiful park.  Large trees with leaves of
silver tower high above you and several benches and tables have been spread
around the area.  A large bronze statue stands here, pointing northward.  Just
south of here, through golden gates, Main Street continues towards the southern
edge of town.  To the north, the immense park continues and to the west a
narrow roadway called Guild Street West leads into the distance.

rooms.name: Rackhir's Shoe Store
rooms.desc:
As you enter this building you are bombarded by the unmistakable odor of 
freshly-made shoes. When you look around you can see why, the walls are lined
with all sorts of shoes, boots, sandals and other footwear you can't even
recognize.

rooms.name: Willow Court
rooms.desc:
This is a typical middle-class neighborhood, quaint little white fences have
been erected to divide the mid-sized lots from each other.  The homes built
upon this court are nice and clean if a bit small.  Perimeter Road is to the
east.

rooms.name: East Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a broad road that runs alongside the town wall.  There
is a pleasant little court to the west but passage to the east is blocked
by the immense walls of town.  Perimeter Road runs north and south.

rooms.name: West Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
This is West Perimeter Road, an old cobblestone way that has run beside the
walls of this town for centuries.  The immense, newly-improved walls block
your way to the west and a large building prevents you from moving to the
east, but this road continues both north and south from this point.

rooms.name: Clerics' Guild
rooms.desc:
This is a large, holy place where clerics come to meditate and commune with
their deities.  Holy symbols hang prominently on the walls here and several
tomes of scripture, commentary and inspirational writing are housed on a
large bookshelf on one wall.  Long white candles burn around the room but
never seem to get shorter.  The only exit is back to the north, onto Guild
Street.

rooms.name: Warriors' Guild
rooms.desc:
This building is a large arena; training weapons of all size and shape have
been carefully arranged in large cases here and mats have been positioned on
the floor to make mock combat more safe. Weights and conditioning aids are
over in one corner of the large area while in another are diagrams of anatomy,
charts showing different weapons, and skematics teaching positioning and
proficiency during battle. The door back to Guild Street is to the north.

rooms.name: First Bank of Alaozar
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a well-appointed, opulent bank. A plush red carpeting
covers the floor and a long, beautifully stained wooden counter dominates the
room. Several potted plants have been scattered about the room and a large,
crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling high above, its candles burning
brightly. You notice a sign on the counter near the doorway leading east, back
to main street.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You are standing on Main Street, just south of Ardyn Park. To the west you see
the small but elegant building that houses the bank. East of here the huge
Temple of Djin looms above you. Main Street itself continues to the south.

rooms.name: Inside the Temple of Djin
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the world-famous Temple of Djin. Before you, to the east,
are rows and rows of wooden pews all facing the high altar. To the west,
through huge wooden doors, is Main Street.

rooms.name: East Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
This is a new section of Perimeter Road.  The roadway is not cobblestone like
the rest of town but rather is paved with smooth red bricks.  The massive city
wall blocks your way to the east while a large building makes travel to the
west impossible.  You may go north or south, along Perimeter Road.

rooms.name: West Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on Perimeter Road, a cobblestone way that runs inside the
city walls.  To the west, the high, strong wall blocks your way and to the
east you see the Sleeping Giant Inn.  Perimeter Road itself continues to
the north and south.

rooms.name: Slumbering Giant Inn
rooms.desc:
You are in the Slumbering Giant Inn, a place where you can get good food,
strong spirits, and a comfortable bed for the night.  This is a dining area
with a bar and several tables.  A staircase in the back of the room leads up
to a lobby area where you can rent a room for the night.  A door to the
west leads back onto the street.

rooms.name: Alaozarian Central Post Office
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside the post office. Upon the wall are many posters of
criminals and traitors against the state. Behind the counter there is a steel
box full of stamps which you can buy. Near the counter is a large sign. The
only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
This is Main Street, the main road through town.  Just west of here is a small
Post Office while to the east is a strange, stone building that houses the
portals where you can travel to distant places magically.  Main Street runs
north-south.

rooms.name: The Portals
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the portal room of Alaozar, a place where travelers can
magically travel across the lands quickly and safely. The stone walls of
this building have strange runes of power burned into them and, upon the
ceiling, is a large circle with magical writing within it. To the west lies
Main Street.

rooms.name: Gryshk Court
rooms.desc:
This is a dirty, smelly court with little hovels and shacks built on it.  Rats
scamper across the street and frolic in the mounds of trash that have built
up here over the years.  Perimeter Road is to the east.

rooms.name: East Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on East Perimeter Road, just west of the city wall.
The road itself leads north and south while a dirty little court runs
to the west.

rooms.name: Blacksmith's Workshop
rooms.desc:
This is the shop of a skilled blacksmith.  A large furnace burns hotter
than dragon fire and makes the whole room very warm.  Over in one corner is
an anvil and next to it a large iron bucket of water.  A huge hammer
hangs on one wall.  You can leave back through the door to the south.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the world-famous Library of Alaozar, a beacon of learning
and knowledge in these dark times. There are hundreds of books in this room,
all neatly arranged upon strong wooden shelves. A large desk sits near the
front of the room with a sign that reads "QUIET!" upon it. The exit is to the
south.

rooms.name: King's Court
rooms.desc:
You are standing on King's Court, the social place to be in Alaozar.  The
houses here are set well off the street and are protected by large gates
and hired security personnel.  The street itself is nicely-paved, and is
very smooth and easy to tread upon.  You have often heard stories of the
vast riches of people who live on this street and wonder what a thief would
do to be able to sneak past the elaborate defenses of these mansions.  South
Perimeter Road is south of here.

rooms.name: Sleepy Hollow Court
rooms.desc:
This is a well-paved little court on which people have built some rather
large, beautiful mansions.  While you could enter the homes from this point,
you rather suspect that the town guards would be summoned to take you away
rather quickly; rich folk like these do not take lightly to trespassers.
Perimeter Road is to the south.

rooms.name: Southwest Corner
rooms.desc:
This is the southwest corner of town.  Perimeter Road bends here, leading to
the north and east.  You look closely at the huge town walls and notice a
iron ladder leading up to some kind of tower far above.

rooms.name: South Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
This is Perimeter Road, a cobblestone avenue that runs parallel to the town
walls around the entire city. You can continue to the east or west on
Perimeter Road; a small workshop lies to the north.

rooms.name: South Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are on South Perimeter Road, just north of the huge town wall at the
southern edge of the city.  The road itself leads east-west while to the
north is the entrance to the library.

rooms.name: Intersection of Main Street and South Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the intersection of two major streets. You may
continue in any cardinal direction as Perimeter Road leads east-west
along the town walls. Main Street leads north-south, running through
the center of town.  The massive southern gate is just south of this
point.

rooms.name: South Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are on Perimeter Road, just east of Main Street.  An exclusive court is
just north of here while to the west Perimeter Road intersects with Main
Street.  Perimeter Road also runs to the east towards the corner of town.

rooms.name: South Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
This is South Perimeter Road, a little roadway that runs along the inside of
the southern wall of town.  Just north of here is a very nice little court.
Perimeter Road continues east and west but passage to the south is made
impossible by the huge walls of town.

rooms.name: Southeastern Corner
rooms.desc:
This is the southeast corner of town where Perimeter Road turns sharply,
following the city walls.  You may follow the road north or west and may
also climb an old iron ladder up to a tower high above you.

rooms.name: Alazoarian Customs House
rooms.desc:
You stand in the small, tidy Alazoarian customs house.  There seems 
to be an inordinate amount of papers, stamps and seals all around you --
evidence of the massive bureaucracy inherent in a city this size.  There
are several harried customs workers here whose job it is to process these
forms, which range from city visitors permits to vendor licences, to
cargo inspection reports and applications for citizenship.  The city
gate south is just to your east.

rooms.name: Beneath the Southern Gate
rooms.desc:
You are standing beneath the massive southern gate of Alaozar.  Main Street
leads northward, through town and to the south is the wild world.  West of
here is a sentry post and to the east are the guard quarters.

rooms.name: Sentry Post
rooms.desc:
This is the sentry room just off the southern gate.  Here guards can sit and
watch the comings and goings at the gate just west of this point.  In addition,
a large table surrounded by chairs is, currently, covered with playing cards.
You know that that table also doubles as an interrogation table when a
suspicious or unsavory type attempts to enter the city limits.  Books on a
shelf here record the possessions and wares of merchants who come to sell in
the markets of town so that they cannot cheat state when filing taxes.  The
only exit is to the west.

rooms.name: A Tattoo Parlor
rooms.desc:
This well-lit shop is one of the better parlors that you've seen. The 
proprietor seems to have good artistic sense, as shown by the small 
renderings of his art lining the walls.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road Marker
rooms.desc:
You are standing just north of a long bridge that spans a clear,
frothy river.  An arrowheaded signpost points north, directing you
toward 'Alaozar' as it appears on the sign.
   The forest grows thick to the east and west, preventing you from
conveniently travelling there.

rooms.name: A Long, Wide Road
rooms.desc:
This road leads north and south and is wide enough to fit two wagons
side by side. To the east and west are impenetrable forest, and far ahead
you can see what looks like the gates to a town. 
   The forest road continues to the south.

rooms.name: Outside the City Gates
rooms.desc:
Just north of you lie the massive southern gates of Alaozar. The spires of
the city are visible even over the city wall, which rises many feet over your
head.
   To the south, a road leads through the forest.

rooms.name: On the Dock
rooms.desc:
You stand on a small wooden dock; to the north lies only water. To the south
is the city gate.

rooms.name: Ares' Office
rooms.desc:
You are in a large, opulently appointed office with a big oaken desk and
a comfortable-looking leather chair.  On a table next to the wall you see
dozens of computers, motherboards, cases, hard drives, power supplies,
expansion cards, and cables.

rooms.name: Fury's Office
rooms.desc: You are standing inside a dummy room, which should get real.

rooms.name: Raven's Office
rooms.desc:
This is Raven's office, a large, spacious room with a hardwood floor and a
huge mahogany desk in the center.  The north and west walls are made entirely
of fine, transparent crystal and the view they offer is spectacular.  You can
almost see the entire world from this room.  The eastern wall is completely
covered with thousands of books on a large bookcase.  A plush elven run par-
tially covers the floor and upon the desk are papers describing the laws of
the universe -- there are editing marks and notes in the margins.  A door
hangs on the southern wall and offers the only exit from this room.

rooms.name: Perimeter Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on Perimeter Road next to the town wall.  To the west there
is a pet shop.  Perimeter Road continues both north and south.

rooms.name: A Corner in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
You are standing knee-high in filthy water deep within the sewer
system underneath the streets of Alaozar.  Everything from half-eaten
food to rotting corpses of dead animals float in this nasty water.  You
can continue to the south or east from this point.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This section of the sewers looks a bit older than the majority of the
tunnels you have seen.  Looking carefully at the walls you note that
there seem to be sealed tombs along them and deduce that this area used
to be a catacomb.  Dead rats and waste float past you in the water and
the stench is so bad here you nearly vmoit.  You can continue to the
east or west.

rooms.name: In the Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The filthy water has grown more shallow here, thankfully, and you can
nearly see the brick floor as you walk through the filth.  Every so
often a gush of dirty water rushes out of little openings in the ceiling
and makes you scurry to get out of the way.  The northern wall here is
made of thick grey stone, instead of simple brick and mortar.  You can
go east or west.

rooms.name: In the Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The water here is only an inch deep or so and it leaks through all
of the walls except the northern one which is made of re-enforced
grey stone and mortar.  On the southern wall you see what appear to
be well-sealed tombs and surmise that this area of the sewers may
have once been used as a catacomb.  You may proceed to the west or
east.

rooms.name: An Intersection in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
You have reached a kind of junction of sewer pipes.  One very small
pipe at ground level leads to the south and seems to connect this
pipe with another.  This pipe continues both east and west.

rooms.name: A Dry Room
rooms.desc:
Amazing, the ground here is totally dry and the filthy waters of the
sewer no longer surround and eat at your feet.  While the stench here
is not so bad as to the west, it is still pretty smelly.  This place
seems to be a dead-end room of some kind.  You do not know who would
ever build a room under a city in a maze of sewers, though!  Someone
has even bothered to hang a large, mud-caked area rug on the eastern
wall.  The only apparent exit is to the west.

rooms.name: In the Secret Passageway
rooms.desc:
Here, in a passageway with stone floors and a more raised dome than
most sewer pipes, the odor of decay and filth is not strong at all.
Through a mud-caked area rug to the west you can hear rushing water and
assume that the sewer system runs in that direction.  This passageway
leads off to the south into the darkness.  The only obvious exit
is to the south.

rooms.name: In a Large Sewer Pipe
rooms.desc:
You are standing in knee-high water inside a large sewer pipe under the
city of Alaozar.  Filthy gushes of water and waste rush down from small
openings in the ceiling of this pipe and cascade into the water in which
you stand.  The western wall, unlike the others, is made of huge grey
stones, iron spikes, and mortar.  A little brick passageway leads to the
north and seems to join this pipe with a smaller one.  This tunnel itself
continues to the east.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
From this point, a rather large sewer pipe leads both east and west while
yet another smaller pipe runs off to the south into the distance.  The
water here is pretty dirty; full of trash, dirt, and waste.  Needless to
say, the smell is very unpleasant, too.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are wading through waist-high water carefully trying to avoid the many
floating collections of filth which share your bath.  There seems to be a
current here -- it is pushing you to the west.  This pipe leads both to the
east and west.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
Here, a small pipe intersects with a larger one and you are offered the
opportunity to go west, east, or south.  A current in the water is
pushing the filth inexorably.  The large pipe in which you stand runs east
and west while another pipe with a smaller diameter runs off to the south
seemingly connecting this tunnel to another.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
The current here has really picked up;  the water around you is being
pushed steadily to the west.  You find a dry ledge running parallel to
the flow along the wall and are, thankfully, able to stand on it rather
than in the filth.  A little tunnel leads north from here, seemingly
connecting this tunnel to another.  The pipe in which you stand leads
to the west and east.

rooms.name: At a Corner in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
Thankfully you are able to scoot along a thin lip on the wall here rather
than wade through the cold, filthy water.  And it's a good thing too, because
there seems to be a strong current swiftly moving the trash and waste along.
This pipe bends sharply here, causing a small whirlpool.  You can
continue to the south or move with the current to the west.

rooms.name: In a Dry Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel is made of strong grey rock and you suspect you are moving
through or near the city walls.  You notice a thick layer of dust on
the ground and wonder how long it has been since anyone has come this
way.  There is also a faint draft coming from the south.  You can go
north or south.

rooms.name: At a Dead-End in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
You have come to a dead-end with the only exit being to the east, against
the current.  The water here swirls and turns as more rushes and you are
forced to cling to one of the moldy walls to keep your balance.  You also
notice that the western wall is not like the others here -- it is made of
huge grey stones instead of old bricks.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
You have reached a four-way intersection; here, a smaller pipe leads to
the north and south while one with a larger diameter runs both east and
west.  Most of the water flows in from the north and east and rushes off
to the south.  There is a little whirlpool here and you notice water is
both leaving and returning from the west...  You can proceed in any dir-
ection.

rooms.name: At a Turn in the Sewer Pipe
rooms.desc:
The pipe you are in bends here leading west and south.  The floor of the
tunnel is very uneven and seems to almost slope against the current which
flows in from the south and runs off to the west.  As the water moves, it
rushes over the uneven floor making rapids.  You can go west or south.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
This sewer pipe is full of fast-moving water which enters from the east
and flows off to the south.  You also hear what sounds like an angry
river from the south.  A smaller pipe leads north connecting this tunnel
to yet another.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a ledge just above the raging waters which rush
through this pipe from east to west.  A plaque is set in the wall
here right next to where you crouch.  You may continue either west
or east.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
This is a very large pipe which seems to lead north and south.  You are
lucky to be up on the lip of the tunnel because huge amounts of water
run in from the south.  More than half of the current rushes down a
large tunnel to the west.  Some of the flow also runs to the north.
You may go north, west or south.

rooms.name: In a Dry Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You must be either directly under the wall or right next to it because
the stones all around you look exactly like the ones used to make the
town walls.  You notice that there are some very old chairs here and
what look to be several empty weapon cases.  While this tunnel only leads
to the north, there is a slight draft coming from the eastern wall!

rooms.name: At a Bend in the Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The pipe in which you stand turns sharply here; water comes in from the
east, swirls around in a little whirlpool, and flows out to the south.
You are standing on a small ledge apparently built for sewer workers to
avoid getting their feet wet.  South of here the tunnel seems to open
into a very large tunnel.

rooms.name: At a Bend in the Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This section of the pipe seems to have been engineered and built to
slow down the current.  Its floor is very uneven and the water is
forced to flow around or over many obsticles made of brick.  You
also note that the grade of the ground is not even -- the water is
forced to rush uphill to the west and it able to only because of
it's momentum.  You may continue to the west or north.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are at a turn in this sewer pipe -- water that roars in from the
east spins for a while in a little whirlpool and then tears away to 
the north.  You are on a small ledge made of bricks and attached to
one wall praying that it does not give way and send you plummeting
into the filthy waters just below.  You can go north or east.

rooms.name: Under the Grate
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a sewer tunnel on a little ledge as dirty water
rushes past below you.  Far, far above you see a grate and, looking
carefully, espy a ladder that you might use to reach it.  This
sewer tunnel leads both west and north.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns here and the clean water flows in from the south and
rushes away to the east.  Through an opening in the south wall you see
the massive Chartuse River tunnel and hear the roar of the entire river
as it gushes under town.  You can go south or east.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
Here the sewer tunnel in which you stand is joined by another leading to 
the north.  Clean water flows in from the west and rushes off to the
north.  You can also go east.

rooms.name: At a Dead-End in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
You have reached a dead-end... the only exit is to the west.  The water
here is about waist-deep and swirls around you and more water rushes in
from the west.

rooms.name: Room #21328
rooms.desc: This description is yet unfinished...

rooms.name: Behind the Grate
rooms.desc:
Wow... the current that pushes against you from the east is almost
unbelievable!  Although this massive tunnel leads east, you cannot
defeat the current to move that direction.  A large grate blocks your
way to the west and through it you see the outside world.  All around
you the waters of the Chartuse River roar as rush past, pin you to the
grate, and flow off to the west.  There is a medium-sized tunnel to
the north from which a stream of filth-ridden water joins the rest
of the river; you could probibly fight the strong current to reach
it.

rooms.name: In the Chartuse River Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are being swept along by the Chartuse River as it gushes through a
massive tunnel deep below Alaozar!  It is all you can do to maintain a
grip on the wall and prevent yourself from being swept away by the strong
current.  As you begin to lose you grip, you notice a passageway to the
south which emits a steady flow of filty water into the river.  Even-
though there is no possible way for you to fight the river and move
along this tunnel to the east, you do suspect you could reach the
tunnel in the southern wall.  You can also move with the current to
the west.

rooms.name: In the Chartuse River Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This massive tunnel is half-filled by the entire Chartuse River!  The
current here is almost indescribable... tons of water rush past you as
you desperatly cling to the moldy wall to prevent yourself from being
swept away.  There is very little you can do in this tunnel -- the
current is far too strong to fight and you cannot move to the east.
The only thing to do, it would seem, is move with the current to the
west.

rooms.name: In the Chartuse River Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This huge tunnel houses the entire Chartuse River!  The current here is
unbelievable and it is all you can do just to cling to a wall to prevent
youself from being swept away by the flood.  While the tunnel leads both
east and west, there is no way to fight the flow of this river by moving
to the east.  It would seem that the only thing to do is move with the
current to the west.

rooms.name: In the Chartuse River Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The current here is so strong that you cannot fight it and move to the
east.  While you cling to the moldy wall here, about to lose your grip,
thinking your only option is to carefully move with the water to the
west, you notice a tunnel carved into the northern wall into which some
of the water branches.  Perhaps you could reach it and go north...?

rooms.name: In the Chartuse River Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This massive subterranean tunnel houses the entire Chartuse River!  The
current is unimaginable and you are clinging to the slimey wall just to
keep yourself from being swept away by the tons of water rushing past
you.  Unfortunately, the river is far too strong to move against to the
east.  As you glance around, you see a tunnel leading south into which
a steady stream of water flows.  If you could just reach it without
losing your grip...

rooms.name: Behind the Grate
rooms.desc:
Maybe coming here was a mistake... the river seems to pick up speed
as it is forced into this large tunnel and the current here is amazing.
It is all you can do to hold on to the moldy wall and avoid being swept
away by the water.  Although you can see out a grate in the eastern wall,
there is just no way to move against the current and reach it.  As you
study your situation you realize that the only thing to do is move with
the current to the west and hope for the best.

rooms.name: Room #21336
rooms.desc: This description is yet unfinished...

rooms.name: At a Bend in the Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a filthy sewer tunnel; the water here is full of
dirt, grime, waste, and gunk that has dripped down through drainage
vents in town and collected in these waters.  The current moves to the
east.  You may go east or south.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
You are standing where one large pipe joins with another.  North of here,
through a little tunnel, you hear the roar of water.  A filthy flow of
waste water rushes in from the west and gushes through the passage to
the north.  A ledge on the eastern wall seems to lead off to some dryer
tunnels.  You may go north, west or east.

rooms.name: In a Dry Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel was probibly not constructed as part of the sewers but rather,
you suspect, is older than the sewers and was perhaps used once as a cat-
acomb.  The ground and walls are not made of brick like the sewer system
but are, instead, made of stone and clay.  Judging from the amount of
dust here, no one has been this way in a while.  To the west, over a small
ledge, you see the sewer system.  East of here, this tunnel joins more
like it.

rooms.name: In a Dry Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a tunnel which is older than the sewer system of Alaozar.  This
place seems to have once been used as a burial ground judging from the seal-
ed tombs in the clay and stone walls.  As you look around carefully, you
notice some carving on one of the walls here.  This dry tunnel leads to
the west and east.

rooms.name: In a Strange Chamber
rooms.desc:
This place seems to be a big burial vault -- or at least at one time it
must have been.  There are tombs sealed in the walls and writing here
and there.  Now it would seem someone is living here!  There is a big,
old sofa next to one of the tombs and a little wooden table sitting in
the center of the room.  Passages lead off to the west and south.

rooms.name: At a bend in the Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing at a bend in the sewer tunnel perched atop a little lip
on one of the walls and thankful that you do not have to wade in this
water.  Every now and again streams of filth and dirt gush from tiny
holes in the ceiling and are embraced by the water flowing beneath you.
Current comes in from the east and rushes off to the south.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
The noise of rushing water to the north is almost deafening and the amount
of water that gushes in from the tunnel leading north is amazing.  This
pipe leads off to the west and the water follows it.  Over a tall dam,
a passageway also leads to the east.  Of course, you can also try to
fight the water current and move to the north.

rooms.name: In a Dry Room
rooms.desc:
This seems to be a single dry room.  Some iron pipes run along the walls
and up through the stone ceiling.  Wow, do people in the city above really
have running water?  The only exit seems to be to the west over a big dam
and back into the waters and sewer.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a sewer tunnel and are forced to actually wade through
the filth as the lip of this tunnel designed to allow people to walk here
without getting wet has crumbled away.  The western wall, unlike the
others, is made of huge grey stone that remind you of the town walls.
Water gushes in from the south and east and runs off to the north.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a sewer tunnel perched on a thin ledge on one wall.
Below you, water full of filth and dirt rushes by from east to west.  The
brick walls here are old, seemingly older than the rest of the sewer sys-
tem.  You can go east or west.

rooms.name: In a Sewer Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a little ledge on one brick wall of this sewer pipe.
Just below you, somewhat clean water runs from the east to west.  Through
pipes in the ceiling, great flows of filth plop down into the water here
to be embrased and swept away.  You can go west or east.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
Here, a large pipe running east-west is joined by a strange tunnel leading
north.  The tunnel to the north seems to be older than these sewers and its
floor is dry -- protected from water by a tall legde.  Water here runs from
east to west and appears to be somewhat clean still.  You may go north, east,
or west.

rooms.name: At a Junction in the Sewers
rooms.desc:
This is a large subterranean chamber far underneath the city of Alaozar.
Here, water rushes in through a big pipe to the north and flows away
through a tunnel leading west.  There is a raised tunnel leading away
to the east and since the water level is low it is still dry.  You may
go north, west, or east.

rooms.name: In the Overflow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel was surely designed to fill only if the water level of the
Chartuse River rose dangerously high to prevent damage to the sewer
system and flooding in the streets above.  The ground here is not bone
dry but rather moldy and slightly moist.  You suspect this place gets
its share of water every now and then when the rains are heavy.  You
can go west or south from this point.

rooms.name: In a Dry Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The walls here are made of the same re-inforced grey stone that was used
in the city walls and if your sense of direction is right you must be
either next to or underneath those massive walls right now.  This passage
leads off to the north and south.

rooms.name: In the Overflow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in some kind of overflow tunnel; the amount of water here is minimal
and it is raised several feet above the other sewer tunnels you have seen.
Clearly this tunnel was built to prevent flooding or damage that might be
caused in the event of a water level rise.  You can go north or east from
here.

rooms.name: In the Overflow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a tunnel designed to act as an overflow tunnel so
that if the water level in the sewers rose too high it would fill and
help alleviate the pressure and reduce the risk of flooding.  Right now,
there is very little water here and you can see the thick mold and slime
on the brick tunnel floor.  There is a huge brick pit here leading down
into the darkness.  Perhaps the engineers thought that this "well" would
take even more overflowing waters back to the earth or some underground
river?  You could probibly climb down.  The overflow tunnel here leads
both east and west.

rooms.name: In the Overflow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel was built as a way to prevent flooding in the rainy season
when the Chartuse River's level typically rises.  Right now there is
very little water on the ground here and you walk over strange green
mold which, like a carpet, covers the floor.  You can go east or west.

rooms.name: In the Overflow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is a mostly dry tunnel with a very large diameter and a lot of
mold growing on the walls and floor.  It leads both west and east.

rooms.name: In the Overflow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel changes direction here, sloping gradually downward to the west
while rising slightly to the north.  Since this entire area is a few feet
higher than the rest of the sewer network, you assume it was built to help
reduce pressure on the other tunnels when the water level rose in rainy
times.  You can go north or west.

rooms.name: In a Secret Passageway
rooms.desc:
This passage is clearly not part of the sewers.  Instead it was built
of the same stone used to make the city walls.  There are a few old
chairs here and what look like cases to store weapons.  Could this
way have once been guarded by soldiers from the city?  You can go
north or east.

rooms.name: Under the Walls!
rooms.desc:
This must be a secret passageway under the city walls!  The stones all
around you look just like the massive grey ones used to build the huge
walls protecting Alaozar.  You are far below the ground and suspect you
have found a secret tunnel out of the city.  Perhaps it was made so that
if ever beseiged, soldiers from Alaozar could smuggle in food or get out
to sneak attack the enemy.  You can go east or west.

rooms.name: In a Small Tunnel!
rooms.desc:
This tunnel is very small and difficult to move through.  It leads both
east and west into the darkness.

rooms.name: In a Small Tunnel!
rooms.desc:
This tunnel is very small and difficult to move through.  It leads both
east and west into the darkness.

rooms.name: In an underground river!
rooms.desc:
The current is not as strong here and you have a moment to rest and
breathe again.  While you can not find the strength to move back against
the water to the north, there is a little crack in the southern wall that
you just might be able to fit through...

rooms.name: In an underground river!
rooms.desc:
SPUTTER... you are being swept along by an underground river.  It is very
difficult to breathe here and there are huge rocks above your head that
you are trying to avoid being swept into.  The water here is freezing
cold and you are beginning to lose feeling in your limbs.  At some places
it is all you can do to find air pockets to breathe in!  Although this
stream seems to run north and south, the current here is way too strong
to fight by moving north.  You can only swim south, with the current.

rooms.name: In an underground river!
rooms.desc:
COUGH... you just swallowed some of this mineral-rich water and almost
choked when it went down the wrong passage.  You are struggling with
this very swift underground river and are being swept along to the
south by the current.  You can hardly breathe... ...and if that were
not enough you are worried about the low-hangling stalagtites and that
this damn river threatons to bach you into.  The water rushes north to
south and is impossible to move against.

rooms.name: In an underground river!
rooms.desc:
WHEW... you just missed a huge, low-hanging rock that, at the speed this
water is carrying you, would have dashed the life out of you.  The river
is very cold and you are beginning to lose feeling in your arms and legs.
To top it all off, you can hardly breathe!  The current is too strong to
fight by moving north and the only direction you can move is south, with
the flow.

rooms.name: In an underground river!
rooms.desc:
GASP... you are being swept along by an underground river.  It is very
difficult to breathe here and there are huge rocks above your head that
you are trying to avoid being swept into.  The current is carrying you
in a southward direction and it is impossible to fight.  The best move
might be just to take a deep breath, dive under, and hope for the best!

rooms.name: In an underground river!
rooms.desc:
SPLASH... you fall right into a raging subterranean stream and are
immediately caught in the strong current.  The rapids pull you
under and it is all you can do to breathe.  The mineral-rich water
is frigid and your limbs start to lose feeling.  You cannot reach the
wall to hang on and are being inexoirable swept southward!

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
The blue water of the ocean stretches to the horizon, making you lose
all sense of direction.  You marvel at the schools of salmon that streak
through the water as though they were birds coasting in the air.  Gusts
of sea air rush past you, spraying you with foam and bits of seamoss.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the restless surface of the sea.  You 
marvel at the schools of tuna that streak through the water as 
though they were birds sailing in the air.  In the distance, you 
can see the foam of a broken water eddies.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the ocean. 
 As you float above the surface, eddies crash into you, forcing 
you to pay attention to the water's motion.  In the distance, you 
can see the foam of a broken ocean waves.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
Here, porpoises and manatees sail, splashing happily into the 
water.  As you float above the surface, currents crash into you, 
forcing you to pay attention to the water's motion.  The lobster 
trap seems to be rotted with wind.

You are floating above the turbulent surface of the sea.  Your 
face sting as the foam whisps you, bringing tears of pain to your 
eyes.  On the water's surface, you note driftwood floating gently 
beside you.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
Here, dolphins and terns skim, splashing intentionally into the 
sea.  Your lips sting as the froth condenses you, bringing tears 
of pain to your eyes.  In the distance, you can see the foam of a 
broken water waves.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the water. 
 As you float above the surface, currents crash into you, forcing 
you to pay attention to the water's motion.  The lobster trap 
seems to be rotted with brine.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
The wide water spans across your sight, making you lose all 
sense of direction.  You marvel at the schools of salmon that 
streak through the ocean as though they were birds flying in the 
air.  On the ocean's surface, you note flotsam floating gently 
beside you.

rooms.desc:

ocean.  Your ears sting as the mist shimmers you, bringing tears 
of pain to your eyes.  The buoy seems to be rotted with age.

rooms.name: Immortal room 30100
rooms.desc:
You stand on a flowery grassland floating high above a forest.  Looking
over the edge of the piece of grassland, you can see a small clearing
in the forest canopy, and a small quaint garden.  Transparent stairs lead
into the clearing

rooms.name: Enterance to the Garden
rooms.desc:
You stand upon a small garden path. The path continues north.  Tall thorny
hedges flank you to the east and west.  To the south is the forest.  
To the north you see a picturesque garden.  Tall multi-colored flowers
lie just inside the garden.  Farther to the north you see tall trees.

You stand upon a small garden path.  The path continues north.  The exit
to the garden is to the south.  To the west, you see thick well-groomed
oak trees.  To the east there is a fence.  On the other side of the fence
you see a small flower garden with very tall multi-colore flowers within.

rooms.name: Garden Path

to the garden is a few steps to the south.  To the west you see a group 
of thick well-groomed oak trees.  To the east there is a fence.  On the
other side of the fence you see a small flower garden, with very tall
multi- colored flowers within.

south.  To the west, you see a cute little bird bath.  To the east there

with very tall multi-colored flowers within.

flowers.

A few steps to the west there is an exit to the garden.  To the south, you

well-groomed oak trees.  To the north you see a dense group of slim
pine trees.

rooms.name: Just Off the Garden Path

rooms.name: The Birdbath
rooms.desc:
You stand next to a small stone bird bath.  Little stone sculpted birds 
spray water into the polished stone basin.  The water looks cool and 
refreshing.  The garden path lies to the north and east.  To the south you
see oak trees.

rooms.name: Beneath the Oaks
rooms.desc:
You stand underneath the branches of a thick oak tree.  The coolness of the
shade is refreshing.  As you look at the tree, you notice the branches are
low enough that you could probably climb to the top of the tree.

rooms.name: Beneath the Oaks
rooms.desc:
You stand underneath the branches of a thick oak tree.  The coolness of the
branches and the distance from the garden trail fill you with a sense of
peacefulness.

rooms.name: Beneath the Oaks

east there is a garden trail.  To the north, you see a cute little bird
bath.

rooms.name: On the Branches of an Oak Tree
rooms.desc:
You stand on the branches of an oak tree.  From here you can easily climb
down to the garden floor.  Looking at another tree, you see a huge birds
nest.  To get to the other tree you can jump from your branch to the 
branch with the nest.  The branches look thick enough to support your
weight and the weight of the nest.

rooms.name: Huge Bird's Nest
rooms.desc:
You are standing next to a huge birds nest.  The size of the nest would
indicate that the bird that built it would be enormous.  A strong breeze
russels the leaves above.  Is that the giant bird.  Perhaps you shouldn't
be here if it is.

On the other side of the fence, you see a small flower garden with very

clump of trees.  You are blocked to the east by a tall thorny hedge.

rooms.name: A Black Birdbath
rooms.desc:
You stand next to a birdbath made of polished black stone.  A few steps to
the west and south there is a garden path.  T othe northeast you see a
small clump of trees.

rooms.name: Clump of trees
rooms.desc:
You stand underneath a small clump of trees.  You look up and cannot help
but see an enormous beehive and swarms of bees that hover around it.

rooms.name: Garden Path
rooms.desc:
You stand upon a garden path.  The path continues to the west.  The exit 
to the garden is a few steps to the east.  To the north you see a small
clump of trees.  To the south you see huge mushrooms.  One of the mushrooms
looks as though you can climb to the top of it.

rooms.name: Garden Path
rooms.desc:
You stand upon a small garden path.  The path continues to the east and
west.  To the west you see a pine tree forest.  To the north you see a
black birdbath.  To the south you see huge mushrooms.

rooms.name: Just Off the Garden Path
rooms.desc:
You stand in lush green grass.  A few steps to the west there is a garden
path.  You are blocked by huge mushrooms to the east and south.

rooms.name: A top a Huge Mushroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing upon a huge mushroom.  You can climb down to the ground
from here.  The mushroom next to you is close enough you can jump to it
from here.

rooms.name: Atop a Huge Mushroom
rooms.desc:
You are standing upon a huge mushroom.  The top surface of the mushroom
is scarred with claw marks and small indentions.  It looks as though this
mushroom gets a lot of traffic.

rooms.name: Pixie Lair
rooms.desc:
You stand within a great tree.  The tree has been hollowed to make room
for an elaborate throne room.  Great patterned rugs hang on the walls and
cover the floor.  At one end of the room, the is a golden throne.  Silk
material is draped over the back and armrests.

you see the blue waters of the sea.  To the west light seems to
almost be absorbed into the thick green forest canopy.  Farther south
the trail hints at turning more inland.  This gravel trail also continues

rooms.name: Lagoon Beachside
rooms.desc:
You are on a very well maintained gravel path.  The trees have been trimmed
back to allow full view of the beach to the south and the east of here.  
However dense vegetation allows almost no visibility into the interior
of this place.

rooms.name: Lagoon Beachside
rooms.desc:
You are on a well maintained gravel path.  In the distance to the south
you can see the docks.  You may follow the path to the east or west.  To
the east lies more clear water, in contrast to the deep green of the
lagoon. To the west lies more deep green lagoon water.

rooms.name: Mouth of Lagoon
rooms.desc:
You are at the point where the sea meets the lagoon.  The water to your
south is very apparently different than the lagoon water farther west.
You can continue on west and head farther into the lagoon, or head
north up the beach on a sturdy gravel trail.

rooms.name: Mushy Ground
rooms.desc:
The path this direction has become softer, and not nearly as well maintained.
Light green algae covers most of the rocks along the trail.  A less pleasant
smell hovers in the air.

rooms.name: Lagoon Dockside
rooms.desc:
Old wooden docks, but very well taken care of.  Not very surprising
considering how well maintained the lagoon is.  The water is green here
because of the abundance of vegetation, but there is no foul odor.
To either side of the docks there is a white sand beach, leading into a small
graval path.

rooms.name: Inside a giant pinball machine
rooms.desc:
Through the black swirling vortex around you, you manage to force your way into this giant pinball machine, an electricly swirling place of colors, light
and most of all, sound. The noise is deafening in here! Bells, whistles, and 
a thundrous roar pound down around you, all making for a nice nap.
Lightning strikes the plastic ground and fizzles into a lump of molten goo.

rooms.name: Like, dead and stuff.
rooms.desc: Lightning strikes no more than 2 inches from your head!

rooms.name: In the Ball Slot
rooms.desc:
Three Immensely huge silver spheres are lined up in the valley that creates
a slot for the spheres to rest. An enormous spring like device is to the south, ready to catapult the lead sphere at any moment, better get out of here before
that happens.

rooms.name: In the Vineyard
rooms.desc:
You stand amid acres of green vines, growing from bare moist soil.
The mist on the horizons refracts the sunlight into octagons and rainbows, 
and the green mountains surrounding this valley enhance the effect. Deeply
rooted vines with lush full grapes hanging on them have grown to almost over-
flow the dark wooden trellises.
